### S045 — `ACCP.Infrastructure/Data/AccpDbContext.cs`


الوظيفة: سياق EF وعلاقات الهوية والكيانات والفهارس

[العودة إلى شرح الملف](#file-045)


````csharp
using ACCP.Domain.Entities;
using ACCP.Domain.Enums;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Identity;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace ACCP.Infrastructure.Data;

public class AccpDbContext
    : IdentityDbContext<
        ApplicationUser,
        IdentityRole<Guid>,
        Guid>
{
    public AccpDbContext(
        DbContextOptions<AccpDbContext> options)
        : base(options)
    {
    }

    public DbSet<PlatformUser> UserProfiles =>
        Set<PlatformUser>();

    public DbSet<CyberCase> CyberCases =>
        Set<CyberCase>();

    public DbSet<AuditLog> AuditLogs =>
        Set<AuditLog>();

    public DbSet<Evidence> EvidenceItems =>
        Set<Evidence>();

    public DbSet<EvidenceRevision> EvidenceRevisions =>
        Set<EvidenceRevision>();

    public DbSet<CaseStatusHistory> CaseStatusHistories =>
        Set<CaseStatusHistory>();

    public DbSet<CaseNote> CaseNotes =>
        Set<CaseNote>();

    public DbSet<CaseMessage> CaseMessages =>
        Set<CaseMessage>();

    public DbSet<UserNotification> UserNotifications =>
        Set<UserNotification>();

    public DbSet<CaseStaffRequest> CaseStaffRequests =>
        Set<CaseStaffRequest>();

    public DbSet<CaseCollaborator> CaseCollaborators =>
        Set<CaseCollaborator>();

    public DbSet<IntakeConversation> IntakeConversations =>
        Set<IntakeConversation>();

    public DbSet<IntakeConversationMessage> IntakeConversationMessages =>
        Set<IntakeConversationMessage>();

    public DbSet<IntakeRiskAssessment> IntakeRiskAssessments =>
        Set<IntakeRiskAssessment>();

    protected override void OnModelCreating(
        ModelBuilder builder)
    {
        base.OnModelCreating(builder);

        builder.Entity<IntakeConversation>(entity =>
        {
            entity.ToTable("IntakeConversations");

            entity.Property(item => item.Title)
                .HasMaxLength(200)
                .IsRequired();

            entity.Property(item => item.RowVersion)
                .IsRowVersion();

            entity.HasIndex(item => new
            {
                item.ReporterId,
                item.UpdatedAtUtc
            });

            entity.HasIndex(item => new
            {
                item.Status,
                item.UpdatedAtUtc
            });

            entity.HasOne<ApplicationUser>()
                .WithMany()
                .HasForeignKey(item => item.ReporterId)
                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);

            entity.HasOne(item => item.CyberCase)
                .WithOne()
                .HasForeignKey<IntakeConversation>(
                    item => item.CyberCaseId)
                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);

            entity.HasIndex(item => item.CyberCaseId)
                .IsUnique()
                .HasFilter("[CyberCaseId] IS NOT NULL");
        });

        builder.Entity<IntakeConversationMessage>(entity =>
        {
            entity.ToTable("IntakeConversationMessages", table =>
            {
                table.HasCheckConstraint(
                    "CK_IntakeMessage_Sequence",
                    "[SequenceNumber] > 0");

                table.HasCheckConstraint(
                    "CK_IntakeMessage_Role",
                    "[Role] IN (0, 1, 2, 3)");

                table.HasCheckConstraint(
                    "CK_IntakeMessage_Operation",
                    "[OperationId] <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'");

                table.HasCheckConstraint(
                    "CK_IntakeMessage_Author",
                    "([Role] IN (0, 2) AND [AuthorUserId] IS NOT NULL) OR ([Role] IN (1, 3) AND [AuthorUserId] IS NULL)");
            });

            entity.Property(item => item.Content)
                .HasMaxLength(6000)
                .IsRequired();

            entity.HasOne(item => item.Conversation)
                .WithMany()
                .HasForeignKey(item => item.ConversationId)
                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);

            entity.HasOne<ApplicationUser>()
                .WithMany()
                .HasForeignKey(item => item.AuthorUserId)
                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);

            entity.HasIndex(item => new
            {
                item.ConversationId,
                item.SequenceNumber
            }).IsUnique();

            entity.HasIndex(item => new
            {
                item.ConversationId,
                item.OperationId,
                item.Role
            }).IsUnique();
        });

        // يمنع ربط التقييم برسالة من محادثة أخرى.
        builder.Entity<IntakeConversationMessage>()
            .HasAlternateKey(item => new
            {
                item.ConversationId,
                item.Id
            });

        builder.Entity<IntakeRiskAssessment>(entity =>
        {
            entity.ToTable("IntakeRiskAssessments", table =>
            {
                table.HasCheckConstraint(
                    "CK_IntakeRiskAssessment_Risk",
                    "[RiskPercentage] >= 0 AND [RiskPercentage] <= 100");

                table.HasCheckConstraint(
                    "CK_IntakeRiskAssessment_Sequence",
                    "[BasedOnSequenceNumber] > 0");

                table.HasCheckConstraint(
                    "CK_IntakeRiskAssessment_IncidentType",
                    "[IncidentType] IN ('Blackmail', 'Fraud', 'AccountHacking', 'IdentityTheft', 'Threat', 'Other')");
            });

            entity.Property(item => item.RiskPercentage)
                .HasPrecision(29, 26);

            entity.Property(item => item.Title)
                .HasMaxLength(200)
                .IsRequired();

            entity.Property(item => item.Summary)
                .HasMaxLength(4000)
                .IsRequired();

            entity.Property(item => item.IncidentType)
                .HasMaxLength(50)
                .IsRequired();

            entity.Property(item => item.RiskExplanation)
                .HasMaxLength(2000)
                .IsRequired();

            entity.HasOne<IntakeConversation>()
                .WithMany()
                .HasForeignKey(item => item.ConversationId)
                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);

            entity.HasOne<IntakeConversationMessage>()
                .WithMany()
                .HasForeignKey(item => new
                {
                    item.ConversationId,
                    item.AssistantMessageId
                })
                .HasPrincipalKey(item => new
                {
                    item.ConversationId,
                    item.Id
                })
                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);

            entity.HasIndex(item => item.AssistantMessageId)
                .IsUnique();

            entity.HasIndex(item => new
            {
                item.ConversationId,
                item.BasedOnSequenceNumber
            });
        });

        // يتيح التحقق من انتماء التقييم المعتمد للمحادثة نفسها.
        builder.Entity<IntakeRiskAssessment>()
            .HasAlternateKey(item => new
            {
                item.ConversationId,
                item.Id
            });

        // العلاقة اختيارية قبل تقديم البلاغ.
        // لا يمكن اعتماد تقييم تابع لمحادثة أخرى.
        builder.Entity<IntakeConversation>()
            .HasOne<IntakeRiskAssessment>()
            .WithMany()
            .HasForeignKey(item => new
            {
                item.Id,
                item.FormalReportAssessmentId
            })
            .HasPrincipalKey(item => new
            {
                item.ConversationId,
                item.Id
            })
            .IsRequired(false)
            .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);

        builder.Entity<CyberCase>()
            .Property(item => item.Path)
            .HasDefaultValue(CasePath.FormalReport)
            .HasSentinel(CasePath.FormalReport);

        builder.Entity<CyberCase>()
            .HasIndex(item => item.CaseNumber)
            .IsUnique();

        builder.Entity<CyberCase>()
            .HasIndex(item => new
            {
                item.ReporterId,
                item.CreatedAtUtc
            });

        builder.Entity<CyberCase>()
            .HasIndex(item => new
            {
                item.AssignedOfficerId,
                item.Status
            });

        builder.Entity<CaseMessage>()
            .HasIndex(item => new
            {
                item.CyberCaseId,
                item.CreatedAtUtc
            });

        builder.Entity<CaseNote>()
            .HasIndex(item => new
            {
                item.CyberCaseId,
                item.CreatedAtUtc
            });

        builder.Entity<AuditLog>()
            .HasIndex(item => new
            {
                item.CyberCaseId,
                item.CreatedAtUtc
            });

        builder.Entity<UserNotification>()
            .HasIndex(item => new
            {
                item.RecipientUserId,
                item.CreatedAtUtc
            });

        builder.Entity<UserNotification>()
            .HasIndex(item => new
            {
                item.RecipientUserId,
                item.IsRead
            });

        builder.Entity<EvidenceRevision>()
            .HasOne(revision => revision.Evidence)
            .WithMany(evidence => evidence.Revisions)
            .HasForeignKey(revision => revision.EvidenceId)
            .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);

        builder.Entity<EvidenceRevision>()
            .HasIndex(revision => new
            {
                revision.EvidenceId,
                revision.VersionNumber
            })
            .IsUnique();

        builder.Entity<CaseStaffRequest>()
            .HasOne(request => request.CyberCase)
            .WithMany(cyberCase => cyberCase.StaffRequests)
            .HasForeignKey(request => request.CyberCaseId)
            .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);

        builder.Entity<CaseStaffRequest>()
            .HasIndex(request => new
            {
                request.Status,
                request.CreatedAtUtc
            });

        builder.Entity<CaseStaffRequest>()
            .HasIndex(request => new
            {
                request.RequestedByOfficerId,
                request.Status
            });

        builder.Entity<CaseCollaborator>()
            .HasOne(collaborator => collaborator.CyberCase)
            .WithMany(cyberCase => cyberCase.Collaborators)
            .HasForeignKey(collaborator => collaborator.CyberCaseId)
            .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);

        builder.Entity<CaseCollaborator>()
            .HasIndex(collaborator => new
            {
                collaborator.CyberCaseId,
                collaborator.OfficerId
            })
            .IsUnique();

        builder.Entity<CaseCollaborator>()
            .HasIndex(collaborator => new
            {
                collaborator.OfficerId,
                collaborator.IsActive
            });

        builder.Entity<CaseCollaborator>()
            .HasIndex(collaborator => collaborator.SourceRequestId)
            .IsUnique();
    }
}
````

### S093 — `ACCP.Infrastructure/Identity/IdentitySeeder.cs`


الوظيفة: إنشاء الأدوار وتهيئة الحسابات من البيئة

[العودة إلى شرح الملف](#file-093)


````csharp
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;

namespace ACCP.Infrastructure.Identity;

public static class IdentitySeeder
{
    private const string AdminEmailVariable =
        "ACCP_ADMIN_EMAIL";

    private const string AdminPasswordVariable =
        "ACCP_ADMIN_PASSWORD";

    private const string OfficerResetEmailVariable =
        "ACCP_OFFICER_RESET_EMAIL";

    private const string OfficerResetPasswordVariable =
        "ACCP_OFFICER_RESET_PASSWORD";

    public static async Task SeedRolesAsync(
        IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
    {
        using IServiceScope scope =
            serviceProvider.CreateScope();

        RoleManager<IdentityRole<Guid>> roleManager =
            scope.ServiceProvider
                .GetRequiredService<
                    RoleManager<IdentityRole<Guid>>>();

        UserManager<ApplicationUser> userManager =
            scope.ServiceProvider
                .GetRequiredService<
                    UserManager<ApplicationUser>>();

        string[] roleNames =
        [
            IdentityRoles.User,
            IdentityRoles.Officer,
            IdentityRoles.Admin
        ];

        foreach (string roleName in roleNames)
        {
            bool roleExists =
                await roleManager.RoleExistsAsync(roleName);

            if (!roleExists)
            {
                IdentityResult roleResult =
                    await roleManager.CreateAsync(
                        new IdentityRole<Guid>(roleName));

                EnsureSucceeded(
                    roleResult,
                    $"تعذر إنشاء الدور {roleName}.");
            }
        }

        await SeedAdminFromEnvironmentAsync(
            userManager);

        await ResetOfficerPasswordFromEnvironmentAsync(
            userManager);
    }

    private static async Task SeedAdminFromEnvironmentAsync(
        UserManager<ApplicationUser> userManager)
    {
        string? adminEmail =
            Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable(
                AdminEmailVariable)
            ?.Trim();

        string? adminPassword =
            Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable(
                AdminPasswordVariable);

        bool emailProvided =
            !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(adminEmail);

        bool passwordProvided =
            !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(adminPassword);

        // إذا لم تُمرر بيانات المدير، يستمر تشغيل المشروع طبيعيًا.
        if (!emailProvided && !passwordProvided)
        {
            return;
        }

        if (!emailProvided || !passwordProvided)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                "يجب تحديد ACCP_ADMIN_EMAIL وACCP_ADMIN_PASSWORD معًا.");
        }

        ApplicationUser? adminUser =
            await userManager.FindByEmailAsync(
                adminEmail!);

        if (adminUser is null)
        {
            adminUser = new ApplicationUser
            {
                Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
                UserName = adminEmail,
                Email = adminEmail,
                FullName = "مدير النظام",
                IsActive = true,
                EmailConfirmed = true,
                CreatedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow
            };

            IdentityResult createResult =
                await userManager.CreateAsync(
                    adminUser,
                    adminPassword!);

            EnsureSucceeded(
                createResult,
                "تعذر إنشاء حساب المدير.");
        }

        if (!adminUser.IsActive)
        {
            adminUser.IsActive = true;

            IdentityResult updateResult =
                await userManager.UpdateAsync(
                    adminUser);

            EnsureSucceeded(
                updateResult,
                "تعذر تفعيل حساب المدير.");
        }

        bool isAdmin =
            await userManager.IsInRoleAsync(
                adminUser,
                IdentityRoles.Admin);

        if (!isAdmin)
        {
            IdentityResult addToRoleResult =
                await userManager.AddToRoleAsync(
                    adminUser,
                    IdentityRoles.Admin);

            EnsureSucceeded(
                addToRoleResult,
                "تعذر منح الحساب صلاحية المدير.");
        }
    }

    private static async Task ResetOfficerPasswordFromEnvironmentAsync(
        UserManager<ApplicationUser> userManager)
    {
        string? officerEmail =
            Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable(
                OfficerResetEmailVariable)
            ?.Trim();

        string? newPassword =
            Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable(
                OfficerResetPasswordVariable);

        bool emailProvided =
            !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(officerEmail);

        bool passwordProvided =
            !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(newPassword);

        // بدون المتغيرين لا يتم تنفيذ أي تغيير على حسابات الموظفين.
        if (!emailProvided && !passwordProvided)
        {
            return;
        }

        if (!emailProvided || !passwordProvided)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                "يجب تحديد ACCP_OFFICER_RESET_EMAIL و" +
                "ACCP_OFFICER_RESET_PASSWORD معًا.");
        }

        ApplicationUser? officer =
            await userManager.FindByEmailAsync(
                officerEmail!);

        if (officer is null)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                $"لم يتم العثور على حساب الموظف {officerEmail}.");
        }

        bool isOfficer =
            await userManager.IsInRoleAsync(
                officer,
                IdentityRoles.Officer);

        if (!isOfficer)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                $"الحساب {officerEmail} لا يحمل صلاحية موظف.");
        }

        if (!officer.IsActive)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                $"حساب الموظف {officerEmail} غير فعال.");
        }

        string resetToken =
            await userManager.GeneratePasswordResetTokenAsync(
                officer);

        IdentityResult resetResult =
            await userManager.ResetPasswordAsync(
                officer,
                resetToken,
                newPassword!);

        EnsureSucceeded(
            resetResult,
            $"تعذر إعادة تعيين كلمة مرور الموظف {officerEmail}.");
    }

    private static void EnsureSucceeded(
        IdentityResult result,
        string message)
    {
        if (result.Succeeded)
        {
            return;
        }

        string errors = string.Join(
            " | ",
            result.Errors.Select(error =>
                error.Description));

        throw new InvalidOperationException(
            $"{message} {errors}");
    }
}
````

### S094 — `ACCP.Infrastructure/Services/AuditService.cs`


الوظيفة: كتابة أحداث التدقيق واستعلامها

[العودة إلى شرح الملف](#file-094)


````csharp
using ACCP.Application.Auditing;
using ACCP.Domain.Entities;
using ACCP.Domain.Enums;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Data;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace ACCP.Infrastructure.Services;

public sealed class AuditService : IAuditService
{
    private const int MaximumResults = 1000;
    private const int MaximumSearchTermLength = 200;

    private readonly AccpDbContext _dbContext;

    public AuditService(AccpDbContext dbContext)
    {
        _dbContext = dbContext;
    }

    public async Task<AuditLog> WriteAsync(
        AuditLogRequest request,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(request);

        string entityType = CleanRequired(
            request.EntityType,
            100,
            nameof(request.EntityType));

        string description = CleanRequired(
            request.Description,
            1000,
            nameof(request.Description));

        string actorRole =
            CleanOptional(request.ActorRole, 50)
            ?? "SYSTEM";

        Guid? actorUserId =
            request.ActorUserId is { } userId &&
            userId != Guid.Empty
                ? userId
                : null;

        Guid? cyberCaseId =
            request.CyberCaseId is { } caseId &&
            caseId != Guid.Empty
                ? caseId
                : null;

        Guid? entityId =
            request.EntityId is { } targetId &&
            targetId != Guid.Empty
                ? targetId
                : null;

        var auditLog = new AuditLog
        {
            Action = request.Action,
            ActorUserId = actorUserId,
            ActorEmail = CleanOptional(
                request.ActorEmail,
                256),
            ActorRole = actorRole,
            CyberCaseId = cyberCaseId,
            EntityType = entityType,
            EntityId = entityId,
            Description = description,
            IsSuccessful = request.IsSuccessful,
            FailureReason = CleanOptional(
                request.FailureReason,
                500),
            IpAddress = CleanOptional(
                request.IpAddress,
                45),
            UserAgent = CleanOptional(
                request.UserAgent,
                500),
            CorrelationId = CleanOptional(
                request.CorrelationId,
                100),
            CreatedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow
        };

        _dbContext.AuditLogs.Add(auditLog);

        await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync(
            cancellationToken);

        return auditLog;
    }

    public async Task<IReadOnlyList<AuditLog>>
        GetLatestAsync(
            int take = 200,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        int safeTake = NormalizeTake(take);

        return await _dbContext.AuditLogs
            .AsNoTracking()
            .OrderByDescending(auditLog =>
                auditLog.CreatedAtUtc)
            .Take(safeTake)
            .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);
    }

    public async Task<IReadOnlyList<AuditLog>>
        GetForCaseAsync(
            Guid cyberCaseId,
            int take = 200,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        if (cyberCaseId == Guid.Empty)
        {
            return [];
        }

        int safeTake = NormalizeTake(take);

        return await _dbContext.AuditLogs
            .AsNoTracking()
            .Where(auditLog =>
                auditLog.CyberCaseId == cyberCaseId)
            .OrderByDescending(auditLog =>
                auditLog.CreatedAtUtc)
            .Take(safeTake)
            .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);
    }

    public async Task<IReadOnlyList<AuditLog>> SearchAsync(
        string? searchTerm = null,
        AuditAction? action = null,
        bool? isSuccessful = null,
        int take = 500,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        int safeTake = NormalizeTake(take);

        IQueryable<AuditLog> query =
            _dbContext.AuditLogs
                .AsNoTracking();

        if (action.HasValue)
        {
            query = query.Where(auditLog =>
                auditLog.Action == action.Value);
        }

        if (isSuccessful.HasValue)
        {
            query = query.Where(auditLog =>
                auditLog.IsSuccessful ==
                    isSuccessful.Value);
        }

        string? cleanSearchTerm =
            CleanOptional(
                searchTerm,
                MaximumSearchTermLength);

        if (cleanSearchTerm is not null)
        {
            IQueryable<Guid> matchingCaseIds =
                _dbContext.CyberCases
                    .AsNoTracking()
                    .Where(cyberCase =>
                        cyberCase.CaseNumber.Contains(
                            cleanSearchTerm))
                    .Select(cyberCase => cyberCase.Id);

            if (Guid.TryParse(
                    cleanSearchTerm,
                    out Guid searchedId))
            {
                query = query.Where(auditLog =>
                    auditLog.ActorUserId == searchedId ||
                    auditLog.CyberCaseId == searchedId ||
                    auditLog.EntityId == searchedId ||
                    (auditLog.ActorEmail != null &&
                     auditLog.ActorEmail.Contains(
                         cleanSearchTerm)) ||
                    auditLog.ActorRole.Contains(
                        cleanSearchTerm) ||
                    auditLog.EntityType.Contains(
                        cleanSearchTerm) ||
                    auditLog.Description.Contains(
                        cleanSearchTerm) ||
                    (auditLog.FailureReason != null &&
                     auditLog.FailureReason.Contains(
                         cleanSearchTerm)) ||
                    (auditLog.CyberCaseId.HasValue &&
                     matchingCaseIds.Contains(
                         auditLog.CyberCaseId.Value)));
            }
            else
            {
                query = query.Where(auditLog =>
                    (auditLog.ActorEmail != null &&
                     auditLog.ActorEmail.Contains(
                         cleanSearchTerm)) ||
                    auditLog.ActorRole.Contains(
                        cleanSearchTerm) ||
                    auditLog.EntityType.Contains(
                        cleanSearchTerm) ||
                    auditLog.Description.Contains(
                        cleanSearchTerm) ||
                    (auditLog.FailureReason != null &&
                     auditLog.FailureReason.Contains(
                         cleanSearchTerm)) ||
                    (auditLog.CyberCaseId.HasValue &&
                     matchingCaseIds.Contains(
                         auditLog.CyberCaseId.Value)));
            }
        }

        return await query
            .OrderByDescending(auditLog =>
                auditLog.CreatedAtUtc)
            .Take(safeTake)
            .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);
    }

    private static int NormalizeTake(int take)
    {
        return Math.Clamp(
            take,
            1,
            MaximumResults);
    }

    private static string CleanRequired(
        string? value,
        int maximumLength,
        string parameterName)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))
        {
            throw new ArgumentException(
                "القيمة المطلوبة فارغة.",
                parameterName);
        }

        string cleanValue = value.Trim();

        return cleanValue.Length <= maximumLength
            ? cleanValue
            : cleanValue[..maximumLength];
    }

    private static string? CleanOptional(
        string? value,
        int maximumLength)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))
        {
            return null;
        }

        string cleanValue = value.Trim();

        return cleanValue.Length <= maximumLength
            ? cleanValue
            : cleanValue[..maximumLength];
    }
}
````

[العودة إلى شرح الملف](#file-095)


````csharp
using System.Data;
using ACCP.Application.Auditing;
using ACCP.Application.Cases;
using ACCP.Application.Notifications;
using ACCP.Domain.Entities;
using ACCP.Domain.Enums;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Data;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Identity;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace ACCP.Infrastructure.Services;

// Called through the Web authorization boundary with a server-derived actor ID.
// A fresh context and the same-context audit/notification writers are required.
public sealed class CaseReopeningService(
    AccpDbContext db,
    IAuditService audit,
    INotificationService notifications)
{
    public async Task<bool> ReopenAsync(
        CaseReopeningSnapshot expected,
        Guid targetOfficerId,
        Guid adminId,
        string reason,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(expected);
        string cleanReason = reason?.Trim() ?? string.Empty;
        if (expected.CaseId == Guid.Empty || adminId == Guid.Empty ||
            targetOfficerId == Guid.Empty || expected.HistoryCount < 0 || cleanReason.Length is < 10 or > 1000 ||
            expected.Status is not (CaseStatus.Resolved or CaseStatus.Closed))
            return false;

        await using var transaction = await db.Database.BeginTransactionAsync(
            IsolationLevel.Serializable, cancellationToken);
        try
        {
            var now = DateTime.UtcNow;
            var admin = await db.Users.AsNoTracking().SingleOrDefaultAsync(
                user => user.Id == adminId, cancellationToken);
            if (!Usable(admin) || !await HasRoleAsync(adminId, IdentityRoles.Admin))
                return false;
            var officer = await db.Users.AsNoTracking().SingleOrDefaultAsync(
                user => user.Id == targetOfficerId, cancellationToken);
            if (!Usable(officer) ||
                !await HasRoleAsync(targetOfficerId, IdentityRoles.Officer) ||
                await HasRoleAsync(targetOfficerId, IdentityRoles.Admin))
                return false;

            bool ownerChanged = expected.OfficerId != targetOfficerId;
            DateTime? assignedAt = ownerChanged ? now : expected.AssignedAtUtc ?? now;
            int affected = await db.CyberCases
                .Where(item => item.Id == expected.CaseId &&
                    item.Path == CasePath.FormalReport &&
                    item.Status == expected.Status &&
                    item.AssignedOfficerId == expected.OfficerId &&
                    item.AssignedAtUtc == expected.AssignedAtUtc &&
                    db.CaseStatusHistories.Count(history => history.CyberCaseId == item.Id) == expected.HistoryCount)
                .ExecuteUpdateAsync(setters => setters
                    .SetProperty(item => item.Status, CaseStatus.InProgress)
                    .SetProperty(item => item.AssignedOfficerId, (Guid?)targetOfficerId)
                    .SetProperty(item => item.AssignedOfficerEmail, officer!.Email)
                    .SetProperty(item => item.AssignedAtUtc, assignedAt), cancellationToken);
            if (affected != 1) return false;

            var info = await db.CyberCases.AsNoTracking()
                .Where(item => item.Id == expected.CaseId)
                .Select(item => new { item.CaseNumber, item.ReporterId })
                .SingleAsync(cancellationToken);
            db.CaseStatusHistories.Add(new CaseStatusHistory
            {
                CyberCaseId = expected.CaseId,
                OldStatus = expected.Status,
                NewStatus = CaseStatus.InProgress,
                ChangedByUserId = adminId,
                ChangedByEmail = admin!.Email!,
                ChangedAtUtc = now,
                Reason = cleanReason
            });

            // A previous owner must not retain a duplicate participation grant.
            // Other collaborators retain their existing participation rights.
            var revoked = await db.CaseCollaborators
                .Where(item => item.CyberCaseId == expected.CaseId && item.IsActive &&
                    (item.OfficerId == targetOfficerId ||
                        (ownerChanged && item.OfficerId == expected.OfficerId)))
                .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);
            foreach (var entry in revoked)
            {
                entry.IsActive = false;
                entry.RemovedByAdminId = adminId;
                entry.RemovedByAdminEmail = admin!.Email;
                entry.RemovedAtUtc = now;
                entry.RemovalReason = entry.OfficerId == targetOfficerId
                    ? "أصبح الموظف مسؤولًا عن القضية عند إعادة فتحها."
                    : "انتهت مسؤولية الموظف السابق عند إعادة فتح القضية.";
            }

            var pending = await db.CaseStaffRequests
                .Where(item => item.CyberCaseId == expected.CaseId &&
                    item.Status == CaseStaffRequestStatus.Pending)
                .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);
            foreach (var request in pending)
            {
                request.Status = CaseStaffRequestStatus.Cancelled;
                request.ReviewedByAdminId = adminId;
                request.ReviewedByAdminEmail = admin!.Email;
                request.ReviewedAtUtc = now;
                request.DecisionNote = "أُلغي الطلب السابق عند إعادة فتح القضية إداريًا؛ يمكن تقديم طلب جديد.";
            }
            await db.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

            await WriteAuditAsync(AuditAction.CaseStatusChanged, nameof(CyberCase),
                expected.CaseId,
                $"أعاد المدير فتح القضية من {expected.Status} إلى InProgress. الموظف المسؤول: {targetOfficerId:D}. السبب محفوظ في سجل الحالة.");
            if (ownerChanged)
                await WriteAuditAsync(AuditAction.CaseAssignmentTransferred, nameof(CyberCase),
                    expected.CaseId, $"تغيّر المسؤول عند إعادة الفتح من {expected.OfficerId} إلى {targetOfficerId:D}.");
            foreach (var entry in revoked)
                await WriteAuditAsync(AuditAction.CaseCollaboratorRemoved, nameof(CaseCollaborator),
                    entry.Id, entry.RemovalReason!);
            foreach (var request in pending)
            {
                await WriteAuditAsync(AuditAction.CaseStaffRequestCancelled, nameof(CaseStaffRequest),
                    request.Id, "أُلغي طلب الموظفين السابق عند إعادة فتح القضية إداريًا.");
                if (await db.Users.AnyAsync(user => user.Id == request.RequestedByOfficerId, cancellationToken))
                    await notifications.CreateAsync(request.RequestedByOfficerId, null,
                        NotificationType.CaseStaffRequestCancelled, "أُلغي طلب الموظفين السابق",
                        $"أُلغي طلبك السابق للقضية {info.CaseNumber} عند إعادة فتحها إداريًا.");
            }
            await notifications.CreateAsync(targetOfficerId, expected.CaseId,
                NotificationType.CaseStatusChanged, "أُعيد فتح قضية لمتابعتها",
                $"أصبحت القضية {info.CaseNumber} قيد المعالجة وأنت الموظف المسؤول عنها.");
            if (info.ReporterId is { } reporter && reporter != Guid.Empty &&
                await db.Users.AnyAsync(user => user.Id == reporter, cancellationToken))
                await notifications.CreateAsync(reporter, expected.CaseId,
                    NotificationType.CaseStatusChanged, "أُعيد فتح بلاغك",
                    $"أُعيد فتح البلاغ {info.CaseNumber} وأصبح قيد المعالجة.");
            if (ownerChanged && expected.OfficerId is { } previous &&
                await db.Users.AnyAsync(user => user.Id == previous, cancellationToken))
                await notifications.CreateAsync(previous, null,
                    NotificationType.CaseAssignmentTransferred, "تغيّرت مسؤولية قضية",
                    $"أُعيد فتح القضية {info.CaseNumber} وأُسندت إلى موظف آخر.");

            await transaction.CommitAsync(cancellationToken);
            return true;

            Task<bool> HasRoleAsync(Guid userId, string roleName) => db.UserRoles
                .Where(member => member.UserId == userId)
                .Join(db.Roles, member => member.RoleId, role => role.Id, (_, role) => role.Name)
                .AnyAsync(name => name == roleName, cancellationToken);

            Task<AuditLog> WriteAuditAsync(AuditAction action, string entityType,
                Guid entityId, string description) => audit.WriteAsync(new AuditLogRequest
                {
                    Action = action, ActorUserId = adminId, ActorEmail = admin!.Email!,
                    ActorRole = IdentityRoles.Admin, CyberCaseId = expected.CaseId,
                    EntityType = entityType, EntityId = entityId,
                    Description = description, IsSuccessful = true
                }, cancellationToken);
        }
        catch
        {
            await transaction.RollbackAsync(CancellationToken.None);
            throw;
        }
    }

    private static bool Usable(ApplicationUser? user) =>
        user is { IsActive: true } && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(user.Email) &&
        (!user.LockoutEnabled || user.LockoutEnd is null ||
            user.LockoutEnd <= DateTimeOffset.UtcNow);
}
````

````csharp
using ACCP.Application.Auditing;
using ACCP.Application.Cases;
using ACCP.Application.Notifications;
using ACCP.Domain.Entities;
using ACCP.Domain.Enums;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Data;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
namespace ACCP.Infrastructure.Services;
public class CaseService : ICaseService
{
    private readonly AccpDbContext _dbContext;
    private readonly IAuditService _auditService;
    private readonly INotificationService _notificationService;
    public CaseService(
        AccpDbContext dbContext,
        IAuditService auditService,
        INotificationService notificationService)
    {
        _dbContext = dbContext;
        _auditService = auditService;
        _notificationService = notificationService;
    }
    public async Task<CyberCase> CreateForReporterAsync(
        CyberCase cyberCase,
        Guid reporterId)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(cyberCase);
        if (reporterId == Guid.Empty)
        {
            throw new ArgumentException(
                "معرّف المستخدم غير صالح.",
                nameof(reporterId));
        }
        if (!Enum.IsDefined(cyberCase.Path))
        {
            throw new ArgumentException(
                "مسار القضية غير صالح.",
                nameof(cyberCase));
        }
        return await ExecuteCaseTransactionAsync<CyberCase>(async () =>
        {
            cyberCase.ReporterId = reporterId;
            cyberCase.CreatedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(cyberCase.CaseNumber))
            {
                cyberCase.CaseNumber =
                    $"ACCP-{cyberCase.CreatedAtUtc:yyyyMMdd}-{Guid.NewGuid():N}";
            }
            _dbContext.CyberCases.Add(cyberCase);
            await _auditService.WriteAsync(
                new AuditLogRequest
                {
                    Action = AuditAction.CaseCreated,
                    ActorUserId = reporterId,
                    ActorRole = "USER",
                    CyberCaseId = cyberCase.Id,
                    EntityType = nameof(CyberCase),
                    EntityId = cyberCase.Id,
                    Description =
                        $"تم إنشاء القضية رقم {cyberCase.CaseNumber}.",
                    IsSuccessful = true
                });
            return cyberCase;
        });
    }
    public async Task<List<CyberCase>> GetAllForReporterAsync(
        Guid reporterId)
    {
        if (reporterId == Guid.Empty)
        {
            return [];
        }
        return await _dbContext.CyberCases
            .AsNoTracking()
            .Where(cyberCase =>
                cyberCase.ReporterId == reporterId)
            .OrderByDescending(cyberCase =>
                cyberCase.CreatedAtUtc)
            .ToListAsync();
    }
    public async Task<CyberCase?> GetByIdForReporterAsync(
        Guid id,
        Guid reporterId)
    {
        if (id == Guid.Empty ||
            reporterId == Guid.Empty)
        {
            return null;
        }
        return await _dbContext.CyberCases
            .AsNoTracking()
            .Include(cyberCase =>
    cyberCase.EvidenceItems)
.ThenInclude(evidence =>
    evidence.Revisions
        .OrderBy(revision =>
            revision.VersionNumber))
            .Include(cyberCase =>
                cyberCase.Messages
                    .OrderBy(message =>
                        message.CreatedAtUtc))
            .AsSplitQuery()
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cyberCase =>
                cyberCase.Id == id &&
                cyberCase.ReporterId == reporterId);
    }
    public async Task<List<CyberCase>> GetAllForOfficerAsync()
    {
        return await _dbContext.CyberCases
            .AsNoTracking()
            .Where(cyberCase =>
                cyberCase.Path == CasePath.FormalReport)
            .Include(cyberCase =>
                cyberCase.EvidenceItems)
            .Include(cyberCase =>
                cyberCase.Collaborators.Where(collaborator =>
                    collaborator.IsActive))
            .AsSplitQuery()
            .OrderByDescending(cyberCase =>
                cyberCase.CreatedAtUtc)
            .ToListAsync();
    }
  public async Task<CyberCase?> GetByIdForOfficerAsync(
    Guid id,
    Guid officerId)
{
    if (id == Guid.Empty ||
        officerId == Guid.Empty)
    {
        return null;
    }
    return await BuildOfficerCaseQuery(
            includeRestrictedEvidence: false)
        .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cyberCase =>
            cyberCase.Id == id &&
            (!cyberCase.AssignedOfficerId.HasValue ||
             cyberCase.AssignedOfficerId == officerId ||
             cyberCase.Collaborators.Any(collaborator =>
                 collaborator.OfficerId == officerId &&
                 collaborator.IsActive)));
}
public async Task<CyberCase?> GetByIdForAdminAsync(
    Guid id)
{
    if (id == Guid.Empty)
    {
        return null;
    }
    return await BuildOfficerCaseQuery(
            includeRestrictedEvidence: true)
        .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cyberCase =>
            cyberCase.Id == id);
}
private IQueryable<CyberCase> BuildOfficerCaseQuery(
    bool includeRestrictedEvidence)
{
    IQueryable<CyberCase> query =
        _dbContext.CyberCases
            .AsNoTracking()
            .Where(cyberCase =>
                cyberCase.Path == CasePath.FormalReport);
if (includeRestrictedEvidence)
{
    query = query
        .Include(cyberCase =>
            cyberCase.EvidenceItems)
        .ThenInclude(evidence =>
            evidence.Revisions
                .OrderBy(revision =>
                    revision.VersionNumber));
}
else
{
    query = query
        .Include(cyberCase =>
            cyberCase.EvidenceItems.Where(evidence =>
                !evidence.IsRestricted ||
                evidence.IsDisclosedToOfficer))
        .ThenInclude(evidence =>
            evidence.Revisions
                .OrderBy(revision =>
                    revision.VersionNumber));
}
    return query
        .Include(cyberCase =>
            cyberCase.StatusHistory
                .OrderByDescending(history =>
                    history.ChangedAtUtc))
        .Include(cyberCase =>
            cyberCase.InternalNotes
                .OrderByDescending(note =>
                    note.CreatedAtUtc))
        .Include(cyberCase =>
            cyberCase.Messages
                .OrderBy(message =>
                    message.CreatedAtUtc))
        .Include(cyberCase =>
            cyberCase.Collaborators.Where(collaborator =>
                collaborator.IsActive))
        .AsSplitQuery();
}
    public async Task<bool> UpdateStatusForOfficerAsync(
        Guid id,
        CaseStatus newStatus,
        Guid officerId,
        string officerEmail,
        string? reason = null)
    {
        if (id == Guid.Empty ||
            officerId == Guid.Empty ||
            string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(officerEmail) ||
            !Enum.IsDefined(newStatus))
        {
            return false;
        }
        return await ExecuteCaseTransactionAsync<bool>(async () =>
        {
            CyberCase? cyberCase =
                await _dbContext.CyberCases
                    .AsNoTracking()
                    .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cyberCase =>
                        cyberCase.Id == id &&
                        cyberCase.Path == CasePath.FormalReport);
            if (cyberCase is null)
            {
                return false;
            }
            if (cyberCase.AssignedOfficerId != officerId)
            {
                return false;
            }
            CaseStatus oldStatus = cyberCase.Status;
            if (oldStatus == newStatus)
            {
                RefreshTrackedCaseStatus(id, newStatus);
                return true;
            }
            if (!ACCP.Domain.Policies.CaseStatusWorkflow.CanTransition(
                    oldStatus, newStatus))
            {
                return false;
            }

            string? cleanReason = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(reason)
                ? null : reason.Trim();
            bool requiresReason = newStatus is CaseStatus.Resolved or CaseStatus.Closed;
            if ((requiresReason && cleanReason is null) ||
                (cleanReason is not null &&
                    (cleanReason.Length < 10 || cleanReason.Length > 1000)))
            {
                return false;
            }

            // Change the status only if ownership and the status read above
            // still match. A competing update must not produce stale history.
            int affectedRows = await _dbContext.CyberCases
                .Where(item => item.Id == id &&
                    item.Path == CasePath.FormalReport &&
                    item.AssignedOfficerId == officerId &&
                    item.Status == oldStatus)
                .ExecuteUpdateAsync(setters => setters
                    .SetProperty(item => item.Status, newStatus));
            if (affectedRows != 1)
            {
                return false;
            }

            RefreshTrackedCaseStatus(id, newStatus);
            var history = new CaseStatusHistory
            {
                CyberCaseId = cyberCase.Id,
                OldStatus = oldStatus,
                NewStatus = newStatus,
                ChangedByUserId = officerId,
                ChangedByEmail = officerEmail.Trim(),
                Reason = cleanReason,
                ChangedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow
            };
            _dbContext.CaseStatusHistories.Add(history);
            await _auditService.WriteAsync(
                new AuditLogRequest
                {
                    Action = AuditAction.CaseStatusChanged,
                    ActorUserId = officerId,
                    ActorEmail = officerEmail.Trim(),
                    ActorRole = "OFFICER",
                    CyberCaseId = cyberCase.Id,
                    EntityType = nameof(CyberCase),
                    EntityId = cyberCase.Id,
                    Description =
                        $"تم تغيير حالة القضية من {oldStatus} إلى {newStatus}.",
                    IsSuccessful = true
                });
            if (cyberCase.ReporterId.HasValue)
            {
                await _notificationService.CreateAsync(
                    cyberCase.ReporterId.Value,
                    cyberCase.Id,
                    NotificationType.CaseStatusChanged,
                    "تحديث على القضية",
                    "تم تحديث حالة إحدى قضاياك. افتح القضية للاطلاع على الحالة الجديدة.");
            }
            return true;
        });
    }
    // ExecuteUpdate bypasses tracking. Keep the status current so a later
    // SaveChanges cannot write a stale status back into the case.
    private void RefreshTrackedCaseStatus(Guid id, CaseStatus status)
    {
        var entry = _dbContext.ChangeTracker.Entries<CyberCase>()
            .FirstOrDefault(item => item.Entity.Id == id);
        if (entry is null)
        {
            return;
        }
        var statusProperty = entry.Property(item => item.Status);
        statusProperty.CurrentValue = status;
        statusProperty.OriginalValue = status;
        statusProperty.IsModified = false;
    }

    public async Task<bool> AssignToOfficerAsync(
        Guid id,
        Guid officerId,
        string officerEmail)
    {
        if (id == Guid.Empty ||
            officerId == Guid.Empty ||
            string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(officerEmail) ||
            officerEmail.Trim().Length > 256)
        {
            return false;
        }

        await using var transaction =
            await _dbContext.Database.BeginTransactionAsync();

        try
        {
            CyberCase? cyberCase =
                await _dbContext.CyberCases
                    .AsNoTracking()
                    .FirstOrDefaultAsync(item =>
                        item.Id == id &&
                        item.Path == CasePath.FormalReport);

            if (cyberCase is null)
            {
                return false;
            }

            // Repeating a completed claim must not duplicate its audit or notification.
            if (cyberCase.AssignedOfficerId.HasValue)
            {
                return cyberCase.AssignedOfficerId == officerId;
            }

            string cleanOfficerEmail = officerEmail.Trim();
            DateTime assignedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;

            // This conditional UPDATE is the claim. Only one officer can change
            // AssignedOfficerId from NULL; another claimant gets zero affected rows.
            int affectedRows = await _dbContext.CyberCases
                .Where(item => item.Id == id &&
                    item.Path == CasePath.FormalReport &&
                    !item.AssignedOfficerId.HasValue)
                .ExecuteUpdateAsync(setters => setters
                    .SetProperty(item => item.AssignedOfficerId, (Guid?)officerId)
                    .SetProperty(item => item.AssignedOfficerEmail, cleanOfficerEmail)
                    .SetProperty(item => item.AssignedAtUtc, (DateTime?)assignedAtUtc)
                    .SetProperty(item => item.Status, item =>
                        item.Status == CaseStatus.New || item.Status == CaseStatus.UnderReview
                            ? CaseStatus.Assigned
                            : item.Status));

            if (affectedRows != 1)
            {
                return false;
            }

            CaseStatus oldStatus = cyberCase.Status;
            if (oldStatus == CaseStatus.New || oldStatus == CaseStatus.UnderReview)
            {
                _dbContext.CaseStatusHistories.Add(new CaseStatusHistory
                {
                    CyberCaseId = id,
                    OldStatus = oldStatus,
                    NewStatus = CaseStatus.Assigned,
                    ChangedByUserId = officerId,
                    ChangedByEmail = cleanOfficerEmail,
                    ChangedAtUtc = assignedAtUtc
                });
            }

            // Both services use the same scoped DbContext, so their saves
            // remain inside this transaction until all three operations succeed.
            await _auditService.WriteAsync(new AuditLogRequest
            {
                Action = AuditAction.CaseAssigned,
                ActorUserId = officerId,
                ActorEmail = cleanOfficerEmail,
                ActorRole = "OFFICER",
                CyberCaseId = id,
                EntityType = nameof(CyberCase),
                EntityId = id,
                Description = "تم استلام القضية وتعيين الموظف المسؤول عنها.",
                IsSuccessful = true
            });

            if (cyberCase.ReporterId.HasValue)
            {
                await _notificationService.CreateAsync(
                    cyberCase.ReporterId.Value,
                    id,
                    NotificationType.CaseAssigned,
                    "تم استلام القضية",
                    "تم تعيين موظف مختص لمتابعة إحدى قضاياك.");
            }

            await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync();
            await transaction.CommitAsync();

            // ExecuteUpdate bypasses tracking. Refresh any already-tracked case
            // to prevent a later operation from using its old assignment.
            var trackedCase = _dbContext.ChangeTracker.Entries<CyberCase>()
                .FirstOrDefault(entry => entry.Entity.Id == id);
            if (trackedCase is not null)
            {
                trackedCase.Entity.AssignedOfficerId = officerId;
                trackedCase.Entity.AssignedOfficerEmail = cleanOfficerEmail;
                trackedCase.Entity.AssignedAtUtc = assignedAtUtc;
                if (oldStatus == CaseStatus.New || oldStatus == CaseStatus.UnderReview)
                {
                    trackedCase.Entity.Status = CaseStatus.Assigned;
                }
                trackedCase.OriginalValues.SetValues(trackedCase.CurrentValues);
            }

            return true;
        }
        catch
        {
            await transaction.RollbackAsync();
            // A Blazor circuit may reuse this context after failure. Remove
            // rolled-back entries so a later save cannot resurrect them.
            _dbContext.ChangeTracker.Clear();
            throw;
        }
    }
    public async Task<CaseNote?> AddInternalNoteForOfficerAsync(
        Guid cyberCaseId,
        string content,
        Guid officerId,
        string officerEmail)
    {
        if (cyberCaseId == Guid.Empty ||
            officerId == Guid.Empty ||
            string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(content) ||
            string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(officerEmail))
        {
            return null;
        }
        string cleanContent = content.Trim();
        if (cleanContent.Length > 2000)
        {
            return null;
        }
        return await ExecuteCaseTransactionAsync<CaseNote?>(async () =>
        {
            CyberCase? cyberCase =
                await _dbContext.CyberCases
                    .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cyberCase =>
                        cyberCase.Id == cyberCaseId &&
                        cyberCase.Path == CasePath.FormalReport &&
                        (cyberCase.AssignedOfficerId == officerId ||
                         cyberCase.Collaborators.Any(collaborator =>
                             collaborator.OfficerId == officerId &&
                             collaborator.IsActive)));
            if (cyberCase is null)
            {
                return null;
            }
            var note = new CaseNote
            {
                CyberCaseId = cyberCase.Id,
                Content = cleanContent,
                OfficerId = officerId,
                OfficerEmail = officerEmail.Trim(),
                CreatedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow
            };
            _dbContext.Set<CaseNote>().Add(note);
            await _auditService.WriteAsync(new AuditLogRequest
            {
                Action = AuditAction.InternalNoteAdded,
                ActorUserId = officerId,
                ActorEmail = officerEmail.Trim(),
                ActorRole = "OFFICER",
                CyberCaseId = cyberCase.Id,
                EntityType = nameof(CaseNote),
                EntityId = note.Id,
                Description = "تمت إضافة ملاحظة داخلية للقضية.",
                IsSuccessful = true
            });
            return note;
        });
    }
    public async Task<CaseMessage?> SendMessageByReporterAsync(
        Guid cyberCaseId,
        string content,
        Guid reporterId,
        string reporterEmail)
    {
        if (cyberCaseId == Guid.Empty ||
            reporterId == Guid.Empty ||
            string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(content) ||
            string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(reporterEmail))
        {
            return null;
        }
        string cleanContent = content.Trim();
        if (cleanContent.Length > 4000)
        {
            return null;
        }
        return await ExecuteCaseTransactionAsync<CaseMessage?>(async () =>
        {
            CyberCase? cyberCase =
                await _dbContext.CyberCases
                    .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cyberCase =>
                        cyberCase.Id == cyberCaseId &&
                        cyberCase.Path == CasePath.FormalReport &&
                        cyberCase.ReporterId == reporterId);
            if (cyberCase is null ||
                !cyberCase.AssignedOfficerId.HasValue)
            {
                return null;
            }
            var message = new CaseMessage
            {
                CyberCaseId = cyberCase.Id,
                Content = cleanContent,
                SenderId = reporterId,
                SenderEmail = reporterEmail.Trim(),
                SenderType = MessageSenderType.User,
                CreatedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow
            };
            _dbContext.CaseMessages.Add(message);
            await _auditService.WriteAsync(new AuditLogRequest
            {
                Action = AuditAction.CaseMessageSent,
                ActorUserId = reporterId,
                ActorEmail = reporterEmail.Trim(),
                ActorRole = "USER",
                CyberCaseId = cyberCase.Id,
                EntityType = nameof(CaseMessage),
                EntityId = message.Id,
                Description = "أرسل المشتكي رسالة في القضية.",
                IsSuccessful = true
            });
            // يصل الإشعار إلى الموظف المسؤول وجميع المشاركين الفعّالين.
            List<Guid> staffRecipientIds =
                await _dbContext.CaseCollaborators
                    .AsNoTracking()
                    .Where(collaborator =>
                        collaborator.CyberCaseId == cyberCase.Id &&
                        collaborator.IsActive)
                    .Select(collaborator =>
                        collaborator.OfficerId)
                    .ToListAsync();

            staffRecipientIds.Add(
                cyberCase.AssignedOfficerId.Value);

            foreach (Guid recipientId in staffRecipientIds.Distinct())
            {
                await _notificationService.CreateAsync(
                    recipientId,
                    cyberCase.Id,
                    NotificationType.NewMessage,
                    "رسالة جديدة",
                    "وصلت رسالة جديدة في قضية تشارك في متابعتها.");
            }
            return message;
        });
    }
    public async Task<CaseMessage?> SendMessageByOfficerAsync(
        Guid cyberCaseId,
        string content,
        Guid officerId,
        string officerEmail)
    {
        if (cyberCaseId == Guid.Empty ||
            officerId == Guid.Empty ||
            string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(content) ||
            string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(officerEmail))
        {
            return null;
        }
        string cleanContent = content.Trim();
        if (cleanContent.Length > 4000)
        {
            return null;
        }
        return await ExecuteCaseTransactionAsync<CaseMessage?>(async () =>
        {
            CyberCase? cyberCase =
                await _dbContext.CyberCases
                    .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cyberCase =>
                        cyberCase.Id == cyberCaseId &&
                        cyberCase.Path == CasePath.FormalReport &&
                        (cyberCase.AssignedOfficerId == officerId ||
                         cyberCase.Collaborators.Any(collaborator =>
                             collaborator.OfficerId == officerId &&
                             collaborator.IsActive)));
            if (cyberCase is null)
            {
                return null;
            }
            var message = new CaseMessage
            {
                CyberCaseId = cyberCase.Id,
                Content = cleanContent,
                SenderId = officerId,
                SenderEmail = officerEmail.Trim(),
                SenderType = MessageSenderType.Officer,
                CreatedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow
            };
            _dbContext.CaseMessages.Add(message);
            await _auditService.WriteAsync(new AuditLogRequest
            {
                Action = AuditAction.CaseMessageSent,
                ActorUserId = officerId,
                ActorEmail = officerEmail.Trim(),
                ActorRole = "OFFICER",
                CyberCaseId = cyberCase.Id,
                EntityType = nameof(CaseMessage),
                EntityId = message.Id,
                Description = "أرسل موظف مشارك في القضية رسالة للمشتكي.",
                IsSuccessful = true
            });
            // الموظف أرسل رسالة، لذلك الإشعار يذهب إلى صاحب القضية.
            if (cyberCase.ReporterId.HasValue)
            {
                await _notificationService.CreateAsync(
                    cyberCase.ReporterId.Value,
                    cyberCase.Id,
                    NotificationType.NewMessage,
                    "رسالة جديدة",
                    "وصلتك رسالة جديدة من الموظف المختص بشأن إحدى قضاياك.");
            }
            return message;
        });
    }
    public async Task<bool> DiscloseReporterIdentityAsync(
        Guid cyberCaseId,
        Guid reporterId)
    {
        if (cyberCaseId == Guid.Empty ||
            reporterId == Guid.Empty)
        {
            return false;
        }
        return await ExecuteCaseTransactionAsync<bool>(async () =>
        {
            CyberCase? cyberCase =
                await _dbContext.CyberCases
                    .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cyberCase =>
                        cyberCase.Id == cyberCaseId &&
                        cyberCase.Path == CasePath.FormalReport &&
                        cyberCase.ReporterId == reporterId);
            if (cyberCase is null)
            {
                return false;
            }
            if (cyberCase.IsReporterIdentityDisclosed)
            {
                return true;
            }
            var reporter =
                await _dbContext.Users
                    .AsNoTracking()
                    .FirstOrDefaultAsync(user =>
                        user.Id == reporterId);
            if (reporter is null)
            {
                return false;
            }
            cyberCase.IsReporterIdentityDisclosed = true;
            cyberCase.DisclosedReporterName =
                string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(reporter.FullName)
                    ? "غير محدد"
                    : reporter.FullName.Trim();
            cyberCase.DisclosedReporterEmail =
                reporter.Email;
            cyberCase.ReporterIdentityDisclosedAtUtc =
                DateTime.UtcNow;
            await _auditService.WriteAsync(new AuditLogRequest
            {
                Action = AuditAction.ReporterIdentityDisclosed,
                ActorUserId = reporterId,
                ActorEmail = reporter.Email,
                ActorRole = "USER",
                CyberCaseId = cyberCase.Id,
                EntityType = nameof(CyberCase),
                EntityId = cyberCase.Id,
                Description = "وافق المشتكي صراحة على كشف هويته للموظف المسؤول.",
                IsSuccessful = true
            });
            return true;
        });
    }

    // AuditService and NotificationService share this scoped DbContext.
    // Commit their saves together with the case operation; rollback on any failure.
    private async Task<T> ExecuteCaseTransactionAsync<T>(Func<Task<T>> operation)
    {
        await using var transaction =
            await _dbContext.Database.BeginTransactionAsync();
        try
        {
            T result = await operation();
            await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync();
            await transaction.CommitAsync();
            return result;
        }
        catch
        {
            await transaction.RollbackAsync();
            _dbContext.ChangeTracker.Clear();
            throw;
        }
    }

}
````
