````csharp
using System.Data;
using ACCP.Application.Auditing;
using ACCP.Application.CaseStaffing;
using ACCP.Application.Notifications;
using ACCP.Domain.Entities;
using ACCP.Domain.Enums;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Data;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Identity;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace ACCP.Infrastructure.Services;

public sealed class CaseStaffRequestService : ICaseStaffRequestService
{
    private readonly AccpDbContext _dbContext;
    private readonly UserManager<ApplicationUser> _userManager;
    private readonly INotificationService _notificationService;
    private readonly IAuditService _auditService;

    public CaseStaffRequestService(
        AccpDbContext dbContext,
        UserManager<ApplicationUser> userManager,
        INotificationService notificationService,
        IAuditService auditService)
    {
        _dbContext = dbContext;
        _userManager = userManager;
        _notificationService = notificationService;
        _auditService = auditService;
    }

    public async Task<CaseStaffRequest?> CreateForOfficerAsync(
        Guid cyberCaseId,
        CaseStaffRequestType requestType,
        string reason,
        Guid officerId,
        string officerEmail)
    {
        var cleanReason = reason?.Trim() ?? string.Empty;

        if (cyberCaseId == Guid.Empty ||
            officerId == Guid.Empty ||
            !IsValidRequestType(requestType) ||
            cleanReason.Length is < 10 or > 1000)
        {
            return null;
        }

        await using var transaction =
            await _dbContext.Database.BeginTransactionAsync(
                IsolationLevel.Serializable);

        try
        {
            var officer = await GetValidatedUserAsync(
                officerId, officerEmail, IdentityRoles.Officer);

            if (officer is null)
                return null;

            var cyberCase = await _dbContext.CyberCases
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(item =>
                    item.Id == cyberCaseId &&
                    item.Path == CasePath.FormalReport);

            if (cyberCase is null ||
                cyberCase.AssignedOfficerId != officerId ||
                !IsOpen(cyberCase.Status))
            {
                return null;
            }

            var hasPending = await _dbContext.CaseStaffRequests
                .AnyAsync(item =>
                    item.CyberCaseId == cyberCaseId &&
                    item.Status == CaseStaffRequestStatus.Pending);

            if (hasPending)
                return null;

            var request = new CaseStaffRequest
            {
                CyberCaseId = cyberCase.Id,
                RequestedByOfficerId = officer.Id,
                RequestedByOfficerEmail = officer.Email!.Trim(),
                RequestType = requestType,
                Reason = cleanReason,
                Status = CaseStaffRequestStatus.Pending,
                CreatedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow
            };

            _dbContext.CaseStaffRequests.Add(request);
            await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync();

            await NotifyAdminsAsync(
                cyberCase.Id,
                NotificationType.CaseStaffRequestCreated,
                "طلب موظف جديد",
                $"تم إرسال طلب {GetRequestTypeText(requestType)} " +
                $"للقضية {cyberCase.CaseNumber}.");

            await _auditService.WriteAsync(new AuditLogRequest
            {
                Action = AuditAction.CaseStaffRequestCreated,
                ActorUserId = officer.Id,
                ActorEmail = officer.Email,
                ActorRole = IdentityRoles.Officer,
                CyberCaseId = cyberCase.Id,
                EntityType = nameof(CaseStaffRequest),
                EntityId = request.Id,
                Description =
                    $"أنشأ الموظف طلب {GetRequestTypeText(requestType)} " +
                    $"للقضية {cyberCase.CaseNumber}."
            });

            await transaction.CommitAsync();
            return request;
        }
        catch
        {
            await transaction.RollbackAsync();
            _dbContext.ChangeTracker.Clear();
            throw;
        }
    }

    public async Task<List<CaseStaffRequest>> GetForOfficerAsync(
        Guid officerId)
    {
        if (officerId == Guid.Empty)
            return [];

        return await _dbContext.CaseStaffRequests
            .AsNoTracking()
            .Include(item => item.CyberCase)
            .Where(item =>
                item.CyberCase.Path == CasePath.FormalReport &&
                item.RequestedByOfficerId == officerId)
            .OrderByDescending(item => item.CreatedAtUtc)
            .ThenBy(item => item.Id)
            .ToListAsync();
    }

    public async Task<List<CaseStaffRequest>> GetForAdminAsync(
        CaseStaffRequestStatus? status = null)
    {
        if (status.HasValue && !Enum.IsDefined(status.Value))
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(status));

        var query = AdminReadQuery();

        if (status.HasValue)
            query = query.Where(item => item.Status == status.Value);

        return await query
            .OrderByDescending(item => item.CreatedAtUtc)
            .ThenBy(item => item.Id)
            .ToListAsync();
    }

    public async Task<CaseStaffRequest?> GetByIdForAdminAsync(
        Guid requestId)
    {
        if (requestId == Guid.Empty)
            return null;

        return await AdminReadQuery()
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(item => item.Id == requestId);
    }

    // بيانات إدارية فقط؛ لا نحمل عنوان القضية أو وصفها أو هوية المشتكي.
    private IQueryable<CaseStaffRequest> AdminReadQuery() =>
        _dbContext.CaseStaffRequests
            .AsNoTracking()
            .Where(item =>
                item.CyberCase.Path == CasePath.FormalReport)
            .Select(item => new CaseStaffRequest
            {
                Id = item.Id,
                CyberCaseId = item.CyberCaseId,
                CyberCase = new CyberCase
                {
                    Id = item.CyberCaseId,
                    CaseNumber = item.CyberCase.CaseNumber,
                    AssignedOfficerId =
                        item.CyberCase.AssignedOfficerId,
                    Path = item.CyberCase.Path
                },
                RequestedByOfficerId = item.RequestedByOfficerId,
                RequestedByOfficerEmail = item.RequestedByOfficerEmail,
                RequestType = item.RequestType,
                Reason = item.Reason,
                Status = item.Status,
                TargetOfficerId = item.TargetOfficerId,
                TargetOfficerEmail = item.TargetOfficerEmail,
                ReviewedByAdminId = item.ReviewedByAdminId,
                ReviewedByAdminEmail = item.ReviewedByAdminEmail,
                DecisionNote = item.DecisionNote,
                CreatedAtUtc = item.CreatedAtUtc,
                ReviewedAtUtc = item.ReviewedAtUtc,
                RowVersion = item.RowVersion
            });

    public async Task<bool> ApproveForAdminAsync(
        Guid requestId,
        Guid targetOfficerId,
        Guid adminId,
        string adminEmail,
        string? decisionNote)
    {
        if (requestId == Guid.Empty ||
            targetOfficerId == Guid.Empty ||
            adminId == Guid.Empty)
        {
            return false;
        }

        var cleanNote = CleanOptionalText(decisionNote, 1000);

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(decisionNote) &&
            cleanNote is null)
        {
            return false;
        }

        await using var transaction =
            await _dbContext.Database.BeginTransactionAsync(
                IsolationLevel.Serializable);

        try
        {
            // يعاد فحص الحسابات والأدوار داخل معاملة القرار.
            var admin = await GetValidatedUserAsync(
                adminId, adminEmail, IdentityRoles.Admin);

            var target = await GetEligibleTargetAsync(targetOfficerId);

            if (admin is null || target is null)
                return false;

            var request = await _dbContext.CaseStaffRequests
                .Include(item => item.CyberCase)
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(item =>
                    item.Id == requestId &&
                    item.Status == CaseStaffRequestStatus.Pending &&
                    item.CyberCase.Path == CasePath.FormalReport);

            if (request is null ||
                !IsValidRequestType(request.RequestType) ||
                !IsOpen(request.CyberCase.Status) ||
                request.CyberCase.AssignedOfficerId !=
                    request.RequestedByOfficerId ||
                target.Id == request.RequestedByOfficerId ||
                target.Id == request.CyberCase.AssignedOfficerId)
            {
                return false;
            }

            // لا نغيّر الطلب إذا كان الموظف مشاركًا فعّالًا بالفعل.
            if (request.RequestType == CaseStaffRequestType.AddCollaborator &&
                await _dbContext.CaseCollaborators.AnyAsync(item =>
                    item.CyberCaseId == request.CyberCaseId &&
                    item.OfficerId == target.Id &&
                    item.IsActive))
            {
                return false;
            }

            var now = DateTime.UtcNow;

            request.Status = CaseStaffRequestStatus.Approved;
            request.TargetOfficerId = target.Id;
            request.TargetOfficerEmail = target.Email!.Trim();
            request.ReviewedByAdminId = admin.Id;
            request.ReviewedByAdminEmail = admin.Email!.Trim();
            request.DecisionNote = cleanNote;
            request.ReviewedAtUtc = now;

            if (request.RequestType ==
                CaseStaffRequestType.TransferAssignment)
            {
                await ApplyTransferAsync(request, target, admin, now);
            }
            else
            {
                await ApplyCollaborationAsync(request, target, admin, now);
            }

            await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync();

            await _notificationService.CreateAsync(
                request.RequestedByOfficerId,
                request.CyberCaseId,
                NotificationType.CaseStaffRequestApproved,
                "تمت الموافقة على طلبك",
                $"وافق المدير على طلب {GetRequestTypeText(request.RequestType)} " +
                $"للقضية {request.CyberCase.CaseNumber}.");

            await _auditService.WriteAsync(new AuditLogRequest
            {
                Action = AuditAction.CaseStaffRequestApproved,
                ActorUserId = admin.Id,
                ActorEmail = admin.Email,
                ActorRole = IdentityRoles.Admin,
                CyberCaseId = request.CyberCaseId,
                EntityType = nameof(CaseStaffRequest),
                EntityId = request.Id,
                Description =
                    $"وافق المدير على طلب {GetRequestTypeText(request.RequestType)} " +
                    $"للقضية {request.CyberCase.CaseNumber}، " +
                    $"وحدد الموظف {target.Email}."
            });

            await transaction.CommitAsync();
            return true;
        }
        catch (DbUpdateException)
        {
            await transaction.RollbackAsync();
            _dbContext.ChangeTracker.Clear();
            return false;
        }
        catch
        {
            await transaction.RollbackAsync();
            _dbContext.ChangeTracker.Clear();
            throw;
        }
    }

    public async Task<bool> RejectForAdminAsync(
        Guid requestId,
        Guid adminId,
        string adminEmail,
        string decisionNote)
    {
        var note = decisionNote?.Trim() ?? string.Empty;

        if (requestId == Guid.Empty ||
            adminId == Guid.Empty ||
            note.Length is < 5 or > 1000)
        {
            return false;
        }

        await using var transaction =
            await _dbContext.Database.BeginTransactionAsync(
                IsolationLevel.Serializable);

        try
        {
            var admin = await GetValidatedUserAsync(
                adminId, adminEmail, IdentityRoles.Admin);

            if (admin is null)
                return false;

            var request = await _dbContext.CaseStaffRequests
                .Include(item => item.CyberCase)
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(item =>
                    item.Id == requestId &&
                    item.Status == CaseStaffRequestStatus.Pending &&
                    item.CyberCase.Path == CasePath.FormalReport);

            if (request is null)
                return false;

            request.Status = CaseStaffRequestStatus.Rejected;
            request.ReviewedByAdminId = admin.Id;
            request.ReviewedByAdminEmail = admin.Email!.Trim();
            request.DecisionNote = note;
            request.ReviewedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;

            await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync();

            // السبب الكامل محفوظ في الطلب؛ نص الإشعار يبقى ضمن حدوده.
            await _notificationService.CreateAsync(
                request.RequestedByOfficerId,
                request.CyberCaseId,
                NotificationType.CaseStaffRequestRejected,
                "تم رفض طلبك",
                $"رفض المدير طلب {GetRequestTypeText(request.RequestType)} " +
                $"للقضية {request.CyberCase.CaseNumber}. " +
                "يمكنك مراجعة سبب الرفض في سجل طلبات القضية.");

            await _auditService.WriteAsync(new AuditLogRequest
            {
                Action = AuditAction.CaseStaffRequestRejected,
                ActorUserId = admin.Id,
                ActorEmail = admin.Email,
                ActorRole = IdentityRoles.Admin,
                CyberCaseId = request.CyberCaseId,
                EntityType = nameof(CaseStaffRequest),
                EntityId = request.Id,
                Description =
                    $"رفض المدير طلب {GetRequestTypeText(request.RequestType)} " +
                    $"للقضية {request.CyberCase.CaseNumber}."
            });

            await transaction.CommitAsync();
            return true;
        }
        catch (DbUpdateException)
        {
            await transaction.RollbackAsync();
            _dbContext.ChangeTracker.Clear();
            return false;
        }
        catch
        {
            await transaction.RollbackAsync();
            _dbContext.ChangeTracker.Clear();
            throw;
        }
    }

    public async Task<bool> CancelForOfficerAsync(
        Guid requestId,
        Guid officerId,
        string officerEmail)
    {
        if (requestId == Guid.Empty || officerId == Guid.Empty)
            return false;

        await using var transaction =
            await _dbContext.Database.BeginTransactionAsync(
                IsolationLevel.Serializable);

        try
        {
            var officer = await GetValidatedUserAsync(
                officerId, officerEmail, IdentityRoles.Officer);

            if (officer is null)
                return false;

            var request = await _dbContext.CaseStaffRequests
                .Include(item => item.CyberCase)
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(item =>
                    item.Id == requestId &&
                    item.RequestedByOfficerId == officerId &&
                    item.Status == CaseStaffRequestStatus.Pending &&
                    item.CyberCase.Path == CasePath.FormalReport);

            if (request is null)
                return false;

            request.Status = CaseStaffRequestStatus.Cancelled;
            request.DecisionNote = "ألغى الموظف الطلب قبل مراجعته.";
            request.ReviewedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;

            await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync();

            await NotifyAdminsAsync(
                request.CyberCaseId,
                NotificationType.CaseStaffRequestCancelled,
                "أُلغي طلب موظف",
                $"ألغى الموظف طلب {GetRequestTypeText(request.RequestType)} " +
                $"للقضية {request.CyberCase.CaseNumber}.");

            await _auditService.WriteAsync(new AuditLogRequest
            {
                Action = AuditAction.CaseStaffRequestCancelled,
                ActorUserId = officer.Id,
                ActorEmail = officer.Email,
                ActorRole = IdentityRoles.Officer,
                CyberCaseId = request.CyberCaseId,
                EntityType = nameof(CaseStaffRequest),
                EntityId = request.Id,
                Description =
                    $"ألغى الموظف طلب {GetRequestTypeText(request.RequestType)} " +
                    $"للقضية {request.CyberCase.CaseNumber}."
            });

            await transaction.CommitAsync();
            return true;
        }
        catch (DbUpdateException)
        {
            await transaction.RollbackAsync();
            _dbContext.ChangeTracker.Clear();
            return false;
        }
        catch
        {
            await transaction.RollbackAsync();
            _dbContext.ChangeTracker.Clear();
            throw;
        }
    }

    private async Task ApplyTransferAsync(
        CaseStaffRequest request,
        ApplicationUser target,
        ApplicationUser admin,
        DateTime now)
    {
        var previousOfficerId = request.CyberCase.AssignedOfficerId;

        // تنظيف مشاركة المسؤول السابق ومشاركة المسؤول الجديد فقط.
        // تبقى مشاركات الموظفين الآخرين دون تغيير.
        var collaborations = await _dbContext.CaseCollaborators
            .Where(item =>
                item.CyberCaseId == request.CyberCaseId &&
                item.IsActive &&
                (item.OfficerId == previousOfficerId ||
                 item.OfficerId == target.Id))
            .ToListAsync();

        foreach (var collaboration in collaborations)
        {
            collaboration.IsActive = false;
            collaboration.RemovedByAdminId = admin.Id;
            collaboration.RemovedByAdminEmail = admin.Email!.Trim();
            collaboration.RemovedAtUtc = now;
            collaboration.RemovalReason =
                collaboration.OfficerId == target.Id
                    ? "أصبح الموظف مسؤولًا عن القضية بعد الموافقة على النقل."
                    : "انتهت مسؤولية الموظف عن القضية بعد الموافقة على النقل.";
        }

        request.CyberCase.AssignedOfficerId = target.Id;
        request.CyberCase.AssignedOfficerEmail = target.Email!.Trim();
        request.CyberCase.AssignedAtUtc = now;

        // إلغاء أي طلبات أخرى معلقة مرتبطة بالإسناد السابق.
        var otherPending = await _dbContext.CaseStaffRequests
            .Where(item =>
                item.CyberCaseId == request.CyberCaseId &&
                item.Id != request.Id &&
                item.Status == CaseStaffRequestStatus.Pending)
            .ToListAsync();

        foreach (var pending in otherPending)
        {
            pending.Status = CaseStaffRequestStatus.Cancelled;
            pending.ReviewedByAdminId = admin.Id;
            pending.ReviewedByAdminEmail = admin.Email!.Trim();
            pending.ReviewedAtUtc = now;
            pending.DecisionNote =
                "أُلغي الطلب بسبب تغيير المسؤول عن القضية.";

            await _notificationService.CreateAsync(
                pending.RequestedByOfficerId,
                request.CyberCaseId,
                NotificationType.CaseStaffRequestCancelled,
                "أُلغي طلب سابق",
                $"أُلغي طلب سابق للقضية {request.CyberCase.CaseNumber} " +
                "بسبب تغيير المسؤول عنها.");

            await _auditService.WriteAsync(new AuditLogRequest
            {
                Action = AuditAction.CaseStaffRequestCancelled,
                ActorUserId = admin.Id,
                ActorEmail = admin.Email,
                ActorRole = IdentityRoles.Admin,
                CyberCaseId = request.CyberCaseId,
                EntityType = nameof(CaseStaffRequest),
                EntityId = pending.Id,
                Description =
                    "أُلغي طلب معلّق بسبب تغيير المسؤول عن القضية."
            });
        }

        await _notificationService.CreateAsync(
            target.Id,
            request.CyberCaseId,
            NotificationType.CaseAssignmentTransferred,
            "تم تحويل قضية إليك",
            $"تم تعيينك مسؤولًا عن القضية {request.CyberCase.CaseNumber}.");

        await _auditService.WriteAsync(new AuditLogRequest
        {
            Action = AuditAction.CaseAssignmentTransferred,
            ActorUserId = admin.Id,
            ActorEmail = admin.Email,
            ActorRole = IdentityRoles.Admin,
            CyberCaseId = request.CyberCaseId,
            EntityType = nameof(CyberCase),
            EntityId = request.CyberCaseId,
            Description =
                $"حوّل المدير مسؤولية القضية من الموظف " +
                $"{previousOfficerId} إلى {target.Email}."
        });
    }

    private async Task ApplyCollaborationAsync(
        CaseStaffRequest request,
        ApplicationUser target,
        ApplicationUser admin,
        DateTime now)
    {
        var collaborator = await _dbContext.CaseCollaborators
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(item =>
                item.CyberCaseId == request.CyberCaseId &&
                item.OfficerId == target.Id);

        if (collaborator is null)
        {
            collaborator = new CaseCollaborator
            {
                CyberCaseId = request.CyberCaseId,
                OfficerId = target.Id
            };

            _dbContext.CaseCollaborators.Add(collaborator);
        }

        collaborator.OfficerEmail = target.Email!.Trim();
        collaborator.SourceRequestId = request.Id;
        collaborator.AddedByAdminId = admin.Id;
        collaborator.AddedByAdminEmail = admin.Email!.Trim();
        collaborator.IsActive = true;
        collaborator.AddedAtUtc = now;
        collaborator.RemovedByAdminId = null;
        collaborator.RemovedByAdminEmail = null;
        collaborator.RemovalReason = null;
        collaborator.RemovedAtUtc = null;

        await _notificationService.CreateAsync(
            target.Id,
            request.CyberCaseId,
            NotificationType.CaseCollaborationAdded,
            "تمت إضافتك إلى قضية",
            $"أضافك المدير كموظف مشارك في القضية " +
            $"{request.CyberCase.CaseNumber}.");

        await _auditService.WriteAsync(new AuditLogRequest
        {
            Action = AuditAction.CaseCollaboratorAdded,
            ActorUserId = admin.Id,
            ActorEmail = admin.Email,
            ActorRole = IdentityRoles.Admin,
            CyberCaseId = request.CyberCaseId,
            EntityType = nameof(CaseCollaborator),
            EntityId = collaborator.Id,
            Description =
                $"أضاف المدير الموظف {target.Email} كمشارك " +
                $"في القضية {request.CyberCase.CaseNumber}."
        });
    }

    private async Task<ApplicationUser?> GetEligibleTargetAsync(
        Guid userId)
    {
        var user = await GetActiveUserInRoleAsync(
            userId, IdentityRoles.Officer);

        if (user is null)
            return null;

        // لا يُستخدم حساب يحمل دور مدير كموظف بديل أو مشارك.
        if (await HasRoleAsync(user.Id, IdentityRoles.Admin))
            return null;

        return user;
    }

    private async Task<ApplicationUser?> GetValidatedUserAsync(
        Guid userId,
        string email,
        string requiredRole)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(email))
            return null;

        var user = await GetActiveUserInRoleAsync(userId, requiredRole);

        if (user is null ||
            !string.Equals(
                user.Email!.Trim(),
                email.Trim(),
                StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            return null;
        }

        return user;
    }

    private async Task<ApplicationUser?> GetActiveUserInRoleAsync(
        Guid userId,
        string requiredRole)
    {
        if (userId == Guid.Empty)
            return null;

        // قراءة جديدة من قاعدة البيانات داخل معاملة العملية.
        var user = await _dbContext.Users
            .AsNoTracking()
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(item => item.Id == userId);

        if (user is null ||
            !user.IsActive ||
            string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(user.Email) ||
            (user.LockoutEnabled &&
             user.LockoutEnd is { } lockout &&
             lockout > DateTimeOffset.UtcNow) ||
            !await HasRoleAsync(user.Id, requiredRole))
        {
            return null;
        }

        return user;
    }

    private Task<bool> HasRoleAsync(Guid userId, string roleName) =>
        _dbContext.UserRoles
            .Join(
                _dbContext.Roles,
                membership => membership.RoleId,
                role => role.Id,
                (membership, role) => new
                {
                    membership.UserId,
                    RoleName = role.Name
                })
            .AnyAsync(item =>
                item.UserId == userId &&
                item.RoleName == roleName);

    private async Task NotifyAdminsAsync(
        Guid caseId,
        NotificationType type,
        string title,
        string message)
    {
        var admins = await _userManager.GetUsersInRoleAsync(
            IdentityRoles.Admin);

        foreach (var admin in admins)
        {
            if (!admin.IsActive)
                continue;

            await _notificationService.CreateAsync(
                admin.Id, caseId, type, title, message);
        }
    }

    private static bool IsOpen(CaseStatus status) =>
        status is CaseStatus.New or
            CaseStatus.UnderReview or
            CaseStatus.Assigned or
            CaseStatus.InProgress;

    private static bool IsValidRequestType(
        CaseStaffRequestType type) =>
        type is CaseStaffRequestType.TransferAssignment or
            CaseStaffRequestType.AddCollaborator;

    private static string? CleanOptionalText(
        string? value,
        int maximumLength)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))
            return null;

        var clean = value.Trim();
        return clean.Length <= maximumLength ? clean : null;
    }

    private static string GetRequestTypeText(
        CaseStaffRequestType type) =>
        type switch
        {
            CaseStaffRequestType.TransferAssignment =>
                "نقل مسؤولية القضية",
            CaseStaffRequestType.AddCollaborator =>
                "إضافة موظف مشارك",
            _ => "غير معروف"
        };
}
````

````csharp
using System.Data;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using ACCP.Application.Auditing;
using ACCP.Application.EvidenceManagement;
using ACCP.Domain.Enums;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Data;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting;
using EvidenceEntity = ACCP.Domain.Entities.Evidence;
using EvidenceRevisionEntity = ACCP.Domain.Entities.EvidenceRevision;
namespace ACCP.Infrastructure.Services;
public class EvidenceService : IEvidenceService
{
    private const long MaximumFileSize = 10 * 1024 * 1024;
    private readonly AccpDbContext _dbContext;
    private readonly IHostEnvironment _environment;
    private readonly IAuditService _auditService;
    public EvidenceService(
        AccpDbContext dbContext,
        IHostEnvironment environment,
        IAuditService auditService)
    {
        _dbContext = dbContext;
        _environment = environment;
        _auditService = auditService;
    }
    public async Task<EvidenceRevisionEntity> UploadRevisionAsync(
        EvidenceRevisionUploadRequest request,
        Guid reporterId)
    {
        ValidateRevisionRequest(request, reporterId);
        var originalEvidenceDetails =
            await _dbContext.EvidenceItems
                .Where(evidence =>
                    evidence.Id == request.EvidenceId &&
                    evidence.CyberCase.ReporterId == reporterId)
                .Select(evidence => new
                {
                    Evidence = evidence,
                    Path = evidence.CyberCase.Path
                })
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync();
        if (originalEvidenceDetails is null)
        {
            await WriteAccessDeniedAuditAsync(
                reporterId,
                null,
                request.EvidenceId,
                "تم رفض محاولة تعديل دليل لعدم امتلاك الصلاحية.",
                "الدليل غير موجود أو لا يملك المستخدم صلاحية تعديله.");
            throw new UnauthorizedAccessException(
                "الدليل غير موجود أو لا تملك صلاحية تعديله.");
        }
        EvidenceEntity originalEvidence = originalEvidenceDetails.Evidence;
        // Read Path from the database projection, even if the case is already tracked.
        bool isFormalReport = originalEvidenceDetails.Path == CasePath.FormalReport;
        if (isFormalReport && !request.IsOriginalEvidenceAccessAcknowledged)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                "يجب قراءة التحذير والموافقة عليه قبل تعديل الدليل.");
        }
        string cleanReason = request.ChangeReason.Trim();
        string safeOriginalFileName =
            Path.GetFileName(request.OriginalFileName);
        string extension =
            Path.GetExtension(safeOriginalFileName)
                .ToLowerInvariant();
        byte[] fileBytes =
            await ReadFileSafelyAsync(request.Content);
        if (fileBytes.LongLength != request.FileSizeBytes)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                "حجم الملف الفعلي لا يطابق الحجم المرسل.");
        }
        (EvidenceType evidenceType, string safeContentType) =
            DetectAndValidateFile(fileBytes, extension);
        if (request.ChangeType ==
                EvidenceChangeType.ModifiedVersion &&
            evidenceType != originalEvidence.Type)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                "النسخة المعدلة يجب أن تكون من نفس نوع الدليل الأصلي.");
        }
        string sha256Hash =
            Convert.ToHexString(SHA256.HashData(fileBytes));
        string? latestHash =
            await _dbContext.EvidenceRevisions
                .AsNoTracking()
                .Where(revision =>
                    revision.EvidenceId == originalEvidence.Id)
                .OrderByDescending(revision =>
                    revision.VersionNumber)
                .Select(revision => revision.Sha256Hash)
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync();
        latestHash ??= originalEvidence.Sha256Hash;
        if (string.Equals(
                latestHash,
                sha256Hash,
                StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                "الملف الجديد مطابق تمامًا لآخر نسخة محفوظة.");
        }
        string storedFileName =
            $"{Guid.NewGuid():N}{extension}";
        string caseFolderName =
            originalEvidence.CyberCaseId.ToString("N");
        string evidenceFolderName =
            originalEvidence.Id.ToString("N");
        string storageDirectory = Path.Combine(
            _environment.ContentRootPath,
            "App_Data",
            "Evidence",
            caseFolderName,
            "Revisions",
            evidenceFolderName);
        Directory.CreateDirectory(storageDirectory);
        string fullFilePath = Path.Combine(
            storageDirectory,
            storedFileName);
        string storageKey =
            $"{caseFolderName}/Revisions/" +
            $"{evidenceFolderName}/{storedFileName}";
        try
        {
            await File.WriteAllBytesAsync(
                fullFilePath,
                fileBytes);
            await using var transaction =
                await _dbContext.Database
                    .BeginTransactionAsync(
                        IsolationLevel.Serializable);
            try
            {
                int latestVersion =
                    await _dbContext.EvidenceRevisions
                        .Where(revision =>
                            revision.EvidenceId ==
                                originalEvidence.Id)
                        .Select(revision =>
                            (int?)revision.VersionNumber)
                        .MaxAsync()
                    ?? 1;

                DateTime createdAtUtc =
                    DateTime.UtcNow;

                bool disclosureGrantedByAcknowledgement =
                    isFormalReport &&
                    originalEvidence.IsRestricted &&
                    !originalEvidence.IsDisclosedToOfficer;

                if (disclosureGrantedByAcknowledgement)
                {
                    originalEvidence.IsDisclosedToOfficer = true;
                    originalEvidence.DisclosedToOfficerAtUtc =
                        createdAtUtc;
                    originalEvidence.DisclosedByReporterId =
                        reporterId;
                }

                var revision = new EvidenceRevisionEntity
                {
                    EvidenceId = originalEvidence.Id,
                    VersionNumber = latestVersion + 1,
                    OriginalFileName = safeOriginalFileName,
                    StorageKey = storageKey,
                    ContentType = safeContentType,
                    FileSizeBytes = fileBytes.LongLength,
                    Type = evidenceType,
                    Sha256Hash = sha256Hash,
                    ChangeType = request.ChangeType,
                    ChangeReason = cleanReason,
                    ChangedByReporterId = reporterId,
                    IsOriginalEvidenceAccessAcknowledged =
                        isFormalReport,
                    OriginalEvidenceAccessAcknowledgedAtUtc =
                        isFormalReport ? createdAtUtc : null,
                    OriginalEvidenceAccessAcknowledgementText =
                        isFormalReport
                            ? EvidenceRevisionUploadRequest.OriginalEvidenceAccessAcknowledgementText
                            : null,
                    CreatedAtUtc = createdAtUtc
                };
                _dbContext.EvidenceRevisions.Add(revision);

                if (disclosureGrantedByAcknowledgement)
                {
                    await _auditService.WriteAsync(
                        new AuditLogRequest
                        {
                            Action =
                                AuditAction.EvidenceDisclosureGranted,
                            ActorUserId = reporterId,
                            ActorRole = "USER",
                            CyberCaseId =
                                originalEvidence.CyberCaseId,
                            EntityType = nameof(EvidenceEntity),
                            EntityId = originalEvidence.Id,
                            Description =
                                "وافق المشتكي أثناء تعديل الدليل " +
                                "على إتاحة النسخة الأصلية والنسخ " +
                                "السابقة للموظف المخوّل.",
                            IsSuccessful = true
                        });
                }

                await _auditService.WriteAsync(
                    new AuditLogRequest
                    {
                        Action = AuditAction.EvidenceRevisionUploaded,
                        ActorUserId = reporterId,
                        ActorRole = "USER",
                        CyberCaseId =
                            originalEvidence.CyberCaseId,
                        EntityType =
                            nameof(EvidenceRevisionEntity),
                        EntityId = revision.Id,
                        Description =
                            isFormalReport
                                ? $"تم رفع النسخة رقم " +
                                  $"{revision.VersionNumber} من الدليل " +
                                  "بعد موافقة المشتكي على إشعار " +
                                  "الاحتفاظ والوصول."
                                : $"تم رفع النسخة رقم {revision.VersionNumber} من مرفق طلب المساعدة.",
                        IsSuccessful = true
                    });
                await transaction.CommitAsync();
                return revision;
            }
            catch
            {
                await transaction.RollbackAsync();
                throw;
            }
        }
        catch
        {
            if (File.Exists(fullFilePath))
            {
                File.Delete(fullFilePath);
            }
            throw;
        }
    }
    public async Task<EvidenceEntity> UploadAsync(
        EvidenceUploadRequest request,
        Guid reporterId)
    {
        ValidateRequest(request, reporterId);
        bool userOwnsCase =
            await _dbContext.CyberCases
                .AsNoTracking()
                .AnyAsync(cyberCase =>
                    cyberCase.Id == request.CyberCaseId &&
                    cyberCase.ReporterId == reporterId);
        if (!userOwnsCase)
        {
            await WriteAccessDeniedAuditAsync(
                reporterId,
                request.CyberCaseId,
                null,
                "تم رفض محاولة رفع دليل إلى قضية غير مملوكة للمستخدم.",
                "القضية غير موجودة أو لا يملك المستخدم صلاحية الوصول إليها.");
            throw new UnauthorizedAccessException(
                "القضية غير موجودة أو لا تملك صلاحية الوصول إليها.");
        }
        string safeOriginalFileName =
            Path.GetFileName(request.OriginalFileName);
        string extension =
            Path.GetExtension(safeOriginalFileName)
                .ToLowerInvariant();
        byte[] fileBytes =
            await ReadFileSafelyAsync(request.Content);
        if (fileBytes.LongLength != request.FileSizeBytes)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                "حجم الملف الفعلي لا يطابق الحجم المرسل.");
        }
        (EvidenceType evidenceType, string safeContentType) =
            DetectAndValidateFile(fileBytes, extension);
        string sha256Hash =
            Convert.ToHexString(SHA256.HashData(fileBytes));
        string storedFileName =
            $"{Guid.NewGuid():N}{extension}";
        string caseFolderName =
            request.CyberCaseId.ToString("N");
        string storageDirectory = Path.Combine(
            _environment.ContentRootPath,
            "App_Data",
            "Evidence",
            caseFolderName);
        Directory.CreateDirectory(storageDirectory);
        string fullFilePath = Path.Combine(
            storageDirectory,
            storedFileName);
        string storageKey =
            $"{caseFolderName}/{storedFileName}";
        await File.WriteAllBytesAsync(
            fullFilePath,
            fileBytes);
        var evidence = new EvidenceEntity
        {
            OriginalFileName = safeOriginalFileName,
            StorageKey = storageKey,
            ContentType = safeContentType,
            FileSizeBytes = fileBytes.LongLength,
            Type = evidenceType,
            Sha256Hash = sha256Hash,
            IsRestricted = request.IsRestricted,
            CyberCaseId = request.CyberCaseId
        };
        try
        {
            _dbContext.EvidenceItems.Add(evidence);
            await _auditService.WriteAsync(
                new AuditLogRequest
                {
                    Action = AuditAction.EvidenceUploaded,
                    ActorUserId = reporterId,
                    ActorRole = "USER",
                    CyberCaseId = request.CyberCaseId,
                    EntityType = nameof(EvidenceEntity),
                    EntityId = evidence.Id,
                    Description =
                        "تم رفع دليل جديد إلى القضية.",
                    IsSuccessful = true
                });
            return evidence;
        }
        catch
        {
            if (File.Exists(fullFilePath))
            {
                File.Delete(fullFilePath);
            }
            throw;
        }
    }
    public async Task<List<EvidenceEntity>> GetByCaseIdAsync(
        Guid cyberCaseId,
        Guid reporterId)
    {
        if (cyberCaseId == Guid.Empty ||
            reporterId == Guid.Empty)
        {
            return [];
        }
        bool userOwnsCase =
            await _dbContext.CyberCases
                .AsNoTracking()
                .AnyAsync(cyberCase =>
                    cyberCase.Id == cyberCaseId &&
                    cyberCase.ReporterId == reporterId);
        if (!userOwnsCase)
        {
            await WriteAccessDeniedAuditAsync(
                reporterId,
                cyberCaseId,
                null,
                "تم رفض محاولة الوصول إلى قائمة أدلة قضية غير مملوكة للمستخدم.",
                "لا يملك المستخدم صلاحية الوصول إلى القضية.");
            return [];
        }
        return await _dbContext.EvidenceItems
            .AsNoTracking()
            .Where(evidence =>
                evidence.CyberCaseId == cyberCaseId)
            .OrderByDescending(evidence =>
                evidence.UploadedAtUtc)
            .ToListAsync();
    }
    public async Task<bool> DiscloseToOfficerAsync(
        Guid evidenceId,
        Guid reporterId)
    {
        if (evidenceId == Guid.Empty ||
            reporterId == Guid.Empty)
        {
            return false;
        }
        EvidenceEntity? evidence =
            await _dbContext.EvidenceItems
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(evidence =>
                    evidence.Id == evidenceId &&
                    evidence.CyberCase.Path == CasePath.FormalReport &&
                    evidence.CyberCase.ReporterId ==
                        reporterId);
        if (evidence is null)
        {
            await WriteAccessDeniedAuditAsync(
                reporterId,
                null,
                evidenceId,
                "تم رفض محاولة الإفصاح عن دليل غير متاح للكشف للموظفين.",
                "الدليل غير موجود أو غير مملوك للمستخدم أو لا يتبع بلاغًا رسميًا.");
            return false;
        }
        // الموافقة مخصصة للأدلة المقيدة فقط.
        if (!evidence.IsRestricted)
        {
            return false;
        }
        // إذا تمت الموافقة سابقًا فلا نكرر العملية أو سجل التدقيق.
        if (evidence.IsDisclosedToOfficer)
        {
            return true;
        }
        evidence.IsDisclosedToOfficer = true;
        evidence.DisclosedToOfficerAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
        evidence.DisclosedByReporterId = reporterId;
        await _auditService.WriteAsync(
            new AuditLogRequest
            {
                Action =
                    AuditAction.EvidenceDisclosureGranted,
                ActorUserId = reporterId,
                ActorRole = "USER",
                CyberCaseId = evidence.CyberCaseId,
                EntityType = nameof(EvidenceEntity),
                EntityId = evidence.Id,
                Description =
                    "وافق المشتكي على إظهار الدليل للموظف المسؤول.",
                IsSuccessful = true
            });
        return true;
    }
    private async Task WriteAccessDeniedAuditAsync(
        Guid actorUserId,
        Guid? cyberCaseId,
        Guid? entityId,
        string description,
        string failureReason)
    {
        await _auditService.WriteAsync(
            new AuditLogRequest
            {
                Action = AuditAction.AccessDenied,
                ActorUserId =
                    actorUserId == Guid.Empty
                        ? (Guid?)null
                        : actorUserId,
                ActorRole = "USER",
                CyberCaseId = cyberCaseId,
                EntityType = nameof(EvidenceEntity),
                EntityId = entityId,
                Description = description,
                IsSuccessful = false,
                FailureReason = failureReason
            });
    }
    private static void ValidateRevisionRequest(
        EvidenceRevisionUploadRequest request,
        Guid reporterId)
    {
        if (reporterId == Guid.Empty)
        {
            throw new UnauthorizedAccessException(
                "يجب تسجيل الدخول لتعديل الدليل.");
        }

        if (request.EvidenceId == Guid.Empty)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                "معرّف الدليل غير صالح.");
        }
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                request.OriginalFileName))
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                "اسم الملف الجديد غير صالح.");
        }
        if (request.Content is null)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                "محتوى الملف الجديد غير موجود.");
        }
        if (request.FileSizeBytes <= 0)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                "الملف الجديد فارغ.");
        }
        if (request.FileSizeBytes > MaximumFileSize)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                "حجم الملف الجديد يتجاوز الحد المسموح.");
        }
        if (!Enum.IsDefined(
                typeof(EvidenceChangeType),
                request.ChangeType))
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                "نوع التغيير غير صالح.");
        }
        string cleanReason =
            request.ChangeReason?.Trim()
            ?? string.Empty;
        if (cleanReason.Length < 10)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                "يجب كتابة سبب واضح للتغيير لا يقل عن 10 أحرف.");
        }
        if (cleanReason.Length > 1000)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                "سبب التغيير يتجاوز 1000 حرف.");
        }
    }
    private static void ValidateRequest(
        EvidenceUploadRequest request,
        Guid reporterId)
    {
        if (reporterId == Guid.Empty)
        {
            throw new UnauthorizedAccessException(
                "يجب تسجيل الدخول لرفع الأدلة.");
        }
        if (request.CyberCaseId == Guid.Empty)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                "رقم القضية غير صالح.");
        }
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                request.OriginalFileName))
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                "اسم الملف غير صالح.");
        }
        if (request.Content is null)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                "محتوى الملف غير موجود.");
        }
        if (request.FileSizeBytes <= 0)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                "الملف فارغ.");
        }
        if (request.FileSizeBytes > MaximumFileSize)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                "حجم الملف يتجاوز الحد المسموح.");
        }
    }
    private static async Task<byte[]> ReadFileSafelyAsync(
        Stream content)
    {
        using var memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
        byte[] buffer = new byte[81920];
        long totalBytes = 0;
        while (true)
        {
            int bytesRead = await content.ReadAsync(buffer);
            if (bytesRead == 0)
            {
                break;
            }
            totalBytes += bytesRead;
            if (totalBytes > MaximumFileSize)
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException(
                    "حجم الملف يتجاوز الحد المسموح.");
            }
            await memoryStream.WriteAsync(
                buffer.AsMemory(0, bytesRead));
        }
        if (totalBytes == 0)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                "الملف فارغ.");
        }
        return memoryStream.ToArray();
    }
    private static (
        EvidenceType EvidenceType,
        string ContentType)
        DetectAndValidateFile(
            byte[] fileBytes,
            string extension)
    {
        bool isPng =
            fileBytes.Length >= 8 &&
            fileBytes[0] == 0x89 &&
            fileBytes[1] == 0x50 &&
            fileBytes[2] == 0x4E &&
            fileBytes[3] == 0x47 &&
            fileBytes[4] == 0x0D &&
            fileBytes[5] == 0x0A &&
            fileBytes[6] == 0x1A &&
            fileBytes[7] == 0x0A;
        bool isJpeg =
            fileBytes.Length >= 3 &&
            fileBytes[0] == 0xFF &&
            fileBytes[1] == 0xD8 &&
            fileBytes[2] == 0xFF;
        bool isPdf =
            fileBytes.Length >= 4 &&
            fileBytes[0] == 0x25 &&
            fileBytes[1] == 0x50 &&
            fileBytes[2] == 0x44 &&
            fileBytes[3] == 0x46;
        if (extension == ".png" && isPng)
        {
            return (
                EvidenceType.Image,
                "image/png");
        }
        if ((extension == ".jpg" ||
             extension == ".jpeg") &&
            isJpeg)
        {
            return (
                EvidenceType.Image,
                "image/jpeg");
        }
        if (extension == ".pdf" && isPdf)
        {
            return (
                EvidenceType.Document,
                "application/pdf");
        }
        throw new InvalidOperationException(
            "نوع الملف غير مسموح أو محتواه لا يطابق امتداده.");
    }
}
````

### S099 — `ACCP.Infrastructure/Services/NotificationReadState.cs`

````csharp
namespace ACCP.Web.Services;

public sealed class NotificationReadState
{
    public event Action? Changed;

    public void NotifyChanged()
    {
        Changed?.Invoke();
    }
}
````

### S100 — `ACCP.Infrastructure/Services/NotificationService.cs`

[العودة إلى شرح الملف](#file-100)


````csharp
using ACCP.Application.Notifications;
using ACCP.Domain.Entities;
using ACCP.Domain.Enums;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Data;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace ACCP.Infrastructure.Services;

public class NotificationService : INotificationService
{
    private readonly AccpDbContext _dbContext;

    public NotificationService(
        AccpDbContext dbContext)
    {
        _dbContext = dbContext;
    }

    public async Task<UserNotification> CreateAsync(
        Guid recipientUserId,
        Guid? cyberCaseId,
        NotificationType type,
        string title,
        string message)
    {
        if (recipientUserId == Guid.Empty)
        {
            throw new ArgumentException(
                "معرّف مستلم الإشعار غير صالح.",
                nameof(recipientUserId));
        }

        string cleanTitle = title.Trim();
        string cleanMessage = message.Trim();

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(cleanTitle) ||
            cleanTitle.Length > 200)
        {
            throw new ArgumentException(
                "عنوان الإشعار غير صالح.",
                nameof(title));
        }

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(cleanMessage) ||
            cleanMessage.Length > 1000)
        {
            throw new ArgumentException(
                "نص الإشعار غير صالح.",
                nameof(message));
        }

        var notification = new UserNotification
        {
            RecipientUserId = recipientUserId,
            CyberCaseId = cyberCaseId,
            Type = type,
            Title = cleanTitle,
            Message = cleanMessage,
            IsRead = false,
            CreatedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow
        };

        _dbContext.UserNotifications.Add(notification);

        await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync();

        return notification;
    }

    public async Task<List<UserNotification>> GetForUserAsync(
        Guid recipientUserId)
    {
        if (recipientUserId == Guid.Empty)
        {
            return [];
        }

        return await _dbContext.UserNotifications
            .AsNoTracking()
            .Where(notification =>
                notification.RecipientUserId == recipientUserId)
            .OrderByDescending(notification =>
                notification.CreatedAtUtc)
            .Take(100)
            .ToListAsync();
    }

    public async Task<int> GetUnreadCountAsync(
        Guid recipientUserId)
    {
        if (recipientUserId == Guid.Empty)
        {
            return 0;
        }

        return await _dbContext.UserNotifications
            .CountAsync(notification =>
                notification.RecipientUserId == recipientUserId &&
                !notification.IsRead);
    }

    public async Task<bool> MarkAsReadAsync(
        Guid notificationId,
        Guid recipientUserId)
    {
        if (notificationId == Guid.Empty ||
            recipientUserId == Guid.Empty)
        {
            return false;
        }

        UserNotification? notification =
            await _dbContext.UserNotifications
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(notification =>
                    notification.Id == notificationId &&
                    notification.RecipientUserId ==
                        recipientUserId);

        if (notification is null)
        {
            return false;
        }

        if (!notification.IsRead)
        {
            notification.IsRead = true;
            notification.ReadAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;

            await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync();
        }

        return true;
    }

    public async Task<int> MarkAllAsReadAsync(
        Guid recipientUserId)
    {
        if (recipientUserId == Guid.Empty)
        {
            return 0;
        }

        DateTime readAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;

        return await _dbContext.UserNotifications
            .Where(notification =>
                notification.RecipientUserId == recipientUserId &&
                !notification.IsRead)
            .ExecuteUpdateAsync(setters => setters
                .SetProperty(
                    notification => notification.IsRead,
                    true)
                .SetProperty(
                    notification => notification.ReadAtUtc,
                    readAtUtc));
    }
}
````

### S102 — `ACCP.Tests/AtomicStatusTests.cs`


الوظيفة: اختبارات تحديث الحالة المشروط وتعارضات محاكاة

[العودة إلى شرح الملف](#file-102)


````csharp
using System.Data.Common;
using ACCP.Domain.Entities;
using ACCP.Domain.Enums;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Data;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Identity;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Services;
using Microsoft.Data.Sqlite;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Diagnostics;

namespace ACCP.Tests;

public sealed class AtomicStatusTests : IAsyncLifetime
{
    private readonly SqliteConnection _connection = new("Data Source=:memory:");
    private readonly Guid _owner = Guid.NewGuid();
    private readonly ChangeBeforeUpdate _interceptor = new();
    private readonly ApplicationUser _reporter = new()
    {
        Id = Guid.NewGuid(), UserName = "synthetic-reporter",
        Email = "reporter@example.test"
    };
    private AccpDbContext _db = null!;
    private CaseService _service = null!;
    private CyberCase _item = null!;

    public async Task InitializeAsync()
    {
        await _connection.OpenAsync();
        var options = new DbContextOptionsBuilder<AccpDbContext>()
            .UseSqlite(_connection).AddInterceptors(_interceptor).Options;
        _db = new AccpDbContext(options);
        await _db.Database.EnsureCreatedAsync();
        _db.Users.Add(_reporter);
        _item = new CyberCase { CaseNumber = "SYNTHETIC", Title = "Test case",
            Description = "Synthetic incident", IncidentType = "Test",
            ReporterId = _reporter.Id, AssignedOfficerId = _owner, Status = CaseStatus.Assigned };
        _db.CyberCases.Add(_item);
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
        _service = new CaseService(_db, new AuditService(_db), new NotificationService(_db));
    }

    public async Task DisposeAsync()
    {
        await _db.DisposeAsync();
        await _connection.DisposeAsync();
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task StaleTrackedStatus_UsesDatabaseStatusForHistoryAndRefreshesTracking()
    {
        await _db.CyberCases.Where(item => item.Id == _item.Id)
            .ExecuteUpdateAsync(setters => setters.SetProperty(item => item.Status, CaseStatus.InProgress));
        Assert.Equal(CaseStatus.Assigned, _item.Status);
        Assert.True(await _service.UpdateStatusForOfficerAsync(_item.Id, CaseStatus.Resolved, _owner, "owner@example.test", "Documented resolution reason"));
        Assert.Equal(CaseStatus.InProgress, (await _db.CaseStatusHistories.SingleAsync()).OldStatus);
        Assert.Equal(CaseStatus.Resolved, _item.Status);
        var notification = await _db.UserNotifications.SingleAsync();
        Assert.Equal(_reporter.Id, notification.RecipientUserId);
        Assert.Equal(NotificationType.CaseStatusChanged, notification.Type);
        _item.Title = "Unrelated edit";
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
        Assert.Equal(CaseStatus.Resolved, (await _db.CyberCases.AsNoTracking().SingleAsync()).Status);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task StaleTrackedStatus_AlreadyCurrentRequestCreatesNoDuplicateEffects()
    {
        await _db.CyberCases.Where(item => item.Id == _item.Id)
            .ExecuteUpdateAsync(setters => setters.SetProperty(item => item.Status, CaseStatus.InProgress));
        Assert.True(await _service.UpdateStatusForOfficerAsync(_item.Id, CaseStatus.InProgress, _owner, "owner@example.test"));
        Assert.Equal(CaseStatus.InProgress, _item.Status);
        Assert.Empty(await _db.CaseStatusHistories.ToListAsync());
        Assert.Empty(await _db.AuditLogs.ToListAsync());
        Assert.Empty(await _db.UserNotifications.ToListAsync());
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task ChangedStatusBetweenReadAndUpdate_RejectsStaleWriteAndItsSideEffects()
    {
        _db.ChangeTracker.Clear();
        _interceptor.Arm(_item.Id, CaseStatus.InProgress);
        Assert.False(await _service.UpdateStatusForOfficerAsync(_item.Id, CaseStatus.InProgress, _owner, "owner@example.test"));
        Assert.True(_interceptor.Triggered);
        Assert.Equal(CaseStatus.InProgress, (await _db.CyberCases.AsNoTracking().SingleAsync()).Status);
        Assert.Empty(await _db.CaseStatusHistories.ToListAsync());
        Assert.Empty(await _db.AuditLogs.ToListAsync());
        Assert.Empty(await _db.UserNotifications.ToListAsync());
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task OwnershipChangedBetweenReadAndUpdate_RejectsFormerOwnerWrite()
    {
        _db.ChangeTracker.Clear();
        var newOwner = Guid.NewGuid();
        _interceptor.ArmOwner(_item.Id, newOwner);

        Assert.False(await _service.UpdateStatusForOfficerAsync(
            _item.Id, CaseStatus.InProgress, _owner, "owner@example.test"));
        Assert.True(_interceptor.Triggered);
        var persisted = await _db.CyberCases.AsNoTracking().SingleAsync();
        Assert.Equal(newOwner, persisted.AssignedOfficerId);
        Assert.Equal(CaseStatus.Assigned, persisted.Status);
        Assert.Empty(await _db.CaseStatusHistories.ToListAsync());
        Assert.Empty(await _db.AuditLogs.ToListAsync());
        Assert.Empty(await _db.UserNotifications.ToListAsync());
    }

    // Deterministically change the row immediately before ExecuteUpdate runs.
    // This checks the conditional write; it is not a SQL Server race test.
    private sealed class ChangeBeforeUpdate : DbCommandInterceptor
    {
        private Guid? _id;
        private CaseStatus _status;
        private Guid? _newOwner;
        public bool Triggered { get; private set; }
        public void Arm(Guid id, CaseStatus status)
        {
            _id = id; _status = status; _newOwner = null;
        }
        public void ArmOwner(Guid id, Guid owner)
        {
            _id = id; _newOwner = owner;
        }

        public override async ValueTask<InterceptionResult<int>> NonQueryExecutingAsync(
            DbCommand command, CommandEventData eventData, InterceptionResult<int> result,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            if (_id.HasValue && command.CommandText.StartsWith("UPDATE \"CyberCases\""))
            {
                var id = _id.Value;
                _id = null;
                await using var injected = command.Connection!.CreateCommand();
                injected.Transaction = command.Transaction;
                injected.CommandText = _newOwner.HasValue
                    ? "UPDATE \"CyberCases\" SET \"AssignedOfficerId\" = @value WHERE \"Id\" = @id"
                    : "UPDATE \"CyberCases\" SET \"Status\" = @value WHERE \"Id\" = @id";
                var idParameter = injected.CreateParameter();
                idParameter.ParameterName = "@id"; idParameter.Value = id;
                var valueParameter = injected.CreateParameter();
                valueParameter.ParameterName = "@value";
                valueParameter.Value = _newOwner.HasValue ? (object)_newOwner.Value : (int)_status;
                injected.Parameters.Add(idParameter); injected.Parameters.Add(valueParameter);
                Assert.Equal(1, await injected.ExecuteNonQueryAsync(cancellationToken));
                Triggered = true;
            }
            return result;
        }
    }
}
````

الوظيفة: اختبارات إعادة الفتح وصلاحية الموظف والآثار

[العودة إلى شرح الملف](#file-103)


````csharp
using ACCP.Application.Cases;
using ACCP.Application.Notifications;
using ACCP.Domain.Entities;
using ACCP.Domain.Enums;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Data;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Identity;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Services;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity;
using Microsoft.Data.Sqlite;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace ACCP.Tests;

public sealed class CaseReopeningTests : IAsyncLifetime
{
    private readonly SqliteConnection connection =
        new("Data Source=:memory:");

    private TestContext db = null!;
    private ApplicationUser admin = null!;
    private ApplicationUser owner = null!;
    private ApplicationUser target = null!;
    private ApplicationUser reporter = null!;
    private CyberCase item = null!;
    private CaseReopeningService service = null!;
    private Guid adminRoleId;

    private const string Reason =
        "Documented reason to reopen this case";

    public async Task InitializeAsync()
    {
        await connection.OpenAsync();

        db = new TestContext(
            new DbContextOptionsBuilder<AccpDbContext>()
                .UseSqlite(connection)
                .Options);

        await db.Database.EnsureCreatedAsync();

        admin = User("admin");
        owner = User("owner");
        target = User("target");
        reporter = User("reporter");

        db.Users.AddRange(admin, owner, target, reporter);

        var adminRole = new IdentityRole<Guid>(IdentityRoles.Admin)
        {
            Id = Guid.NewGuid()
        };

        var officerRole = new IdentityRole<Guid>(IdentityRoles.Officer)
        {
            Id = Guid.NewGuid()
        };

        adminRoleId = adminRole.Id;

        db.Roles.AddRange(adminRole, officerRole);

        db.UserRoles.AddRange(
            new IdentityUserRole<Guid>
            {
                UserId = admin.Id,
                RoleId = adminRole.Id
            },
            new IdentityUserRole<Guid>
            {
                UserId = owner.Id,
                RoleId = officerRole.Id
            },
            new IdentityUserRole<Guid>
            {
                UserId = target.Id,
                RoleId = officerRole.Id
            });

        item = new CyberCase
        {
            CaseNumber = "SYNTHETIC-REOPEN",
            Title = "Synthetic case",
            Description = "Synthetic",
            IncidentType = "Other",
            Path = CasePath.FormalReport,
            Status = CaseStatus.Closed,
            ReporterId = reporter.Id,
            AssignedOfficerId = owner.Id,
            AssignedOfficerEmail = owner.Email,
            AssignedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(-1)
        };

        db.CyberCases.Add(item);

        await db.SaveChangesAsync();
        db.ChangeTracker.Clear();

        service = CreateService();
    }

    public async Task DisposeAsync()
    {
        await db.DisposeAsync();
        await connection.DisposeAsync();
    }

    private static ApplicationUser User(string name) => new()
    {
        Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
        UserName = name,
        Email = name + "@example.test",
        IsActive = true
    };

    private CaseReopeningService CreateService(
        INotificationService? notifications = null) =>
        new(
            db,
            new AuditService(db),
            notifications ?? new NotificationService(db));

    private async Task<CaseReopeningSnapshot> SnapshotAsync()
    {
        var current = await db.CyberCases
            .AsNoTracking()
            .SingleAsync();

        return new CaseReopeningSnapshot(
            current.Id,
            current.CaseNumber,
            current.Status,
            current.AssignedOfficerId,
            current.AssignedAtUtc,
            await db.CaseStatusHistories.CountAsync());
    }

    private async Task AssertNoEffectsAsync(
        CaseStatus status = CaseStatus.Closed)
    {
        Assert.Equal(
            status,
            (await db.CyberCases.AsNoTracking().SingleAsync()).Status);

        Assert.Empty(
            await db.CaseStatusHistories.AsNoTracking().ToListAsync());

        Assert.Empty(
            await db.AuditLogs.AsNoTracking().ToListAsync());

        Assert.Empty(
            await db.UserNotifications.AsNoTracking().ToListAsync());
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(CaseStatus.Closed)]
    [InlineData(CaseStatus.Resolved)]
    public async Task ReopensTerminalCaseWithReasonAndNotifiesOwnerAndReporter(
        CaseStatus status)
    {
        await db.CyberCases.ExecuteUpdateAsync(
            setters => setters.SetProperty(c => c.Status, status));

        var expected = await SnapshotAsync();

        Assert.True(
            await service.ReopenAsync(
                expected,
                owner.Id,
                admin.Id,
                "  " + Reason + "  "));

        var current = await db.CyberCases
            .AsNoTracking()
            .SingleAsync();

        Assert.Equal(CaseStatus.InProgress, current.Status);
        Assert.Equal(owner.Id, current.AssignedOfficerId);
        Assert.Equal(expected.AssignedAtUtc, current.AssignedAtUtc);

        var history = await db.CaseStatusHistories.SingleAsync();

        Assert.Equal(status, history.OldStatus);
        Assert.Equal(CaseStatus.InProgress, history.NewStatus);
        Assert.Equal(admin.Id, history.ChangedByUserId);
        Assert.Equal(Reason, history.Reason);

        Assert.Single(await db.AuditLogs.ToListAsync());

        var recipients = await db.UserNotifications
            .Select(n => n.RecipientUserId)
            .ToListAsync();

        Assert.Equal(2, recipients.Count);
        Assert.Contains(owner.Id, recipients);
        Assert.Contains(reporter.Id, recipients);

        Assert.False(
            await service.ReopenAsync(
                expected,
                owner.Id,
                admin.Id,
                Reason));

        Assert.Equal(1, await db.CaseStatusHistories.CountAsync());
        Assert.Equal(2, await db.UserNotifications.CountAsync());
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task RejectsNonAdminAndDisabledTarget()
    {
        var expected = await SnapshotAsync();

        Assert.False(
            await service.ReopenAsync(
                expected,
                target.Id,
                owner.Id,
                Reason));

        await db.Users
            .Where(u => u.Id == target.Id)
            .ExecuteUpdateAsync(
                setters => setters.SetProperty(u => u.IsActive, false));

        Assert.False(
            await service.ReopenAsync(
                expected,
                target.Id,
                admin.Id,
                Reason));

        await AssertNoEffectsAsync();
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task RejectsOpenOrPrivateCase()
    {
        await db.CyberCases.ExecuteUpdateAsync(
            setters => setters.SetProperty(
                c => c.Status,
                CaseStatus.InProgress));

        Assert.False(
            await service.ReopenAsync(
                await SnapshotAsync(),
                owner.Id,
                admin.Id,
                Reason));

        await AssertNoEffectsAsync(CaseStatus.InProgress);

        await db.CyberCases.ExecuteUpdateAsync(
            setters => setters
                .SetProperty(c => c.Status, CaseStatus.Closed)
                .SetProperty(c => c.Path, (CasePath)1));

        Assert.False(
            await service.ReopenAsync(
                await SnapshotAsync(),
                owner.Id,
                admin.Id,
                Reason));

        await AssertNoEffectsAsync();
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task RejectsInvalidReasonAndChangedAssignment()
    {
        var expected = await SnapshotAsync();

        foreach (var reason in new[]
        {
            "",
            "   ",
            "short",
            new string('x', 1001)
        })
        {
            Assert.False(
                await service.ReopenAsync(
                    expected,
                    owner.Id,
                    admin.Id,
                    reason));
        }

        await db.CyberCases.ExecuteUpdateAsync(
            setters => setters.SetProperty(
                c => c.AssignedOfficerId,
                (Guid?)target.Id));

        Assert.False(
            await service.ReopenAsync(
                expected,
                owner.Id,
                admin.Id,
                Reason));

        await AssertNoEffectsAsync();
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task RejectsTargetWithAdminRoleAndAdminWhoseRoleWasRemoved()
    {
        db.UserRoles.Add(new IdentityUserRole<Guid>
        {
            UserId = target.Id,
            RoleId = adminRoleId
        });

        await db.SaveChangesAsync();

        var expected = await SnapshotAsync();

        Assert.False(
            await service.ReopenAsync(
                expected,
                target.Id,
                admin.Id,
                Reason));

        await db.UserRoles
            .Where(r => r.UserId == admin.Id)
            .ExecuteDeleteAsync();

        Assert.False(
            await service.ReopenAsync(
                expected,
                owner.Id,
                admin.Id,
                Reason));

        await AssertNoEffectsAsync();
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task ChangedHistoryInvalidatesSnapshotEvenWhenStatusIsClosedAgain()
    {
        var expected = await SnapshotAsync();

        db.CaseStatusHistories.Add(new CaseStatusHistory
        {
            CyberCaseId = item.Id,
            OldStatus = CaseStatus.InProgress,
            NewStatus = CaseStatus.Closed,
            ChangedByUserId = owner.Id,
            ChangedByEmail = owner.Email!,
            Reason = Reason
        });

        await db.SaveChangesAsync();

        Assert.False(
            await service.ReopenAsync(
                expected,
                owner.Id,
                admin.Id,
                Reason));

        Assert.Equal(
            CaseStatus.Closed,
            (await db.CyberCases.AsNoTracking().SingleAsync()).Status);

        Assert.Equal(1, await db.CaseStatusHistories.CountAsync());
        Assert.Empty(await db.UserNotifications.ToListAsync());
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task ChangedOwnerRevokesDuplicateGrantsAndCancelsPendingRequest()
    {
        db.CaseCollaborators.AddRange(
            Grant(owner),
            Grant(target),
            Grant(reporter));

        db.CaseStaffRequests.Add(new CaseStaffRequest
        {
            CyberCaseId = item.Id,
            RequestedByOfficerId = owner.Id,
            RequestedByOfficerEmail = owner.Email!,
            Reason = Reason,
            Status = CaseStaffRequestStatus.Pending
        });

        await db.SaveChangesAsync();
        db.ChangeTracker.Clear();

        Assert.True(
            await service.ReopenAsync(
                await SnapshotAsync(),
                target.Id,
                admin.Id,
                Reason));

        var current = await db.CyberCases
            .AsNoTracking()
            .SingleAsync();

        Assert.Equal(target.Id, current.AssignedOfficerId);

        Assert.False(
            (await db.CaseCollaborators.SingleAsync(
                c => c.OfficerId == owner.Id)).IsActive);

        Assert.False(
            (await db.CaseCollaborators.SingleAsync(
                c => c.OfficerId == target.Id)).IsActive);

        Assert.True(
            (await db.CaseCollaborators.SingleAsync(
                c => c.OfficerId == reporter.Id)).IsActive);

        Assert.Equal(
            CaseStaffRequestStatus.Cancelled,
            (await db.CaseStaffRequests.SingleAsync()).Status);

        Assert.All(
            await db.UserNotifications
                .Where(n => n.RecipientUserId == owner.Id)
                .ToListAsync(),
            notification => Assert.Null(notification.CyberCaseId));
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task NotificationFailureRollsBackStatusHistoryAuditAndNotification()
    {
        db.CaseCollaborators.AddRange(
            Grant(owner),
            Grant(target));

        db.CaseStaffRequests.Add(new CaseStaffRequest
        {
            CyberCaseId = item.Id,
            RequestedByOfficerId = owner.Id,
            RequestedByOfficerEmail = owner.Email!,
            Reason = Reason,
            Status = CaseStaffRequestStatus.Pending
        });

        await db.SaveChangesAsync();
        db.ChangeTracker.Clear();

        var expected = await SnapshotAsync();

        var failing = CreateService(
            new FailingNotifications(new NotificationService(db)));

        await Assert.ThrowsAsync<InjectedFailure>(
            () => failing.ReopenAsync(
                expected,
                target.Id,
                admin.Id,
                Reason));

        await AssertNoEffectsAsync();

        Assert.Equal(
            owner.Id,
            (await db.CyberCases.AsNoTracking().SingleAsync())
                .AssignedOfficerId);

        Assert.All(
            await db.CaseCollaborators.AsNoTracking().ToListAsync(),
            entry => Assert.True(entry.IsActive));

        Assert.Equal(
            CaseStaffRequestStatus.Pending,
            (await db.CaseStaffRequests.AsNoTracking().SingleAsync())
                .Status);
    }

    private CaseCollaborator Grant(ApplicationUser user) => new()
    {
        CyberCaseId = item.Id,
        OfficerId = user.Id,
        OfficerEmail = user.Email!,
        AddedByAdminId = admin.Id,
        AddedByAdminEmail = admin.Email!,
        SourceRequestId = Guid.NewGuid(),
        IsActive = true
    };

    private sealed class InjectedFailure : Exception
    {
    }

    private sealed class FailingNotifications(
        INotificationService inner) : INotificationService
    {
        public async Task<UserNotification> CreateAsync(
            Guid recipientUserId,
            Guid? cyberCaseId,
            NotificationType type,
            string title,
            string message)
        {
            await inner.CreateAsync(
                recipientUserId,
                cyberCaseId,
                type,
                title,
                message);

            throw new InjectedFailure();
        }

        public Task<List<UserNotification>> GetForUserAsync(Guid id) =>
            inner.GetForUserAsync(id);

        public Task<int> GetUnreadCountAsync(Guid id) =>
            inner.GetUnreadCountAsync(id);

        public Task<bool> MarkAsReadAsync(Guid id, Guid user) =>
            inner.MarkAsReadAsync(id, user);

        public Task<int> MarkAllAsReadAsync(Guid id) =>
            inner.MarkAllAsReadAsync(id);
    }

    private sealed class TestContext(
        DbContextOptions<AccpDbContext> options) : AccpDbContext(options)
    {
        protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder builder)
        {
            base.OnModelCreating(builder);

            builder.Entity<CaseCollaborator>()
                .Property(c => c.RowVersion)
                .IsRequired()
                .ValueGeneratedNever();

            builder.Entity<CaseStaffRequest>()
                .Property(c => c.RowVersion)
                .IsRequired()
                .ValueGeneratedNever();
        }
    }
}
````
