````csharp
using ACCP.Application.Notifications;
using ACCP.Domain.Entities;
using ACCP.Domain.Enums;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Data;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Identity;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Services;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Data.Sqlite;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;

namespace ACCP.Tests;

public sealed class CaseStaffRequestTests : IAsyncLifetime
{
    private readonly SqliteConnection connection =
        new("Data Source=:memory:");

    private TestContext db = null!;
    private UserManager<ApplicationUser> users = null!;
    private ServiceProvider provider = null!;
    private CaseStaffRequestService service = null!;

    private ApplicationUser admin = null!;
    private ApplicationUser owner = null!;
    private ApplicationUser target = null!;
    private ApplicationUser participant = null!;

    private CyberCase caseItem = null!;
    private CaseStaffRequest request = null!;

    private Guid adminRoleId;
    private Guid officerRoleId;

    public async Task InitializeAsync()
    {
        await connection.OpenAsync();

        db = new TestContext(
            new DbContextOptionsBuilder<AccpDbContext>()
                .UseSqlite(connection)
                .Options);

        await db.Database.EnsureCreatedAsync();

        admin = NewUser("admin");
        owner = NewUser("owner");
        target = NewUser("target");
        participant = NewUser("participant");

        db.Users.AddRange(admin, owner, target, participant);

        var adminRole = new IdentityRole<Guid>(IdentityRoles.Admin)
        {
            Id = Guid.NewGuid()
        };

        var officerRole = new IdentityRole<Guid>(IdentityRoles.Officer)
        {
            Id = Guid.NewGuid()
        };

        adminRoleId = adminRole.Id;
        officerRoleId = officerRole.Id;

        db.Roles.AddRange(adminRole, officerRole);

        AddRole(admin.Id, adminRoleId);
        AddRole(owner.Id, officerRoleId);
        AddRole(target.Id, officerRoleId);
        AddRole(participant.Id, officerRoleId);

        caseItem = new CyberCase
        {
            CaseNumber = "SYNTHETIC-STAFF-REQUEST",
            Title = "Private complaint title",
            Description = "Private complaint description",
            IncidentType = "Other",
            Path = CasePath.FormalReport,
            Status = CaseStatus.InProgress,
            AssignedOfficerId = owner.Id,
            AssignedOfficerEmail = owner.Email,
            AssignedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(-1),
            ReporterId = Guid.NewGuid(),
            IsReporterIdentityDisclosed = true,
            DisclosedReporterName = "Private reporter name",
            DisclosedReporterEmail = "private@example.test"
        };

        request = new CaseStaffRequest
        {
            CyberCaseId = caseItem.Id,
            RequestedByOfficerId = owner.Id,
            RequestedByOfficerEmail = owner.Email!,
            RequestType = CaseStaffRequestType.TransferAssignment,
            Reason = "Synthetic documented transfer request",
            Status = CaseStaffRequestStatus.Pending
        };

        db.CyberCases.Add(caseItem);
        db.CaseStaffRequests.Add(request);

        await db.SaveChangesAsync();
        db.ChangeTracker.Clear();

        provider = new ServiceCollection().BuildServiceProvider();

        users = new UserManager<ApplicationUser>(
            new UserStore<
                ApplicationUser,
                IdentityRole<Guid>,
                AccpDbContext,
                Guid>(db),
            Options.Create(new IdentityOptions()),
            new PasswordHasher<ApplicationUser>(),
            Array.Empty<IUserValidator<ApplicationUser>>(),
            Array.Empty<IPasswordValidator<ApplicationUser>>(),
            new UpperInvariantLookupNormalizer(),
            new IdentityErrorDescriber(),
            provider,
            NullLogger<UserManager<ApplicationUser>>.Instance);

        service = CreateService(new NotificationService(db));
    }

    public async Task DisposeAsync()
    {
        users.Dispose();
        await provider.DisposeAsync();
        await db.DisposeAsync();
        await connection.DisposeAsync();
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Transfer_RemovesOldAndNewOwnerParticipation_KeepsOthers()
    {
        db.CaseCollaborators.AddRange(
            Collaboration(owner),
            Collaboration(target),
            Collaboration(participant));

        await db.SaveChangesAsync();
        db.ChangeTracker.Clear();

        Assert.True(await ApproveAsync());

        db.ChangeTracker.Clear();

        var persisted = await db.CyberCases.SingleAsync();
        Assert.Equal(target.Id, persisted.AssignedOfficerId);
        Assert.Equal(CaseStatus.InProgress, persisted.Status);

        var collaborations = await db.CaseCollaborators.ToListAsync();

        Assert.False(collaborations.Single(
            item => item.OfficerId == owner.Id).IsActive);

        Assert.False(collaborations.Single(
            item => item.OfficerId == target.Id).IsActive);

        Assert.True(collaborations.Single(
            item => item.OfficerId == participant.Id).IsActive);

        Assert.Equal(
            CaseStaffRequestStatus.Approved,
            (await db.CaseStaffRequests.SingleAsync()).Status);

        Assert.NotEmpty(await db.AuditLogs.ToListAsync());
        Assert.NotEmpty(await db.UserNotifications.ToListAsync());
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("inactive")]
    [InlineData("locked")]
    [InlineData("admin")]
    [InlineData("no-officer-role")]
    public async Task IneligibleTarget_IsRejectedWithoutSideEffects(
        string condition)
    {
        var account = await db.Users.SingleAsync(
            item => item.Id == target.Id);

        switch (condition)
        {
            case "inactive":
                account.IsActive = false;
                break;

            case "locked":
                account.LockoutEnabled = true;
                account.LockoutEnd = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.AddHours(1);
                break;

            case "admin":
                AddRole(target.Id, adminRoleId);
                break;

            case "no-officer-role":
                var membership = await db.UserRoles.SingleAsync(item =>
                    item.UserId == target.Id &&
                    item.RoleId == officerRoleId);

                db.UserRoles.Remove(membership);
                break;
        }

        await db.SaveChangesAsync();
        db.ChangeTracker.Clear();

        Assert.False(await ApproveAsync());

        await AssertUnchangedAsync();
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(CaseStatus.Resolved)]
    [InlineData(CaseStatus.Closed)]
    public async Task FinishedCase_CannotBeTransferred(CaseStatus status)
    {
        var item = await db.CyberCases.SingleAsync();
        item.Status = status;

        await db.SaveChangesAsync();
        db.ChangeTracker.Clear();

        Assert.False(await ApproveAsync());

        await AssertUnchangedAsync();
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task RepeatingApproval_DoesNotDuplicateEffects()
    {
        Assert.True(await ApproveAsync());

        var auditCount = await db.AuditLogs.CountAsync();
        var notificationCount = await db.UserNotifications.CountAsync();

        db.ChangeTracker.Clear();

        Assert.False(await ApproveAsync());

        Assert.Equal(auditCount, await db.AuditLogs.CountAsync());
        Assert.Equal(
            notificationCount,
            await db.UserNotifications.CountAsync());
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task ChangedOwner_RejectsOldPendingRequest()
    {
        var item = await db.CyberCases.SingleAsync();
        item.AssignedOfficerId = participant.Id;
        item.AssignedOfficerEmail = participant.Email;

        await db.SaveChangesAsync();
        db.ChangeTracker.Clear();

        Assert.False(await ApproveAsync());

        Assert.Equal(
            participant.Id,
            (await db.CyberCases.AsNoTracking().SingleAsync())
                .AssignedOfficerId);

        Assert.Equal(
            CaseStaffRequestStatus.Pending,
            (await db.CaseStaffRequests.AsNoTracking().SingleAsync())
                .Status);

        Assert.Empty(await db.AuditLogs.ToListAsync());
        Assert.Empty(await db.UserNotifications.ToListAsync());
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task AdminRead_ReturnsMetadataWithoutComplaintContent()
    {
        var rows = await service.GetForAdminAsync();

        var row = Assert.Single(rows);

        Assert.Equal(caseItem.CaseNumber, row.CyberCase.CaseNumber);
        Assert.Equal(owner.Id, row.CyberCase.AssignedOfficerId);

        Assert.True(string.IsNullOrEmpty(row.CyberCase.Title));
        Assert.True(string.IsNullOrEmpty(row.CyberCase.Description));
        Assert.Null(row.CyberCase.ReporterId);
        Assert.Null(row.CyberCase.DisclosedReporterName);
        Assert.Null(row.CyberCase.DisclosedReporterEmail);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task NotificationFailure_RollsBackTransferAndParticipation()
    {
        db.CaseCollaborators.Add(Collaboration(owner));
        await db.SaveChangesAsync();
        db.ChangeTracker.Clear();

        service = CreateService(
            new FailingNotifications(new NotificationService(db)));

        await Assert.ThrowsAsync<InjectedFailure>(
            async () => { await ApproveAsync(); });

        await AssertUnchangedAsync();

        var collaboration = await db.CaseCollaborators
            .AsNoTracking()
            .SingleAsync();

        Assert.True(collaboration.IsActive);
        Assert.Null(collaboration.RemovedAtUtc);
    }

    private Task<bool> ApproveAsync() =>
        service.ApproveForAdminAsync(
            request.Id,
            target.Id,
            admin.Id,
            admin.Email!,
            "Synthetic administrative approval");

    private CaseStaffRequestService CreateService(
        INotificationService notifications) =>
        new(db, users, notifications, new AuditService(db));

    private async Task AssertUnchangedAsync()
    {
        db.ChangeTracker.Clear();

        Assert.Equal(
            owner.Id,
            (await db.CyberCases.AsNoTracking().SingleAsync())
                .AssignedOfficerId);

        Assert.Equal(
            CaseStaffRequestStatus.Pending,
            (await db.CaseStaffRequests.AsNoTracking().SingleAsync())
                .Status);

        Assert.Empty(await db.AuditLogs.ToListAsync());
        Assert.Empty(await db.UserNotifications.ToListAsync());
    }

    private void AddRole(Guid userId, Guid roleId) =>
        db.UserRoles.Add(new IdentityUserRole<Guid>
        {
            UserId = userId,
            RoleId = roleId
        });

    private static ApplicationUser NewUser(string name) =>
        new()
        {
            Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
            UserName = name,
            NormalizedUserName = name.ToUpperInvariant(),
            Email = $"{name}@example.test",
            NormalizedEmail = $"{name}@example.test".ToUpperInvariant(),
            FullName = name,
            IsActive = true,
            SecurityStamp = Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N")
        };

    private CaseCollaborator Collaboration(ApplicationUser user) =>
        new()
        {
            CyberCaseId = caseItem.Id,
            OfficerId = user.Id,
            OfficerEmail = user.Email!,
            SourceRequestId = Guid.NewGuid(),
            AddedByAdminId = admin.Id,
            AddedByAdminEmail = admin.Email!,
            IsActive = true
        };

    private sealed class InjectedFailure : Exception
    {
    }

    private sealed class FailingNotifications(
        INotificationService inner) : INotificationService
    {
        public async Task<UserNotification> CreateAsync(
            Guid recipientUserId,
            Guid? cyberCaseId,
            NotificationType type,
            string title,
            string message)
        {
            await inner.CreateAsync(
                recipientUserId,
                cyberCaseId,
                type,
                title,
                message);

            throw new InjectedFailure();
        }

        public Task<List<UserNotification>> GetForUserAsync(Guid id) =>
            inner.GetForUserAsync(id);

        public Task<int> GetUnreadCountAsync(Guid id) =>
            inner.GetUnreadCountAsync(id);

        public Task<bool> MarkAsReadAsync(Guid id, Guid userId) =>
            inner.MarkAsReadAsync(id, userId);

        public Task<int> MarkAllAsReadAsync(Guid userId) =>
            inner.MarkAllAsReadAsync(userId);
    }

    private sealed class TestContext(
        DbContextOptions<AccpDbContext> options) : AccpDbContext(options)
    {
        protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder builder)
        {
            base.OnModelCreating(builder);

            // SQLite لا يولّد SQL Server rowversion.
            builder.Entity<CaseCollaborator>()
                .Property(item => item.RowVersion)
                .IsRequired()
                .ValueGeneratedNever();

            builder.Entity<CaseStaffRequest>()
                .Property(item => item.RowVersion)
                .IsRequired()
                .ValueGeneratedNever();
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using ACCP.Application.Auditing;
using ACCP.Application.Notifications;
using ACCP.Domain.Entities;
using ACCP.Domain.Enums;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Data;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Identity;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Services;
using Microsoft.Data.Sqlite;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace ACCP.Tests;

// Each test gets its own in-memory database and synthetic users.
public sealed class CaseServiceTests : IAsyncLifetime
{
    private readonly SqliteConnection _connection = new("Data Source=:memory:");
    private AccpDbContext _db = null!;
    private AuditService _audit = null!;
    private NotificationService _notifications = null!;
    private CaseService _service = null!;
    private ApplicationUser _reporter = null!;
    private ApplicationUser _owner = null!;
    private ApplicationUser _collaborator = null!;
    private ApplicationUser _formerCollaborator = null!;
    private Guid _caseId;

    public async Task InitializeAsync()
    {
        await _connection.OpenAsync();
        var options = new DbContextOptionsBuilder<AccpDbContext>()
            .UseSqlite(_connection).Options;
        _db = new SqliteCaseTestContext(options);
        await _db.Database.EnsureCreatedAsync();

        _reporter = NewUser("reporter");
        _reporter.FullName = "Synthetic Reporter";
        _owner = NewUser("owner");
        _collaborator = NewUser("collaborator");
        _formerCollaborator = NewUser("former");
        _db.Users.AddRange(_reporter, _owner, _collaborator, _formerCollaborator);

        var item = NewCase();
        item.ReporterId = _reporter.Id;
        item.AssignedOfficerId = _owner.Id;
        item.AssignedOfficerEmail = _owner.Email;
        item.Status = CaseStatus.Assigned;
        _caseId = item.Id;
        _db.CyberCases.Add(item);
        _db.CaseCollaborators.Add(NewCollaborator(_collaborator, true));
        _db.CaseCollaborators.Add(NewCollaborator(_formerCollaborator, false));
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
        _db.ChangeTracker.Clear();

        _audit = new AuditService(_db);
        _notifications = new NotificationService(_db);
        _service = new CaseService(_db, _audit, _notifications);
    }

    public async Task DisposeAsync()
    {
        if (_db is not null)
        {
            await _db.DisposeAsync();
        }
        await _connection.DisposeAsync();
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task ActiveCollaborator_Note_SavesLinkedAuditWithoutNoteContent()
    {
        const string content = "Synthetic private note content";
        var note = await _service.AddInternalNoteForOfficerAsync(
            _caseId, content, _collaborator.Id, _collaborator.Email!);

        Assert.NotNull(note);
        Assert.True(await _db.CaseNotes.AnyAsync(item => item.Id == note.Id));
        var log = await _db.AuditLogs.SingleAsync();
        Assert.Equal(AuditAction.InternalNoteAdded, log.Action);
        Assert.Equal(note.Id, log.EntityId);
        Assert.Equal(_caseId, log.CyberCaseId);
        Assert.Equal(_collaborator.Id, log.ActorUserId);
        Assert.Equal("OFFICER", log.ActorRole);
        Assert.DoesNotContain(content, log.Description);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task InactiveCollaborator_CannotAddNotesOrSendMessages()
    {
        var before = await ReadCountsAsync();
        Assert.Null(await _service.AddInternalNoteForOfficerAsync(
            _caseId, "Denied note", _formerCollaborator.Id, _formerCollaborator.Email!));
        Assert.Null(await _service.SendMessageByOfficerAsync(
            _caseId, "Denied message", _formerCollaborator.Id, _formerCollaborator.Email!));
        Assert.Equal(before, await ReadCountsAsync());
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task ReporterMessage_AuditsAndNotifiesOnlyDistinctActiveStaff()
    {
        // Listing the owner as a collaborator must not duplicate the notification.
        _db.CaseCollaborators.Add(NewCollaborator(_owner, true));
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
        _db.ChangeTracker.Clear();

        var message = await _service.SendMessageByReporterAsync(
            _caseId, "Synthetic reporter message", _reporter.Id, _reporter.Email!);

        Assert.NotNull(message);
        var recipients = await _db.UserNotifications
            .Select(notification => notification.RecipientUserId).ToListAsync();
        Assert.Equal(2, recipients.Count);
        Assert.Contains(_owner.Id, recipients);
        Assert.Contains(_collaborator.Id, recipients);
        Assert.DoesNotContain(_formerCollaborator.Id, recipients);
        var log = await _db.AuditLogs.SingleAsync();
        Assert.Equal(AuditAction.CaseMessageSent, log.Action);
        Assert.Equal(message.Id, log.EntityId);
        Assert.Equal(_reporter.Id, log.ActorUserId);
        Assert.Equal("USER", log.ActorRole);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task CollaboratorMessage_AuditsAndNotifiesTheReporter()
    {
        var message = await _service.SendMessageByOfficerAsync(
            _caseId, "Synthetic collaborator message", _collaborator.Id, _collaborator.Email!);

        Assert.NotNull(message);
        var notification = await _db.UserNotifications.SingleAsync();
        Assert.Equal(_reporter.Id, notification.RecipientUserId);
        Assert.Equal(NotificationType.NewMessage, notification.Type);
        var log = await _db.AuditLogs.SingleAsync();
        Assert.Equal(AuditAction.CaseMessageSent, log.Action);
        Assert.Equal(message.Id, log.EntityId);
        Assert.Equal(_collaborator.Id, log.ActorUserId);
        Assert.Equal("OFFICER", log.ActorRole);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task AnotherUser_CannotDiscloseReporterIdentity()
    {
        var before = await ReadCountsAsync();
        Assert.False(await _service.DiscloseReporterIdentityAsync(
            _caseId, _formerCollaborator.Id));
        var item = await _db.CyberCases.AsNoTracking().SingleAsync();
        Assert.False(item.IsReporterIdentityDisclosed);
        Assert.Null(item.DisclosedReporterEmail);
        Assert.Equal(before, await ReadCountsAsync());
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task RepeatedReporterConsent_CreatesExactlyOneDisclosureAudit()
    {
        Assert.True(await _service.DiscloseReporterIdentityAsync(_caseId, _reporter.Id));
        Assert.True(await _service.DiscloseReporterIdentityAsync(_caseId, _reporter.Id));

        var item = await _db.CyberCases.AsNoTracking().SingleAsync();
        Assert.True(item.IsReporterIdentityDisclosed);
        Assert.Equal(_reporter.FullName, item.DisclosedReporterName);
        Assert.Equal(_reporter.Email, item.DisclosedReporterEmail);
        Assert.NotNull(item.ReporterIdentityDisclosedAtUtc);
        var log = await _db.AuditLogs.SingleAsync();
        Assert.Equal(AuditAction.ReporterIdentityDisclosed, log.Action);
        Assert.Equal(_reporter.Id, log.ActorUserId);
        Assert.Equal(_caseId, log.EntityId);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task FailedMessageNotification_RollsBackMessageAuditAndNotification()
    {
        var service = new CaseService(_db, _audit,
            new FailingNotificationService(_notifications));
        var before = await ReadCountsAsync();

        await Assert.ThrowsAsync<InjectedFailureException>(() =>
            service.SendMessageByOfficerAsync(
                _caseId, "Must roll back", _collaborator.Id, _collaborator.Email!));

        Assert.Equal(before, await ReadCountsAsync());
        Assert.False(_db.ChangeTracker.HasChanges());
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task FailedNoteAudit_RollsBackTheNoteAndAudit()
    {
        var service = new CaseService(_db,
            new FailingAuditService(_audit), _notifications);
        var before = await ReadCountsAsync();

        await Assert.ThrowsAsync<InjectedFailureException>(() =>
            service.AddInternalNoteForOfficerAsync(
                _caseId, "Must roll back", _collaborator.Id, _collaborator.Email!));

        Assert.Equal(before, await ReadCountsAsync());
        Assert.False(_db.ChangeTracker.HasChanges());
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task CreateCase_PersistsCaseAndMatchingAudit()
    {
        var item = await _service.CreateForReporterAsync(NewCase(), _reporter.Id);

        Assert.True(await _db.CyberCases.AnyAsync(current =>
            current.Id == item.Id && current.ReporterId == _reporter.Id));
        var log = await _db.AuditLogs.SingleAsync();
        Assert.Equal(AuditAction.CaseCreated, log.Action);
        Assert.Equal(item.Id, log.EntityId);
        Assert.Equal(item.Id, log.CyberCaseId);
        Assert.Equal(_reporter.Id, log.ActorUserId);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task CreatedCases_GetDistinctNumbersWithinStorageLimit()
    {
        var first = await _service.CreateForReporterAsync(NewCase(), _reporter.Id);
        var second = await _service.CreateForReporterAsync(NewCase(), _reporter.Id);

        Assert.False(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(first.CaseNumber));
        Assert.False(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(second.CaseNumber));
        Assert.NotEqual(first.CaseNumber, second.CaseNumber);
        Assert.InRange(first.CaseNumber.Length, 1, 50);
        Assert.InRange(second.CaseNumber.Length, 1, 50);

        var persistedNumbers = await _db.CyberCases.AsNoTracking()
            .Where(item => item.Id == first.Id || item.Id == second.Id)
            .Select(item => item.CaseNumber).ToListAsync();
        Assert.Equal(2, persistedNumbers.Count);
        Assert.Contains(first.CaseNumber, persistedNumbers);
        Assert.Contains(second.CaseNumber, persistedNumbers);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task DuplicateCaseNumber_RejectsCreationWithoutPartialEffects()
    {
        var first = NewCase();
        first.CaseNumber = "ACCP-SYNTHETIC-DUPLICATE";
        await _service.CreateForReporterAsync(first, _reporter.Id);
        var before = await ReadCountsAsync();

        var duplicate = NewCase();
        duplicate.CaseNumber = first.CaseNumber;
        var failure = await Assert.ThrowsAsync<DbUpdateException>(() =>
            _service.CreateForReporterAsync(duplicate, _reporter.Id));

        // SQLite's extended code 2067 identifies a UNIQUE constraint violation.
        var databaseFailure = Assert.IsType<SqliteException>(failure.InnerException);
        Assert.Equal(2067, databaseFailure.SqliteExtendedErrorCode);
        Assert.Equal(before, await ReadCountsAsync());
        Assert.False(_db.ChangeTracker.HasChanges());
        Assert.False(await _db.CyberCases.AnyAsync(item => item.Id == duplicate.Id));
        Assert.Equal(1, await _db.CyberCases.CountAsync(item =>
            item.CaseNumber == first.CaseNumber));
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task FailedCreationAudit_RollsBackTheCaseAndAudit()
    {
        var service = new CaseService(_db,
            new FailingAuditService(_audit), _notifications);
        var before = await ReadCountsAsync();

        await Assert.ThrowsAsync<InjectedFailureException>(() =>
            service.CreateForReporterAsync(NewCase(), _reporter.Id));

        Assert.Equal(before, await ReadCountsAsync());
        Assert.False(_db.ChangeTracker.HasChanges());
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task StatusChange_SavesStateHistoryAuditAndNotification()
    {
        Assert.True(await _service.UpdateStatusForOfficerAsync(
            _caseId, CaseStatus.InProgress, _owner.Id, _owner.Email!));

        var item = await _db.CyberCases.AsNoTracking().SingleAsync();
        Assert.Equal(CaseStatus.InProgress, item.Status);
        var history = await _db.CaseStatusHistories.SingleAsync();
        Assert.Equal(CaseStatus.Assigned, history.OldStatus);
        Assert.Equal(CaseStatus.InProgress, history.NewStatus);
        Assert.Equal(_owner.Id, history.ChangedByUserId);
        var log = await _db.AuditLogs.SingleAsync();
        Assert.Equal(AuditAction.CaseStatusChanged, log.Action);
        Assert.Equal(_caseId, log.EntityId);
        var notification = await _db.UserNotifications.SingleAsync();
        Assert.Equal(_reporter.Id, notification.RecipientUserId);
        Assert.Equal(NotificationType.CaseStatusChanged, notification.Type);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task RepeatedIdenticalStatus_DoesNotDuplicateHistoryAuditOrNotifications()
    {
        Assert.True(await _service.UpdateStatusForOfficerAsync(
            _caseId, CaseStatus.InProgress, _owner.Id, _owner.Email!));
        var before = await ReadCountsAsync();

        Assert.True(await _service.UpdateStatusForOfficerAsync(
            _caseId, CaseStatus.InProgress, _owner.Id, _owner.Email!));

        Assert.Equal(before, await ReadCountsAsync());
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task StatusChange_RejectsCollaboratorsAndUndefinedEnumValues()
    {
        var before = await ReadCountsAsync();
        Assert.False(await _service.UpdateStatusForOfficerAsync(
            _caseId, CaseStatus.Resolved, _collaborator.Id, _collaborator.Email!));
        Assert.False(await _service.UpdateStatusForOfficerAsync(
            _caseId, (CaseStatus)999, _owner.Id, _owner.Email!));

        var item = await _db.CyberCases.AsNoTracking().SingleAsync();
        Assert.Equal(CaseStatus.Assigned, item.Status);
        Assert.Equal(before, await ReadCountsAsync());
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task FailedStatusNotification_RollsBackStateHistoryAuditAndNotification()
    {
        var service = new CaseService(_db, _audit,
            new FailingNotificationService(_notifications));
        var before = await ReadCountsAsync();

        await Assert.ThrowsAsync<InjectedFailureException>(() =>
            service.UpdateStatusForOfficerAsync(
                _caseId, CaseStatus.InProgress, _owner.Id, _owner.Email!));

        var item = await _db.CyberCases.AsNoTracking().SingleAsync();
        Assert.Equal(CaseStatus.Assigned, item.Status);
        Assert.Equal(before, await ReadCountsAsync());
        Assert.False(_db.ChangeTracker.HasChanges());
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Assignment_KeepsOneOwnerAndDoesNotDuplicateEffectsOnRetry()
    {
        var item = await _service.CreateForReporterAsync(NewCase(), _reporter.Id);
        Assert.True(await _service.AssignToOfficerAsync(item.Id, _owner.Id, _owner.Email!));
        var before = await ReadCountsAsync();

        Assert.True(await _service.AssignToOfficerAsync(item.Id, _owner.Id, _owner.Email!));
        Assert.False(await _service.AssignToOfficerAsync(
            item.Id, _collaborator.Id, _collaborator.Email!));

        var persisted = await _db.CyberCases.AsNoTracking().SingleAsync(current => current.Id == item.Id);
        Assert.Equal(_owner.Id, persisted.AssignedOfficerId);
        Assert.Equal(CaseStatus.Assigned, persisted.Status);
        Assert.Equal(before, await ReadCountsAsync());
        Assert.Equal(1, await _db.AuditLogs.CountAsync(log =>
            log.Action == AuditAction.CaseAssigned && log.EntityId == item.Id));
        Assert.Equal(1, await _db.UserNotifications.CountAsync(notification =>
            notification.CyberCaseId == item.Id && notification.Type == NotificationType.CaseAssigned));
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task FailedAssignmentNotification_RollsBackClaimHistoryAuditAndNotification()
    {
        var item = await _service.CreateForReporterAsync(NewCase(), _reporter.Id);
        var service = new CaseService(_db, _audit,
            new FailingNotificationService(_notifications));
        var before = await ReadCountsAsync();

        await Assert.ThrowsAsync<InjectedFailureException>(() =>
            service.AssignToOfficerAsync(item.Id, _owner.Id, _owner.Email!));

        var persisted = await _db.CyberCases.AsNoTracking().SingleAsync(current => current.Id == item.Id);
        Assert.Null(persisted.AssignedOfficerId);
        Assert.Null(persisted.AssignedAtUtc);
        Assert.Equal(CaseStatus.New, persisted.Status);
        Assert.Equal(before, await ReadCountsAsync());
        Assert.False(_db.ChangeTracker.HasChanges());
    }

    private static ApplicationUser NewUser(string name) => new()
    {
        Id = Guid.NewGuid(), UserName = name, Email = name + "@example.test"
    };

    private static CyberCase NewCase() => new()
    {
        Title = "Synthetic test case",
        Description = "Synthetic incident description for service tests.",
        IncidentType = "Blackmail"
    };

    private CaseCollaborator NewCollaborator(ApplicationUser user, bool active) => new()
    {
        CyberCaseId = _caseId,
        OfficerId = user.Id,
        OfficerEmail = user.Email!,
        AddedByAdminId = Guid.NewGuid(),
        AddedByAdminEmail = "admin@example.test",
        SourceRequestId = Guid.NewGuid(),
        IsActive = active
    };

    [Fact]
    public async Task StatusChange_RejectsSkippingAssignedToResolved()
    {
        var before = await ReadCountsAsync();

        Assert.False(await _service.UpdateStatusForOfficerAsync(
            _caseId, CaseStatus.Resolved, _owner.Id, _owner.Email!, "Documented status change reason"));

        Assert.Equal(CaseStatus.Assigned,
            (await _db.CyberCases.AsNoTracking().SingleAsync()).Status);
        Assert.Equal(before, await ReadCountsAsync());
        Assert.False(_db.ChangeTracker.HasChanges());
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task StatusChange_RejectsBackwardMoveFromInProgress()
    {
        Assert.True(await _service.UpdateStatusForOfficerAsync(
            _caseId, CaseStatus.InProgress, _owner.Id, _owner.Email!));
        var before = await ReadCountsAsync();

        Assert.False(await _service.UpdateStatusForOfficerAsync(
            _caseId, CaseStatus.Assigned, _owner.Id, _owner.Email!));

        Assert.Equal(CaseStatus.InProgress,
            (await _db.CyberCases.AsNoTracking().SingleAsync()).Status);
        Assert.Equal(before, await ReadCountsAsync());
        Assert.False(_db.ChangeTracker.HasChanges());
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task StatusChange_ClosedCaseCannotBeReopenedByOfficer()
    {
        await _db.CyberCases.Where(item => item.Id == _caseId)
            .ExecuteUpdateAsync(setters => setters
                .SetProperty(item => item.Status, CaseStatus.Closed));
        var before = await ReadCountsAsync();

        Assert.False(await _service.UpdateStatusForOfficerAsync(
            _caseId, CaseStatus.InProgress, _owner.Id, _owner.Email!));

        Assert.Equal(CaseStatus.Closed,
            (await _db.CyberCases.AsNoTracking().SingleAsync()).Status);
        Assert.Equal(before, await ReadCountsAsync());
        Assert.False(_db.ChangeTracker.HasChanges());
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task StatusChange_AllowedChainRecordsEveryTransition()
    {
        Assert.True(await _service.UpdateStatusForOfficerAsync(
            _caseId, CaseStatus.InProgress, _owner.Id, _owner.Email!));
        Assert.True(await _service.UpdateStatusForOfficerAsync(
            _caseId, CaseStatus.Resolved, _owner.Id, _owner.Email!, "Documented status change reason"));
        Assert.True(await _service.UpdateStatusForOfficerAsync(
            _caseId, CaseStatus.Closed, _owner.Id, _owner.Email!, "Documented status change reason"));

        Assert.Equal(CaseStatus.Closed,
            (await _db.CyberCases.AsNoTracking().SingleAsync()).Status);
        var history = await _db.CaseStatusHistories.AsNoTracking().ToListAsync();
        Assert.Equal(3, history.Count);
        Assert.Contains(history, item => item.OldStatus == CaseStatus.Assigned &&
            item.NewStatus == CaseStatus.InProgress);
        Assert.Contains(history, item => item.OldStatus == CaseStatus.InProgress &&
            item.NewStatus == CaseStatus.Resolved);
        Assert.Contains(history, item => item.OldStatus == CaseStatus.Resolved &&
            item.NewStatus == CaseStatus.Closed);
        Assert.Equal(3, await _db.AuditLogs.CountAsync(
            item => item.Action == AuditAction.CaseStatusChanged));
        Assert.Equal(3, await _db.UserNotifications.CountAsync(
            item => item.Type == NotificationType.CaseStatusChanged));

        var beforeRetry = await ReadCountsAsync();
        Assert.True(await _service.UpdateStatusForOfficerAsync(
            _caseId, CaseStatus.Closed, _owner.Id, _owner.Email!, "Documented status change reason"));
        Assert.Equal(beforeRetry, await ReadCountsAsync());
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(CaseStatus.Resolved, null)]
    [InlineData(CaseStatus.Resolved, "   ")]
    [InlineData(CaseStatus.Resolved, "short")]
    [InlineData(CaseStatus.Closed, null)]
    [InlineData(CaseStatus.Closed, "   ")]
    [InlineData(CaseStatus.Closed, "short")]
    public async Task StatusReason_TerminalChangeRejectsMissingOrShortReason(
        CaseStatus target, string? reason)
    {
        Assert.True(await _service.UpdateStatusForOfficerAsync(
            _caseId, CaseStatus.InProgress, _owner.Id, _owner.Email!));
        var before = await ReadCountsAsync();
        Assert.False(await _service.UpdateStatusForOfficerAsync(
            _caseId, target, _owner.Id, _owner.Email!, reason));
        Assert.Equal(CaseStatus.InProgress,
            (await _db.CyberCases.AsNoTracking().SingleAsync()).Status);
        Assert.Equal(before, await ReadCountsAsync());
        Assert.False(_db.ChangeTracker.HasChanges());
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task StatusReason_RejectsOverlongReasonWithoutSideEffects()
    {
        Assert.True(await _service.UpdateStatusForOfficerAsync(
            _caseId, CaseStatus.InProgress, _owner.Id, _owner.Email!));
        var before = await ReadCountsAsync();
        Assert.False(await _service.UpdateStatusForOfficerAsync(
            _caseId, CaseStatus.Closed, _owner.Id, _owner.Email!, new string('x', 1001)));
        Assert.Equal(CaseStatus.InProgress,
            (await _db.CyberCases.AsNoTracking().SingleAsync()).Status);
        Assert.Equal(before, await ReadCountsAsync());
        Assert.False(_db.ChangeTracker.HasChanges());
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(CaseStatus.Resolved, 10)]
    [InlineData(CaseStatus.Closed, 1000)]
    public async Task StatusReason_SavesTrimmedReasonAndRetryDoesNotReplaceIt(
        CaseStatus target, int length)
    {
        Assert.True(await _service.UpdateStatusForOfficerAsync(
            _caseId, CaseStatus.InProgress, _owner.Id, _owner.Email!));
        string reason = new string('x', length);
        Assert.True(await _service.UpdateStatusForOfficerAsync(
            _caseId, target, _owner.Id, _owner.Email!, "  " + reason + "  "));
        var history = await _db.CaseStatusHistories.AsNoTracking()
            .SingleAsync(item => item.NewStatus == target);
        Assert.Equal(reason, history.Reason);
        var before = await ReadCountsAsync();
        Assert.True(await _service.UpdateStatusForOfficerAsync(
            _caseId, target, _owner.Id, _owner.Email!, "A different retry reason"));
        Assert.Equal(before, await ReadCountsAsync());
        Assert.Equal(reason, (await _db.CaseStatusHistories.AsNoTracking()
            .SingleAsync(item => item.Id == history.Id)).Reason);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task StatusReason_NotificationFailureRollsBackTerminalChangeAndReason()
    {
        Assert.True(await _service.UpdateStatusForOfficerAsync(
            _caseId, CaseStatus.InProgress, _owner.Id, _owner.Email!));
        var before = await ReadCountsAsync();
        var service = new CaseService(_db, _audit,
            new FailingNotificationService(_notifications));
        await Assert.ThrowsAsync<InjectedFailureException>(() =>
            service.UpdateStatusForOfficerAsync(
                _caseId, CaseStatus.Resolved, _owner.Id, _owner.Email!,
                "A documented resolution reason"));
        Assert.Equal(CaseStatus.InProgress,
            (await _db.CyberCases.AsNoTracking().SingleAsync()).Status);
        Assert.Equal(before, await ReadCountsAsync());
        Assert.False(await _db.CaseStatusHistories.AnyAsync(
            item => item.NewStatus == CaseStatus.Resolved));
        Assert.False(_db.ChangeTracker.HasChanges());
    }

    private async Task<(int Cases, int Notes, int Messages, int History, int Audits, int Notifications)> ReadCountsAsync() =>
        (await _db.CyberCases.CountAsync(),
         await _db.CaseNotes.CountAsync(),
         await _db.CaseMessages.CountAsync(),
         await _db.CaseStatusHistories.CountAsync(),
         await _db.AuditLogs.CountAsync(),
         await _db.UserNotifications.CountAsync());

    private sealed class SqliteCaseTestContext : AccpDbContext
    {
        public SqliteCaseTestContext(DbContextOptions<AccpDbContext> options) : base(options) { }

        protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder builder)
        {
            base.OnModelCreating(builder);
            // Only this test context uses SQLite. SQL Server generates the real rowversion.
            builder.Entity<CaseCollaborator>()
                .Property(item => item.RowVersion).ValueGeneratedNever();
        }
    }

    private sealed class InjectedFailureException : Exception { }

    // Deliberately fail AFTER the real save to prove the transaction rolls it back.
    private sealed class FailingNotificationService : INotificationService
    {
        private readonly INotificationService _inner;
        public FailingNotificationService(INotificationService inner) => _inner = inner;

        public async Task<UserNotification> CreateAsync(Guid recipientUserId, Guid? cyberCaseId,
            NotificationType type, string title, string message)
        {
            await _inner.CreateAsync(recipientUserId, cyberCaseId, type, title, message);
            throw new InjectedFailureException();
        }

        public Task<List<UserNotification>> GetForUserAsync(Guid id) => _inner.GetForUserAsync(id);
        public Task<int> GetUnreadCountAsync(Guid id) => _inner.GetUnreadCountAsync(id);
        public Task<bool> MarkAsReadAsync(Guid id, Guid user) => _inner.MarkAsReadAsync(id, user);
        public Task<int> MarkAllAsReadAsync(Guid user) => _inner.MarkAllAsReadAsync(user);
    }

    private sealed class FailingAuditService : IAuditService
    {
        private readonly IAuditService _inner;
        public FailingAuditService(IAuditService inner) => _inner = inner;

        public async Task<AuditLog> WriteAsync(AuditLogRequest request,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            await _inner.WriteAsync(request, cancellationToken);
            throw new InjectedFailureException();
        }

        public Task<IReadOnlyList<AuditLog>> GetLatestAsync(int take = 200,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) =>
            _inner.GetLatestAsync(take, cancellationToken);

        public Task<IReadOnlyList<AuditLog>> GetForCaseAsync(Guid id, int take = 200,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) =>
            _inner.GetForCaseAsync(id, take, cancellationToken);

        public Task<IReadOnlyList<AuditLog>> SearchAsync(string? searchTerm = null,
            AuditAction? action = null, bool? isSuccessful = null, int take = 500,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) =>
            _inner.SearchAsync(searchTerm, action, isSuccessful, take, cancellationToken);
    }
}
````

````css
.app-shell {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 17.5rem minmax(0, 1fr);
    min-height: 100vh;
    min-height: 100dvh;
    background: var(--accp-canvas, #f4f7fb);
}
.app-sidebar {
    position: sticky;
    top: 0;
    align-self: start;
    height: 100vh;
    height: 100dvh;
    background: #13243a;
    color: #fff;
    z-index: 30;
}
.app-frame { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; }
.workspace-header {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 1rem;
    padding: 1.05rem 2rem;
    min-height: 5.25rem;
    background: #fff;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--accp-border, #e0e7ef);
}
.workspace-title { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: .12rem; min-width: 0; }
.workspace-kicker { color: var(--accp-muted, #617087); font-size: .78rem; }
.workspace-heading { font-weight: 700; font-size: 1rem; color: #1d3049; }
.workspace-mark {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    min-height: 2.25rem;
    padding: .35rem .85rem;
    border: 1px solid #d7e8e3;
    border-radius: .65rem;
    color: #146c60;
    background: #f0f8f5;
    font: 700 .8rem/1.3 "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
    letter-spacing: .08em;
}
.content-region {
    flex: 1;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 1500px;
    margin-inline: auto;
    padding: 2rem;
    min-width: 0;
}
.content-region ::deep > .container { padding-inline: 0; max-width: 100%; }
.workspace-footer {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 1rem;
    padding: 1rem 2rem;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--accp-border, #e0e7ef);
    color: var(--accp-muted, #617087);
    font-size: .78rem;
}
.skip-link {
    position: fixed;
    inset-inline-start: 1rem;
    top: -10rem;
    z-index: 2000;
    padding: .7rem 1rem;
    color: #fff;
    background: #125f54;
    border-radius: .5rem;
}
.skip-link:focus { top: 1rem; }
#blazor-error-ui {
    display: none;
    position: fixed;
    inset-inline: 1rem;
    bottom: 1rem;
    z-index: 1500;
    padding: 1rem 1rem 1rem 3rem;
    background: #fff5df;
    color: #573c13;
    border: 1px solid #e8ca89;
    border-radius: .75rem;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 32px #13243a20;
}
#blazor-error-ui .reload { margin-inline-start: .65rem; font-weight: 700; color: #573c13; }
#blazor-error-ui .dismiss {
    position: absolute;
    inset-inline-end: .6rem;
    top: .55rem;
    width: 2rem;
    height: 2rem;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: .4rem;
    color: inherit;
    background: transparent;
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    line-height: 1;
    cursor: pointer;
}
@media (max-width: 991.98px) {
    .app-shell { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
    .app-sidebar { position: relative; height: auto; }
    .workspace-header { padding: 1rem 1.25rem; min-height: 4.6rem; }
    .content-region { padding: 1.25rem; }
    .workspace-footer { padding: 1rem 1.25rem; }
}
@media (max-width: 479.98px) {
    .workspace-header { padding: .85rem 1rem; }
    .workspace-heading { font-size: .88rem; }
    .workspace-mark { display: none; }
    .content-region { padding: 1rem; }
    .workspace-footer { flex-wrap: wrap; padding-inline: 1rem; }
}
````

````razor
@rendermode InteractiveServer
@using System.Security.Claims
@using ACCP.Application.Notifications
@using ACCP.Web.Security
@using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Authorization
@using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Routing
@implements IDisposable

@inject INotificationService NotificationService
@inject AuthenticationStateProvider AuthenticationStateProvider
@inject NavigationManager NavigationManager

<div class="navigation-shell">
    <div class="navigation-brand">
        <a href="/"
           class="brand-link"
           aria-label="ACCP — الصفحة الرئيسية">
            <span class="brand-emblem" aria-hidden="true">
                <svg width="24"
                     height="24"
                     viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                     fill="none"
                     stroke="currentColor"
                     stroke-width="1.7">
                    <path d="M12 3 4 6v6c0 4 4 7 8 9 4-2 8-5 8-9V6l-8-3Z" />
                    <path d="m8.5 12 2.3 2.3 4.7-5" />
                </svg>
            </span>

            <span class="brand-copy">
                <strong dir="ltr">ACCP</strong>
                <span>منصة متابعة البلاغات</span>
            </span>
        </a>
    </div>

    <input type="checkbox"
           id="accp-menu-toggle"
           class="menu-toggle"
           aria-label="فتح قائمة التنقل أو إغلاقها"
           aria-controls="accp-navigation"
           @bind="menuOpen" />

    <label for="accp-menu-toggle" class="menu-trigger">
        <span class="menu-icon icon-menu" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        <span>القائمة</span>
    </label>

    <div id="accp-navigation" class="navigation-panel">
        <nav class="navigation-links"
             aria-label="التنقل بين صفحات المنصة"
             @onclick="CloseMenu">

            <span class="navigation-section">التنقل الرئيسي</span>

            <NavLink class="menu-link"
                     href="/"
                     Match="NavLinkMatch.All">
                <span class="menu-icon icon-home" aria-hidden="true"></span>
                <span>الصفحة الرئيسية</span>
            </NavLink>

            <AuthorizeView>
                <Authorized Context="signedInState">
                    <AuthorizeView Roles="USER" Context="userRoleState">
                        <Authorized>
                            <span class="navigation-section">
                                مساحة المشتكي
                            </span>

                            <NavLink class="menu-link"
                                     href="/cases"
                                     Match="NavLinkMatch.All">
                                <span class="menu-icon icon-cases"
                                      aria-hidden="true"></span>
                                <span>طلباتي وبلاغاتي</span>
                            </NavLink>

                            <NavLink class="menu-link"
                                     href="/cases/new"
                                     Match="NavLinkMatch.All">
                                <span class="menu-icon icon-plus"
                                      aria-hidden="true"></span>
                                <span>محادثة جديدة</span>
                            </NavLink>
                        </Authorized>
                    </AuthorizeView>

                    <AuthorizeView Roles="OFFICER" Context="officerRoleState">
                        <Authorized>
                            <span class="navigation-section">
                                مساحة الموظف
                            </span>

                            <NavLink class="menu-link"
                                     href="/officer/dashboard"
                                     Match="NavLinkMatch.Prefix">
                                <span class="menu-icon icon-dashboard"
                                      aria-hidden="true"></span>
                                <span>لوحة الموظف</span>
                            </NavLink>
                        </Authorized>
                    </AuthorizeView>

                    <AuthorizeView Roles="ADMIN" Context="adminRoleState">
                        <Authorized>
                            <span class="navigation-section">
                                إدارة المنصة
                            </span>

                            <NavLink class="menu-link"
                                     href="/admin/employees"
                                     Match="NavLinkMatch.Prefix">
                                <span class="menu-icon icon-people"
                                      aria-hidden="true"></span>
                                <span>إدارة الموظفين</span>
                            </NavLink>

                            <NavLink class="menu-link"
                                     href="/admin/workload"
                                     Match="NavLinkMatch.Prefix">
                                <span class="menu-icon icon-dashboard"
                                      aria-hidden="true"></span>
                                <span>توزيع القضايا</span>
                            </NavLink>

                            <NavLink class="menu-link"
                                     href="/admin/case-reopening"
                                     Match="NavLinkMatch.Prefix">
                                <span class="menu-icon icon-reopen"
                                      aria-hidden="true"></span>
                                <span>إعادة فتح القضايا</span>
                            </NavLink>

                            <NavLink class="menu-link"
                                     href="/admin/staff-requests"
                                     Match="NavLinkMatch.Prefix">
                                <span class="menu-icon icon-request"
                                      aria-hidden="true"></span>
                                <span>طلبات الموظفين</span>
                            </NavLink>

                            <NavLink class="menu-link"
                                     href="/admin/audit-logs"
                                     Match="NavLinkMatch.Prefix">
                                <span class="menu-icon icon-shield"
                                      aria-hidden="true"></span>
                                <span>سجل التدقيق</span>
                            </NavLink>
                        </Authorized>
                    </AuthorizeView>

                    <span class="navigation-section">حسابي</span>

                    <NavLink class="menu-link" href="/notifications">
                        <span class="menu-icon icon-bell"
                              aria-hidden="true"></span>
                        <span>الإشعارات</span>

                        @if (unreadCount > 0)
                        {
                            <span class="notification-count"
                                  aria-live="polite"
                                  aria-label="@($"{unreadCount} إشعار غير مقروء")">
                                @GetUnreadCountText()
                            </span>
                        }
                    </NavLink>
                </Authorized>

                <NotAuthorized>
                    <span class="navigation-section">ابدأ من هنا</span>

                    <a class="menu-link"
                       href="/login"
                       data-enhance-nav="false">
                        <span class="menu-icon icon-login"
                              aria-hidden="true"></span>
                        <span>تسجيل الدخول</span>
                    </a>

                    <a class="menu-link"
                       href="/register"
                       data-enhance-nav="false">
                        <span class="menu-icon icon-people"
                              aria-hidden="true"></span>
                        <span>إنشاء حساب</span>
                    </a>
                </NotAuthorized>
            </AuthorizeView>
        </nav>

        <div class="navigation-account">
            <AuthorizeView>
                <Authorized Context="accountState">
                    <span class="account-caption">الحساب الحالي</span>

                    <bdi class="account-name">
                        @accountState.User.Identity?.Name
                    </bdi>

                    <a class="logout-link"
                       href="/logout"
                       data-enhance-nav="false">
                        <span class="menu-icon icon-logout"
                              aria-hidden="true"></span>
                        <span>تسجيل الخروج</span>
                    </a>
                </Authorized>

                <NotAuthorized>
                    <span class="account-caption">مرحبًا بك في ACCP</span>
                    <p class="guest-note">
                        سجّل الدخول للوصول إلى مساحة حسابك ومتابعة طلباتك.
                    </p>
                </NotAuthorized>
            </AuthorizeView>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

@code {
    private int unreadCount;
    private bool menuOpen;
    private bool componentDisposed;
    private int refreshVersion;

    private AuthorizedNotificationService? notificationEvents;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        NavigationManager.LocationChanged += HandleLocationChanged;

        AuthenticationStateProvider.AuthenticationStateChanged +=
            HandleAuthenticationStateChanged;

        notificationEvents =
            NotificationService as AuthorizedNotificationService;

        if (notificationEvents is not null)
        {
            notificationEvents.ReadStateChanged +=
                HandleNotificationReadChanged;
        }

        await RefreshUnreadCountAsync();
    }

    private void CloseMenu() => menuOpen = false;

    private async Task RefreshUnreadCountAsync()
    {
        var requestVersion = ++refreshVersion;
        var count = 0;

        try
        {
            var state = await AuthenticationStateProvider
                .GetAuthenticationStateAsync();

            var user = state.User;

            if (user.Identity?.IsAuthenticated == true &&
                Guid.TryParse(
                    user.FindFirstValue(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier),
                    out var userId) &&
                userId != Guid.Empty)
            {
                count = await NotificationService
                    .GetUnreadCountAsync(userId);
            }
        }
        catch
        {
            // لا نعرض عددًا قديمًا عند فشل التحقق أو القراءة.
            count = 0;
        }

        if (!componentDisposed && requestVersion == refreshVersion)
            unreadCount = Math.Max(0, count);
    }

    private async void HandleLocationChanged(
        object? sender,
        LocationChangedEventArgs args)
    {
        await RefreshAfterEventAsync(resetDisplay: true);
    }

    private async void HandleAuthenticationStateChanged(
        Task<AuthenticationState> state)
    {
        await RefreshAfterEventAsync(resetDisplay: true);
    }

    private async void HandleNotificationReadChanged()
    {
        await RefreshAfterEventAsync(resetDisplay: false);
    }

    private async Task RefreshAfterEventAsync(bool resetDisplay)
    {
        if (componentDisposed)
            return;

        try
        {
            await InvokeAsync(async () =>
            {
                if (componentDisposed)
                    return;

                if (resetDisplay)
                {
                    menuOpen = false;
                    unreadCount = 0;
                }

                await RefreshUnreadCountAsync();

                if (!componentDisposed)
                    StateHasChanged();
            });
        }
        catch
        {
            // قد يُزال المكوّن أو تنتهي الجلسة أثناء التحديث.
        }
    }

    private string GetUnreadCountText() =>
        unreadCount > 99 ? "99+" : unreadCount.ToString();

    public void Dispose()
    {
        componentDisposed = true;
        refreshVersion++;

        NavigationManager.LocationChanged -= HandleLocationChanged;

        AuthenticationStateProvider.AuthenticationStateChanged -=
            HandleAuthenticationStateChanged;

        if (notificationEvents is not null)
        {
            notificationEvents.ReadStateChanged -=
                HandleNotificationReadChanged;

            notificationEvents = null;
        }
    }
}
````

### S111 — `ACCP.Web/Components/Layout/NavMenu.razor.css`


الوظيفة: تنسيقات معزولة للمكوّن NavMenu.razor؛ يعالجها SDK ضمن ACCP.Web.styles.css ولا تستبدل الحزمة المولدة يدويا.

[العودة إلى شرح الملف](#file-111)


````css
.navigation-shell { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; height: 100%; }
.navigation-brand { padding: 1.6rem 1.35rem 1.3rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #ffffff14; }
.brand-link { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .8rem; text-decoration: none; color: #fff; }
.brand-link:hover { color: #fff; }
.brand-emblem {
    display: grid; place-items: center; width: 2.75rem; height: 2.75rem; flex-shrink: 0;
    border: 1px solid #8ed4bd4d; border-radius: .85rem; background: #20433f; color: #a0e3c8;
}
.brand-emblem svg { width: 1.75rem; height: 1.75rem; }
.brand-copy { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: .1rem; min-width: 0; }
.brand-copy strong { font: 750 1.3rem/1.25 "Segoe UI", sans-serif; letter-spacing: .12em; text-align: start; }
.brand-copy > span { font-size: .72rem; color: #b0c1d4; }
.navigation-panel { display: flex; flex-direction: column; flex: 1; min-height: 0; overflow-y: auto; scrollbar-width: thin; }
.navigation-links { padding: .6rem .8rem 1.25rem; }
.navigation-section { display: block; padding: 1rem .75rem .55rem; color: #a3b5ca; font-size: .7rem; font-weight: 600; }
.navigation-links ::deep .menu-link {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .8rem; min-height: 2.9rem; padding: .7rem .85rem;
    margin-bottom: .22rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: .65rem;
    color: #d3deea; text-decoration: none; font-size: .88rem; font-weight: 500;
    transition: background-color .15s ease, color .15s ease;
}
.navigation-links ::deep .menu-link:hover { color: #fff; background: #ffffff0d; }
.navigation-links ::deep .menu-link.active { color: #123f37; background: #d8eee5; border-color: #d8eee5; font-weight: 700; }
.navigation-links ::deep .menu-link:focus-visible, .logout-link:focus-visible, .brand-link:focus-visible {
    outline: 3px solid #a0e3c8; outline-offset: 3px;
}
.menu-icon { display: inline-block; width: 1.15rem; height: 1.15rem; flex-shrink: 0; background-color: currentColor; }
.notification-count {
    margin-inline-start: auto; min-width: 1.5rem; padding: .12rem .4rem; border-radius: .5rem;
    color: #fff; background: #b33449; font: 700 .75rem/1.5 "Segoe UI", sans-serif; text-align: center; direction: ltr;
}
.navigation-account { margin-top: auto; padding: 1.15rem 1.45rem; border-top: 1px solid #ffffff14; background: #101f33; }
.account-caption { display: block; color: #a3b5ca; font-size: .7rem; margin-bottom: .25rem; }
.account-name { display: block; font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 500; color: #f0f5fa; overflow-wrap: anywhere; text-align: start; }
.logout-link { display: flex; gap: .65rem; align-items: center; margin-top: .8rem; padding-block: .45rem; min-height: 2.75rem; color: #d3deea; text-decoration: none; font-size: .8rem; }
.logout-link:hover { color: #fff; text-decoration: underline; }
.guest-note { margin: .4rem 0 0; color: #b0c1d4; font-size: .78rem; line-height: 1.8; }
.menu-toggle, .menu-trigger { display: none; }
@media (max-width: 991.98px) {
    .navigation-shell { height: auto; }
    .navigation-brand { padding: 1rem 1.25rem; padding-inline-end: 7.5rem; min-height: 5rem; border-bottom: 0; }
    .brand-emblem { width: 2.5rem; height: 2.5rem; }
    .menu-trigger {
        position: absolute; inset-inline-end: 1.25rem; top: 1.15rem; display: flex; gap: .5rem; align-items: center;
        min-height: 2.75rem; padding: .55rem .75rem; border: 1px solid #ffffff40; border-radius: .6rem;
        color: #fff; cursor: pointer; font-size: .8rem;
    }
    .menu-toggle {
        display: block; position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden;
        clip-path: inset(50%); white-space: nowrap; inset-inline-end: 2rem; top: 2rem;
    }
    .menu-toggle:focus-visible + .menu-trigger { outline: 3px solid #a0e3c8; outline-offset: 3px; }
    .menu-toggle:checked + .menu-trigger { background: #2a4158; }
    .navigation-panel { display: none; border-top: 1px solid #ffffff14; max-height: 75vh; max-height: 75dvh; overflow-y: auto; }
    .menu-toggle:checked ~ .navigation-panel { display: flex; }
    .navigation-links { padding-bottom: .8rem; }
    .navigation-account { padding-block: .9rem; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .navigation-links ::deep .menu-link { transition: none; }
}
````

````razor
        </button>

</dialog>
````

````css
.components-reconnect-first-attempt-visible,
.components-reconnect-repeated-attempt-visible,
.components-reconnect-failed-visible,
.components-pause-visible,
.components-resume-failed-visible,
.components-rejoining-animation {
    display: none;
}

#components-reconnect-modal.components-reconnect-show .components-reconnect-first-attempt-visible,
#components-reconnect-modal.components-reconnect-show .components-rejoining-animation,
#components-reconnect-modal.components-reconnect-paused .components-pause-visible,
#components-reconnect-modal.components-reconnect-resume-failed .components-resume-failed-visible,
#components-reconnect-modal.components-reconnect-retrying,
#components-reconnect-modal.components-reconnect-retrying .components-reconnect-repeated-attempt-visible,
#components-reconnect-modal.components-reconnect-retrying .components-rejoining-animation,
#components-reconnect-modal.components-reconnect-failed,
#components-reconnect-modal.components-reconnect-failed .components-reconnect-failed-visible {
    display: block;
}


#components-reconnect-modal {
    background-color: white;
    width: 20rem;
    margin: 20vh auto;
    padding: 2rem;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 0.5rem;
    box-shadow: 0 3px 6px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
    opacity: 0;
    transition: display 0.5s allow-discrete, overlay 0.5s allow-discrete;
    animation: components-reconnect-modal-fadeOutOpacity 0.5s both;
    &[open]

{
    animation: components-reconnect-modal-slideUp 1.5s cubic-bezier(.05, .89, .25, 1.02) 0.3s, components-reconnect-modal-fadeInOpacity 0.5s ease-in-out 0.3s;
    animation-fill-mode: both;
}

}

#components-reconnect-modal::backdrop {
    background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
    animation: components-reconnect-modal-fadeInOpacity 0.5s ease-in-out;
    opacity: 1;
}

@keyframes components-reconnect-modal-slideUp {
    0% {
        transform: translateY(30px) scale(0.95);
    }

    100% {
        transform: translateY(0);
    }
}

@keyframes components-reconnect-modal-fadeInOpacity {
    0% {
        opacity: 0;
    }

    100% {
        opacity: 1;
    }
}

@keyframes components-reconnect-modal-fadeOutOpacity {
    0% {
        opacity: 1;
    }

    100% {
        opacity: 0;
    }
}

.components-reconnect-container {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 1rem;
}

#components-reconnect-modal p {
    margin: 0;
    text-align: center;
}

#components-reconnect-modal button {
    border: 0;
    background-color: #6b9ed2;
    color: white;
    padding: 4px 24px;
    border-radius: 4px;
}

    #components-reconnect-modal button:hover {
        background-color: #3b6ea2;
    }

    #components-reconnect-modal button:active {
        background-color: #6b9ed2;
    }

.components-rejoining-animation {
    position: relative;
    width: 80px;
    height: 80px;
}

    .components-rejoining-animation div {
        position: absolute;
        border: 3px solid #0087ff;
        opacity: 1;
        border-radius: 50%;
        animation: components-rejoining-animation 1.5s cubic-bezier(0, 0.2, 0.8, 1) infinite;
    }

        .components-rejoining-animation div:nth-child(2) {
            animation-delay: -0.5s;
        }

@keyframes components-rejoining-animation {
    0% {
        top: 40px;
        left: 40px;
        width: 0;
        height: 0;
        opacity: 0;
    }

    4.9% {
        top: 40px;
        left: 40px;
        width: 0;
        height: 0;
        opacity: 0;
    }

    5% {
        top: 40px;
        left: 40px;
        width: 0;
        height: 0;
        opacity: 1;
    }

    100% {
        top: 0px;
        left: 0px;
        width: 80px;
        height: 80px;
        opacity: 0;
    }
}
````



<a id="source-114"></a>
### S114 — `ACCP.Web/Components/Layout/ReconnectModal.razor.js`


الوظيفة: سكربت دورة إعادة اتصال Blazor وأحداث نافذة الانقطاع والعد التنازلي وإعادة المحاولة.

[العودة إلى شرح الملف](#file-114)


````javascript
// Set up event handlers
const reconnectModal = document.getElementById("components-reconnect-modal");
reconnectModal.addEventListener("components-reconnect-state-changed", handleReconnectStateChanged);

const retryButton = document.getElementById("components-reconnect-button");
retryButton.addEventListener("click", retry);

const resumeButton = document.getElementById("components-resume-button");
resumeButton.addEventListener("click", resume);

function handleReconnectStateChanged(event) {
    if (event.detail.state === "show") {
        reconnectModal.showModal();
    } else if (event.detail.state === "hide") {
        reconnectModal.close();
    } else if (event.detail.state === "failed") {
        document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", retryWhenDocumentBecomesVisible);
    } else if (event.detail.state === "rejected") {
        location.reload();
    }
}

async function retry() {
    document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", retryWhenDocumentBecomesVisible);

    try {
        // Reconnect will asynchronously return:
        // - true to mean success
        // - false to mean we reached the server, but it rejected the connection (e.g., unknown circuit ID)
        // - exception to mean we didn't reach the server (this can be sync or async)
        const successful = await Blazor.reconnect();
        if (!successful) {
            // We have been able to reach the server, but the circuit is no longer available.
            // We'll reload the page so the user can continue using the app as quickly as possible.
            const resumeSuccessful = await Blazor.resumeCircuit();
            if (!resumeSuccessful) {
                location.reload();
            } else {
                reconnectModal.close();
            }
        }
    } catch (err) {
        // We got an exception, server is currently unavailable
        document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", retryWhenDocumentBecomesVisible);
    }
}

async function resume() {
    try {
        const successful = await Blazor.resumeCircuit();
        if (!successful) {
            location.reload();
        }
    } catch {
        reconnectModal.classList.replace("components-reconnect-paused", "components-reconnect-resume-failed");
    }
}

async function retryWhenDocumentBecomesVisible() {
    if (document.visibilityState === "visible") {
        await retry();
    }
}
````

### S115 — `ACCP.Web/Components/Pages/AccessDenied.razor`


الوظيفة: واجهة رفض الوصول والعودة لمساحة الدور

[العودة إلى شرح الملف](#file-115)


````razor
@page "/access-denied"
@attribute [Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization.AllowAnonymous]
@using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Authorization

<PageTitle>رفض الوصول | ACCP</PageTitle>

<ACCP.Web.Components.Shared.StatusPanel
    Code="403"
    Title="ليس لديك صلاحية الوصول"
    Description="هذه الصفحة متاحة للحسابات التي تملك الصلاحية المطلوبة.">

    <AuthorizeView Context="accessState">
        <Authorized>
            <p>
                أنت مسجّل الدخول. يمكنك العودة إلى المساحة المناسبة لحسابك.
            </p>

            <div class="status-actions">
                @if (accessState.User.IsInRole("ADMIN"))
                {
                    <a class="status-link" href="/admin/workload">
                        العودة إلى إدارة القضايا
                    </a>
                }
                else if (accessState.User.IsInRole("OFFICER"))
                {
                    <a class="status-link" href="/officer/dashboard">
                        العودة إلى لوحة الموظف
                    </a>
                }
                else if (accessState.User.IsInRole("USER"))
                {
                    <a class="status-link" href="/cases">
                        العودة إلى طلباتي وبلاغاتي
                    </a>
                }

                <a class="status-link secondary" href="/">
                    الصفحة الرئيسية
                </a>
            </div>
        </Authorized>

        <NotAuthorized>
            <p>سجّل الدخول بحساب يملك الصلاحية المطلوبة للمتابعة.</p>

            <div class="status-actions">
                <a class="status-link"
                   href="/login"
                   data-enhance-nav="false">
                    تسجيل الدخول
                </a>

                <a class="status-link secondary" href="/">
                    الصفحة الرئيسية
                </a>
            </div>
        </NotAuthorized>
    </AuthorizeView>
</ACCP.Web.Components.Shared.StatusPanel>
````
