### S153 — `ACCP.Web/Pages/Account/EnableTwoFactor.cshtml.cs`


الوظيفة: معالجة تفعيل العامل الثاني وإعادة التحقق

[العودة إلى شرح الملف](#file-153)


````csharp
using System.Data;
using System.Security.Claims;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text.Json;
using ACCP.Application.Auditing;
using ACCP.Domain.Enums;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Data;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Identity;
using ACCP.Web.Security;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.DataProtection;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.RazorPages;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace ACCP.Web.Pages.Account;

// The password-verified enrollment cookie grants access to this page only.
// Every handler rechecks that proof or the current authenticated staff account.
[AllowAnonymous]
[ResponseCache(Duration = 0, Location = ResponseCacheLocation.None, NoStore = true)]
[RequestSizeLimit(16 * 1024)]
public sealed class EnableTwoFactorModel : PageModel
{
    private const string EnrollmentCookie = "ACCP.TwoFactorEnrollment";
    private const string EnrollmentPurpose = "ACCP.Account.TwoFactorEnrollment.v1";
    private readonly CaseAuthorizationService _authorization;
    private readonly SignInManager<ApplicationUser> _signInManager;
    private readonly UserManager<ApplicationUser> _users;
    private readonly IUserStore<ApplicationUser> _store;
    private readonly AccpDbContext _db;
    private readonly IAuditService _audit;

    public EnableTwoFactorModel(CaseAuthorizationService authorization,
        SignInManager<ApplicationUser> signInManager, UserManager<ApplicationUser> users,
        IUserStore<ApplicationUser> store, AccpDbContext db, IAuditService audit)
    {
        _authorization = authorization;
        _signInManager = signInManager;
        _users = users;
        _store = store;
        _db = db;
        _audit = audit;
    }

    [BindProperty]
    public InputModel Input { get; set; } = new();

    public string AccountEmail { get; private set; } = string.Empty;
    public bool TwoFactorEnabled { get; private set; }
    public bool EnrollmentPending { get; private set; }
    public string SharedKey { get; private set; } = string.Empty;
    public string AuthenticatorUri { get; private set; } = string.Empty;
    public IReadOnlyList<string> RecoveryCodes { get; private set; } = Array.Empty<string>();
    public bool EnrollmentCompleted { get; private set; }

    private bool EnrollmentOnly => User.Identity?.IsAuthenticated != true;

    public async Task<IActionResult> OnGetAsync()
    {
        PrepareResponse();
        var user = await GetStaffAsync();
        if (user is null) return await EndSessionAsync();
        ShowAccount(user);
        if (user.TwoFactorEnabled) DeleteEnrollment();
        else if (ReadEnrollment(user) is { } enrollment) ShowEnrollment(user, enrollment);
        else if (EnrollmentOnly) StartEnrollment(user);
        else DeleteEnrollment();
        return Page();
    }

    public async Task<IActionResult> OnPostBeginAsync()
    {
        PrepareResponse();
        var user = await GetStaffAsync();
        if (user is null) return await EndSessionAsync();
        ShowAccount(user);
        DeleteEnrollment();
        if (user.TwoFactorEnabled) { ClearInputs(); return Page(); }

        // The first-login flow has already checked the password. It carries no
        // application session and cannot access staff pages or case services.
        if (EnrollmentOnly)
        {
            ClearInputs();
            StartEnrollment(user);
            return Page();
        }

        var password = Input.Password ?? string.Empty;
        if (!ModelState.IsValid || password.Length == 0 || password.Length > 128)
            return Error("أدخل كلمة مرور حسابك الحالية.");

        var expectedStamp = user.SecurityStamp;
        Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.SignInResult result;
        try
        {
            // Reauthentication does not issue a new application login cookie.
            result = await _signInManager.CheckPasswordSignInAsync(user, password, lockoutOnFailure: true);
        }
        finally { ClearInputs(); }

        if (!result.Succeeded)
        {
            if (result.IsLockedOut || result.IsNotAllowed) return await EndSessionAsync();
            return Error("كلمة المرور غير صحيحة. حاول مجددًا.");
        }

        // A disable, role removal or stamp change during reauthentication cancels setup.
        user = await GetStaffAsync();
        if (user is null || user.TwoFactorEnabled ||
            !string.Equals(user.SecurityStamp, expectedStamp, StringComparison.Ordinal))
            return await EndSessionAsync();

        StartEnrollment(user);
        return Page();
    }

    public async Task<IActionResult> OnPostConfirmAsync()
    {
        PrepareResponse();
        var user = await GetStaffAsync();
        if (user is null) return await EndSessionAsync();
        ShowAccount(user);
        if (user.TwoFactorEnabled) { ClearInputs(); DeleteEnrollment(); return Page(); }

        var enrollment = ReadEnrollment(user);
        if (enrollment is null)
        {
            DeleteEnrollment();
            if (EnrollmentOnly) return LocalRedirect("/account/two-factor");
            return Error("انتهت جلسة التفعيل. أدخل كلمة المرور لبدء التفعيل مجددًا.");
        }
        ShowEnrollment(user, enrollment);
        var code = (Input.Code ?? string.Empty).Replace(" ", string.Empty).Replace("-", string.Empty);
        var validInput = ModelState.IsValid && code.Length == 6 && code.All(ch => ch >= '0' && ch <= '9');
        ClearInputs();
        if (!validInput) return Error("أدخل الرمز الحالي من تطبيق المصادقة، المكوّن من 6 أرقام.");

        bool incorrectCode = false;
        string[] codes = [];
        try
        {
            await using var transaction = await _db.Database.BeginTransactionAsync(
                IsolationLevel.Serializable, HttpContext.RequestAborted);
            // Recheck through this transaction's connection, before any writes.
            // The authorization service uses another scope: calling it after a
            // user update here can wait on this transaction's own SQL Server lock.
            user = await LoadStaffAsync(user.Id);
            if (user is null || user.TwoFactorEnabled ||
                !string.Equals(user.SecurityStamp, enrollment.SecurityStamp, StringComparison.Ordinal))
                throw new EnrollmentChangedException();

            if (_store is not IUserAuthenticatorKeyStore<ApplicationUser> keyStore)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Authenticator storage is unavailable.");
            // Do not replace the persisted authenticator key until proof succeeds.
            // The store stages this token in the same DbContext/transaction.
            await keyStore.SetAuthenticatorKeyAsync(user, enrollment.Key, HttpContext.RequestAborted);
            if (!await _users.VerifyTwoFactorTokenAsync(user,
                    _users.Options.Tokens.AuthenticatorTokenProvider, code))
            {
                incorrectCode = true;
                await transaction.RollbackAsync(HttpContext.RequestAborted);
                _db.ChangeTracker.Clear();
            }
            else
            {
                var roles = await _users.GetRolesAsync(user);
                var isOfficer = roles.Contains(IdentityRoles.Officer);
                Ensure(await _users.SetTwoFactorEnabledAsync(user, true));
                if (isOfficer)
                {
                    // No backup credentials are generated for OFFICER accounts,
                    // including ADMIN/OFFICER accounts. Clear any historical codes
                    // within the same transaction that enables the verified key.
                    if (_store is not IUserTwoFactorRecoveryCodeStore<ApplicationUser> recoveryStore)
                        throw new InvalidOperationException("Recovery credential storage is unavailable.");
                    await recoveryStore.ReplaceCodesAsync(user, Array.Empty<string>(), HttpContext.RequestAborted);
                }
                else
                {
                    codes = (await _users.GenerateNewTwoFactorRecoveryCodesAsync(user, 10))?.ToArray() ?? [];
                    if (codes.Length != 10) throw new InvalidOperationException("Recovery code creation failed.");
                }
                Ensure(await _users.ResetAccessFailedCountAsync(user));
                Ensure(await _users.UpdateSecurityStampAsync(user));
                await _audit.WriteAsync(new AuditLogRequest
                {
                    Action = AuditAction.TwoFactorEnabled,
                    ActorUserId = user.Id, ActorEmail = user.Email,
                    ActorRole = roles.Contains(IdentityRoles.Admin) ? IdentityRoles.Admin : IdentityRoles.Officer,
                    EntityType = nameof(ApplicationUser), EntityId = user.Id,
                    Description = isOfficer
                        ? "تم تفعيل المصادقة الثنائية بكود تطبيق التحقق لحساب الموظف."
                        : "تم تفعيل المصادقة الثنائية وإنشاء رموز الاسترداد للحساب.",
                    IsSuccessful = true,
                    IpAddress = HttpContext.Connection.RemoteIpAddress?.ToString(),
                    UserAgent = Request.Headers["User-Agent"].ToString(),
                    CorrelationId = HttpContext.TraceIdentifier
                }, HttpContext.RequestAborted);
                await transaction.CommitAsync(HttpContext.RequestAborted);
            }
        }
        catch (EnrollmentChangedException)
        {
            _db.ChangeTracker.Clear();
            return await EndSessionAsync();
        }
        catch (Exception exception) when (exception is not OperationCanceledException)
        {
            _db.ChangeTracker.Clear();
            HideEnrollment();
            DeleteEnrollment();
            // Transaction disposal rolls back the key, MFA flag, codes and stamps.
            if (EnrollmentOnly) return await EndSessionAsync();
            return Error("تعذر إكمال التفعيل. أعد المحاولة من خطوة كلمة المرور.");
        }

        if (incorrectCode)
        {
            // Transaction has been disposed; do not save its unverified key.
            user = await GetStaffAsync();
            if (user is null || user.TwoFactorEnabled ||
                !string.Equals(user.SecurityStamp, enrollment.SecurityStamp, StringComparison.Ordinal))
                return await EndSessionAsync();
            var increment = await _users.AccessFailedAsync(user);
            if (!increment.Succeeded || await _users.IsLockedOutAsync(user))
                return await EndSessionAsync();
            return Error("رمز التحقق غير صحيح. أدخل الرمز الحالي من تطبيق المصادقة.");
        }

        HideEnrollment();
        DeleteEnrollment();
        TwoFactorEnabled = true;
        // Stamp rotation revokes every old session. Show credentials only in this
        // response, never in cookies, TempData, URLs, logs or subsequent requests.
        await _signInManager.SignOutAsync();
        StaffTwoFactorFlow.ClearEnrollment(HttpContext);
        RecoveryCodes = codes;
        EnrollmentCompleted = true;
        return Page();
    }

    public async Task<IActionResult> OnPostCancelAsync()
    {
        PrepareResponse();
        ClearInputs();
        DeleteEnrollment();
        var user = await GetStaffAsync();
        if (user is null || EnrollmentOnly) return await EndSessionAsync();
        ShowAccount(user);
        return Page();
    }

    private async Task<ApplicationUser?> GetStaffAsync()
    {
        if (EnrollmentOnly)
            return await StaffTwoFactorFlow.GetEnrollmentUserAsync(HttpContext);
        // An authenticated account never falls back to another account's
        // pending cookie if its own current permissions are rejected.
        var actor = await _authorization.GetCurrentActorAsync(HttpContext.RequestAborted);
        if (actor is null || (!actor.HasRole(IdentityRoles.Admin) && !actor.HasRole(IdentityRoles.Officer)))
            return null;
        return await LoadStaffAsync(actor.UserId);
    }

    private async Task<ApplicationUser?> LoadStaffAsync(Guid id)
    {
        if (EnrollmentOnly)
        {
            // Same request DbContext, including during the confirmation
            // transaction; no second connection can wait on our own writes.
            var pending = await StaffTwoFactorFlow.GetEnrollmentUserAsync(HttpContext);
            return pending?.Id == id ? pending : null;
        }
        if (!Guid.TryParse(User.FindFirstValue(_users.Options.ClaimsIdentity.UserIdClaimType), out var principalId) ||
            principalId != id || User.Identity?.IsAuthenticated != true) return null;
        var user = await _users.FindByIdAsync(id.ToString());
        if (user is null) return null;
        await _db.Entry(user).ReloadAsync(HttpContext.RequestAborted);
        var stamp = User.FindFirstValue(_users.Options.ClaimsIdentity.SecurityStampClaimType);
        if (_db.Entry(user).State == EntityState.Detached || !user.IsActive ||
            string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(stamp) || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(user.SecurityStamp) ||
            !string.Equals(user.SecurityStamp, stamp, StringComparison.Ordinal) ||
            await _users.IsLockedOutAsync(user)) return null;
        var roles = await _users.GetRolesAsync(user);
        return roles.Contains(IdentityRoles.Admin) || roles.Contains(IdentityRoles.Officer) ? user : null;
    }

    private void StartEnrollment(ApplicationUser user)
    {
        var enrollment = new Enrollment(user.Id, user.SecurityStamp!, _users.GenerateNewAuthenticatorKey());
        Response.Cookies.Append(EnrollmentCookie,
            Protector().Protect(JsonSerializer.Serialize(enrollment), TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5)), CookieOptions());
        ShowEnrollment(user, enrollment);
    }

    private Enrollment? ReadEnrollment(ApplicationUser user)
    {
        if (!Request.Cookies.TryGetValue(EnrollmentCookie, out var value)) return null;
        try
        {
            var enrollment = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<Enrollment>(Protector().Unprotect(value));
            return enrollment is not null && enrollment.UserId == user.Id &&
                !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(enrollment.SecurityStamp) &&
                string.Equals(enrollment.SecurityStamp, user.SecurityStamp, StringComparison.Ordinal) &&
                !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(enrollment.Key) && enrollment.Key.Length is >= 16 and <= 128 &&
                enrollment.Key.All(ch => ch is >= 'A' and <= 'Z' or >= '2' and <= '7')
                ? enrollment : null;
        }
        catch (CryptographicException) { return null; }
        catch (JsonException) { return null; }
    }

    private void ShowAccount(ApplicationUser user)
    {
        AccountEmail = user.Email ?? user.UserName ?? string.Empty;
        TwoFactorEnabled = user.TwoFactorEnabled;
    }

    private void ShowEnrollment(ApplicationUser user, Enrollment enrollment)
    {
        ShowAccount(user);
        EnrollmentPending = true;
        SharedKey = enrollment.Key;
        AuthenticatorUri = "otpauth://totp/" + Uri.EscapeDataString("ACCP:" + AccountEmail) +
            "?secret="<REDACTED_LITERAL>"&issuer=ACCP&digits=6";
    }

    private void HideEnrollment()
    {
        EnrollmentPending = false;
        SharedKey = string.Empty;
        AuthenticatorUri = string.Empty;
    }

    private ITimeLimitedDataProtector Protector() =>
        HttpContext.RequestServices.GetRequiredService<IDataProtectionProvider>()
            .CreateProtector(EnrollmentPurpose).ToTimeLimitedDataProtector();

    private CookieOptions CookieOptions() => new()
    {
        HttpOnly = true, Secure = Request.IsHttps, SameSite = SameSiteMode.Strict,
        Path = "/", IsEssential = true, MaxAge = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5)
    };

    private void DeleteEnrollment()
    {
        var options = CookieOptions();
        options.MaxAge = TimeSpan.Zero;
        Response.Cookies.Delete(EnrollmentCookie, options);
    }

    private void PrepareResponse()
    {
        Response.Headers.CacheControl = "no-store";
        Response.Headers.Pragma = "no-cache";
        Response.Headers["X-Content-Type-Options"] = "nosniff";
    }

    private void ClearInputs()
    {
        Input.Password = string.Empty;
        Input.Code = string.Empty;
        ModelState.Remove("Input.Password");
        ModelState.Remove("Input.Code");
    }

    private IActionResult Error(string message)
    {
        ClearInputs();
        ModelState.AddModelError(string.Empty, message);
        return Page();
    }

    private async Task<IActionResult> EndSessionAsync()
    {
        // Preserve the existing denial for a signed-in non-staff user.
        if (!EnrollmentOnly && !User.IsInRole(IdentityRoles.Admin) &&
            !User.IsInRole(IdentityRoles.Officer)) return Forbid();
        ClearInputs();
        HideEnrollment();
        DeleteEnrollment();
        StaffTwoFactorFlow.ClearEnrollment(HttpContext);
        await _signInManager.SignOutAsync();
        return LocalRedirect("/login");
    }

    private static void Ensure(IdentityResult result)
    {
        if (!result.Succeeded) throw new InvalidOperationException("Identity update failed.");
    }

    private sealed record Enrollment(Guid UserId, string SecurityStamp, string Key);
    private sealed class EnrollmentChangedException : Exception { }

    public sealed class InputModel
    {
        public string Password { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public string Code { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    }
}
````

@page "/forgot-password"
@model ACCP.Web.Pages.Account.ForgotPasswordModel

@{
    Layout = null;

    var hasEmailError =
        ViewData.ModelState.TryGetValue("Input.Email", out var emailState)
        && emailState.Errors.Count > 0;
}

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">
<head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
    <meta name="referrer" content="no-referrer" />
    <title>استعادة كلمة المرور | ACCP</title>

    <style>
        * { box-sizing: border-box; }
        :root { color-scheme: light; }

        a { color: #176d65; text-underline-offset: 4px; }
        input, button { font: inherit; }
        .page { max-width: 1120px; margin: auto; padding: 25px 24px 55px; }
        .topbar { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 55px; }
        .brand { color: #19324d; font-size: 1.4rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .08em; text-decoration: none; }
        .back { color: #647e96; font-size: .82rem; text-decoration: none; }
        .back:hover { color: #176d65; text-decoration: underline; }
        .layout { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.05fr 1fr; grid-template-areas: "form intro"; border: 1px solid #dce6ef; border-radius: 19px; overflow: hidden; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 12px 35px #19324d05; }
        .intro { grid-area: intro; min-width: 0; padding: 48px 40px; background: #152639; color: #fff; }
        .eyebrow { display: inline-block; margin: 0 0 24px; padding: 5px 12px; border: 1px solid #426a61; border-radius: 20px; color: #c4e6dc; background: #203f39; font-size: .75rem; }
        h1 { margin: 0 0 22px; font-size: clamp(1.65rem, 3vw, 2rem); font-weight: 750; line-height: 1.7; }
        h1 span { color: #9ddbc9; }
        .lead { margin: 0; color: #c4d3e1; font-size: .88rem; line-height: 2; }
        .steps { display: grid; gap: 22px; margin: 32px 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
        .step { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; }
        .step-number { display: grid; place-items: center; flex-shrink: 0; width: 31px; height: 31px; border: 1px solid #3c5064; border-radius: 8px; color: #b9e6da; font-size: .74rem; }
        .step strong { display: block; margin-bottom: 4px; font-size: .85rem; }
        .step p { margin: 0; color: #c4d3e1; font-size: .79rem; line-height: 1.95; }
        .privacy { margin: 0; padding-top: 22px; border-top: 1px solid #35485b; color: #c4d3e1; font-size: .78rem; line-height: 2; }
        .card { grid-area: form; min-width: 0; padding: 48px 40px; align-self: center; }
        .tag { display: block; margin-bottom: 13px; color: #176d65; font-size: .79rem; font-weight: 650; }
        h2 { margin: 0 0 15px; font-size: 1.5rem; line-height: 1.6; }
        .description { margin: 0 0 27px; color: #6b8095; font-size: .86rem; line-height: 1.95; }
        label { display: block; margin-bottom: 9px; font-size: .84rem; font-weight: 650; }
        .input { display: block; width: 100%; min-height: 49px; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid #cbd9e6; border-radius: 9px; background: #fff; color: #19324d; font-size: .9rem; text-align: left; }
        .input:focus { border-color: #176d65; outline: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #e2f1ed; }
        .input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: #bd6571; }
        .help { margin: 10px 0 23px; color: #71859a; font-size: .76rem; line-height: 1.9; }
        .field-error { display: block; margin-top: 7px; color: #a43f4b; font-size: .78rem; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
        .field-validation-valid, .validation-summary-valid { display: none; }
        .alert { margin-bottom: 20px; padding: 14px 16px; border: 1px solid #edcbd1; border-radius: 9px; background: #fff0f2; color: #993b46; font-size: .82rem; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
        .alert ul { margin: 0; padding-inline-start: 20px; }
        .button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 47px; padding: 11px 18px; border: 1px solid #176d65; border-radius: 9px; background: #176d65; color: #fff; font-size: .86rem; font-weight: 650; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; }
        .button:hover { background: #11564f; border-color: #11564f; }
        .wide { width: 100%; }
        a:focus-visible, button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #8cc9bc; outline-offset: 4px; }
        .staff-note { margin: 24px 0 0; padding: 17px; border: 1px solid #e0e8ef; border-radius: 9px; background: #f5f8fb; color: #6b8095; font-size: .76rem; line-height: 1.95; }
        .notice { margin: 23px 0; padding: 17px; border: 1px solid #d6e9df; border-radius: 10px; background: #eff8f3; color: #416b59; font-size: .82rem; line-height: 1.95; }
        .actions { display: flex; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 18px; margin-top: 25px; }
        .retry { font-size: .8rem; }
        @@media (max-width: 800px) {
            .page { max-width: 620px; }
            .topbar { margin-bottom: 28px; }
            .layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr; grid-template-areas: "form" "intro"; }
            .card, .intro { padding: 32px; }
        }
        @@media (max-width: 480px) {
            .page { padding: 20px 14px 32px; }
            .card, .intro { padding: 27px 21px; }
            .layout { border-radius: 14px; }
            .actions { align-items: stretch; flex-direction: column; }
            .retry { text-align: center; }
        }
    </style>
</head>

<body>
    <main class="page">
        <nav class="topbar" aria-label="التنقل">
            <a href="/" class="brand" dir="ltr">ACCP</a>
            <a href="/login" class="back">العودة إلى تسجيل الدخول ←</a>
        </nav>

        <div class="layout">
            <aside class="intro" aria-labelledby="page-title">
                <p class="eyebrow">استعادة حساب المشتكي</p>

                <h1 id="page-title">
                    ارجع إلى حسابك.<br />
                    <span>وكمل متابعتك.</span>
                </h1>

                <p class="lead">
                    استخدم البريد الإلكتروني المرتبط بحسابك لطلب
                    رابط تعيين كلمة مرور جديدة.
                </p>

                <ol class="steps" aria-label="خطوات استعادة الحساب">
                    <li class="step">
                        <span class="step-number" aria-hidden="true">01</span>
                        <div>
                            <strong>أدخل البريد المسجّل</strong>
                            <p>استخدم البريد نفسه الذي أنشأت به حسابك.</p>
                        </div>
                    </li>

                    <li class="step">
                        <span class="step-number" aria-hidden="true">02</span>
                        <div>
                            <strong>افتح رسالة الاستعادة</strong>
                            <p>اتبع الرابط الموجود في الرسالة للمتابعة.</p>
                        </div>
                    </li>

                    <li class="step">
                        <span class="step-number" aria-hidden="true">03</span>
                        <div>
                            <strong>عيّن كلمة مرور جديدة</strong>
                            <p>احفظ التغيير ثم عد إلى تسجيل الدخول.</p>
                        </div>
                    </li>
                </ol>

                <p class="privacy">
                    احتفظ برابط الاستعادة لنفسك، ولا تشاركه في المحادثات أو البلاغات.
                </p>
            </aside>

            <section class="card" aria-labelledby="section-title">
                @if (Model.RequestCompleted)
                {
                    <span class="tag">متابعة طلب الاستعادة</span>
                    <h2 id="section-title">راجع بريدك للمتابعة</h2>

                    <p id="confirmation"
                       class="description"
                       role="status">
                        @Model.ConfirmationMessage
                    </p>

                    <div class="notice">
                        تحقّق من صندوق الوارد ومجلد الرسائل غير المرغوب فيها.
                        افتح رابط الاستعادة الموجود في الرسالة للمتابعة.
                    </div>

                    <div class="actions">
                        <a href="/login" class="button">
                            العودة إلى تسجيل الدخول
                        </a>
                        <a href="/forgot-password" class="retry">
                            إدخال البريد مجددًا
                        </a>
                    </div>
                }
                else
                {
                    <span class="tag">حسابات المشتكين</span>
                    <h2 id="section-title">نسيت كلمة المرور؟</h2>

                    <p class="description">
                        أدخل بريدك الإلكتروني لطلب رابط الاستعادة.
                    </p>

                    <div asp-validation-summary="ModelOnly"
                         class="alert"
                         role="alert"></div>

                    <form method="post"
                          asp-page="/Account/ForgotPassword"
                          asp-antiforgery="true">

                        <label for="recovery-email">
                            البريد الإلكتروني المسجّل
                        </label>

                        <input asp-for="Input.Email"
                               id="recovery-email"
                               type="email"
                               class="input"
                               dir="ltr"
                               autocomplete="email"
                               inputmode="email"
                               autocapitalize="none"
                               spellcheck="false"
                               maxlength="256"
                               required
                               aria-describedby="email-help email-error"
                               aria-invalid="@(hasEmailError ? "true" : "false")" />

                        <span asp-validation-for="Input.Email"
                              id="email-error"
                              class="field-error"
                              role="alert"></span>

                        <p id="email-help" class="help">
                            استخدم البريد الذي سجّلت به حسابك في المنصة.
                        </p>

                        <button type="submit" class="button wide">
                            إرسال رابط الاستعادة
                        </button>
                    </form>

                    <p class="staff-note">
                        حسابات الموظفين تُدار من المسؤول.
                        إذا نسيت كلمة مرور حساب الموظف،
                        تواصل مع مسؤول المنصة.
                    </p>
                }
            </section>
        </div>
    </main>
</body>
</html>

### S155 — `ACCP.Web/Pages/Account/ForgotPassword.cshtml.cs`


الوظيفة: معالجة طلب رابط الاستعادة

[العودة إلى شرح الملف](#file-155)


````csharp
using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;
using ACCP.Web.Security;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.RazorPages;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.RateLimiting;

namespace ACCP.Web.Pages.Account;

[AllowAnonymous]
[AutoValidateAntiforgeryToken]
[EnableRateLimiting("reporter-recovery-request")]
[ResponseCache(Duration = 0, Location = ResponseCacheLocation.None, NoStore = true)]
[RequestSizeLimit(16 * 1024)]
public sealed class ForgotPasswordModel : PageModel
{
    private readonly ReporterPasswordResetService _recovery;
    private readonly ILogger<ForgotPasswordModel> _logger;

    public ForgotPasswordModel(
        ReporterPasswordResetService recovery,
        ILogger<ForgotPasswordModel> logger)
    {
        _recovery = recovery;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    [BindProperty]
    public InputModel Input { get; set; } = new();

    public bool RequestCompleted { get; private set; }
    public string ConfirmationMessage { get; private set; } = string.Empty;

    public void OnGet()
    {
        PrepareResponse();
        Input = new InputModel();
    }

    public async Task<IActionResult> OnPostAsync()
    {
        PrepareResponse();
        if (!ModelState.IsValid) return Page();

        var email = Input?.Email?.Trim() ?? string.Empty;
        if (email.Length is 0 or > 256 || email.Any(char.IsControl) ||
            !new EmailAddressAttribute().IsValid(email))
        {
            ModelState.AddModelError("Input.Email", "أدخل بريدًا إلكترونيًا صحيحًا.");
            return Page();
        }

        try
        {
            // Eligibility is checked against current database roles by the
            // recovery service. Posted role/user identifiers are never used.
            await _recovery.RequestResetAsync(email, HttpContext.RequestAborted);
        }
        catch (Exception exception) when (!HttpContext.RequestAborted.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            // Keep response/status identical for unknown emails, staff,
            // disabled accounts, and provider failures. Log only a category;
            // exception messages can contain recipients or reset links.
            _logger.LogWarning(new EventId(4710, "PasswordRecoveryRequestFailed"),
                "Password recovery request could not be processed. Failure category: {FailureCategory}.",
                exception.GetType().Name);
        }
        finally
        {
            Input = new InputModel();
            ModelState.Clear();
        }

        RequestCompleted = true;
        ConfirmationMessage = ReporterPasswordResetService.RequestConfirmation;
        return Page();
    }

    private void PrepareResponse()
    {
        RequestCompleted = false;
        ConfirmationMessage = string.Empty;
        Response.Headers["Cache-Control"] = "no-store";
        Response.Headers["Pragma"] = "no-cache";
        Response.Headers["Referrer-Policy"] = "no-referrer";
        Response.Headers["X-Content-Type-Options"] = "nosniff";
        Response.Headers["X-Frame-Options"] = "DENY";
        Response.Headers["Content-Security-Policy"] =
            "default-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; form-action 'self'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'";
    }

    public sealed class InputModel
    {
        [Required(ErrorMessage = "أدخل البريد الإلكتروني.")]
        [EmailAddress(ErrorMessage = "أدخل بريدًا إلكترونيًا صحيحًا.")]
        [StringLength(256, ErrorMessage = "البريد الإلكتروني طويل جدًا.")]
        public string Email { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    }
}
````

.auth-shell { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.1fr) minmax(0, 1fr); width: min(1040px, calc(100% - 3rem)); margin: auto; border: 1px solid #dce5ed; border-radius: 1.1rem; background: #fff; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 16px 48px #13243a08; }

.auth-introduction h2 { color: #fff; font-size: clamp(1.7rem, 2.6vw, 2.2rem); margin: 0 0 1rem; line-height: 1.7; }

.auth-role-list h3 { color: #fff; font-size: .85rem; margin: .1rem 0 .25rem; }
.auth-role-list p { color: #b9c9da; font-size: .73rem; line-height: 1.9; margin: 0; }

.auth-footer { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; flex-wrap: wrap; width: min(1040px, calc(100% - 3rem)); margin: 1.25rem auto 0; padding-block: .5rem 1rem; font-size: .7rem; color: #617087; }
.accp-auth :focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #247f73; outline-offset: 3px; }
@@media (max-width: 767.98px) {
    .auth-topbar { width: calc(100% - 2rem); padding-block: 1rem; }
    .auth-shell { width: min(560px, calc(100% - 2rem)); grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); margin-block: .25rem; }

}

.accp-auth, .accp-auth * { box-sizing: border-box; }
.accp-auth h1, .accp-auth h2, .accp-auth h3 { font-family: inherit; font-weight: 700; }
.accp-auth a { text-underline-offset: .2em; }
.auth-form .form-label { display: block; font-weight: 600; }
.auth-form .form-control { display: block; width: 100%; padding: .65rem .8rem; border: 1px solid #c9d4e0; font: inherit; line-height: 1.5; }
.auth-options .form-check { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .5rem; padding: 0; }
.auth-options .form-check-input { width: 1.05rem; height: 1.05rem; margin: 0; accent-color: #146c60; cursor: pointer; flex-shrink: 0; }
.auth-submit { border: 1px solid #146c60; background: #146c60; color: #fff; font: 600 .95rem/1.5 "Segoe UI", Tahoma, Arial, sans-serif; padding: .75rem 1rem; cursor: pointer; }
.auth-submit:hover { background: #10584e; border-color: #10584e; }
.auth-field-error:empty { display: none; }
.auth-brand-icon svg, .auth-note-icon svg { display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; flex-shrink: 0; }
    </style>
</head>
<body class="accp-auth">
    <header class="auth-topbar">
        <a href="/" class="auth-brand" aria-label="ACCP — الصفحة الرئيسية">
            <span class="auth-brand-icon" aria-hidden="true">
                <svg width="26" height="26" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="m12 3-8 3v6c0 4 4 7 8 9 4-2 8-5 8-9V6Z" /><path d="m8.5 12 2.3 2.3 4.7-5" /></svg>
            </span>
            <span><strong dir="ltr">ACCP</strong><small>منصة متابعة البلاغات</small></span>
        </a>
        <a href="/" class="auth-home-link"><span aria-hidden="true">→</span> العودة إلى الرئيسية</a>
    </header>

    <main class="auth-shell">
        <section class="auth-form-panel" aria-labelledby="login-title">
            <span class="auth-eyebrow">مرحبًا بعودتك</span>
            <h1 id="login-title">تسجيل الدخول</h1>
            <p class="auth-description">أدخل بيانات حسابك للوصول إلى مساحتك في المنصة.</p>

            <form method="post" class="auth-form">
                @Html.AntiForgeryToken()
                <input type="hidden" name="returnUrl" value="@Model.ReturnUrl" />

                <div asp-validation-summary="ModelOnly" class="auth-validation" role="alert"></div>

                <div class="auth-field">
                    <label asp-for="Input.Email" class="form-label">البريد الإلكتروني</label>
                    <input asp-for="Input.Email" class="form-control" autocomplete="username"
                           dir="ltr" inputmode="email" autocapitalize="none" spellcheck="false"
                           aria-describedby="login-email-error" />
                    <span asp-validation-for="Input.Email" id="login-email-error" class="auth-field-error"></span>
                </div>

                <div class="auth-field">
                    <label asp-for="Input.Password" class="form-label">كلمة المرور</label>
                    <input asp-for="Input.Password" class="form-control" autocomplete="current-password"
                           dir="ltr" aria-describedby="login-password-error" />
                    <span asp-validation-for="Input.Password" id="login-password-error" class="auth-field-error"></span>
                </div>

                <div class="auth-options">
                    <div class="form-check">
                        <input asp-for="Input.RememberMe" class="form-check-input" />
                        <label asp-for="Input.RememberMe" class="form-check-label">تذكرني على هذا الجهاز</label>
                    </div>
                    <a href="/forgot-password">نسيت كلمة المرور؟</a>
                </div>

                <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary auth-submit">تسجيل الدخول <span aria-hidden="true">←</span></button>
            </form>

            <div class="auth-recovery-note">
                <span class="auth-note-icon" aria-hidden="true">
                    <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9" /><path d="M12 11v6M12 7h.01" /></svg>
                </span>
                <p>استعادة كلمة المرور بالبريد متاحة للمشتكين. الموظف الذي نسي كلمة مروره يتواصل مع مسؤول المنصة.</p>
            </div>

            <p class="auth-register">لا تمتلك حساب مشتكي؟ <a href="/register">إنشاء حساب جديد</a></p>
        </section>

        <aside class="auth-introduction" aria-labelledby="introduction-title">
            <span class="auth-intro-badge">مساحتك في ACCP</span>
            <h2 id="introduction-title">متابعة أوضح.<br /><span>وخطوات منظّمة.</span></h2>
            <p class="auth-intro-description">بعد تسجيل الدخول، تظهر لك مساحة الحساب والإجراءات المتاحة وفق دورك في المنصة.</p>
            <ul class="auth-role-list">
                <li><span class="auth-role-number" aria-hidden="true">01</span><div><h3>للمشتكي</h3><p>الطلبات والبلاغات والرسائل والإشعارات المرتبطة بحسابك.</p></div></li>
                <li><span class="auth-role-number" aria-hidden="true">02</span><div><h3>للموظف</h3><p>متابعة القضايا المتاحة لك بحسب الإسناد وصلاحيات المشاركة.</p></div></li>
                <li><span class="auth-role-number" aria-hidden="true">03</span><div><h3>للمدير</h3><p>إدارة الموظفين وتوزيع القضايا ومراجعة طلبات الفريق.</p></div></li>
            </ul>
            <div class="auth-mfa-note">
                <strong>خطوة التحقق لحسابات الموظفين والمديرين</strong>
                <p>بعد التحقق من بيانات الدخول، أكمل خطوة إعداد المصادقة أو إدخال رمز التحقق التي تظهر لحسابك.</p>
            </div>
        </aside>
    </main>

    <footer class="auth-footer"><span>ACCP · منصة متابعة البلاغات</span><span>© @DateTime.UtcNow.Year</span></footer>
</body>
</html>

### S157 — `ACCP.Web/Pages/Account/Login.cshtml.cs`


الوظيفة: التحقق من بيانات الدخول وتوجيه الجلسة

[العودة إلى شرح الملف](#file-157)


````csharp
using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;
using System.Security.Claims;
using ACCP.Application.Auditing;
using ACCP.Domain.Enums;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Data;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Identity;
using ACCP.Web.Security;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.RazorPages;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace ACCP.Web.Pages.Account;

[AllowAnonymous]
[ResponseCache(
    Duration = 0,
    Location = ResponseCacheLocation.None,
    NoStore = true)]
[RequestSizeLimit(16 * 1024)]
public class LoginModel : PageModel
{
    private readonly SignInManager<ApplicationUser> _signInManager;
    private readonly UserManager<ApplicationUser> _userManager;
    private readonly IAuditService _auditService;
    private readonly AccpDbContext _db;

    public LoginModel(
        SignInManager<ApplicationUser> signInManager,
        UserManager<ApplicationUser> userManager,
        IAuditService auditService,
        AccpDbContext db)
    {
        _signInManager = signInManager;
        _userManager = userManager;
        _auditService = auditService;
        _db = db;
    }

    [BindProperty]
    public InputModel Input { get; set; } = new();

    public string ReturnUrl { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    public void OnGet(string? returnUrl = null)
    {
        ReturnUrl = GetSafeReturnUrl(returnUrl);
        SetResponseHeaders();
    }

    public async Task<IActionResult> OnPostAsync(
        string? returnUrl = null)
    {
        ReturnUrl = GetSafeReturnUrl(returnUrl);
        SetResponseHeaders();

        await _signInManager.SignOutAsync();

        HttpContext.User =
            new ClaimsPrincipal(new ClaimsIdentity());

        await ClearPendingLoginAsync();
        StaffTwoFactorFlow.ClearEnrollment(HttpContext);

        Response.Cookies.Delete(
            "ACCP.TwoFactorEnrollment",
            new CookieOptions
            {
                Path = "/",
                HttpOnly = true,
                Secure = Request.IsHttps,
                SameSite = SameSiteMode.Strict
            });

        if (!ModelState.IsValid)
        {
            return LoginPage();
        }

        var attemptedEmail = Input.Email.Trim();

        var user = await _userManager.FindByEmailAsync(
            attemptedEmail);

        if (user is null)
        {
            await WriteLoginAuditAsync(
                AuditAction.UserLoginFailed,
                null,
                attemptedEmail,
                "UNKNOWN",
                false,
                "البريد الإلكتروني غير مسجل.");

            ModelState.AddModelError(
                string.Empty,
                "البريد الإلكتروني أو كلمة المرور غير صحيحة.");

            return LoginPage();
        }

        var actorRole = await GetUserRoleAsync(user);

        if (!user.IsActive)
        {
            await WriteLoginAuditAsync(
                AuditAction.UserLoginFailed,
                user,
                attemptedEmail,
                actorRole,
                false,
                "الحساب غير فعال.");

            ModelState.AddModelError(
                string.Empty,
                "هذا الحساب غير فعال.");

            return LoginPage();
        }

        var expectedStamp = user.SecurityStamp;
        var expectedTwoFactor = user.TwoFactorEnabled;

        var enrollmentRequired = !user.TwoFactorEnabled &&
            (await _userManager.IsInRoleAsync(
                user,
                IdentityRoles.Officer) ||
             await _userManager.IsInRoleAsync(
                user,
                IdentityRoles.Admin));

        Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.SignInResult result =
            enrollmentRequired
                ? await _signInManager.CheckPasswordSignInAsync(
                    user,
                    Input.Password,
                    lockoutOnFailure: true)
                : await _signInManager.PasswordSignInAsync(
                    user,
                    Input.Password,
                    Input.RememberMe,
                    lockoutOnFailure: true);

        if (result.Succeeded || result.RequiresTwoFactor)
        {
            await _db.Entry(user).ReloadAsync();

            if (_db.Entry(user).State == EntityState.Detached ||
                !user.IsActive ||
                string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(expectedStamp) ||
                !string.Equals(
                    user.SecurityStamp,
                    expectedStamp,
                    StringComparison.Ordinal) ||
                user.TwoFactorEnabled != expectedTwoFactor ||
                (result.RequiresTwoFactor &&
                 !user.TwoFactorEnabled) ||
                (result.Succeeded &&
                 user.TwoFactorEnabled))
            {
                await _signInManager.SignOutAsync();
                await _signInManager.ForgetTwoFactorClientAsync();
                await ClearPendingLoginAsync();

                await WriteLoginAuditAsync(
                    AuditAction.UserLoginFailed,
                    user,
                    attemptedEmail,
                    await GetUserRoleAsync(user),
                    false,
                    "تغيّرت حالة الحساب أو لم يكتمل التحقق بخطوتين.");

                ModelState.AddModelError(
                    string.Empty,
                    "تغيّرت حالة الحساب أو يلزم التحقق بخطوتين. " +
                    "أعد تسجيل الدخول.");

                return LoginPage();
            }

            actorRole = await GetUserRoleAsync(user);
        }

        if (result.Succeeded)
        {
            var currentStaff =
                await _userManager.IsInRoleAsync(
                    user,
                    IdentityRoles.Officer) ||
                await _userManager.IsInRoleAsync(
                    user,
                    IdentityRoles.Admin);

            if (enrollmentRequired && !currentStaff)
            {
                return await RejectChangedEnrollmentAsync(
                    user,
                    attemptedEmail,
                    actorRole);
            }

            if (!user.TwoFactorEnabled && currentStaff)
            {
                try
                {
                    await StaffTwoFactorFlow.BeginEnrollmentAsync(
                        HttpContext,
                        user,
                        expectedStamp!);
                }
                catch (InvalidOperationException)
                {
                    return await RejectChangedEnrollmentAsync(
                        user,
                        attemptedEmail,
                        actorRole);
                }

                ClearPassword();

                return LocalRedirect("/account/two-factor");
            }

            try
            {
                await WriteLoginAuditAsync(
                    AuditAction.UserLoggedIn,
                    user,
                    attemptedEmail,
                    actorRole,
                    true);
            }
            catch
            {
                await _signInManager.SignOutAsync();

                ModelState.AddModelError(
                    string.Empty,
                    "تعذر إكمال تسجيل الدخول. حاول مجددًا.");

                return LoginPage();
            }

            ClearPassword();

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ReturnUrl))
            {
                return LocalRedirect(ReturnUrl);
            }

            if (actorRole == IdentityRoles.Admin)
            {
                return LocalRedirect("/admin/employees");
            }

            if (actorRole == IdentityRoles.Officer)
            {
                return LocalRedirect("/officer/dashboard");
            }

            return LocalRedirect("/cases");
        }

        if (result.IsLockedOut)
        {
            await WriteLoginAuditAsync(
                AuditAction.UserLoginFailed,
                user,
                attemptedEmail,
                actorRole,
                false,
                "تم قفل الحساب مؤقتًا بسبب تكرار المحاولات الفاشلة.");

            ModelState.AddModelError(
                string.Empty,
                "تم إيقاف تسجيل الدخول مؤقتًا " +
                "بسبب تكرار المحاولات الخاطئة.");

            return LoginPage();
        }

        if (result.RequiresTwoFactor)
        {
            LoginTwoFactorModel.BindPendingLogin(
                HttpContext,
                user,
                Input.RememberMe);

            ClearPassword();

            return LocalRedirect(
                string.IsNullOrEmpty(ReturnUrl)
                    ? "/login/two-factor"
                    : "/login/two-factor?returnUrl=" +
                      Uri.EscapeDataString(ReturnUrl));
        }

        await WriteLoginAuditAsync(
            AuditAction.UserLoginFailed,
            user,
            attemptedEmail,
            actorRole,
            false,
            "كلمة المرور غير صحيحة.");

        ModelState.AddModelError(
            string.Empty,
            "البريد الإلكتروني أو كلمة المرور غير صحيحة.");

        return LoginPage();
    }

    private async Task<PageResult> RejectChangedEnrollmentAsync(
        ApplicationUser user,
        string attemptedEmail,
        string actorRole)
    {
        await _signInManager.SignOutAsync();
        await _signInManager.ForgetTwoFactorClientAsync();
        await ClearPendingLoginAsync();

        StaffTwoFactorFlow.ClearEnrollment(HttpContext);

        await WriteLoginAuditAsync(
            AuditAction.UserLoginFailed,
            user,
            attemptedEmail,
            actorRole,
            false,
            "تغيّرت حالة الحساب أثناء بدء تفعيل المصادقة الثنائية.");

        ModelState.AddModelError(
            string.Empty,
            "تغيّرت حالة الحساب. أعد تسجيل الدخول.");

        return LoginPage();
    }

    private PageResult LoginPage()
    {
        ClearPassword();
        return Page();
    }

    private void ClearPassword()
    {
        Input.Password = string.Empty;

        if (ModelState.TryGetValue(
                "Input.Password",
                out var entry))
        {
            entry.RawValue = null;
            entry.AttemptedValue = null;
        }
    }

    private async Task ClearPendingLoginAsync()
    {
        Response.Cookies.Delete(
            "ACCP.PendingTwoFactor",
            new CookieOptions
            {
                Path = "/",
                HttpOnly = true,
                Secure = Request.IsHttps,
                SameSite = SameSiteMode.Strict
            });

        await HttpContext.SignOutAsync(
            IdentityConstants.TwoFactorUserIdScheme);
    }

    private void SetResponseHeaders()
    {
        Response.Headers.CacheControl = "no-store";
        Response.Headers.Pragma = "no-cache";
        Response.Headers["X-Content-Type-Options"] = "nosniff";
    }

    private async Task<string> GetUserRoleAsync(
        ApplicationUser user)
    {
        if (await _userManager.IsInRoleAsync(
                user,
                IdentityRoles.Admin))
        {
            return IdentityRoles.Admin;
        }

        if (await _userManager.IsInRoleAsync(
                user,
                IdentityRoles.Officer))
        {
            return IdentityRoles.Officer;
        }

        return IdentityRoles.User;
    }

    private async Task WriteLoginAuditAsync(
        AuditAction action,
        ApplicationUser? user,
        string attemptedEmail,
        string actorRole,
        bool isSuccessful,
        string? failureReason = null)
    {
        var actorEmail = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(user?.Email)
            ? attemptedEmail
            : user.Email;

        await _auditService.WriteAsync(
            new AuditLogRequest
            {
                Action = action,
                ActorUserId = user?.Id,
                ActorEmail = actorEmail,
                ActorRole = actorRole,
                EntityType = nameof(ApplicationUser),
                EntityId = user?.Id,
                Description = isSuccessful
                    ? "تم تسجيل الدخول بنجاح."
                    : "فشلت محاولة تسجيل الدخول.",
                IsSuccessful = isSuccessful,
                FailureReason = failureReason,
                IpAddress = HttpContext.Connection
                    .RemoteIpAddress?.ToString(),
                UserAgent =
                    Request.Headers["User-Agent"].ToString(),
                CorrelationId = HttpContext.TraceIdentifier
            });
    }

    private string GetSafeReturnUrl(string? returnUrl)
    {
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(returnUrl) &&
            Url.IsLocalUrl(returnUrl))
        {
            return returnUrl;
        }

        return string.Empty;
    }

    public class InputModel
    {
        [Required(ErrorMessage = "البريد الإلكتروني مطلوب.")]
        [EmailAddress(
            ErrorMessage = "صيغة البريد الإلكتروني غير صحيحة.")]
        [StringLength(
            256,
            ErrorMessage = "البريد الإلكتروني طويل جدًا.")]
        public string Email { get; set; } = string.Empty;

        [Required(ErrorMessage = "كلمة المرور مطلوبة.")]
        [DataType(DataType.Password)]
        [StringLength(
            128,
            ErrorMessage = "كلمة المرور طويلة جدًا.")]
        public string Password { get; set; } = string.Empty;

        public bool RememberMe { get; set; }
    }
}
````

@{

<!DOCTYPE html>

    <style>
:root { color-scheme: light; }
* { box-sizing: border-box; }
body { margin: 0; background: #f4f7fb; color: #20324a; font-family: "Segoe UI", Tahoma, Arial, sans-serif; line-height: 1.8; }

label { display: block; font-size: .85rem; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: .5rem; }

.code { text-align: center; font-size: 1.8rem; letter-spacing: .25em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.input:focus { outline: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 .2rem #146c601c; border-color: #368c7e; }
.help { color: #617087; font-size: .76rem; line-height: 1.9; margin: .65rem 0 1.3rem; }
.button { width: 100%; border: 1px solid #146c60; border-radius: .6rem; min-height: 3rem; padding: .65rem 1rem; cursor: pointer; font-weight: 600; font-size: .9rem; background: #146c60; color: #fff; }
.button:hover { background: #10584e; border-color: #10584e; }
.button:focus-visible, summary:focus-visible, .cancel:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #247f73; outline-offset: 3px; }
.recovery { margin-top: 1.5rem; padding-top: 1.1rem; border-top: 1px solid #e0e7ef; }
.recovery summary { cursor: pointer; font-size: .8rem; color: #617087; min-height: 2.75rem; padding-block: .35rem; }
.recovery summary::marker { color: #146c60; }
.recovery form { margin-top: .9rem; }
.secondary { color: #526279; border: 1px solid #c9d4e0; background: #fff; }
.secondary:hover { background: #f5f7fb; border-color: #aabccc; }
.cancel-form { margin-top: 1rem; text-align: center; }
.cancel { min-height: 2.75rem; background: none; border: 0; color: #617087; cursor: pointer; font-size: .8rem; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: .2em; }
.validation-summary-valid { display: none; }
.validation-summary-errors { padding: .8rem .9rem; background: #fff0f1; border: 1px solid #f0cbd1; color: #8e2030; border-radius: .65rem; margin-bottom: 1.2rem; font-size: .83rem; }
.validation-summary-errors ul { margin: 0; padding-inline-start: 1.15rem; }
@@media (max-width: 480px) { .card { padding: 1.5rem 1.2rem; } }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <main class="shell">
        <section class="card" aria-labelledby="verify-title">
            <span class="brand" dir="ltr">ACCP</span>
            <h1 id="verify-title">أدخل رمز التحقق</h1>
            <div asp-validation-summary="All" role="alert"></div>

            @if (Model.ChallengeAvailable)
            {
                <p class="description">أدخل الرمز من تطبيق المصادقة لإكمال تسجيل الدخول.</p>
                <form method="post" asp-page="/Account/LoginTwoFactor" asp-antiforgery="true">
                    <input type="hidden" name="returnUrl" value="@Model.ReturnUrl" />
                    <input type="hidden" name="Input.UseRecoveryCode" value="false" />
                    <label for="authenticator-code">رمز تطبيق المصادقة</label>
                    <input id="authenticator-code" name="Input.Code" type="text" dir="ltr" class="input code"
                           inputmode="numeric" autocomplete="one-time-code" minlength="6" maxlength="12"
                           pattern="[0-9 -]{6,12}" required autofocus aria-describedby="authenticator-help" />
                    <p id="authenticator-help" class="help">الرمز مكوّن من 6 أرقام. استخدم الرمز الحالي الظاهر في التطبيق.</p>
                    <button type="submit" class="button">دخول</button>
                </form>
                @if (Model.CanUseRecoveryCodes)
                {
                    <details class="recovery" open="@Model.Input.UseRecoveryCode">
                        <summary>استخدام رمز استرداد بدلًا من رمز التطبيق</summary>
                        <form method="post" asp-page="/Account/LoginTwoFactor" asp-antiforgery="true">
                            <input type="hidden" name="returnUrl" value="@Model.ReturnUrl" />
                            <input type="hidden" name="Input.UseRecoveryCode" value="true" />
                            <label for="recovery-code">رمز الاسترداد</label>
                            <input id="recovery-code" name="Input.RecoveryCode" type="password" dir="ltr" class="input"
                                   maxlength="128" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false" required aria-describedby="recovery-help" />
                            <p id="recovery-help" class="help">كل رمز استرداد يُستخدم مرة واحدة فقط.</p>
                            <button type="submit" class="button secondary">دخول برمز الاسترداد</button>
                        </form>
                    </details>
                }
            }
            else
            {
                <p class="description">أعد تسجيل الدخول للمتابعة. إذا كان الحساب مقفلًا مؤقتًا، انتظر انتهاء مدة القفل.</p>
            }
            <form method="post" asp-page="/Account/LoginTwoFactor" asp-page-handler="Cancel"
                  asp-antiforgery="true" class="cancel-form">
                <input type="hidden" name="returnUrl" value="@Model.ReturnUrl" />
                <button type="submit" class="cancel">العودة إلى تسجيل الدخول</button>
            </form>
        </section>
    </main>
</body>
</html>

<a id="source-159"></a>
### S159 — `ACCP.Web/Pages/Account/LoginTwoFactor.cshtml.cs`


الوظيفة: معالجة تحدي المصادقة الثانية

[العودة إلى شرح الملف](#file-159)


````csharp
using ACCP.Application.Auditing;
using ACCP.Domain.Enums;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Data;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Identity;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.DataProtection;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.RazorPages;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text.Json;

namespace ACCP.Web.Pages.Account;

// The page is anonymous because the password step has not issued an application
// login yet. The protected Identity two-factor cookie identifies the account.
[AllowAnonymous]
[ResponseCache(Duration = 0, Location = ResponseCacheLocation.None, NoStore = true)]
[RequestSizeLimit(16 * 1024)]
public sealed class LoginTwoFactorModel : PageModel
{
    private const string PendingCookieName = "ACCP.PendingTwoFactor";
    private const string PendingPurpose = "ACCP.Login.PendingTwoFactor.v1";
    private readonly SignInManager<ApplicationUser> _signInManager;
    private readonly UserManager<ApplicationUser> _userManager;
    private readonly AccpDbContext _db;
    private readonly IAuditService _audit;

    public LoginTwoFactorModel(SignInManager<ApplicationUser> signInManager,
        UserManager<ApplicationUser> userManager, AccpDbContext db, IAuditService audit)
    {
        _signInManager = signInManager;
        _userManager = userManager;
        _db = db;
        _audit = audit;
    }

    [BindProperty]
    public InputModel Input { get; set; } = new();

    [BindProperty(SupportsGet = true)]
    public bool RememberMe { get; set; }

    public string ReturnUrl { get; private set; } = string.Empty;
    public bool ChallengeAvailable { get; private set; } = true;
    // Derived only from current database roles. This is never bound from a form.
    public bool CanUseRecoveryCodes { get; private set; }

    // Call only from LoginModel after PasswordSignInAsync returns RequiresTwoFactor.
    // Identity's temporary user-id cookie does not contain the security stamp.
    // This additional protected, expiring cookie binds that challenge to the
    // password-verified account's stamp and its server-selected persistence flag.
    public static void BindPendingLogin(HttpContext context, ApplicationUser user, bool rememberMe)
    {
        if (!user.IsActive || !user.TwoFactorEnabled || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(user.SecurityStamp))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("لا يمكن بدء التحقق لهذا الحساب.");
        var protector = context.RequestServices.GetRequiredService<IDataProtectionProvider>()
            .CreateProtector(PendingPurpose).ToTimeLimitedDataProtector();
        var payload = JsonSerializer.Serialize(new PendingLogin(user.Id, user.SecurityStamp, rememberMe));
        context.Response.Cookies.Append(PendingCookieName, protector.Protect(payload, TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5)),
            PendingCookieOptions(context));
    }

    public async Task<IActionResult> OnGetAsync(string? returnUrl = null)
    {
        PrepareResponse(returnUrl);
        if (await GetPendingUserAsync() is null) return RestartLogin();
        return Page();
    }

    public async Task<IActionResult> OnPostAsync(string? returnUrl = null)
    {
        PrepareResponse(returnUrl);
        var user = await GetPendingUserAsync();
        if (user is null) return RestartLogin();

        // OFFICER membership takes precedence, including ADMIN/OFFICER accounts.
        // Reject even a valid, previously generated recovery code before Identity
        // can redeem it or issue an application login cookie.
        if (Input.UseRecoveryCode && !CanUseRecoveryCodes)
            return await RejectOfficerRecoveryAsync(user);

        var submitted = Input.UseRecoveryCode ? Input.RecoveryCode : Input.Code;
        var code = (submitted ?? string.Empty).Replace(" ", string.Empty);
        // Recovery-code separators are part of Identity's generated credential.
        if (!Input.UseRecoveryCode) code = code.Replace("-", string.Empty);
        // Bounded, conditional validation: only the selected form is required.
        if (!ModelState.IsValid || code.Length == 0 || code.Length > 128 ||
            (!Input.UseRecoveryCode && (code.Length != 6 || code.Any(ch => ch < '0' || ch > '9'))))
        {
            ClearCodes();
            ModelState.AddModelError(string.Empty, Input.UseRecoveryCode
                ? "أدخل رمز استرداد صالحًا." : "أدخل رمز تطبيق المصادقة المكوّن من 6 أرقام.");
            return Page();
        }

        var expectedStamp = user.SecurityStamp;
        var recovery = Input.UseRecoveryCode;
        var failedBefore = user.AccessFailedCount;
        Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.SignInResult result;
        try
        {
            // RememberMe controls cookie persistence only. Remembering the
            // second-factor device is deliberately unavailable in this flow.
            result = recovery
                ? await _signInManager.TwoFactorRecoveryCodeSignInAsync(code)
                : await _signInManager.TwoFactorAuthenticatorSignInAsync(code, RememberMe, rememberClient: false);
        }
        finally { ClearCodes(); }

        if (result.Succeeded)
        {
            DeleteBoundCookie();
            // Identity tracks the user within this request. Reload after issuing
            // the cookie so a concurrent disable/stamp change cancels this login.
            await _db.Entry(user).ReloadAsync();
            if (_db.Entry(user).State == EntityState.Detached || !user.IsActive || !user.TwoFactorEnabled ||
                !string.Equals(user.SecurityStamp, expectedStamp, StringComparison.Ordinal))
            {
                await _signInManager.SignOutAsync();
                ChallengeAvailable = false;
                await WriteAuditAsync(user, false, "تغيّرت حالة الحساب أو جلسة التحقق أثناء تسجيل الدخول.");
                ModelState.AddModelError(string.Empty, "تغيّرت حالة الحساب. أعد تسجيل الدخول.");
                return Page();
            }

            // Recheck membership after Identity sign-in as well. A newly assigned
            // officer role must not retain a login just completed with recovery.
            CanUseRecoveryCodes = !await _userManager.IsInRoleAsync(user, IdentityRoles.Officer);
            if (recovery && !CanUseRecoveryCodes)
            {
                await _signInManager.SignOutAsync();
                return await RejectOfficerRecoveryAsync(user);
            }

            try { await WriteAuditAsync(user, true, null); }
            catch
            {
                // Never leave a successful login cookie after audit persistence fails.
                await _signInManager.SignOutAsync();
                ChallengeAvailable = false;
                ModelState.AddModelError(string.Empty, "تعذر إكمال تسجيل الدخول. حاول تسجيل الدخول مجددًا.");
                return Page();
            }

            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(ReturnUrl)) return LocalRedirect(ReturnUrl);
            if (await _userManager.IsInRoleAsync(user, IdentityRoles.Admin)) return LocalRedirect("/admin/employees");
            if (await _userManager.IsInRoleAsync(user, IdentityRoles.Officer)) return LocalRedirect("/officer/dashboard");
            return LocalRedirect("/cases");
        }

        // Identity's authenticator path applies lockout. Recovery-code failure
        // can return Failed without incrementing; cover it without double-counting.
        if (recovery && !result.IsLockedOut && !result.IsNotAllowed && _userManager.SupportsUserLockout)
        {
            await _db.Entry(user).ReloadAsync();
            if (user.AccessFailedCount == failedBefore && !await _userManager.IsLockedOutAsync(user))
            {
                var increment = await _userManager.AccessFailedAsync(user);
                if (!increment.Succeeded)
                {
                    await ClearPendingCookieAsync();
                    ChallengeAvailable = false;
                    ModelState.AddModelError(string.Empty, "تعذر إكمال التحقق. أعد تسجيل الدخول.");
                    return Page();
                }
            }
            if (await _userManager.IsLockedOutAsync(user)) result = Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.SignInResult.LockedOut;
        }

        await WriteAuditAsync(user, false, result.IsLockedOut
            ? "تم قفل الحساب مؤقتًا بعد محاولات تحقق فاشلة."
            : "فشل التحقق من العامل الثاني.");

        if (result.IsLockedOut || result.IsNotAllowed)
        {
            await ClearPendingCookieAsync();
            ChallengeAvailable = false;
            ModelState.AddModelError(string.Empty, result.IsLockedOut
                ? "تم إيقاف تسجيل الدخول مؤقتًا بسبب تكرار المحاولات الخاطئة. حاول لاحقًا."
                : "تعذر إكمال تسجيل الدخول لهذا الحساب.");
        }
        else
        {
            ModelState.AddModelError(string.Empty, recovery
                ? "رمز الاسترداد غير صحيح أو استُخدم سابقًا."
                : "رمز التحقق غير صحيح. أدخل الرمز الحالي من تطبيق المصادقة.");
        }
        return Page();
    }

    public async Task<IActionResult> OnPostCancelAsync(string? returnUrl = null)
    {
        PrepareResponse(returnUrl);
        ClearCodes();
        await ClearPendingCookieAsync();
        return RestartLogin();
    }

    private async Task<ApplicationUser?> GetPendingUserAsync()
    {
        var ticket = await HttpContext.AuthenticateAsync(IdentityConstants.TwoFactorUserIdScheme);
        if (!ticket.Succeeded || ticket.Principal is null) return null;
        var user = await _signInManager.GetTwoFactorAuthenticationUserAsync();
        if (user is null) { await ClearPendingCookieAsync(); return null; }

        await _db.Entry(user).ReloadAsync();
        if (_db.Entry(user).State == EntityState.Detached || !user.IsActive || !user.TwoFactorEnabled)
        {
            await ClearPendingCookieAsync();
            return null;
        }
        PendingLogin? pending = null;
        if (Request.Cookies.TryGetValue(PendingCookieName, out var protectedState))
        {
            try
            {
                var protector = HttpContext.RequestServices.GetRequiredService<IDataProtectionProvider>()
                    .CreateProtector(PendingPurpose).ToTimeLimitedDataProtector();
                pending = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<PendingLogin>(protector.Unprotect(protectedState));
            }
            catch (CryptographicException) { }
            catch (JsonException) { }
        }
        if (pending is null || pending.UserId != user.Id || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(pending.SecurityStamp) ||
            !string.Equals(pending.SecurityStamp, user.SecurityStamp, StringComparison.Ordinal))
        {
            await ClearPendingCookieAsync();
            return null;
        }
        RememberMe = pending.RememberMe;
        CanUseRecoveryCodes = !await _userManager.IsInRoleAsync(user, IdentityRoles.Officer);
        return user;
    }

    private async Task<IActionResult> RejectOfficerRecoveryAsync(ApplicationUser user)
    {
        ClearCodes();
        Input.UseRecoveryCode = false;
        ModelState.Remove("Input.UseRecoveryCode");
        CanUseRecoveryCodes = false;
        ChallengeAvailable = false;
        await ClearPendingCookieAsync();
        await WriteAuditAsync(user, false, "رموز الاسترداد غير مسموحة لحسابات الموظفين.");
        ModelState.AddModelError(string.Empty,
            "حساب الموظف يتطلب كود تطبيق التحقق. أعد تسجيل الدخول واستخدم الكود الحالي من التطبيق.");
        return Page();
    }

    private void PrepareResponse(string? returnUrl)
    {
        ReturnUrl = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(returnUrl) && Url.IsLocalUrl(returnUrl) ? returnUrl : string.Empty;
        CanUseRecoveryCodes = false;
        Response.Headers.CacheControl = "no-store";
        Response.Headers.Pragma = "no-cache";
        Response.Headers["X-Content-Type-Options"] = "nosniff";
    }

    private IActionResult RestartLogin() => LocalRedirect(string.IsNullOrEmpty(ReturnUrl)
        ? "/login" : "/login?returnUrl=" + Uri.EscapeDataString(ReturnUrl));

    private async Task ClearPendingCookieAsync()
    {
        DeleteBoundCookie();
        await HttpContext.SignOutAsync(IdentityConstants.TwoFactorUserIdScheme);
    }

    private void DeleteBoundCookie()
    {
        var options = PendingCookieOptions(HttpContext);
        options.MaxAge = TimeSpan.Zero;
        Response.Cookies.Delete(PendingCookieName, options);
    }

    private static CookieOptions PendingCookieOptions(HttpContext context) => new()
    {
        HttpOnly = true, Secure = context.Request.IsHttps, SameSite = SameSiteMode.Strict,
        Path = "/", IsEssential = true, MaxAge = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5)
    };

    private sealed record PendingLogin(Guid UserId, string SecurityStamp, bool RememberMe);

    private void ClearCodes()
    {
        Input.Code = string.Empty;
        Input.RecoveryCode = string.Empty;
        ModelState.Remove("Input.Code");
        ModelState.Remove("Input.RecoveryCode");
    }

    private async Task WriteAuditAsync(ApplicationUser user, bool successful, string? reason)
    {
        var role = await _userManager.IsInRoleAsync(user, IdentityRoles.Admin) ? IdentityRoles.Admin
            : await _userManager.IsInRoleAsync(user, IdentityRoles.Officer) ? IdentityRoles.Officer : IdentityRoles.User;
        await _audit.WriteAsync(new AuditLogRequest
        {
            Action = successful ? AuditAction.UserLoggedIn : AuditAction.UserLoginFailed,
            ActorUserId = user.Id, ActorEmail = user.Email, ActorRole = role,
            EntityType = nameof(ApplicationUser), EntityId = user.Id,
            Description = successful ? "تم تسجيل الدخول بالمصادقة الثنائية." : "فشلت محاولة التحقق من العامل الثاني.",
            IsSuccessful = successful, FailureReason = reason,
            IpAddress = HttpContext.Connection.RemoteIpAddress?.ToString(),
            UserAgent = Request.Headers["User-Agent"].ToString(), CorrelationId = HttpContext.TraceIdentifier
        });
    }

    public sealed class InputModel
    {
        public string Code { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public string RecoveryCode { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public bool UseRecoveryCode { get; set; }
    }
}
````

### S161 — `ACCP.Web/Pages/Account/Logout.cshtml.cs`


الوظيفة: إنهاء الجلسة وتسجيل حدث الخروج

[العودة إلى شرح الملف](#file-161)


````csharp
using System.Security.Claims;
using ACCP.Application.Auditing;
using ACCP.Domain.Enums;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Identity;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.RazorPages;

namespace ACCP.Web.Pages.Account;

[Authorize]
public class LogoutModel : PageModel
{
    private readonly SignInManager<ApplicationUser> _signInManager;
    private readonly IAuditService _auditService;

    public LogoutModel(
        SignInManager<ApplicationUser> signInManager,
        IAuditService auditService)
    {
        _signInManager = signInManager;
        _auditService = auditService;
    }

    public void OnGet()
    {
    }

    public async Task<IActionResult> OnPostAsync()
    {
        string? userIdValue =
            User.FindFirstValue(
                ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier);

        Guid? actorUserId =
            Guid.TryParse(
                userIdValue,
                out Guid parsedUserId)
                ? parsedUserId
                : null;

        string? actorEmail =
            User.FindFirstValue(
                ClaimTypes.Email)
            ?? User.Identity?.Name;

        string actorRole = GetActorRole();

        string? ipAddress =
            HttpContext.Connection
                .RemoteIpAddress
                ?.ToString();

        string userAgent =
            Request.Headers[
                "User-Agent"].ToString();

        string correlationId =
            HttpContext.TraceIdentifier;

        await _signInManager.SignOutAsync();

        await _auditService.WriteAsync(
            new AuditLogRequest
            {
                Action = AuditAction.UserLoggedOut,
                ActorUserId = actorUserId,
                ActorEmail = actorEmail,
                ActorRole = actorRole,
                EntityType = nameof(ApplicationUser),
                EntityId = actorUserId,
                Description =
                    "تم تسجيل الخروج بنجاح.",
                IsSuccessful = true,
                IpAddress = ipAddress,
                UserAgent = userAgent,
                CorrelationId = correlationId
            });

        return LocalRedirect("/login");
    }

    private string GetActorRole()
    {
        if (User.IsInRole(IdentityRoles.Admin))
        {
            return IdentityRoles.Admin;
        }

        if (User.IsInRole(IdentityRoles.Officer))
        {
            return IdentityRoles.Officer;
        }

        if (User.IsInRole(IdentityRoles.User))
        {
            return IdentityRoles.User;
        }

        return "UNKNOWN";
    }
}
````

        .alert ul { margin: 0; padding-inline-start: 20px; }
