````cshtml
        .button:hover { background: #11564f; border-color: #11564f; }
        .wide { width: 100%; }
        a:focus-visible, button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #8cc9bc; outline-offset: 4px; }
        .actions { margin-top: 24px; padding-top: 20px; border-top: 1px solid #e5edf3; text-align: center; }
        .retry { font-size: .8rem; }
        @@media (max-width: 800px) {
            .page { max-width: 620px; }
            .topbar { margin-bottom: 28px; }
            .layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr; grid-template-areas: "form" "intro"; }
            .card, .intro { padding: 32px; }
        }
        @@media (max-width: 480px) {
            .page { padding: 20px 14px 32px; }
            .card, .intro { padding: 27px 21px; }
            .layout { border-radius: 14px; }
        }
    </style>
</head>

<body>
    <main class="page">
        <nav class="topbar" aria-label="التنقل">
            <a href="/" class="brand" dir="ltr">ACCP</a>
            <a href="/login" class="back">العودة إلى تسجيل الدخول ←</a>
        </nav>

        <div class="layout">
            <aside class="intro" aria-labelledby="page-title">
                <p class="eyebrow">استعادة حساب المشتكي</p>

                <h1 id="page-title">
                    كلمة مرور جديدة.<br />
                    <span>ومتابعتك مستمرة.</span>
                </h1>

                <p class="lead">
                    اختر كلمة مرور جديدة لحسابك،
                    ثم سجّل الدخول للعودة إلى محادثاتك وبلاغاتك.
                </p>

                <ol class="steps" aria-label="خطوات تعيين كلمة المرور">
                    <li class="step">
                        <span class="step-number" aria-hidden="true">01</span>
                        <div>
                            <strong>اكتب كلمة المرور الجديدة</strong>
                            <p>استخدم كلمة مرور طويلة وفريدة لهذا الحساب.</p>
                        </div>
                    </li>

                    <li class="step">
                        <span class="step-number" aria-hidden="true">02</span>
                        <div>
                            <strong>أكّدها واحفظ التغيير</strong>
                            <p>أعد كتابتها للتأكد من تطابق الحقلين.</p>
                        </div>
                    </li>

                    <li class="step">
                        <span class="step-number" aria-hidden="true">03</span>
                        <div>
                            <strong>عد إلى تسجيل الدخول</strong>
                            <p>استخدم كلمة المرور الجديدة لمتابعة حسابك.</p>
                        </div>
                    </li>
                </ol>

                <p class="privacy">
                    احتفظ بكلمة مرورك لنفسك، ولا تشارك رابط الاستعادة.
                </p>
            </aside>

            <section class="card" aria-labelledby="section-title">
                @if (Model.RequestCompleted)
                {
                    <span class="tag">اكتمل التغيير</span>
                    <h2 id="section-title">تم تحديث كلمة المرور</h2>

                    <p id="confirmation"
                       class="description"
                       role="status">
                        @Model.ConfirmationMessage
                    </p>

                    <a href="/login" class="button wide">
                        تسجيل الدخول
                    </a>
                }
                else if (Model.ShowResetForm)
                {
                    <span class="tag">حسابات المشتكين</span>
                    <h2 id="section-title">تعيين كلمة مرور جديدة</h2>

                    <p class="description">
                        أدخل كلمة المرور مرتين للتأكد من كتابتها بشكل صحيح.
                    </p>

                    <div asp-validation-summary="ModelOnly"
                         class="alert"
                         role="alert"></div>

                    <form method="post"
                          asp-page="/Account/ResetPassword"
                          asp-antiforgery="true"
                          autocomplete="on">

                        <input asp-for="Input.Token" type="hidden" />

                        <div class="field">
                            <label for="new-password">
                                كلمة المرور الجديدة
                            </label>

                            <input asp-for="Input.Password"
                                   id="new-password"
                                   type="password"
                                   class="input"
                                   dir="ltr"
                                   autocomplete="new-password"
                                   minlength="8"
                                   maxlength="128"
                                   required
                                   aria-describedby="password-help password-error"
                                   aria-invalid="@(passwordError ? "true" : "false")" />

                            <span asp-validation-for="Input.Password"
                                  id="password-error"
                                  class="field-error"
                                  role="alert"></span>
                        </div>

                        <p id="password-help" class="help">
                            من 8 إلى 128 حرفًا، تتضمن حرفًا إنجليزيًا كبيرًا
                            وصغيرًا ورقمًا ورمزًا.
                            يُفضّل استخدام عبارة طويلة وفريدة.
                        </p>

                        <div class="field">
                            <label for="confirm-password">
                                تأكيد كلمة المرور
                            </label>

                            <input asp-for="Input.ConfirmPassword"
                                   id="confirm-password"
                                   type="password"
                                   class="input"
                                   dir="ltr"
                                   autocomplete="new-password"
                                   minlength="8"
                                   maxlength="128"
                                   required
                                   aria-describedby="confirmation-error"
                                   aria-invalid="@(confirmationError ? "true" : "false")" />

                            <span asp-validation-for="Input.ConfirmPassword"
                                  id="confirmation-error"
                                  class="field-error"
                                  role="alert"></span>
                        </div>

                        <button type="submit" class="button wide">
                            حفظ كلمة المرور الجديدة
                        </button>
                    </form>

                    <div class="actions">
                        <a href="/forgot-password" class="retry">
                            انتهت صلاحية الرابط؟ اطلب رابطًا جديدًا
                        </a>
                    </div>
                }
                else
                {
                    <span class="tag">رابط الاستعادة</span>
                    <h2 id="section-title">تعذّر استخدام رابط الاستعادة</h2>

                    <div asp-validation-summary="All"
                         class="alert"
                         role="alert"></div>

                    <p class="description">
                        اطلب رسالة استعادة جديدة وافتح الرابط الموجود فيها للمتابعة.
                    </p>

                    <a href="/forgot-password" class="button wide">
                        طلب رابط جديد
                    </a>
                }
            </section>
        </div>
    </main>
</body>
</html>
````

### S163 — `ACCP.Web/Pages/Account/ResetPassword.cshtml.cs`


الوظيفة: معالجة تذكرة الاستعادة وكلمة المرور

[العودة إلى شرح الملف](#file-163)


````csharp
using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;
using ACCP.Web.Security;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.RazorPages;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.RateLimiting;

namespace ACCP.Web.Pages.Account;

[AllowAnonymous]
[AutoValidateAntiforgeryToken]
[EnableRateLimiting("reporter-recovery-reset")]
[ResponseCache(Duration = 0, Location = ResponseCacheLocation.None, NoStore = true)]
[RequestSizeLimit(64 * 1024)]
public sealed class ResetPasswordModel : PageModel
{
    private const string InvalidLink = "رابط الاستعادة غير صالح أو انتهت صلاحيته. اطلب رابطًا جديدًا.";
    private readonly ReporterPasswordResetService _recovery;
    private readonly ILogger<ResetPasswordModel> _logger;

    public ResetPasswordModel(ReporterPasswordResetService recovery, ILogger<ResetPasswordModel> logger)
    {
        _recovery = recovery;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    [BindProperty]
    public InputModel Input { get; set; } = new();
    public bool ShowResetForm { get; private set; }
    public bool RequestCompleted { get; private set; }
    public string ConfirmationMessage { get; private set; } = string.Empty;

    public void OnGet(string? token)
    {
        PrepareResponse();
        ModelState.Clear();
        Input = new InputModel();
        if (!HasTokenShape(token))
        {
            ModelState.AddModelError(string.Empty, InvalidLink);
            return;
        }
        // Actual expiry, eligibility and single use are checked on POST.
        Input.Token = token!;
        ShowResetForm = true;
    }

    public async Task<IActionResult> OnPostAsync()
    {
        PrepareResponse();
        Input ??= new InputModel();
        try
        {
            if (!HasTokenShape(Input.Token))
            {
                Input.Token = string.Empty;
                ModelState.Clear();
                ModelState.AddModelError(string.Empty, InvalidLink);
                return Page();
            }
            ShowResetForm = true;
            if (!ModelState.IsValid) return Page();
            var result = await _recovery.ResetPasswordAsync(
                Input.Token, Input.Password, HttpContext.RequestAborted);
            if (!result.Succeeded)
            {
                ModelState.AddModelError(string.Empty, result.Message);
                return Page();
            }
            Input.Token = string.Empty;
            ModelState.Clear();
            ShowResetForm = false;
            RequestCompleted = true;
            ConfirmationMessage = result.Message;
            // Password recovery never signs the browser in automatically.
            return Page();
        }
        catch (Exception exception) when (!HttpContext.RequestAborted.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            // Never log exception messages, tickets or passwords.
            _logger.LogWarning(new EventId(4711, "PasswordRecoveryResetFailed"),
                "Password recovery reset failed. Failure category: {FailureCategory}.",
                exception.GetType().Name);
            ModelState.AddModelError(string.Empty, "تعذر إكمال الاستعادة. حاول مرة أخرى.");
            return Page();
        }
        finally
        {
            Input.Password = string.Empty;
            Input.ConfirmPassword = string.Empty;
            ClearPostedValue("Input.Password");
            ClearPostedValue("Input.ConfirmPassword");
        }
    }

    private void ClearPostedValue(string key)
    {
        // Retain validation errors while erasing attempted and raw values.
        if (ModelState.ContainsKey(key))
            ModelState.SetModelValue(key, string.Empty, string.Empty);
    }

    private static bool HasTokenShape(string? token) =>
        !string.IsNullOrEmpty(token) && token.Length <= 16384 &&
        !token.Any(character => char.IsWhiteSpace(character) || char.IsControl(character));

    private void PrepareResponse()
    {
        ShowResetForm = false;
        RequestCompleted = false;
        ConfirmationMessage = string.Empty;
        Response.Headers["Cache-Control"] = "no-store";
        Response.Headers["Pragma"] = "no-cache";
        Response.Headers["Referrer-Policy"] = "no-referrer";
        Response.Headers["X-Content-Type-Options"] = "nosniff";
        Response.Headers["X-Frame-Options"] = "DENY";
        Response.Headers["Content-Security-Policy"] =
            "default-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; form-action 'self'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'";
    }

    public sealed class InputModel
    {
        [Required(ErrorMessage = InvalidLink)]
        [StringLength(16384, ErrorMessage = InvalidLink)]
        public string Token { get; set; } = string.Empty;

        [Required(ErrorMessage = "أدخل كلمة المرور الجديدة.")]
        [StringLength(128, MinimumLength = 8, ErrorMessage = "كلمة المرور يجب أن تكون بين 8 و128 حرفًا.")]
        [DataType(DataType.Password)]
        public string Password { get; set; } = string.Empty;

        [Required(ErrorMessage = "أكّد كلمة المرور الجديدة.")]
        [StringLength(128, ErrorMessage = "تأكيد كلمة المرور طويل جدًا.")]
        [DataType(DataType.Password)]
        [Compare(nameof(Password), ErrorMessage = "كلمتا المرور غير متطابقتين.")]
        public string ConfirmPassword { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    }
}
````

[العودة إلى شرح الملف](#file-165)


````csharp
using System.Security.Claims;
using System.Threading.RateLimiting;
using ACCP.Application.Auditing;
using ACCP.Application.Cases;
using ACCP.Application.EvidenceManagement;
using ACCP.Application.Notifications;
using ACCP.Application.Security;
using ACCP.Domain.Enums;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Data;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Identity;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Services;
using ACCP.Web.Components;
using ACCP.Web.Security;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.RateLimiting;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using EvidenceEntity = ACCP.Domain.Entities.Evidence;
using EvidenceRevisionEntity = ACCP.Domain.Entities.EvidenceRevision;

var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

builder.Services.AddHttpContextAccessor();

var connectionString =
    builder.Configuration.GetConnectionString("DefaultConnection")
    ?? throw new InvalidOperationException(
        "Database connection string was not found.");

builder.Services.AddDbContext<AccpDbContext>(options =>
    options.UseSqlServer(connectionString));

// خدمات الصلاحيات وإدارة الموظفين.
builder.Services.AddScoped<CaseAuthorizationService>();
builder.Services.AddScoped<EmployeeManagementService>();

builder.Services.AddScoped<
    ACCP.Web.Security.AdminOfficerWorkloadService>();

builder.Services.AddScoped<
    ACCP.Web.Security.AdminCaseReassignmentService>();

builder.Services.AddScoped<
    ACCP.Web.Security.AdminCaseReopeningService>();

builder.Services.AddScoped<
    ACCP.Web.Security.EmployeeTwoFactorResetService>();

// سجل التدقيق.
builder.Services.AddScoped<
    ACCP.Infrastructure.Services.AuditService>();

builder.Services.AddScoped<
    IAuditService,
    ACCP.Web.Security.AuthorizedAuditService>();

// الإشعارات.
builder.Services.AddScoped<
    ACCP.Infrastructure.Services.NotificationService>();

builder.Services.AddScoped<
    INotificationService,
    ACCP.Web.Security.AuthorizedNotificationService>();

builder.Services.AddDataProtection();

// استعادة كلمة المرور.
builder.Services.AddOptions<SmtpPasswordResetOptions>()
    .Bind(builder.Configuration.GetSection("Email:Smtp"));

builder.Services.AddScoped<
    IPasswordResetEmailSender,
    SmtpPasswordResetEmailSender>();

builder.Services.AddScoped<ReporterPasswordResetService>();

// القضايا والطلبات والأدلة.
builder.Services.AddScoped<
    ICaseService,
    AuthorizedCaseService>();

builder.Services.AddScoped<
    ACCP.Application.CaseStaffing.ICaseStaffRequestService,
    ACCP.Web.Security.AuthorizedCaseStaffRequestService>();

builder.Services.AddScoped<
    IEvidenceService,
    AuthorizedEvidenceService>();

// الهوية.
builder.Services
    .AddIdentity<ApplicationUser, IdentityRole<Guid>>(options =>
    {
        options.User.RequireUniqueEmail = true;

        options.Password.RequiredLength = 8;
        options.Password.RequireDigit = true;
        options.Password.RequireLowercase = true;
        options.Password.RequireUppercase = true;
        options.Password.RequireNonAlphanumeric = true;

        options.Lockout.MaxFailedAccessAttempts = 5;
        options.Lockout.DefaultLockoutTimeSpan =
            TimeSpan.FromMinutes(15);
    })
    .AddEntityFrameworkStores<AccpDbContext>()
    .AddDefaultTokenProviders();

builder.Services.ConfigureApplicationCookie(options =>
{
    options.Cookie.Name = "ACCP.Authentication";
    options.LoginPath = "/login";
    options.AccessDeniedPath = "/access-denied";
    options.ExpireTimeSpan = TimeSpan.FromHours(2);
    options.SlidingExpiration = true;
    options.Cookie.HttpOnly = true;
    options.Cookie.SameSite = SameSiteMode.Strict;
    options.Cookie.SecurePolicy =
        CookieSecurePolicy.SameAsRequest;
});

builder.Services.Configure<SecurityStampValidatorOptions>(options =>
{
    options.OnRefreshingPrincipal = context =>
    {
        var current = context.CurrentPrincipal;
        var refreshed = context.NewPrincipal;

        if (current is null || refreshed is null)
            return Task.CompletedTask;

        var oldId = current.FindFirstValue(
            ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier);

        var newId = refreshed.FindFirstValue(
            ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier);

        var oldStamp = current.FindFirstValue(
            "AspNet.Identity.SecurityStamp");

        var newStamp = refreshed.FindFirstValue(
            "AspNet.Identity.SecurityStamp");

        if (StaffTwoFactorFlow.HasCompletedTwoFactor(current) &&
            Guid.TryParse(oldId, out var accountId) &&
            accountId != Guid.Empty &&
            Guid.TryParse(newId, out var refreshedId) &&
            refreshedId == accountId &&
            !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(oldStamp) &&
            string.Equals(
                oldStamp,
                newStamp,
                StringComparison.Ordinal) &&
            refreshed.Identity is ClaimsIdentity identity &&
            identity.AuthenticationType ==
                IdentityConstants.ApplicationScheme &&
            !identity.HasClaim("amr", "mfa"))
        {
            identity.AddClaim(new Claim("amr", "mfa"));
        }

        return Task.CompletedTask;
    };
});

builder.Services.AddAuthorization();
builder.Services.AddCascadingAuthenticationState();

builder.Services.AddRazorComponents()
    .AddInteractiveServerComponents();

builder.Services.AddRazorPages();

// تحديد محاولات استعادة كلمة المرور.
builder.Services.AddRateLimiter(options =>
{
    options.RejectionStatusCode =
        StatusCodes.Status429TooManyRequests;

    options.AddPolicy(
        "reporter-recovery-request",
        context => RecoveryPartition(context, 3));

    options.AddPolicy(
        "reporter-recovery-reset",
        context => RecoveryPartition(context, 10));

    options.OnRejected = async (context, cancellationToken) =>
    {
        var response = context.HttpContext.Response;

        response.StatusCode =
            StatusCodes.Status429TooManyRequests;

        response.ContentType = "text/plain; charset=utf-8";
        response.Headers["Cache-Control"] = "no-store";

        if (context.Lease.TryGetMetadata(
            MetadataName.RetryAfter,
            out var retryAfter))
        {
            response.Headers["Retry-After"] =
                Math.Max(
                    1,
                    Math.Ceiling(retryAfter.TotalSeconds))
                .ToString(
                    System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        }

        await response.WriteAsync(
            "وصلت للحد المسموح من محاولات الاستعادة. انتظر بضع دقائق ثم حاول مجددًا.",
            cancellationToken);
    };
});

// خدمات المحادثات الحالية.
builder.Services.AddScoped<
    ACCP.Application.Chat.ICaseIntakeAssistant,
    ACCP.Web.Services.Chat.UnavailableCaseIntakeAssistant>();

builder.Services.AddScoped<
    ACCP.Application.Chat.IIntakeConversationService,
    ACCP.Web.Services.Chat.IntakeConversationService>();

builder.Services.AddScoped<
    ACCP.Application.Chat.IIntakeAssistantWorkflow,
    ACCP.Web.Services.Chat.IntakeAssistantWorkflow>();

builder.Services.AddScoped<
    ACCP.Application.Chat.IIntakeFormalReportService,
    ACCP.Web.Services.Chat.IntakeFormalReportService>();

builder.Services.AddScoped<
    ACCP.Application.Chat.IStaffIntakeHistoryService,
    ACCP.Web.Services.Chat.StaffIntakeHistoryService>();
builder.Services.AddScoped<
    ACCP.Web.Services.NotificationReadState>();
var app = builder.Build();

var staffHistoryRegistered = app.Services
    .GetRequiredService<
        Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.IServiceProviderIsService>()
    .IsService(
        typeof(ACCP.Application.Chat.IStaffIntakeHistoryService));

app.Logger.LogInformation(
    "ACCP startup PID {ProcessId}: StaffIntakeHistoryService registered = {Registered}",
    Environment.ProcessId,
    staffHistoryRegistered);

await IdentitySeeder.SeedRolesAsync(app.Services);

if (!app.Environment.IsDevelopment())
{
    app.UseExceptionHandler(
        "/Error",
        createScopeForErrors: true);

    app.UseHsts();
}

app.UseStatusCodePagesWithReExecute(
    "/not-found",
    createScopeForStatusCodePages: true);

app.UseHttpsRedirection();
app.UseRouting();
app.UseAuthentication();
app.UseRequiredOfficerTwoFactor();
app.UseRateLimiter();
app.UseAuthorization();
app.UseAntiforgery();

app.MapStaticAssets();

// عرض الدليل الحالي.
app.MapGet(
    "/evidence/{id:guid}/view",
    async (
        Guid id,
        ClaimsPrincipal currentUser,
        HttpContext httpContext,
        AccpDbContext dbContext,
        IWebHostEnvironment environment,
        CaseAuthorizationService authorizationService,
        IAuditService auditService) =>
    {
        var actor =
            await authorizationService.GetCurrentActorAsync(
                httpContext.RequestAborted);

        if (actor is null)
        {
            await WriteEvidenceAuditAsync(
                auditService,
                dbContext,
                AuditAction.AccessDenied,
                currentUser,
                null,
                nameof(EvidenceEntity),
                id,
                "تم رفض محاولة فتح دليل بسبب هوية مستخدم غير صالحة.",
                false,
                "تعذر التعرف على معرّف المستخدم.");

            return Results.Unauthorized();
        }

        Guid currentUserId = actor.UserId;

        var evidence = await dbContext.EvidenceItems
            .AsNoTracking()
            .Where(item => item.Id == id)
            .Select(item => new
            {
                item.Id,
                item.CyberCaseId,
                item.StorageKey,
                item.ContentType,
                item.IsRestricted,
                item.IsDisclosedToOfficer,
                ReporterId = item.CyberCase.ReporterId
            })
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(
                httpContext.RequestAborted);

        if (evidence is null)
        {
            await WriteEvidenceAuditAsync(
                auditService,
                dbContext,
                AuditAction.AccessDenied,
                currentUser,
                null,
                nameof(EvidenceEntity),
                id,
                "تم رفض محاولة فتح دليل غير متاح.",
                false,
                "الدليل غير موجود.");

            return Results.NotFound();
        }

        var decision = await authorizationService.CheckAsync(
            evidence.CyberCaseId,
            CasePermission.ReadDetails,
            httpContext.RequestAborted);

        bool isReporter =
            decision.Actor is not null &&
            decision.Actor.HasRole(IdentityRoles.User) &&
            evidence.ReporterId == currentUserId;

        bool officerCanViewEvidence =
            decision.Actor is not null &&
            decision.Actor.HasRole(IdentityRoles.Officer) &&
            (!evidence.IsRestricted ||
             evidence.IsDisclosedToOfficer);

        if (!decision.IsAllowed ||
            decision.Actor?.UserId != currentUserId ||
            (!isReporter && !officerCanViewEvidence))
        {
            await WriteEvidenceAuditAsync(
                auditService,
                dbContext,
                AuditAction.AccessDenied,
                currentUser,
                evidence.CyberCaseId,
                nameof(EvidenceEntity),
                evidence.Id,
                "تم رفض محاولة فتح دليل دون صلاحية.",
                false,
                "المستخدم لا يملك صلاحية عرض الدليل.");

            return Results.NotFound();
        }

        string evidenceRoot = Path.GetFullPath(
            Path.Combine(
                environment.ContentRootPath,
                "App_Data",
                "Evidence"));

        string fullFilePath = Path.GetFullPath(
            Path.Combine(
                evidenceRoot,
                evidence.StorageKey));

        string allowedRoot =
            evidenceRoot.TrimEnd(
                Path.DirectorySeparatorChar,
                Path.AltDirectorySeparatorChar)
            + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar;

        if (!fullFilePath.StartsWith(
            allowedRoot,
            OperatingSystem.IsWindows()
                ? StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase
                : StringComparison.Ordinal))
        {
            await WriteEvidenceAuditAsync(
                auditService,
                dbContext,
                AuditAction.AccessDenied,
                currentUser,
                evidence.CyberCaseId,
                nameof(EvidenceEntity),
                evidence.Id,
                "تم رفض فتح دليل بسبب مسار تخزين غير صالح.",
                false,
                "فشل التحقق الأمني من مسار الدليل.");

            return Results.NotFound();
        }

        if (!File.Exists(fullFilePath))
        {
            await WriteEvidenceAuditAsync(
                auditService,
                dbContext,
                AuditAction.EvidenceViewed,
                currentUser,
                evidence.CyberCaseId,
                nameof(EvidenceEntity),
                evidence.Id,
                "تعذر فتح الدليل.",
                false,
                "ملف الدليل غير موجود في التخزين.");

            return Results.NotFound();
        }

        if (ShouldWriteViewAudit(httpContext.Request))
        {
            await WriteEvidenceAuditAsync(
                auditService,
                dbContext,
                AuditAction.EvidenceViewed,
                currentUser,
                evidence.CyberCaseId,
                nameof(EvidenceEntity),
                evidence.Id,
                "تم فتح الدليل الحالي.",
                true);
        }

        httpContext.Response.Headers.CacheControl =
            "no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate";

        httpContext.Response.Headers.Pragma = "no-cache";

        httpContext.Response.Headers["X-Content-Type-Options"] =
            "nosniff";

        return Results.File(
            fullFilePath,
            evidence.ContentType,
            enableRangeProcessing: true);
    })
    .RequireAuthorization();

// عرض نسخة محفوظة من الدليل.
app.MapGet(
    "/evidence-revisions/{id:guid}/view",
    async (
        Guid id,
        ClaimsPrincipal currentUser,
        HttpContext httpContext,
        AccpDbContext dbContext,
        IWebHostEnvironment environment,
        CaseAuthorizationService authorizationService,
        IAuditService auditService) =>
    {
        var actor =
            await authorizationService.GetCurrentActorAsync(
                httpContext.RequestAborted);

        if (actor is null)
        {
            await WriteEvidenceAuditAsync(
                auditService,
                dbContext,
                AuditAction.AccessDenied,
                currentUser,
                null,
                nameof(EvidenceRevisionEntity),
                id,
                "تم رفض محاولة فتح نسخة دليل بسبب هوية مستخدم غير صالحة.",
                false,
                "تعذر التعرف على معرّف المستخدم.");

            return Results.Unauthorized();
        }

        Guid currentUserId = actor.UserId;

        var revision = await dbContext.EvidenceRevisions
            .AsNoTracking()
            .Where(item => item.Id == id)
            .Select(item => new
            {
                item.Id,
                item.EvidenceId,
                item.VersionNumber,
                item.StorageKey,
                item.ContentType,
                CyberCaseId = item.Evidence.CyberCaseId,
                ReporterId = item.Evidence.CyberCase.ReporterId,
                item.Evidence.IsRestricted,
                item.Evidence.IsDisclosedToOfficer
            })
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(
                httpContext.RequestAborted);

        if (revision is null)
        {
            await WriteEvidenceAuditAsync(
                auditService,
                dbContext,
                AuditAction.AccessDenied,
                currentUser,
                null,
                nameof(EvidenceRevisionEntity),
                id,
                "تم رفض محاولة فتح نسخة دليل غير متاحة.",
                false,
                "نسخة الدليل غير موجودة.");

            return Results.NotFound();
        }

        var decision = await authorizationService.CheckAsync(
            revision.CyberCaseId,
            CasePermission.ReadDetails,
            httpContext.RequestAborted);

        bool reporterOwnsCase =
            decision.Actor is not null &&
            decision.Actor.HasRole(IdentityRoles.User) &&
            revision.ReporterId == currentUserId;

        int latestVersionNumber =
            await dbContext.EvidenceRevisions
                .AsNoTracking()
                .Where(item =>
                    item.EvidenceId == revision.EvidenceId)
                .Select(item => (int?)item.VersionNumber)
                .MaxAsync()
            ?? 0;

        bool reporterCanViewRevision =
            reporterOwnsCase &&
            revision.VersionNumber == latestVersionNumber;

        bool officerCanViewRevision =
            decision.Actor is not null &&
            decision.Actor.HasRole(IdentityRoles.Officer) &&
            (!revision.IsRestricted ||
             revision.IsDisclosedToOfficer);

        if (!decision.IsAllowed ||
            decision.Actor?.UserId != currentUserId ||
            (!reporterCanViewRevision &&
             !officerCanViewRevision))
        {
            await WriteEvidenceAuditAsync(
                auditService,
                dbContext,
                AuditAction.AccessDenied,
                currentUser,
                revision.CyberCaseId,
                nameof(EvidenceRevisionEntity),
                revision.Id,
                "تم رفض محاولة فتح نسخة سابقة من الدليل دون صلاحية.",
                false,
                "المستخدم لا يملك صلاحية عرض نسخة الدليل.");

            return Results.NotFound();
        }

        string evidenceRoot = Path.GetFullPath(
            Path.Combine(
                environment.ContentRootPath,
                "App_Data",
                "Evidence"));

        string fullFilePath = Path.GetFullPath(
            Path.Combine(
                evidenceRoot,
                revision.StorageKey));

        string allowedRoot =
            evidenceRoot.TrimEnd(
                Path.DirectorySeparatorChar,
                Path.AltDirectorySeparatorChar)
            + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar;

        if (!fullFilePath.StartsWith(
            allowedRoot,
            OperatingSystem.IsWindows()
                ? StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase
                : StringComparison.Ordinal))
        {
            await WriteEvidenceAuditAsync(
                auditService,
                dbContext,
                AuditAction.AccessDenied,
                currentUser,
                revision.CyberCaseId,
                nameof(EvidenceRevisionEntity),
                revision.Id,
                "تم رفض فتح نسخة دليل بسبب مسار تخزين غير صالح.",
                false,
                "فشل التحقق الأمني من مسار نسخة الدليل.");

            return Results.NotFound();
        }

        if (!File.Exists(fullFilePath))
        {
            await WriteEvidenceAuditAsync(
                auditService,
                dbContext,
                AuditAction.EvidenceViewed,
                currentUser,
                revision.CyberCaseId,
                nameof(EvidenceRevisionEntity),
                revision.Id,
                "تعذر فتح نسخة الدليل.",
                false,
                "ملف نسخة الدليل غير موجود في التخزين.");

            return Results.NotFound();
        }

        if (ShouldWriteViewAudit(httpContext.Request))
        {
            await WriteEvidenceAuditAsync(
                auditService,
                dbContext,
                AuditAction.EvidenceViewed,
                currentUser,
                revision.CyberCaseId,
                nameof(EvidenceRevisionEntity),
                revision.Id,
                "تم فتح نسخة محفوظة من الدليل.",
                true);
        }

        httpContext.Response.Headers.CacheControl =
            "no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate";

        httpContext.Response.Headers.Pragma = "no-cache";

        httpContext.Response.Headers["X-Content-Type-Options"] =
            "nosniff";

        return Results.File(
            fullFilePath,
            revision.ContentType,
            enableRangeProcessing: true);
    })
    .RequireAuthorization();

app.MapRazorComponents<App>()
    .AddInteractiveServerRenderMode();

app.MapRazorPages();

app.Run();

static RateLimitPartition<string> RecoveryPartition(
    HttpContext context,
    int permitLimit)
{
    if (!HttpMethods.IsPost(context.Request.Method))
    {
        return RateLimitPartition.GetNoLimiter(
            "recovery-form-read");
    }

    var address = context.Connection.RemoteIpAddress;

    if (address?.IsIPv4MappedToIPv6 == true)
        address = address.MapToIPv4();

    return RateLimitPartition.GetFixedWindowLimiter(
        address?.ToString() ?? "unknown-client",
        _ => new FixedWindowRateLimiterOptions
        {
            PermitLimit = permitLimit,
            Window = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5),
            QueueLimit = 0,
            AutoReplenishment = true
        });
}

static bool ShouldWriteViewAudit(HttpRequest request)
{
    string rangeHeader =
        request.Headers["Range"].ToString();

    return string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(rangeHeader) ||
           rangeHeader.StartsWith(
               "bytes=0-",
               StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
}

static async Task WriteEvidenceAuditAsync(
    IAuditService auditService,
    AccpDbContext dbContext,
    AuditAction action,
    ClaimsPrincipal currentUser,
    Guid? cyberCaseId,
    string entityType,
    Guid entityId,
    string description,
    bool isSuccessful,
    string? failureReason = null)
{
    string? userIdValue =
        currentUser.FindFirstValue(
            ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier);

    Guid? actorUserId =
        Guid.TryParse(
            userIdValue,
            out Guid parsedUserId)
            ? parsedUserId
            : null;

    string? actorEmail = null;
    var roles = new List<string>();

    if (actorUserId is { } accountId &&
        accountId != Guid.Empty)
    {
        actorEmail = await dbContext.Users
            .AsNoTracking()
            .Where(user => user.Id == accountId)
            .Select(user => user.Email)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync();

        roles = await dbContext.UserRoles
            .Where(userRole => userRole.UserId == accountId)
            .Join(
                dbContext.Roles,
                userRole => userRole.RoleId,
                role => role.Id,
                (_, role) => role.Name)
            .Where(name => name != null)
            .Select(name => name!)
            .ToListAsync();
    }

    string actorRole =
        roles.Contains(IdentityRoles.Officer)
            ? IdentityRoles.Officer
            : roles.Contains(IdentityRoles.User)
                ? IdentityRoles.User
                : roles.Contains(IdentityRoles.Admin)
                    ? IdentityRoles.Admin
                    : "UNKNOWN";

    await auditService.WriteAsync(
        new AuditLogRequest
        {
            Action = action,
            ActorUserId = actorUserId,
            ActorEmail = actorEmail,
            ActorRole = actorRole,
            CyberCaseId = cyberCaseId,
            EntityType = entityType,
            EntityId = entityId,
            Description = description,
            IsSuccessful = isSuccessful,
            FailureReason = failureReason
        });
}
````

### S167 — `ACCP.Web/Security/AdminCaseReassignmentService.cs`


الوظيفة: التحقق وتنفيذ النقل الإداري مع توثيق الآثار

[العودة إلى شرح الملف](#file-167)


````csharp
using System.Data;
using System.Data.Common;
using ACCP.Application.Auditing;
using ACCP.Application.Notifications;
using ACCP.Application.Security;
using ACCP.Domain.Entities;
using ACCP.Domain.Enums;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Data;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Identity;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

namespace ACCP.Web.Security;

public sealed record AdminCaseAssignmentSnapshot(
    Guid CaseId,
    string CaseNumber,
    Guid OfficerId,
    CaseStatus Status,
    DateTime? AssignedAtUtc);

public sealed record AdminCaseReassignmentResult(
    bool Succeeded,
    string Message);

public sealed class AdminCaseReassignmentService
{
    private readonly CaseAuthorizationService _authorization;
    private readonly IServiceScopeFactory _scopeFactory;
    private readonly ILogger<AdminCaseReassignmentService> _logger;

    public AdminCaseReassignmentService(
        CaseAuthorizationService authorization,
        IServiceScopeFactory scopeFactory,
        ILogger<AdminCaseReassignmentService> logger)
    {
        _authorization = authorization;
        _scopeFactory = scopeFactory;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public async Task<AdminCaseAssignmentSnapshot?> GetCaseAsync(
        Guid caseId,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        await RequireAdminAsync(cancellationToken);

        if (caseId == Guid.Empty)
            return null;

        await using var scope = _scopeFactory.CreateAsyncScope();

        var db = scope.ServiceProvider
            .GetRequiredService<AccpDbContext>();

        return await db.CyberCases
            .AsNoTracking()
            .Where(item =>
                item.Id == caseId &&
                item.Path == CasePath.FormalReport &&
                item.AssignedOfficerId.HasValue &&
                item.Status != CaseStatus.Resolved &&
                item.Status != CaseStatus.Closed)
            .Select(item => new AdminCaseAssignmentSnapshot(
                item.Id,
                item.CaseNumber,
                item.AssignedOfficerId!.Value,
                item.Status,
                item.AssignedAtUtc))
            .SingleOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken);
    }

    public async Task<AdminCaseReassignmentResult> ReassignAsync(
        AdminCaseAssignmentSnapshot? expected,
        Guid targetOfficerId,
        string reason,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var actor = await RequireAdminAsync(cancellationToken);

        var cleanReason = reason?.Trim() ?? string.Empty;

        if (expected is null ||
            expected.CaseId == Guid.Empty ||
            expected.OfficerId == Guid.Empty ||
            targetOfficerId == Guid.Empty ||
            targetOfficerId == expected.OfficerId ||
            !Enum.IsDefined(expected.Status) ||
            expected.Status is CaseStatus.Resolved or CaseStatus.Closed)
        {
            return Failure(
                "اختر قضية مفتوحة وموظفًا بديلًا " +
                "مختلفًا عن المسؤول الحالي.");
        }

        if (cleanReason.Length is < 10 or > 500 ||
            cleanReason.Any(char.IsControl))
        {
            return Failure(
                "اكتب سبب النقل من 10 إلى 500 حرف في سطر واحد.");
        }

        await using var scope = _scopeFactory.CreateAsyncScope();

        var services = scope.ServiceProvider;
        var db = services.GetRequiredService<AccpDbContext>();
        var audit = services.GetRequiredService<IAuditService>();

        var notifications =
            services.GetRequiredService<INotificationService>();

        await using var transaction =
            await db.Database.BeginTransactionAsync(
                IsolationLevel.Serializable,
                cancellationToken);

        try
        {
            var target = await db.Users
                .AsNoTracking()
                .Where(user =>
                    user.Id == targetOfficerId &&
                    user.IsActive)
                .Select(user => new
                {
                    user.Id,
                    user.Email,
                    user.LockoutEnabled,
                    user.LockoutEnd
                })
                .SingleOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken);

            var now = DateTime.UtcNow;

            if (target is null ||
                string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(target.Email) ||
                (target.LockoutEnabled &&
                 target.LockoutEnd is { } end &&
                 end > DateTimeOffset.UtcNow))
            {
                return Failure(
                    "اختر موظفًا مفعّلًا وغير مقفل مؤقتًا.");
            }

            var targetRoles = await db.UserRoles
                .Where(member =>
                    member.UserId == targetOfficerId)
                .Join(
                    db.Roles,
                    member => member.RoleId,
                    role => role.Id,
                    (_, role) => role.Name)
                .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

            if (!targetRoles.Contains(IdentityRoles.Officer) ||
                targetRoles.Contains(IdentityRoles.Admin))
            {
                return Failure(
                    "الموظف البديل يجب أن يحمل دور موظف؛ " +
                    "حسابات المديرين محمية.");
            }

            // التحقق من أن الإسناد والحالة لم يتغيرا
            // منذ تحميل بيانات صفحة التأكيد.
            var updated = await db.CyberCases
                .Where(item =>
                    item.Id == expected.CaseId &&
                    item.Path == CasePath.FormalReport &&
                    item.AssignedOfficerId == expected.OfficerId &&
                    item.AssignedAtUtc == expected.AssignedAtUtc &&
                    item.Status == expected.Status &&
                    item.Status != CaseStatus.Resolved &&
                    item.Status != CaseStatus.Closed)
                .ExecuteUpdateAsync(
                    setters => setters
                        .SetProperty(
                            item => item.AssignedOfficerId,
                            (Guid?)target.Id)
                        .SetProperty(
                            item => item.AssignedOfficerEmail,
                            target.Email)
                        .SetProperty(
                            item => item.AssignedAtUtc,
                            (DateTime?)now),
                    cancellationToken);

            if (updated != 1)
            {
                return Failure(
                    "تغيّر إسناد القضية أو حالتها. " +
                    "حدّث البيانات قبل إعادة المحاولة.");
            }

            var caseInfo = await db.CyberCases
                .AsNoTracking()
                .Where(item => item.Id == expected.CaseId)
                .Select(item => new
                {
                    item.CaseNumber,
                    item.ReporterId
                })
                .SingleAsync(cancellationToken);

            var adminEmail = await db.Users
                .AsNoTracking()
                .Where(user => user.Id == actor.UserId)
                .Select(user => user.Email)
                .SingleOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken);

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(adminEmail))
            {
                throw new UnauthorizedAccessException(
                    "تعذر التحقق من حساب المدير.");
            }

            // إزالة أي مشاركة إضافية للمسؤول السابق،
            // وتحويل مشاركة الموظف الجديد إلى مسؤولية مباشرة.
            var collaborations = await db.CaseCollaborators
                .Where(item =>
                    item.CyberCaseId == expected.CaseId &&
                    item.IsActive &&
                    (item.OfficerId == expected.OfficerId ||
                     item.OfficerId == target.Id))
                .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

            foreach (var item in collaborations)
            {
                item.IsActive = false;
                item.RemovedByAdminId = actor.UserId;
                item.RemovedByAdminEmail = adminEmail;
                item.RemovedAtUtc = now;

                item.RemovalReason = item.OfficerId == target.Id
                    ? "أصبح الموظف مسؤولًا عن القضية بالنقل الإداري."
                    : "انتهت مسؤولية الموظف عن القضية بالنقل الإداري.";
            }

            // إلغاء الطلبات المعلقة المرتبطة بالإسناد السابق.
            var pending = await db.CaseStaffRequests
                .Where(item =>
                    item.CyberCaseId == expected.CaseId &&
                    item.Status == CaseStaffRequestStatus.Pending)
                .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

            foreach (var request in pending)
            {
                request.Status = CaseStaffRequestStatus.Cancelled;
                request.ReviewedByAdminId = actor.UserId;
                request.ReviewedByAdminEmail = adminEmail;
                request.ReviewedAtUtc = now;

                request.DecisionNote =
                    $"أُلغي الطلب بسبب النقل الإداري. السبب: {cleanReason}";
            }

            await db.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

            foreach (var item in collaborations)
            {
                await WriteAuditAsync(
                    AuditAction.CaseCollaboratorRemoved,
                    nameof(CaseCollaborator),
                    item.Id,
                    item.RemovalReason!);
            }

            foreach (var request in pending)
            {
                await WriteAuditAsync(
                    AuditAction.CaseStaffRequestCancelled,
                    nameof(CaseStaffRequest),
                    request.Id,
                    "أُلغي طلب الموظفين المعلّق بسبب " +
                    "تغيير مسؤول القضية إداريًا.");

                var requesterExists = await db.Users.AnyAsync(
                    user => user.Id == request.RequestedByOfficerId,
                    cancellationToken);

                if (requesterExists)
                {
                    await notifications.CreateAsync(
                        request.RequestedByOfficerId,
                        null,
                        NotificationType.CaseStaffRequestCancelled,
                        "أُلغي طلب الموظفين",
                        $"أُلغي طلبك المرتبط بالقضية {caseInfo.CaseNumber} " +
                        "بسبب تغيير مسؤولها إداريًا.");
                }
            }

            await notifications.CreateAsync(
                target.Id,
                expected.CaseId,
                NotificationType.CaseAssignmentTransferred,
                "تم نقل قضية إليك",
                $"أصبحت مسؤولًا عن القضية {caseInfo.CaseNumber} " +
                "بقرار من المدير.");

            var previousOfficerExists = await db.Users.AnyAsync(
                user => user.Id == expected.OfficerId,
                cancellationToken);

            if (previousOfficerExists)
            {
                await notifications.CreateAsync(
                    expected.OfficerId,
                    null,
                    NotificationType.CaseAssignmentTransferred,
                    "تم نقل مسؤولية قضية",
                    $"نقل المدير مسؤولية القضية {caseInfo.CaseNumber} " +
                    "إلى موظف آخر.");
            }

            if (caseInfo.ReporterId is { } reporterId &&
                reporterId != Guid.Empty &&
                await db.Users.AnyAsync(
                    user => user.Id == reporterId,
                    cancellationToken))
            {
                await notifications.CreateAsync(
                    reporterId,
                    expected.CaseId,
                    NotificationType.CaseAssignmentTransferred,
                    "تحديث متابعة البلاغ",
                    $"تم تحديث الموظف المسؤول عن بلاغك " +
                    $"{caseInfo.CaseNumber}. سجل البلاغ محفوظ.");
            }

            await WriteAuditAsync(
                AuditAction.CaseAssignmentTransferred,
                nameof(CyberCase),
                expected.CaseId,
                $"نقل المدير المسؤولية من الموظف {expected.OfficerId:D} " +
                $"إلى {target.Id:D}. السبب: {cleanReason}");

            var current = await RequireAdminAsync(cancellationToken);

            if (current.UserId != actor.UserId)
            {
                throw new UnauthorizedAccessException(
                    "تغيّرت جلسة المدير أثناء النقل.");
            }

            await transaction.CommitAsync(cancellationToken);

            return new AdminCaseReassignmentResult(
                true,
                "تم نقل مسؤولية القضية وتسجيل العملية وإرسال الإشعارات.");

            Task<AuditLog> WriteAuditAsync(
                AuditAction action,
                string entityType,
                Guid entityId,
                string description) =>
                audit.WriteAsync(
                    new AuditLogRequest
                    {
                        Action = action,
                        ActorUserId = actor.UserId,
                        ActorEmail = adminEmail,
                        ActorRole = IdentityRoles.Admin,
                        CyberCaseId = expected.CaseId,
                        EntityType = entityType,
                        EntityId = entityId,
                        Description = description,
                        IsSuccessful = true
                    },
                    cancellationToken);
        }
        catch (Exception exception)
            when (exception is DbException or DbUpdateException)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning(
                "Administrative transfer outcome unavailable. Category: {Category}",
                exception.GetType().Name);

            try
            {
                await transaction.RollbackAsync(CancellationToken.None);
            }
            catch (Exception rollbackException)
                when (rollbackException is DbException or InvalidOperationException)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning(
                    "Administrative transfer rollback unavailable. Category: {Category}",
                    rollbackException.GetType().Name);
            }

            return Failure(
                "تعذر تأكيد نتيجة النقل. حدّث القائمة وتحقق من " +
                "المسؤول الحالي قبل المحاولة مجددًا.");
        }
    }

    private async Task<CaseAccessActor> RequireAdminAsync(
        CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var actor = await _authorization.GetCurrentActorAsync(
            cancellationToken);

        if (actor is null ||
            !actor.IsAuthenticated ||
            !actor.IsActive ||
            actor.UserId == Guid.Empty ||
            !actor.HasRole(IdentityRoles.Admin))
        {
            throw new UnauthorizedAccessException(
                "النقل الإداري متاح لمدير فعّال " +
                "أكمل التحقق الثنائي فقط.");
        }

        return actor;
    }

    private static AdminCaseReassignmentResult Failure(
        string message) =>
        new(false, message);
}
````

[العودة إلى شرح الملف](#file-168)


````csharp
using ACCP.Application.Cases;
using ACCP.Domain.Enums;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Data;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Identity;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Services;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;

namespace ACCP.Web.Security;

public sealed record ReopeningOfficer(Guid Id, string FullName, string Email);
public sealed record ReopeningPage(IReadOnlyList<CaseReopeningSnapshot> Items, bool HasMore);

public sealed class AdminCaseReopeningService(
    CaseAuthorizationService authorization,
    IServiceScopeFactory scopeFactory)
{
    public async Task<ReopeningPage> GetCasesAsync(
        int page, string? caseNumber, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        await RequireAdminAsync(cancellationToken);
        if (page is < 0 or > 100000) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(page));
        string search = caseNumber?.Trim() ?? string.Empty;
        if (search.Length > 200) throw new ArgumentException("رقم القضية طويل جدًا.");
        await using var scope = scopeFactory.CreateAsyncScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<AccpDbContext>();
        var query = db.CyberCases.AsNoTracking().Where(item =>
            item.Path == CasePath.FormalReport &&
            (item.Status == CaseStatus.Resolved || item.Status == CaseStatus.Closed));
        if (search.Length > 0) query = query.Where(item => item.CaseNumber == search);
        var rows = await query.OrderByDescending(item => item.CreatedAtUtc).ThenBy(item => item.Id)
            .Skip(page * 20).Take(21)
            .Select(item => new { item.Id, item.CaseNumber, item.Status,
                item.AssignedOfficerId, item.AssignedAtUtc,
                HistoryCount = db.CaseStatusHistories.Count(history => history.CyberCaseId == item.Id) })
            .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);
        return new(rows.Take(20).Select(item => new CaseReopeningSnapshot(
            item.Id, item.CaseNumber, item.Status, item.AssignedOfficerId, item.AssignedAtUtc, item.HistoryCount))
            .ToList(), rows.Count > 20);
    }

    public async Task<IReadOnlyList<ReopeningOfficer>> GetOfficersAsync(
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        await RequireAdminAsync(cancellationToken);
        await using var scope = scopeFactory.CreateAsyncScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<AccpDbContext>();
        var members = db.UserRoles.Join(db.Roles, member => member.RoleId,
            role => role.Id, (member, role) => new { member.UserId, role.Name });
        var officers = members.Where(item => item.Name == IdentityRoles.Officer).Select(item => item.UserId);
        var admins = members.Where(item => item.Name == IdentityRoles.Admin).Select(item => item.UserId);
        var now = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow;
        var rows = await db.Users.AsNoTracking().Where(user => user.IsActive &&
                officers.Contains(user.Id) && !admins.Contains(user.Id) && user.Email != null &&
                (!user.LockoutEnabled || user.LockoutEnd == null || user.LockoutEnd <= now))
            .OrderBy(user => user.FullName).ThenBy(user => user.Id)
            .Select(user => new { user.Id, user.FullName, user.Email })
            .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);
        return rows.Select(user => new ReopeningOfficer(user.Id, user.FullName, user.Email!)).ToList();
    }

    public async Task<bool> ReopenAsync(CaseReopeningSnapshot expected,
        Guid targetOfficerId, string reason)
    {
        var adminId = await RequireAdminAsync(CancellationToken.None);
        await using var scope = scopeFactory.CreateAsyncScope();
        var service = ActivatorUtilities.CreateInstance<CaseReopeningService>(scope.ServiceProvider);
        // Do not cancel a submitted write merely because the page is closed.
        return await service.ReopenAsync(expected, targetOfficerId, adminId, reason);
    }

    private async Task<Guid> RequireAdminAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        // Current actor checks active account, current role, security stamp and MFA.
        var actor = await authorization.GetCurrentActorAsync(cancellationToken);
        if (actor is null || !actor.IsAuthenticated || !actor.IsActive ||
            actor.UserId == Guid.Empty || !actor.HasRole(IdentityRoles.Admin))
            throw new UnauthorizedAccessException("إعادة الفتح متاحة لمدير فعّال أكمل التحقق الثنائي فقط.");
        return actor.UserId;
    }
}
````

````csharp
using ACCP.Domain.Enums;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Data;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Identity;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;

namespace ACCP.Web.Security;

public sealed record OfficerWorkloadSummary(
    Guid OfficerId,
    string FullName,
    string Email,
    bool IsActive,
    bool HasAdminRole,
    int OpenCaseCount);

public sealed record OfficerOpenCaseSummary(
    Guid CaseId,
    string CaseNumber,
    CaseStatus Status,
    DateTime CreatedAtUtc,
    DateTime? AssignedAtUtc);

public sealed record OfficerOpenCasesPage(
    IReadOnlyList<OfficerOpenCaseSummary> Items,
    bool HasMore);

public sealed class AdminOfficerWorkloadService
{
    private readonly CaseAuthorizationService _authorization;
    private readonly IServiceScopeFactory _scopeFactory;

    public AdminOfficerWorkloadService(
        CaseAuthorizationService authorization,
        IServiceScopeFactory scopeFactory)
    {
        _authorization = authorization;
        _scopeFactory = scopeFactory;
    }

    public async Task<IReadOnlyList<OfficerWorkloadSummary>>
        GetOfficersAsync(
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        await RequireAdminAsync(cancellationToken);

        await using var scope = _scopeFactory.CreateAsyncScope();

        var db = scope.ServiceProvider
            .GetRequiredService<AccpDbContext>();

        var officerIds = db.UserRoles
            .Join(
                db.Roles,
                membership => membership.RoleId,
                role => role.Id,
                (membership, role) => new
                {
                    membership.UserId,
                    role.Name
                })
            .Where(item => item.Name == IdentityRoles.Officer)
            .Select(item => item.UserId);

        var adminIds = db.UserRoles
            .Join(
                db.Roles,
                membership => membership.RoleId,
                role => role.Id,
                (membership, role) => new
                {
                    membership.UserId,
                    role.Name
                })
            .Where(item => item.Name == IdentityRoles.Admin)
            .Select(item => item.UserId);

        return await db.Users
            .AsNoTracking()
            .Where(user => officerIds.Contains(user.Id))
            .Select(user => new
            {
                user.Id,
                user.FullName,
                Email = user.Email ?? string.Empty,
                user.IsActive,
                HasAdminRole = adminIds.Contains(user.Id),
                OpenCaseCount = db.CyberCases.Count(item =>
                    item.Path == CasePath.FormalReport &&
                    item.AssignedOfficerId == user.Id &&
                    item.Status != CaseStatus.Resolved &&
                    item.Status != CaseStatus.Closed)
            })
            .OrderByDescending(item => item.OpenCaseCount)
            .ThenBy(item => item.Id)
            .Select(item => new OfficerWorkloadSummary(
                item.Id,
                item.FullName,
                item.Email,
                item.IsActive,
                item.HasAdminRole,
                item.OpenCaseCount))
            .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);
    }

    public async Task<OfficerOpenCasesPage> GetOpenCasesAsync(
        Guid officerId,
        int skip = 0,
        int take = 20,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        await RequireAdminAsync(cancellationToken);

        if (officerId == Guid.Empty)
        {
            throw new ArgumentException(
                "اختر موظفًا صالحًا.",
                nameof(officerId));
        }

        if (skip < 0)
        {
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(skip));
        }

        var pageSize = Math.Clamp(take, 1, 100);

        await using var scope = _scopeFactory.CreateAsyncScope();

        var db = scope.ServiceProvider
            .GetRequiredService<AccpDbContext>();

        var rows = await db.CyberCases
            .AsNoTracking()
            .Where(item =>
                item.Path == CasePath.FormalReport &&
                item.AssignedOfficerId == officerId &&
                item.Status != CaseStatus.Resolved &&
                item.Status != CaseStatus.Closed)
            .OrderBy(item => item.AssignedAtUtc)
            .ThenBy(item => item.Id)
            .Skip(skip)
            .Take(pageSize + 1)
            .Select(item => new OfficerOpenCaseSummary(
                item.Id,
                item.CaseNumber,
                item.Status,
                item.CreatedAtUtc,
                item.AssignedAtUtc))
            .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

        return new OfficerOpenCasesPage(
            rows.Take(pageSize).ToArray(),
            rows.Count > pageSize);
    }

    private async Task RequireAdminAsync(
        CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var actor = await _authorization.GetCurrentActorAsync(
            cancellationToken);

        if (actor is null ||
            !actor.IsAuthenticated ||
            !actor.IsActive ||
            actor.UserId == Guid.Empty ||
            !actor.HasRole(IdentityRoles.Admin))
        {
            throw new UnauthorizedAccessException(
                "متابعة توزيع القضايا متاحة لمدير فعّال " +
                "أكمل التحقق الثنائي فقط.");
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using ACCP.Application.Auditing;
using ACCP.Domain.Entities;
using ACCP.Domain.Enums;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Identity;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Services;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;

namespace ACCP.Web.Security;

public sealed class AuthorizedAuditService : IAuditService
{
    private readonly CaseAuthorizationService _authorization;
    private readonly IServiceScopeFactory _scopeFactory;
    private readonly AuditService _writer;

    public AuthorizedAuditService(
        CaseAuthorizationService authorization,
        IServiceScopeFactory scopeFactory,
        AuditService writer)
    {
        _authorization = authorization;
        _scopeFactory = scopeFactory;
        _writer = writer;
    }

    // تسجيل الأحداث يستخدم نطاق العملية الأصلية.
    // يشمل ذلك محاولات الدخول الفاشلة قبل تسجيل الدخول.
    public Task<AuditLog> WriteAsync(
        AuditLogRequest request,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) =>
        _writer.WriteAsync(
            request,
            cancellationToken);

    public Task<IReadOnlyList<AuditLog>> GetLatestAsync(
        int take = 200,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) =>
        ReadAsAdminAsync(
            service => service.GetLatestAsync(
                take,
                cancellationToken),
            cancellationToken);

    public Task<IReadOnlyList<AuditLog>> GetForCaseAsync(
        Guid cyberCaseId,
        int take = 200,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) =>
        ReadAsAdminAsync(
            service => service.GetForCaseAsync(
                cyberCaseId,
                take,
                cancellationToken),
            cancellationToken);

    public Task<IReadOnlyList<AuditLog>> SearchAsync(
        string? searchTerm = null,
        AuditAction? action = null,
        bool? isSuccessful = null,
        int take = 500,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) =>
        ReadAsAdminAsync(
            service => service.SearchAsync(
                searchTerm,
                action,
                isSuccessful,
                take,
                cancellationToken),
            cancellationToken);

    private async Task<IReadOnlyList<AuditLog>> ReadAsAdminAsync(
        Func<AuditService, Task<IReadOnlyList<AuditLog>>> operation,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();

        var actor = await _authorization.GetCurrentActorAsync(
            cancellationToken);

        if (actor is null ||
            !actor.IsAuthenticated ||
            !actor.IsActive ||
            actor.UserId == Guid.Empty ||
            !actor.HasRole(IdentityRoles.Admin))
        {
            throw new UnauthorizedAccessException(
                "قراءة سجل التدقيق متاحة للمدير فقط. " +
                "تأكد من صلاحية حسابك وسجّل الدخول مجددًا.");
        }

        await using var scope = _scopeFactory.CreateAsyncScope();

        var service = scope.ServiceProvider
            .GetRequiredService<AuditService>();

        return await operation(service);
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;
using ACCP.Application.Auditing;
using ACCP.Application.Cases;
using ACCP.Application.Notifications;
using ACCP.Application.Security;
using ACCP.Domain.Entities;
using ACCP.Domain.Enums;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Data;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Services;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace ACCP.Web.Security;

/// <summary>
/// The web-facing case service. Identity and permissions come from the server,
/// never from the user IDs or email addresses supplied by a component.
/// Register as ICaseService only after the officer queue can claim a report
/// without first opening its private details.
/// Evidence endpoints and staffing services need their own authorization checks.
/// </summary>
public sealed class AuthorizedCaseService : ICaseService
{
    private readonly CaseAuthorizationService _authorization;
    private readonly IServiceScopeFactory _scopeFactory;

    public AuthorizedCaseService(
        CaseAuthorizationService authorization,
        IServiceScopeFactory scopeFactory)
    {
        _authorization = authorization;
        _scopeFactory = scopeFactory;
    }

    public async Task<CyberCase> CreateForReporterAsync(CyberCase cyberCase, Guid reporterId)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(cyberCase);
        var actor = await ActorForAsync(reporterId, "USER");
        if (actor is null)
            throw new UnauthorizedAccessException("لا تملك صلاحية إنشاء هذا الطلب.");

        // Copy only intake fields. Ignore submitted IDs, assignment, status,
        // identity disclosure, files, messages, collaborators, and timestamps.
        var clean = new CyberCase
        {
            Title = cyberCase.Title?.Trim() ?? string.Empty,
            Description = cyberCase.Description?.Trim() ?? string.Empty,
            IncidentType = cyberCase.IncidentType?.Trim() ?? string.Empty,
            Path = cyberCase.Path,
            SeverityLevel = cyberCase.SeverityLevel,
            Status = CaseStatus.New
        };
        Validator.ValidateObject(clean, new ValidationContext(clean), validateAllProperties: true);
        if (!Enum.IsDefined(clean.Path) || !Enum.IsDefined(clean.SeverityLevel) ||
            clean.IncidentType is not ("Blackmail" or "Fraud" or "AccountHacking" or
                "IdentityTheft" or "Threat" or "Other"))
        {
            throw new ValidationException("بيانات الطلب غير صالحة.");
        }

        // The current intake flow is preserved here. AI risk and versioned
        // consent must be validated by the future server-owned chat workflow.
        return await WithCoreAsync((core, _) => core.CreateForReporterAsync(clean, actor.UserId));
    }

    public async Task<List<CyberCase>> GetAllForReporterAsync(Guid reporterId)
    {
        var actor = await ActorForAsync(reporterId, "USER");
        if (actor is null) return [];
        return await WithCoreAsync((_, db) => db.CyberCases.AsNoTracking()
            .Where(item => item.ReporterId == actor.UserId)
            .OrderByDescending(item => item.CreatedAtUtc)
            .Select(item => new CyberCase
            {
                Id = item.Id, CaseNumber = item.CaseNumber, Title = item.Title,
                IncidentType = item.IncidentType, SeverityLevel = item.SeverityLevel,
                Path = item.Path, Status = item.Status, CreatedAtUtc = item.CreatedAtUtc,
                AssignedOfficerId = item.AssignedOfficerId,
                AssignedOfficerEmail = item.AssignedOfficerEmail
            }).ToListAsync());
    }

    public async Task<CyberCase?> GetByIdForReporterAsync(Guid id, Guid reporterId)
    {
        if (!await AllowedAsync(id, reporterId, "USER", CasePermission.ReadDetails))
            return null;
        return await WithCoreAsync((core, _) => core.GetByIdForReporterAsync(id, reporterId));
    }

    public async Task<List<CyberCase>> GetAllForOfficerAsync()
    {
        var actor = await _authorization.GetCurrentActorAsync();
        if (actor is null || !actor.HasRole("OFFICER")) return [];
        return await WithCoreAsync(async (_, db) =>
        {
            var summaries = await db.CyberCases.AsNoTracking()
            .Where(item => item.Path == CasePath.FormalReport &&
                (item.AssignedOfficerId == actor.UserId ||
                 item.Collaborators.Any(collaborator => collaborator.IsActive &&
                     collaborator.OfficerId == actor.UserId) ||
                 (item.AssignedOfficerId == null &&
                     (item.Status == CaseStatus.New || item.Status == CaseStatus.UnderReview))))
            .OrderByDescending(item => item.CreatedAtUtc)
            .Select(item => new CyberCase
            {
                Id = item.Id, CaseNumber = item.CaseNumber,
                // An unclaimed report's user-written title may contain identity data.
                Title = item.AssignedOfficerId == actor.UserId ||
                    item.Collaborators.Any(collaborator => collaborator.IsActive &&
                        collaborator.OfficerId == actor.UserId)
                    ? item.Title : "بلاغ جديد بانتظار الاستلام",
                IncidentType = item.IncidentType, SeverityLevel = item.SeverityLevel,
                Path = item.Path, Status = item.Status, CreatedAtUtc = item.CreatedAtUtc,
                AssignedOfficerId = item.AssignedOfficerId,
                AssignedOfficerEmail = item.AssignedOfficerEmail
            }).ToListAsync();

            if (summaries.Count == 0) return summaries;
            // Fetch only identifiers for counts, with the case relationship
            // checked in SQL again. Never fetch filenames or private file metadata.
            var visibleEvidence = await db.EvidenceItems.AsNoTracking()
                .Where(evidence => evidence.CyberCase.Path == CasePath.FormalReport &&
                    (!evidence.IsRestricted || evidence.IsDisclosedToOfficer) &&
                    (evidence.CyberCase.AssignedOfficerId == actor.UserId ||
                     evidence.CyberCase.Collaborators.Any(collaborator => collaborator.IsActive &&
                         collaborator.OfficerId == actor.UserId)))
                .Select(evidence => new Evidence
                {
                    Id = evidence.Id, CyberCaseId = evidence.CyberCaseId
                }).ToListAsync();
            var collaborations = await db.CaseCollaborators.AsNoTracking()
                .Where(collaborator => collaborator.IsActive && collaborator.OfficerId == actor.UserId &&
                    collaborator.CyberCase.Path == CasePath.FormalReport)
                .Select(collaborator => new CaseCollaborator
                {
                    CyberCaseId = collaborator.CyberCaseId,
                    OfficerId = collaborator.OfficerId, IsActive = true
                }).ToListAsync();
            var byId = summaries.ToDictionary(item => item.Id);
            foreach (var evidence in visibleEvidence)
                if (byId.TryGetValue(evidence.CyberCaseId, out var item)) item.EvidenceItems.Add(evidence);
            foreach (var collaborator in collaborations)
                if (byId.TryGetValue(collaborator.CyberCaseId, out var item)) item.Collaborators.Add(collaborator);
            return summaries;
        });
    }

    public async Task<CyberCase?> GetByIdForOfficerAsync(Guid id, Guid officerId)
    {
        if (!await AllowedAsync(id, officerId, "OFFICER", CasePermission.ReadDetails))
            return null;
        var result = await WithCoreAsync((core, _) => core.GetByIdForOfficerAsync(id, officerId));
        if (result is not null) RemoveStaffIdentityMetadata(result);
        return result;
    }

    public async Task<CyberCase?> GetByIdForAdminAsync(Guid id)
    {
        // ADMIN grants account administration, not blanket access to complaints.
        // A separately granted OFFICER role uses the same case relationship rules.
        var actor = await _authorization.GetCurrentActorAsync();
        if (actor is null || !actor.HasRole("OFFICER")) return null;
        return await GetByIdForOfficerAsync(id, actor.UserId);
    }

    public async Task<bool> UpdateStatusForOfficerAsync(
        Guid id, CaseStatus newStatus, Guid officerId, string officerEmail,
        string? reason = null)
    {
        if (!Enum.IsDefined(newStatus) ||
            !await AllowedAsync(id, officerId, "OFFICER", CasePermission.ManageCase))
            return false;
        return await WithCoreAsync(async (core, db) =>
        {
            var email = await AccountEmailAsync(db, officerId);
            return email is not null && await core.UpdateStatusForOfficerAsync(id, newStatus, officerId, email, reason);
        });
    }

    public async Task<bool> AssignToOfficerAsync(Guid id, Guid officerId, string officerEmail)
    {
        if (!await AllowedAsync(id, officerId, "OFFICER", CasePermission.ClaimCase) &&
            !await AllowedAsync(id, officerId, "OFFICER", CasePermission.ManageCase))
            return false;
        // Existing owners may repeat a completed claim: the core service is idempotent.
        return await WithCoreAsync(async (core, db) =>
        {
            var email = await AccountEmailAsync(db, officerId);
            return email is not null && await core.AssignToOfficerAsync(id, officerId, email);
        });
    }

    public async Task<CaseNote?> AddInternalNoteForOfficerAsync(
        Guid cyberCaseId, string content, Guid officerId, string officerEmail)
    {
        if (!await AllowedAsync(cyberCaseId, officerId, "OFFICER", CasePermission.ParticipateInConversation))
            return null;
        return await WithCoreAsync<CaseNote?>(async (core, db) =>
        {
            var email = await AccountEmailAsync(db, officerId);
            if (email is null) return null;
            var note = await core.AddInternalNoteForOfficerAsync(cyberCaseId, content, officerId, email);
            if (note is not null) note.CyberCase = null!;
            return note;
        });
    }

    public async Task<CaseMessage?> SendMessageByReporterAsync(
        Guid cyberCaseId, string content, Guid reporterId, string reporterEmail)
    {
        if (!await AllowedAsync(cyberCaseId, reporterId, "USER", CasePermission.ParticipateInConversation))
            return null;
        return await WithCoreAsync<CaseMessage?>(async (core, db) =>
        {
            var email = await AccountEmailAsync(db, reporterId);
            if (email is null) return null;
            var message = await core.SendMessageByReporterAsync(cyberCaseId, content, reporterId, email);
            if (message is not null) message.CyberCase = null!;
            return message;
        });
    }

    public async Task<CaseMessage?> SendMessageByOfficerAsync(
        Guid cyberCaseId, string content, Guid officerId, string officerEmail)
    {
        if (!await AllowedAsync(cyberCaseId, officerId, "OFFICER", CasePermission.ParticipateInConversation))
            return null;
        return await WithCoreAsync<CaseMessage?>(async (core, db) =>
        {
            var email = await AccountEmailAsync(db, officerId);
            if (email is null) return null;
            var message = await core.SendMessageByOfficerAsync(cyberCaseId, content, officerId, email);
            if (message is not null) message.CyberCase = null!;
            return message;
        });
    }

    public async Task<bool> DiscloseReporterIdentityAsync(Guid cyberCaseId, Guid reporterId)
    {
        if (!await AllowedAsync(cyberCaseId, reporterId, "USER", CasePermission.ReadDetails))
            return false;
        return await WithCoreAsync((core, _) => core.DiscloseReporterIdentityAsync(cyberCaseId, reporterId));
    }

    private async Task<CaseAccessActor?> ActorForAsync(Guid userId, string role)
    {
        if (userId == Guid.Empty) return null;
        var actor = await _authorization.GetCurrentActorAsync();
        return actor is not null && actor.UserId == userId && actor.HasRole(role) ? actor : null;
    }

    private async Task<bool> AllowedAsync(Guid id, Guid userId, string role, CasePermission permission)
    {
        if (userId == Guid.Empty) return false;
        var decision = await _authorization.CheckAsync(id, permission);
        return decision.IsAllowed && decision.Actor is not null &&
            decision.Actor.UserId == userId && decision.Actor.HasRole(role);
    }

    private async Task<T> WithCoreAsync<T>(Func<CaseService, AccpDbContext, Task<T>> operation)
    {
        // One short-lived context per operation; audit and notifications share it
        // with the core service so existing transactional guarantees remain intact.
        await using var scope = _scopeFactory.CreateAsyncScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<AccpDbContext>();
        var core = new CaseService(db,
            scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<IAuditService>(),
            scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<INotificationService>());
        return await operation(core, db);
    }

    private static async Task<string?> AccountEmailAsync(AccpDbContext db, Guid userId)
    {
        var email = await db.Users.AsNoTracking()
            .Where(user => user.Id == userId && user.IsActive)
            .Select(user => user.Email).FirstOrDefaultAsync();
        return !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(email) && email.Length <= 256 ? email.Trim() : null;
    }

    private static void RemoveStaffIdentityMetadata(CyberCase item)
    {
        item.ReporterId = null;
        if (!item.IsReporterIdentityDisclosed)
        {
            item.DisclosedReporterName = null;
            item.DisclosedReporterEmail = null;
            item.ReporterIdentityDisclosedAtUtc = null;
        }
        foreach (var message in item.Messages.Where(message => message.SenderType == MessageSenderType.User))
        {
            message.SenderId = Guid.Empty;
            if (!item.IsReporterIdentityDisclosed) message.SenderEmail = string.Empty;
        }
        foreach (var evidence in item.EvidenceItems)
        {
            evidence.DisclosedByReporterId = null;
            evidence.StorageKey = string.Empty;
            foreach (var revision in evidence.Revisions)
            {
                revision.ChangedByReporterId = Guid.Empty;
                revision.StorageKey = string.Empty;
            }
        }
    }
}
````
