````csharp
using ACCP.Application.CaseStaffing;
using ACCP.Application.Security;
using ACCP.Domain.Entities;
using ACCP.Domain.Enums;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Data;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Identity;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Services;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;

namespace ACCP.Web.Security;

public sealed class AuthorizedCaseStaffRequestService
    : ICaseStaffRequestService
{
    private readonly CaseAuthorizationService _authorization;
    private readonly IServiceScopeFactory _scopeFactory;

    public AuthorizedCaseStaffRequestService(
        CaseAuthorizationService authorization,
        IServiceScopeFactory scopeFactory)
    {
        _authorization = authorization;
        _scopeFactory = scopeFactory;
    }

    public Task<CaseStaffRequest?> CreateForOfficerAsync(
        Guid cyberCaseId,
        CaseStaffRequestType requestType,
        string reason,
        Guid officerId,
        string officerEmail) =>
        ExecuteAsync<CaseStaffRequest?>(
            IdentityRoles.Officer,
            officerId,
            async (service, actor, email) =>
            {
                var decision = await _authorization.CheckAsync(
                    cyberCaseId,
                    CasePermission.ManageStaffing);

                if (!decision.IsAllowed ||
                    decision.Actor?.UserId != actor.UserId)
                {
                    throw AccessDenied();
                }

                return await service.CreateForOfficerAsync(
                    cyberCaseId,
                    requestType,
                    reason,
                    actor.UserId,
                    email);
            });

    public Task<List<CaseStaffRequest>> GetForOfficerAsync(
        Guid officerId) =>
        ExecuteAsync<List<CaseStaffRequest>>(
            IdentityRoles.Officer,
            officerId,
            (service, actor, _) =>
                service.GetForOfficerAsync(actor.UserId));

    public async Task<List<CaseStaffRequest>> GetForAdminAsync(
        CaseStaffRequestStatus? status = null)
    {
        await RequireAdminAsync();

        if (status.HasValue && !Enum.IsDefined(status.Value))
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(status));

        await using var scope = _scopeFactory.CreateAsyncScope();

        var db = scope.ServiceProvider
            .GetRequiredService<AccpDbContext>();

        var query = AdminReadQuery(db);

        if (status.HasValue)
            query = query.Where(item => item.Status == status.Value);

        return await query
            .OrderByDescending(item => item.CreatedAtUtc)
            .ThenBy(item => item.Id)
            .ToListAsync();
    }

    public async Task<CaseStaffRequest?> GetByIdForAdminAsync(
        Guid requestId)
    {
        await RequireAdminAsync();

        if (requestId == Guid.Empty)
            return null;

        await using var scope = _scopeFactory.CreateAsyncScope();

        var db = scope.ServiceProvider
            .GetRequiredService<AccpDbContext>();

        return await AdminReadQuery(db)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(item => item.Id == requestId);
    }

    // لا نحمل كائن القضية كاملًا.
    // الحقول غير المحددة هنا لا تُقرأ من قاعدة البيانات.
    private static IQueryable<CaseStaffRequest> AdminReadQuery(
        AccpDbContext db) =>
        db.CaseStaffRequests
            .AsNoTracking()
            .Where(item =>
                item.CyberCase.Path == CasePath.FormalReport)
            .Select(item => new CaseStaffRequest
            {
                Id = item.Id,
                CyberCaseId = item.CyberCaseId,

                CyberCase = new CyberCase
                {
                    Id = item.CyberCaseId,
                    CaseNumber = item.CyberCase.CaseNumber,
                    AssignedOfficerId =
                        item.CyberCase.AssignedOfficerId,
                    Path = item.CyberCase.Path
                },

                RequestedByOfficerId = item.RequestedByOfficerId,
                RequestedByOfficerEmail = item.RequestedByOfficerEmail,
                RequestType = item.RequestType,
                Reason = item.Reason,
                Status = item.Status,
                TargetOfficerId = item.TargetOfficerId,
                TargetOfficerEmail = item.TargetOfficerEmail,
                ReviewedByAdminId = item.ReviewedByAdminId,
                ReviewedByAdminEmail = item.ReviewedByAdminEmail,
                DecisionNote = item.DecisionNote,
                CreatedAtUtc = item.CreatedAtUtc,
                ReviewedAtUtc = item.ReviewedAtUtc,
                RowVersion = item.RowVersion
            });

    public Task<bool> ApproveForAdminAsync(
        Guid requestId,
        Guid targetOfficerId,
        Guid adminId,
        string adminEmail,
        string? decisionNote) =>
        ExecuteAsync<bool>(
            IdentityRoles.Admin,
            adminId,
            (service, actor, email) =>
                service.ApproveForAdminAsync(
                    requestId,
                    targetOfficerId,
                    actor.UserId,
                    email,
                    decisionNote));

    public Task<bool> RejectForAdminAsync(
        Guid requestId,
        Guid adminId,
        string adminEmail,
        string decisionNote) =>
        ExecuteAsync<bool>(
            IdentityRoles.Admin,
            adminId,
            (service, actor, email) =>
                service.RejectForAdminAsync(
                    requestId,
                    actor.UserId,
                    email,
                    decisionNote));

    public Task<bool> CancelForOfficerAsync(
        Guid requestId,
        Guid officerId,
        string officerEmail) =>
        ExecuteAsync<bool>(
            IdentityRoles.Officer,
            officerId,
            (service, actor, email) =>
                service.CancelForOfficerAsync(
                    requestId,
                    actor.UserId,
                    email));

    private async Task RequireAdminAsync()
    {
        var actor = await _authorization.GetCurrentActorAsync();

        if (actor is null ||
            !actor.IsAuthenticated ||
            !actor.IsActive ||
            actor.UserId == Guid.Empty ||
            !actor.HasRole(IdentityRoles.Admin))
        {
            throw AccessDenied();
        }
    }

    private async Task<T> ExecuteAsync<T>(
        string requiredRole,
        Guid? expectedActorId,
        Func<CaseStaffRequestService, CaseAccessActor, string, Task<T>>
            operation)
    {
        var actor = await _authorization.GetCurrentActorAsync();

        if (actor is null ||
            !actor.IsAuthenticated ||
            !actor.IsActive ||
            actor.UserId == Guid.Empty ||
            !actor.HasRole(requiredRole) ||
            (expectedActorId.HasValue &&
             expectedActorId.Value != actor.UserId))
        {
            throw AccessDenied();
        }

        await using var scope = _scopeFactory.CreateAsyncScope();

        var db = scope.ServiceProvider
            .GetRequiredService<AccpDbContext>();

        var email = await db.Users
            .AsNoTracking()
            .Where(user =>
                user.Id == actor.UserId && user.IsActive)
            .Select(user => user.Email)
            .SingleOrDefaultAsync();

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(email))
            throw AccessDenied();

        var service =
            ActivatorUtilities.CreateInstance<CaseStaffRequestService>(
                scope.ServiceProvider);

        return await operation(service, actor, email.Trim());
    }

    private static UnauthorizedAccessException AccessDenied() =>
        new(
            "لا تملك صلاحية تنفيذ هذا الإجراء، " +
            "أو انتهت صلاحية جلستك. سجّل الدخول مجددًا.");
}
````

````csharp
using ACCP.Application.Auditing;
using ACCP.Application.EvidenceManagement;
using ACCP.Application.Security;
using ACCP.Domain.Entities;
using ACCP.Domain.Enums;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Data;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Services;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting;

namespace ACCP.Web.Security;

/// <summary>
/// Server-authorized evidence operations for the current reporter.
/// Register as IEvidenceService in Program.cs when this file has been added.
/// File downloads continue to use the separately protected HTTP endpoints.
/// </summary>
public sealed class AuthorizedEvidenceService : IEvidenceService
{
    private const long MaximumFileSize = 10 * 1024 * 1024;
    private readonly CaseAuthorizationService _authorization;
    private readonly IServiceScopeFactory _scopeFactory;

    public AuthorizedEvidenceService(CaseAuthorizationService authorization, IServiceScopeFactory scopeFactory)
    {
        _authorization = authorization;
        _scopeFactory = scopeFactory;
    }

    public async Task<Evidence> UploadAsync(EvidenceUploadRequest request, Guid reporterId)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(request);
        // Capture mutable form values before awaiting authentication or reading a file.
        var clean = new EvidenceUploadRequest
        {
            CyberCaseId = request.CyberCaseId, OriginalFileName = request.OriginalFileName,
            ContentType = request.ContentType, FileSizeBytes = request.FileSizeBytes,
            Content = request.Content, IsRestricted = request.IsRestricted
        };
        await using var scope = _scopeFactory.CreateAsyncScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<AccpDbContext>();
        await RequireOwnedCaseAsync(scope.ServiceProvider, db, clean.CyberCaseId, reporterId);
        var bytes = await ReadBoundedAsync(clean.Content, clean.FileSizeBytes);
        // Reading a browser upload can take time. Check again before passing bytes
        // to the core service, which validates type/signature/hash and writes the file.
        var path = await RequireOwnedCaseAsync(scope.ServiceProvider, db, clean.CyberCaseId, reporterId);
        clean.IsRestricted = path == CasePath.Assistance || clean.IsRestricted;
        using var content = new MemoryStream(bytes, writable: false);
        clean.Content = content;
        return await Core(scope.ServiceProvider, db).UploadAsync(clean, reporterId);
    }

    public async Task<List<Evidence>> GetByCaseIdAsync(Guid cyberCaseId, Guid reporterId)
    {
        await using var scope = _scopeFactory.CreateAsyncScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<AccpDbContext>();
        if (await OwnedCasePathAsync(scope.ServiceProvider, db, cyberCaseId, reporterId) is null)
            return [];
        return await Core(scope.ServiceProvider, db).GetByCaseIdAsync(cyberCaseId, reporterId);
    }

    public async Task<bool> DiscloseToOfficerAsync(Guid evidenceId, Guid reporterId)
    {
        await using var scope = _scopeFactory.CreateAsyncScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<AccpDbContext>();
        var caseId = await OwnedEvidenceCaseAsync(scope.ServiceProvider, db, evidenceId, reporterId);
        if (caseId is null) return false;
        var path = await OwnedCasePathAsync(scope.ServiceProvider, db, caseId.Value, reporterId);
        if (path is null) return false;
        if (path != CasePath.FormalReport)
        {
            await DeniedAsync(scope.ServiceProvider, await _authorization.GetCurrentActorAsync(),
                caseId, evidenceId, "لا يجوز كشف مرفق طلب خاص للموظفين.");
            return false;
        }
        return await Core(scope.ServiceProvider, db).DiscloseToOfficerAsync(evidenceId, reporterId);
    }

    public async Task<EvidenceRevision> UploadRevisionAsync(EvidenceRevisionUploadRequest request, Guid reporterId)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(request);
        var clean = new EvidenceRevisionUploadRequest
        {
            EvidenceId = request.EvidenceId, OriginalFileName = request.OriginalFileName,
            FileSizeBytes = request.FileSizeBytes, Content = request.Content,
            ChangeType = request.ChangeType, ChangeReason = request.ChangeReason,
            IsOriginalEvidenceAccessAcknowledged = request.IsOriginalEvidenceAccessAcknowledged
        };
        await using var scope = _scopeFactory.CreateAsyncScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<AccpDbContext>();
        var caseId = await OwnedEvidenceCaseAsync(scope.ServiceProvider, db, clean.EvidenceId, reporterId);
        if (caseId is null) throw DeniedException();
        var path = await RequireOwnedCaseAsync(scope.ServiceProvider, db, caseId.Value, reporterId);
        if (path == CasePath.FormalReport && !clean.IsOriginalEvidenceAccessAcknowledged)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("يجب قراءة إشعار الاحتفاظ بالنسخ والموافقة عليه قبل تعديل الدليل.");
        var bytes = await ReadBoundedAsync(clean.Content, clean.FileSizeBytes);
        path = await RequireOwnedCaseAsync(scope.ServiceProvider, db, caseId.Value, reporterId);
        if (path == CasePath.FormalReport && !clean.IsOriginalEvidenceAccessAcknowledged)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("يجب الموافقة على إشعار الاحتفاظ بالنسخ قبل تعديل الدليل.");
        using var content = new MemoryStream(bytes, writable: false);
        clean.Content = content;
        return await Core(scope.ServiceProvider, db).UploadRevisionAsync(clean, reporterId);
    }

    private async Task<CasePath> RequireOwnedCaseAsync(IServiceProvider services, AccpDbContext db, Guid caseId, Guid reporterId)
        => await OwnedCasePathAsync(services, db, caseId, reporterId) ?? throw DeniedException();

    private async Task<CasePath?> OwnedCasePathAsync(IServiceProvider services, AccpDbContext db, Guid caseId, Guid reporterId)
    {
        var decision = await _authorization.CheckAsync(caseId, CasePermission.ReadDetails);
        if (reporterId != Guid.Empty && decision.IsAllowed && decision.Actor is not null &&
            decision.Actor.UserId == reporterId && decision.Actor.HasRole("USER"))
        {
            // A USER+OFFICER account must still own the case to upload or disclose.
            var path = await db.CyberCases.AsNoTracking()
                .Where(item => item.Id == caseId && item.ReporterId == reporterId)
                .Select(item => (CasePath?)item.Path).FirstOrDefaultAsync();
            if (path is not null) return path;
        }
        await DeniedAsync(services, decision.Actor, caseId, null, "المستخدم لا يملك صلاحية تنفيذ عملية المرفقات على هذا الطلب.");
        return null;
    }

    private async Task<Guid?> OwnedEvidenceCaseAsync(IServiceProvider services, AccpDbContext db, Guid evidenceId, Guid reporterId)
    {
        var actor = await _authorization.GetCurrentActorAsync();
        if (evidenceId != Guid.Empty && reporterId != Guid.Empty && actor is not null &&
            actor.UserId == reporterId && actor.HasRole("USER"))
        {
            var caseId = await db.EvidenceItems.AsNoTracking()
                .Where(item => item.Id == evidenceId && item.CyberCase.ReporterId == reporterId)
                .Select(item => (Guid?)item.CyberCaseId).FirstOrDefaultAsync();
            if (caseId is not null) return caseId;
        }
        await DeniedAsync(services, actor, null, evidenceId, "المرفق غير متاح لهذا الحساب أو لا يملك المستخدم صلاحية تعديله.");
        return null;
    }

    private static EvidenceService Core(IServiceProvider services, AccpDbContext db)
        => new(db, services.GetRequiredService<IHostEnvironment>(), services.GetRequiredService<IAuditService>());

    private static Task<AuditLog> DeniedAsync(IServiceProvider services, CaseAccessActor? actor,
        Guid? caseId, Guid? evidenceId, string reason)
        => services.GetRequiredService<IAuditService>().WriteAsync(new AuditLogRequest
        {
            Action = AuditAction.AccessDenied,
            ActorUserId = actor?.UserId,
            ActorRole = actor is null ? "UNKNOWN" : actor.HasRole("USER") ? "USER"
                : actor.HasRole("OFFICER") ? "OFFICER" : actor.HasRole("ADMIN") ? "ADMIN" : "UNKNOWN",
            CyberCaseId = caseId is { } id && id != Guid.Empty ? id : null,
            EntityType = nameof(Evidence),
            EntityId = evidenceId is { } itemId && itemId != Guid.Empty ? itemId : null,
            Description = "تم رفض عملية مرفقات بسبب صلاحيات الوصول.",
            IsSuccessful = false, FailureReason = reason
        });

    private static UnauthorizedAccessException DeniedException()
        => new("لا تملك صلاحية تنفيذ هذه العملية. تحقق من تسجيل الدخول وملكية الطلب.");

    private static async Task<byte[]> ReadBoundedAsync(Stream content, long expectedSize)
    {
        if (content is null || !content.CanRead || expectedSize <= 0 || expectedSize > MaximumFileSize)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("الملف غير قابل للقراءة أو حجمه غير صالح. الحد الأقصى 10 ميغابايت.");
        using var buffer = new MemoryStream();
        var block = new byte[81920];
        while (true)
        {
            var count = await content.ReadAsync(block.AsMemory());
            if (count == 0) break;
            if (buffer.Length + count > expectedSize || buffer.Length + count > MaximumFileSize)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("حجم الملف الفعلي يتجاوز الحجم المسموح أو المعلن.");
            await buffer.WriteAsync(block.AsMemory(0, count));
        }
        if (buffer.Length != expectedSize)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("حجم الملف الفعلي لا يطابق الحجم المرسل.");
        return buffer.ToArray();
    }
}
````

````csharp
using ACCP.Application.Notifications;
using ACCP.Domain.Entities;
using ACCP.Domain.Enums;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Services;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;

namespace ACCP.Web.Security;

public sealed class AuthorizedNotificationService : INotificationService
{
    private readonly CaseAuthorizationService _authorization;
    private readonly IServiceScopeFactory _scopeFactory;
    private readonly NotificationService _writer;

    public event Action? ReadStateChanged;

    public AuthorizedNotificationService(
        CaseAuthorizationService authorization,
        IServiceScopeFactory scopeFactory,
        NotificationService writer)
    {
        _authorization = authorization;
        _scopeFactory = scopeFactory;
        _writer = writer;
    }

    // تبقى كتابة الإشعار ضمن نطاق العملية الأصلية
    // للحفاظ على معاملتها مع تغييرات القضية.
    public Task<UserNotification> CreateAsync(
        Guid recipientUserId,
        Guid? cyberCaseId,
        NotificationType type,
        string title,
        string message) =>
        _writer.CreateAsync(
            recipientUserId,
            cyberCaseId,
            type,
            title,
            message);

    public Task<List<UserNotification>> GetForUserAsync(
        Guid recipientUserId) =>
        ExecuteForOwnerAsync(
            recipientUserId,
            (service, userId) =>
                service.GetForUserAsync(userId));

    public Task<int> GetUnreadCountAsync(
        Guid recipientUserId) =>
        ExecuteForOwnerAsync(
            recipientUserId,
            (service, userId) =>
                service.GetUnreadCountAsync(userId));

    public async Task<bool> MarkAsReadAsync(
        Guid notificationId,
        Guid recipientUserId)
    {
        var marked = await ExecuteForOwnerAsync(
            recipientUserId,
            (service, userId) =>
                service.MarkAsReadAsync(
                    notificationId,
                    userId));

        if (marked)
            NotifyReadStateChanged();

        return marked;
    }

    public async Task<int> MarkAllAsReadAsync(
        Guid recipientUserId)
    {
        var affected = await ExecuteForOwnerAsync(
            recipientUserId,
            (service, userId) =>
                service.MarkAllAsReadAsync(userId));

        NotifyReadStateChanged();

        return affected;
    }

    private void NotifyReadStateChanged()
    {
        var handlers = ReadStateChanged;

        if (handlers is null)
            return;

        foreach (Action handler in handlers.GetInvocationList())
        {
            try
            {
                handler();
            }
            catch
            {
                // فشل تحديث مكوّن واجهة لا يغيّر نتيجة الحفظ الناجح.
            }
        }
    }

    private async Task<T> ExecuteForOwnerAsync<T>(
        Guid requestedUserId,
        Func<NotificationService, Guid, Task<T>> operation)
    {
        var actor = await _authorization.GetCurrentActorAsync();

        if (actor is null ||
            !actor.IsAuthenticated ||
            !actor.IsActive ||
            actor.UserId == Guid.Empty ||
            requestedUserId != actor.UserId)
        {
            throw new UnauthorizedAccessException(
                "لا تملك صلاحية الوصول لهذه الإشعارات، " +
                "أو انتهت صلاحية جلستك.");
        }

        await using var scope = _scopeFactory.CreateAsyncScope();

        var service = scope.ServiceProvider
            .GetRequiredService<NotificationService>();

        return await operation(service, actor.UserId);
    }
}
````

[العودة إلى شرح الملف](#file-175)


````csharp
using ACCP.Domain.Entities;
using ACCP.Domain.Enums;

namespace ACCP.Application.Security;

public enum CasePermission
{
    ReadQueueSummary,
    ReadDetails,
    ParticipateInConversation,
    ManageCase,
    ManageStaffing,
    ClaimCase,
    ReadReporterIdentity
}

/// <summary>
/// A snapshot built by server code from the authenticated identity and current account.
/// Never bind this object, its roles, or IsActive from browser input.
/// </summary>
public sealed class CaseAccessActor
{
    private readonly HashSet<string> _roles;

    public Guid UserId { get; }
    public bool IsAuthenticated { get; }
    public bool IsActive { get; }

    public CaseAccessActor(
        Guid userId,
        bool isAuthenticated,
        bool isActive,
        IEnumerable<string>? roles)
    {
        UserId = userId;
        IsAuthenticated = isAuthenticated;
        IsActive = isActive;
        _roles = roles is null
            ? new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal)
            : new HashSet<string>(roles, StringComparer.Ordinal);
    }

    public bool HasRole(string role) => _roles.Contains(role);
}

/// <summary>
/// Case relationship rules. All inputs must be loaded and verified by the server.
/// The caller must load current collaborators before evaluating collaborator access.
/// MFA, evidence restrictions, consent to submit a report, and status transitions
/// are additional checks: permission here never overrides them.
/// </summary>
public static class CaseAccessPolicy
{
    private const string UserRole = "USER";
    private const string OfficerRole = "OFFICER";
    private const string SupervisorRole = "SUPERVISOR";

    public static bool IsAllowed(
        CaseAccessActor? actor,
        CyberCase? cyberCase,
        CasePermission permission,
        bool isWithinSupervisorScope = false)
    {
        if (actor is null || cyberCase is null ||
            !actor.IsAuthenticated || !actor.IsActive ||
            actor.UserId == Guid.Empty || cyberCase.Id == Guid.Empty ||
            !Enum.IsDefined(cyberCase.Path) || !Enum.IsDefined(permission))
        {
            return false;
        }

        bool isReporter = actor.HasRole(UserRole) &&
            cyberCase.ReporterId == actor.UserId;

        bool isFormalReport = cyberCase.Path == CasePath.FormalReport;
        bool isOfficer = actor.HasRole(OfficerRole);
        bool isResponsibleOfficer = isFormalReport && isOfficer &&
            cyberCase.AssignedOfficerId == actor.UserId;

        bool isCollaborator = isFormalReport && isOfficer &&
            cyberCase.Collaborators.Any(collaborator =>
                collaborator.CyberCaseId == cyberCase.Id &&
                collaborator.OfficerId == actor.UserId &&
                collaborator.IsActive);

        // Scope is established by the server from the supervisor's team/assignment.
        // The default is false until that scope has been verified.
        bool isScopedSupervisor = isFormalReport &&
            actor.HasRole(SupervisorRole) && isWithinSupervisorScope;

        bool isStaffParticipant = isResponsibleOfficer ||
            isCollaborator || isScopedSupervisor;

        bool isAvailableForClaim = isFormalReport &&
            !cyberCase.AssignedOfficerId.HasValue &&
            cyberCase.Status is CaseStatus.New or CaseStatus.UnderReview;

        // ADMIN alone does not grant access to case contents or the reporter's identity.
        // Another explicitly granted role is evaluated using its own relationship rules.
        return permission switch
        {
            CasePermission.ReadQueueSummary =>
                isFormalReport && (isStaffParticipant || (isOfficer && isAvailableForClaim)),

            CasePermission.ReadDetails =>
                isReporter || isStaffParticipant,

            CasePermission.ParticipateInConversation =>
                isReporter || isStaffParticipant,

            CasePermission.ManageCase =>
                isResponsibleOfficer || isScopedSupervisor,

            CasePermission.ManageStaffing =>
                isResponsibleOfficer || isScopedSupervisor,

            CasePermission.ClaimCase =>
                isOfficer && isAvailableForClaim,

            CasePermission.ReadReporterIdentity =>
                isReporter || (isStaffParticipant && cyberCase.IsReporterIdentityDisclosed),

            _ => false
        };
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System.Security.Claims;
using ACCP.Application.Security;
using ACCP.Domain.Entities;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Data;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Identity;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;

namespace ACCP.Web.Security;

/// <summary>
/// Server-owned result of a current access check, not a token or browser input.
/// Recheck for every operation; do not cache an allowed result in the page.
/// </summary>
public sealed record CaseAuthorizationDecision(
    CaseAccessActor? Actor,
    bool IsAllowed);

/// <summary>
/// Resolves the server-authenticated identity and reloads account status, roles,
/// and case relationships before evaluating CaseAccessPolicy.
/// Registration and calls from case/evidence services are added separately.
/// </summary>
public sealed class CaseAuthorizationService
{
    private readonly AuthenticationStateProvider _authenticationStateProvider;
    private readonly IHttpContextAccessor _httpContextAccessor;
    private readonly IServiceScopeFactory _scopeFactory;
    private readonly IdentityOptions _identityOptions;

    public CaseAuthorizationService(
        AuthenticationStateProvider authenticationStateProvider,
        IHttpContextAccessor httpContextAccessor,
        IServiceScopeFactory scopeFactory,
        IOptions<IdentityOptions> identityOptions)
    {
        _authenticationStateProvider = authenticationStateProvider;
        _httpContextAccessor = httpContextAccessor;
        _scopeFactory = scopeFactory;
        _identityOptions = identityOptions.Value;
    }

    public async Task<CaseAccessActor?> GetCurrentActorAsync(
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var principal = await GetCurrentPrincipalAsync(cancellationToken);
        await using var scope = _scopeFactory.CreateAsyncScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<AccpDbContext>();
        return await ReadActorAsync(principal, db, cancellationToken);
    }

    public async Task<CaseAuthorizationDecision> CheckAsync(
        Guid caseId,
        CasePermission permission,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        if (caseId == Guid.Empty || !Enum.IsDefined(permission))
            return new(null, false);

        var principal = await GetCurrentPrincipalAsync(cancellationToken);
        // A separate scope avoids concurrent access to a circuit's shared DbContext.
        await using var scope = _scopeFactory.CreateAsyncScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<AccpDbContext>();
        var actor = await ReadActorAsync(principal, db, cancellationToken);
        if (actor is null)
            return new(null, false);

        // Load only the fields needed for authorization, not complaint text or files.
        var snapshot = await db.CyberCases
            .AsNoTracking()
            .Where(item => item.Id == caseId)
            .Select(item => new CyberCase
            {
                Id = item.Id,
                ReporterId = item.ReporterId,
                Path = item.Path,
                Status = item.Status,
                AssignedOfficerId = item.AssignedOfficerId,
                IsReporterIdentityDisclosed = item.IsReporterIdentityDisclosed,
                Collaborators = item.Collaborators
                    .Where(collaborator => collaborator.IsActive)
                    .Select(collaborator => new CaseCollaborator
                    {
                        CyberCaseId = collaborator.CyberCaseId,
                        OfficerId = collaborator.OfficerId,
                        IsActive = collaborator.IsActive
                    }).ToList()
            })
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken);

        // Supervisor team scope is not implemented yet: it remains denied by default.
        return new(actor, CaseAccessPolicy.IsAllowed(actor, snapshot, permission));
    }

    private async Task<ClaimsPrincipal> GetCurrentPrincipalAsync(
        CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        try
        {
            var state = await _authenticationStateProvider
                .GetAuthenticationStateAsync()
                .WaitAsync(cancellationToken);
            return state.User;
        }
        catch (InvalidOperationException) when (_httpContextAccessor.HttpContext is not null)
        {
            // Outside a Blazor component/circuit, the request's authentication
            // middleware supplies HttpContext.User. Never accept a principal from a form.
            return _httpContextAccessor.HttpContext.User;
        }
    }

    private async Task<CaseAccessActor?> ReadActorAsync(
        ClaimsPrincipal principal,
        AccpDbContext db,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        if (principal.Identity?.IsAuthenticated != true ||
            !Guid.TryParse(principal.FindFirstValue(
                _identityOptions.ClaimsIdentity.UserIdClaimType), out var userId) ||
            userId == Guid.Empty)
        {
            return null;
        }

        var account = await db.Users
            .AsNoTracking()
            .Where(user => user.Id == userId)
            .Select(user => new { user.Id, user.IsActive, user.SecurityStamp, user.TwoFactorEnabled, user.LockoutEnabled, user.LockoutEnd })
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken);

        var sessionStamp = principal.FindFirstValue(
            _identityOptions.ClaimsIdentity.SecurityStampClaimType);
        if (account is null || !account.IsActive ||
            (account.LockoutEnabled && account.LockoutEnd is { } lockout && lockout > DateTimeOffset.UtcNow) ||
            string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(account.SecurityStamp) ||
            string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(sessionStamp) ||
            !string.Equals(account.SecurityStamp, sessionStamp, StringComparison.Ordinal))
        {
            return null;
        }

        // Read current database roles; cookie role claims may have become stale.
        var roles = await db.UserRoles
            .Where(userRole => userRole.UserId == userId)
            .Join(db.Roles,
                userRole => userRole.RoleId,
                role => role.Id,
                (_, role) => role.Name)
            .Where(name => name != null)
            .Select(name => name!)
            .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

        // A Blazor circuit can outlive its HTTP request and retain an old
        // principal. Require both the current MFA flag and factor proof on
        // every operation, including accounts with ADMIN and OFFICER roles.
if ((roles.Contains(IdentityRoles.Officer) ||
     roles.Contains(IdentityRoles.Admin)) &&
    (!account.TwoFactorEnabled ||
     !HasOfficerMfa(principal, account.Id, sessionStamp)))
        {
            return null;
        }

        return new CaseAccessActor(account.Id, true, true, roles);
    }

    private bool HasOfficerMfa(ClaimsPrincipal principal, Guid accountId, string securityStamp) =>
        principal.Identities.Any(identity => identity.IsAuthenticated &&
            identity.AuthenticationType == IdentityConstants.ApplicationScheme &&
            identity.HasClaim("amr", "mfa") &&
            Guid.TryParse(identity.FindFirst(_identityOptions.ClaimsIdentity.UserIdClaimType)?.Value,
                out var identityAccountId) && identityAccountId == accountId &&
            string.Equals(identity.FindFirst(_identityOptions.ClaimsIdentity.SecurityStampClaimType)?.Value,
                securityStamp, StringComparison.Ordinal));
}
````

### S177 — `ACCP.Web/Security/EmployeeManagementService.cs`


الوظيفة: العمليات الإدارية لحسابات الموظفين

[العودة إلى شرح الملف](#file-177)


````csharp
using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;
using System.Data;
using ACCP.Application.Auditing;
using ACCP.Application.Security;
using ACCP.Domain.Enums;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Data;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Identity;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace ACCP.Web.Security;

public sealed record EmployeeAccountSummary(
    Guid Id, string FullName, string Email, bool IsActive,
    bool TwoFactorEnabled, bool HasAdminRole, DateTime CreatedAtUtc,
    string ConcurrencyToken);

public sealed record EmployeeOperationResult(bool Succeeded, string Message, Guid? EmployeeId = null);

/// <summary>
/// Current ADMIN accounts may manage OFFICER accounts. Caller input never
/// selects the administrator identity or the role granted to a new employee.
/// Email/password changes preserve MFA and revoke previously issued sessions.
/// </summary>
public sealed class EmployeeManagementService
{
    private readonly CaseAuthorizationService _authorization;
    private readonly IServiceScopeFactory _scopeFactory;

    public EmployeeManagementService(CaseAuthorizationService authorization, IServiceScopeFactory scopeFactory)
    {
        _authorization = authorization;
        _scopeFactory = scopeFactory;
    }

    public async Task<List<EmployeeAccountSummary>> GetOfficersAsync()
    {
        await RequireAdminAsync();
        await using var scope = _scopeFactory.CreateAsyncScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<AccpDbContext>();
        var officerIds = db.UserRoles.Join(db.Roles, member => member.RoleId, role => role.Id,
            (member, role) => new { member.UserId, role.Name })
            .Where(member => member.Name == IdentityRoles.Officer).Select(member => member.UserId);
        var adminIds = db.UserRoles.Join(db.Roles, member => member.RoleId, role => role.Id,
            (member, role) => new { member.UserId, role.Name })
            .Where(member => member.Name == IdentityRoles.Admin).Select(member => member.UserId);

        // Explicit projection excludes password hashes, security stamps, and tokens.
        // ConcurrencyToken is an optimistic edit token, not a login credential.
        return await db.Users.AsNoTracking().Where(user => officerIds.Contains(user.Id))
            .OrderByDescending(user => user.CreatedAtUtc).ThenBy(user => user.Id)
            .Select(user => new EmployeeAccountSummary(user.Id, user.FullName, user.Email ?? string.Empty,
                user.IsActive, user.TwoFactorEnabled, adminIds.Contains(user.Id),
                user.CreatedAtUtc, user.ConcurrencyStamp ?? string.Empty)).ToListAsync();
    }

    public async Task<EmployeeOperationResult> CreateOfficerAsync(string fullName, string email, string password)
    {
        var actor = await RequireAdminAsync();
        var name = fullName?.Trim() ?? string.Empty;
        var address = email?.Trim() ?? string.Empty;
        if (name.Length is < 2 or > 120 || name.Any(char.IsControl))
            return Failure("اسم الموظف يجب أن يكون بين حرفين و120 حرفًا.");
        if (address.Length > 256 || !new EmailAddressAttribute().IsValid(address) || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(address))
            return Failure("أدخل بريدًا إلكترونيًا صالحًا.");
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(password) || password.Length is < 12 or > 128)
            return Failure("كلمة مرور الموظف يجب أن تكون بين 12 و128 حرفًا.");

        await using var scope = _scopeFactory.CreateAsyncScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<AccpDbContext>();
        var users = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<UserManager<ApplicationUser>>();
        if (!await db.Roles.AnyAsync(role => role.Name == IdentityRoles.Officer))
            return Failure("دور الموظف غير مهيّأ في النظام.");
        if (await users.FindByEmailAsync(address) is not null)
            return Failure("هذا البريد الإلكتروني مستخدم بالفعل.");

        // Account creation, role assignment, and audit commit together.
        await using var transaction = await db.Database.BeginTransactionAsync();
        var employee = new ApplicationUser
        {
            Id = Guid.NewGuid(), UserName = address, Email = address, FullName = name,
            IsActive = true, LockoutEnabled = true, EmailConfirmed = false,
            CreatedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow
        };
        var result = await users.CreateAsync(employee, password);
        if (!result.Succeeded) return IdentityFailure(result);
        result = await users.AddToRoleAsync(employee, IdentityRoles.Officer);
        if (!result.Succeeded) return IdentityFailure(result);
        await EnsureSameAdminAsync(actor.UserId);
        await WriteAuditAsync(scope.ServiceProvider, db, actor.UserId, employee.Id,
            AuditAction.AccountCreated, "تم إنشاء حساب موظف ومنحه دور الموظف.");
        await transaction.CommitAsync();
        return new(true, "تم إنشاء حساب الموظف بنجاح.", employee.Id);
    }

    public async Task<EmployeeOperationResult> SetOfficerActiveAsync(
        Guid employeeId, bool isActive, string expectedConcurrencyToken)
    {
        var actor = await RequireAdminAsync();
        if (employeeId == Guid.Empty || employeeId == actor.UserId)
            return Failure("لا يمكن تغيير حالة حسابك من إدارة الموظفين.");
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(expectedConcurrencyToken) || expectedConcurrencyToken.Length > 128)
            return Failure("حدّث قائمة الموظفين قبل تغيير حالة الحساب.");

        await using var scope = _scopeFactory.CreateAsyncScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<AccpDbContext>();
        var users = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<UserManager<ApplicationUser>>();
        // Keep the target's role membership stable while its status is changed.
        await using var transaction = await db.Database.BeginTransactionAsync(IsolationLevel.Serializable);
        var employee = await users.FindByIdAsync(employeeId.ToString());
        if (employee is null || !await users.IsInRoleAsync(employee, IdentityRoles.Officer) ||
            await users.IsInRoleAsync(employee, IdentityRoles.Admin))
            return Failure("يمكن إدارة حسابات الموظفين فقط؛ حسابات المديرين محمية.");
        if (!string.Equals(employee.ConcurrencyStamp, expectedConcurrencyToken, StringComparison.Ordinal))
            return Failure("تغيّرت بيانات الحساب. حدّث القائمة وحاول مجددًا.");
        if (employee.IsActive == isActive)
            return new(true, isActive ? "الحساب مفعّل بالفعل." : "الحساب معطّل بالفعل.", employee.Id);

        employee.IsActive = isActive;
        // This persists the changed status and a new security stamp through Identity.
        // Both activation and deactivation invalidate previously issued sessions.
        var result = await users.UpdateSecurityStampAsync(employee);
        if (!result.Succeeded) return IdentityFailure(result);
        await EnsureSameAdminAsync(actor.UserId);
        await WriteAuditAsync(scope.ServiceProvider, db, actor.UserId, employee.Id,
            isActive ? AuditAction.AccountActivated : AuditAction.AccountDeactivated,
            isActive ? "تم تفعيل حساب الموظف وإلغاء جلساته السابقة."
                : "تم تعطيل حساب الموظف وإلغاء جلساته السابقة.");
        await transaction.CommitAsync();
        return new(true, isActive ? "تم تفعيل الحساب. يجب تسجيل الدخول مجددًا."
            : "تم تعطيل الحساب وإلغاء جلساته السابقة.", employee.Id);
    }

    public async Task<EmployeeOperationResult> ChangeOfficerEmailAsync(
        Guid employeeId, string newEmail, string expectedConcurrencyToken)
    {
        var actor = await RequireAdminAsync();
        var requestError = ValidateEditRequest(actor.UserId, employeeId, expectedConcurrencyToken);
        if (requestError is not null) return requestError;
        var address = newEmail?.Trim() ?? string.Empty;
        if (address.Length > 256 || address.Any(char.IsControl) ||
            string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(address) || !new EmailAddressAttribute().IsValid(address))
            return Failure("أدخل بريدًا إلكترونيًا صالحًا.");

        await using var scope = _scopeFactory.CreateAsyncScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<AccpDbContext>();
        var users = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<UserManager<ApplicationUser>>();
        await using var transaction = await db.Database.BeginTransactionAsync(IsolationLevel.Serializable);
        var employee = await GetEditableOfficerAsync(users, employeeId);
        if (employee is null)
            return Failure("يمكن إدارة حسابات الموظفين فقط؛ حسابات المديرين محمية.");
        if (!string.Equals(employee.ConcurrencyStamp, expectedConcurrencyToken, StringComparison.Ordinal))
            return Failure("تغيّرت بيانات الحساب. حدّث القائمة وحاول مجددًا.");
        if (string.Equals(employee.Email, address, StringComparison.Ordinal) &&
            string.Equals(employee.UserName, address, StringComparison.Ordinal))
            return new(true, "البريد الإلكتروني مطابق للبريد الحالي.", employee.Id);

        // Both email and username are login identifiers; neither may belong to another account.
        var emailOwner = await users.FindByEmailAsync(address);
        var nameOwner = await users.FindByNameAsync(address);
        if ((emailOwner is not null && emailOwner.Id != employee.Id) ||
            (nameOwner is not null && nameOwner.Id != employee.Id))
            return Failure("هذا البريد الإلكتروني مستخدم بالفعل.");

        // Identity normalizes and validates each identifier. The transaction prevents
        // a half-completed edit when updating the second identifier or auditing fails.
        var result = await users.SetEmailAsync(employee, address);
        if (!result.Succeeded) return IdentityFailure(result);
        result = await users.SetUserNameAsync(employee, address);
        if (!result.Succeeded) return IdentityFailure(result);
        employee.EmailConfirmed = false;
        result = await users.UpdateSecurityStampAsync(employee);
        if (!result.Succeeded) return IdentityFailure(result);
        await EnsureSameAdminAsync(actor.UserId);
        await WriteAuditAsync(scope.ServiceProvider, db, actor.UserId, employee.Id,
            AuditAction.AccountEmailChanged,
            "تم تغيير بريد الموظف واسم تسجيل دخوله وإلغاء جلساته السابقة بواسطة المدير.");
        await transaction.CommitAsync();
        return new(true, "تم تغيير البريد. يسجّل الموظف دخوله بالبريد الجديد وكود التحقق المعتاد.", employee.Id);
    }

    public async Task<EmployeeOperationResult> ResetOfficerPasswordAsync(
        Guid employeeId, string newPassword, string expectedConcurrencyToken)
    {
        var actor = await RequireAdminAsync();
        var requestError = ValidateEditRequest(actor.UserId, employeeId, expectedConcurrencyToken);
        if (requestError is not null) return requestError;
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(newPassword) || newPassword.Length is < 12 or > 128)
            return Failure("كلمة مرور الموظف يجب أن تكون بين 12 و128 حرفًا.");

        await using var scope = _scopeFactory.CreateAsyncScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<AccpDbContext>();
        var users = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<UserManager<ApplicationUser>>();
        await using var transaction = await db.Database.BeginTransactionAsync(IsolationLevel.Serializable);
        var employee = await GetEditableOfficerAsync(users, employeeId);
        if (employee is null)
            return Failure("يمكن إدارة حسابات الموظفين فقط؛ حسابات المديرين محمية.");
        if (!string.Equals(employee.ConcurrencyStamp, expectedConcurrencyToken, StringComparison.Ordinal))
            return Failure("تغيّرت بيانات الحساب. حدّث القائمة وحاول مجددًا.");

        // Only this already-authorized server operation generates the reset token.
        // Neither the old password nor a caller-supplied reset token is required.
        var resetToken = await users.GeneratePasswordResetTokenAsync(employee);
        var result = await users.ResetPasswordAsync(employee, resetToken, newPassword);
        if (!result.Succeeded) return IdentityFailure(result);
        employee.AccessFailedCount = 0;
        employee.LockoutEnd = null;
        // Preserve IsActive, role membership, authenticator key, and TwoFactorEnabled.
        result = await users.UpdateSecurityStampAsync(employee);
        if (!result.Succeeded) return IdentityFailure(result);
        await EnsureSameAdminAsync(actor.UserId);
        await WriteAuditAsync(scope.ServiceProvider, db, actor.UserId, employee.Id,
            AuditAction.AccountPasswordReset,
            "تم تعيين كلمة مرور جديدة للموظف وإلغاء جلساته السابقة بواسطة المدير.");
        await transaction.CommitAsync();
        return new(true, "تم تعيين كلمة مرور جديدة وإلغاء الجلسات السابقة. كود التحقق يبقى مطلوبًا.", employee.Id);
    }

    private static EmployeeOperationResult? ValidateEditRequest(
        Guid actorId, Guid employeeId, string expectedConcurrencyToken)
    {
        if (employeeId == Guid.Empty || employeeId == actorId)
            return Failure("لا يمكن تعديل حسابك من إدارة الموظفين.");
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(expectedConcurrencyToken) || expectedConcurrencyToken.Length > 128)
            return Failure("حدّث قائمة الموظفين قبل تعديل الحساب.");
        return null;
    }

    private static async Task<ApplicationUser?> GetEditableOfficerAsync(
        UserManager<ApplicationUser> users, Guid employeeId)
    {
        var employee = await users.FindByIdAsync(employeeId.ToString());
        if (employee is null || !await users.IsInRoleAsync(employee, IdentityRoles.Officer) ||
            await users.IsInRoleAsync(employee, IdentityRoles.Admin)) return null;
        return employee;
    }

    private async Task<CaseAccessActor> RequireAdminAsync()
    {
        var actor = await _authorization.GetCurrentActorAsync();
        if (actor is not null && actor.HasRole(IdentityRoles.Admin)) return actor;
        throw new UnauthorizedAccessException("إدارة حسابات الموظفين متاحة لمدير نظام فعّال فقط.");
    }

    private async Task EnsureSameAdminAsync(Guid actorId)
    {
        var current = await RequireAdminAsync();
        if (current.UserId != actorId)
            throw new UnauthorizedAccessException("تغيّرت جلسة الحساب أثناء العملية. أعد تسجيل الدخول.");
    }

    private static async Task WriteAuditAsync(IServiceProvider services, AccpDbContext db,
        Guid actorId, Guid employeeId, AuditAction action, string description)
    {
        var email = await db.Users.AsNoTracking().Where(user => user.Id == actorId)
            .Select(user => user.Email).FirstOrDefaultAsync();
        await services.GetRequiredService<IAuditService>().WriteAsync(new AuditLogRequest
        {
            Action = action, ActorUserId = actorId, ActorEmail = email, ActorRole = IdentityRoles.Admin,
            EntityType = nameof(ApplicationUser), EntityId = employeeId,
            Description = description, IsSuccessful = true
        });
    }

    private static EmployeeOperationResult Failure(string message) => new(false, message);

    private static EmployeeOperationResult IdentityFailure(IdentityResult result)
    {
        var codes = result.Errors.Select(error => error.Code).ToHashSet(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        if (codes.Contains("DuplicateEmail") || codes.Contains("DuplicateUserName"))
            return Failure("هذا البريد الإلكتروني مستخدم بالفعل.");
        if (codes.Contains("ConcurrencyFailure"))
            return Failure("تغيّرت بيانات الحساب أثناء العملية. حدّث القائمة وحاول مجددًا.");
        if (codes.Any(code => code.StartsWith("Password", StringComparison.Ordinal)))
            return Failure("كلمة المرور يجب أن تحتوي على حرف كبير وصغير ورقم ورمز خاص، مع الالتزام بالطول المطلوب.");
        return Failure("تعذر تنفيذ عملية الحساب. تحقق من البيانات وحاول مجددًا.");
    }
}
````



<a id="source-178"></a>
### S178 — `ACCP.Web/Security/EmployeeTwoFactorResetService.cs`


الوظيفة: إعادة تهيئة تحقق الموظف إداريا مع التدقيق

[العودة إلى شرح الملف](#file-178)


````csharp
using System.Data;
using ACCP.Application.Auditing;
using ACCP.Application.Security;
using ACCP.Domain.Enums;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Data;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Identity;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;

namespace ACCP.Web.Security;

public sealed class EmployeeTwoFactorResetService
{
    private readonly CaseAuthorizationService _authorization;
    private readonly IServiceScopeFactory _scopeFactory;

    public EmployeeTwoFactorResetService(
        CaseAuthorizationService authorization,
        IServiceScopeFactory scopeFactory)
    {
        _authorization = authorization;
        _scopeFactory = scopeFactory;
    }

    public async Task<EmployeeOperationResult> ResetOfficerTwoFactorAsync(
        Guid employeeId,
        string reason,
        string expectedConcurrencyToken,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var actor = await RequireAdminAsync(cancellationToken);

        if (employeeId == Guid.Empty ||
            employeeId == actor.UserId)
        {
            return Failure(
                "لا يمكن إعادة تهيئة تحقق حسابك من إدارة الموظفين.");
        }

        var cleanReason = reason?.Trim() ?? string.Empty;

        if (cleanReason.Length is < 10 or > 500 ||
            cleanReason.Any(char.IsControl))
        {
            return Failure(
                "اكتب سببًا من 10 إلى 500 حرف في سطر واحد.");
        }

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(expectedConcurrencyToken) ||
            expectedConcurrencyToken.Length > 128)
        {
            return Failure(
                "حدّث قائمة الموظفين قبل إعادة تهيئة التحقق.");
        }

        await using var scope = _scopeFactory.CreateAsyncScope();

        var services = scope.ServiceProvider;

        var db = services.GetRequiredService<AccpDbContext>();

        var users = services
            .GetRequiredService<UserManager<ApplicationUser>>();

        var store = services
            .GetRequiredService<IUserStore<ApplicationUser>>();

        if (store is not
                IUserAuthenticatorKeyStore<ApplicationUser> keyStore ||
            store is not
                IUserTwoFactorRecoveryCodeStore<ApplicationUser> recoveryStore)
        {
            return Failure(
                "مخزن الحسابات لا يدعم إعادة تهيئة التحقق.");
        }

        await using var transaction =
            await db.Database.BeginTransactionAsync(
                IsolationLevel.Serializable,
                cancellationToken);

        try
        {
            var employee = await users.FindByIdAsync(
                employeeId.ToString());

            if (employee is null ||
                !await users.IsInRoleAsync(
                    employee,
                    IdentityRoles.Officer) ||
                await users.IsInRoleAsync(
                    employee,
                    IdentityRoles.Admin))
            {
                return Failure(
                    "هذه العملية لحساب الموظف فقط؛ " +
                    "حسابات المديرين محمية.");
            }

            if (!string.Equals(
                    employee.ConcurrencyStamp,
                    expectedConcurrencyToken,
                    StringComparison.Ordinal))
            {
                return Failure(
                    "تغيّرت بيانات الموظف. " +
                    "حدّث القائمة وحاول مجددًا.");
            }

            // إبطال المفتاح السابق دون إظهار المفتاح البديل للمدير.
            await keyStore.SetAuthenticatorKeyAsync(
                employee,
                users.GenerateNewAuthenticatorKey(),
                cancellationToken);

            // إلغاء أي رموز احتياطية تاريخية.
            await recoveryStore.ReplaceCodesAsync(
                employee,
                Array.Empty<string>(),
                cancellationToken);

            var result = await users.SetTwoFactorEnabledAsync(
                employee,
                false);

            if (!result.Succeeded)
            {
                return IdentityFailure(result);
            }

            // إبطال الجلسات وتذاكر التفعيل السابقة.
            result = await users.UpdateSecurityStampAsync(employee);

            if (!result.Succeeded)
            {
                return IdentityFailure(result);
            }

            var currentAdmin = await RequireAdminAsync(
                cancellationToken);

            if (currentAdmin.UserId != actor.UserId)
            {
                throw new UnauthorizedAccessException(
                    "تغيّرت جلسة المدير أثناء العملية. " +
                    "أعد تسجيل الدخول.");
            }

            var adminEmail = await db.Users
                .AsNoTracking()
                .Where(user => user.Id == actor.UserId)
                .Select(user => user.Email)
                .SingleOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken);

            await services
                .GetRequiredService<IAuditService>()
                .WriteAsync(
                    new AuditLogRequest
                    {
                        Action = AuditAction.TwoFactorDisabled,
                        ActorUserId = actor.UserId,
                        ActorEmail = adminEmail,
                        ActorRole = IdentityRoles.Admin,
                        EntityType = nameof(ApplicationUser),
                        EntityId = employee.Id,
                        Description =
                            "أعاد المدير تهيئة تحقق الموظف " +
                            "وأبطل مفتاحه وجلساته السابقة. " +
                            "يلزم إعداد التحقق مجددًا بعد كلمة المرور. " +
                            $"السبب: {cleanReason}",
                        IsSuccessful = true
                    },
                    cancellationToken);

            await transaction.CommitAsync(cancellationToken);

            return new EmployeeOperationResult(
                true,
                "تمت إعادة تهيئة التحقق وإبطال الجلسات السابقة. " +
                "عند السماح للموظف بالدخول سيعيد ربط " +
                "تطبيق التحقق بعد كلمة المرور.",
                employee.Id);
        }
        catch (DbUpdateException)
        {
            await transaction.RollbackAsync(cancellationToken);

            return Failure(
                "تعذر حفظ العملية. " +
                "حدّث القائمة وحاول مجددًا.");
        }
    }

    private async Task<CaseAccessActor> RequireAdminAsync(
        CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var actor = await _authorization.GetCurrentActorAsync(
            cancellationToken);

        if (actor is null ||
            !actor.IsAuthenticated ||
            !actor.IsActive ||
            actor.UserId == Guid.Empty ||
            !actor.HasRole(IdentityRoles.Admin))
        {
            throw new UnauthorizedAccessException(
                "إعادة تهيئة تحقق الموظف متاحة لمدير فعّال " +
                "أكمل التحقق الثنائي فقط.");
        }

        return actor;
    }

    private static EmployeeOperationResult IdentityFailure(
        IdentityResult result)
    {
        var concurrencyFailure = result.Errors.Any(
            error => error.Code == "ConcurrencyFailure");

        return Failure(
            concurrencyFailure
                ? "تغيّرت بيانات الموظف أثناء العملية. " +
                  "حدّث القائمة وحاول مجددًا."
                : "تعذرت إعادة تهيئة التحقق. لم تُعتمد العملية.");
    }

    private static EmployeeOperationResult Failure(
        string message) =>
        new(false, message);
}
````

````csharp
namespace ACCP.Application.Security;

/// <summary>
/// Delivers a password-reset link to the email stored on the eligible account.
/// Account eligibility and token generation belong to the reset service.
/// </summary>
public interface IPasswordResetEmailSender
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Sends the link through the configured email provider.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="recipientEmail">The account's current email address.</param>
    /// <param name="resetLink">
    /// An absolute HTTPS link created by the application using its configured
    /// public address. It must not be created from an untrusted request host.
    /// </param>
    /// <param name="cancellationToken">Cancels the send operation.</param>
    /// <remarks>
    /// Implementations must report delivery failures by throwing an exception.
    /// Never log or display the link or its token as a substitute for sending.
    /// </remarks>
    Task SendPasswordResetLinkAsync(
        string recipientEmail,
        Uri resetLink,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
}
````

### S180 — `ACCP.Web/Security/ReporterPasswordResetService.cs`


الوظيفة: إنشاء تذكرة الاستعادة وتغيير كلمة مرور المشتكي

[العودة إلى شرح الملف](#file-180)


````csharp
using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;
using System.Data;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text.Json;
using ACCP.Application.Auditing;
using ACCP.Application.Security;
using ACCP.Domain.Enums;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Data;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Identity;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.DataProtection;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace ACCP.Web.Security;

public sealed class ReporterPasswordResetService
{
    public const string RequestConfirmation =
        "إذا كان البريد مرتبطًا بحساب مشتكي مؤهل، سيصلك رابط استعادة كلمة المرور.";
    private const string InvalidLink =
        "رابط الاستعادة غير صالح أو انتهت صلاحيته. اطلب رابطًا جديدًا.";
    private static readonly TimeSpan LinkLifetime = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(30);
    private readonly IServiceScopeFactory _scopes;
    private readonly IPasswordResetEmailSender _emailSender;
    private readonly ITimeLimitedDataProtector _protector;
    private readonly IConfiguration _configuration;
    private readonly IHostEnvironment _environment;
    private readonly IHttpContextAccessor _http;

    public ReporterPasswordResetService(
        IServiceScopeFactory scopes,
        IPasswordResetEmailSender emailSender,
        IDataProtectionProvider protection,
        IConfiguration configuration,
        IHostEnvironment environment,
        IHttpContextAccessor http)
    {
        _scopes = scopes;
        _emailSender = emailSender;
        _protector = protection
            .CreateProtector("ACCP.ReporterPasswordReset.v1")
            .ToTimeLimitedDataProtector();
        _configuration = configuration;
        _environment = environment;
        _http = http;
    }

    // The page must always use RequestConfirmation, including unknown and
    // staff emails. Request limiting belongs on the anonymous HTTP endpoint.
    public async Task RequestResetAsync(
        string? email,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
        var address = email?.Trim() ?? string.Empty;
        if (address.Length is 0 or > 256 || address.Any(char.IsControl) ||
            !new EmailAddressAttribute().IsValid(address)) return;

        // Resolve the site address from trusted configuration, never Host or
        // forwarded headers supplied by the person requesting the email.
        var baseAddress = GetPublicBaseAddress();
        await using var scope = _scopes.CreateAsyncScope();
        var users = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<UserManager<ApplicationUser>>();
        var user = await users.FindByEmailAsync(address);
        if (user is null || !await IsEligibleReporterAsync(users, user)) return;

        var identityToken = await users.GeneratePasswordResetTokenAsync(user);
        var ticket = new ResetTicket(
            user.Id, user.NormalizedEmail!, user.SecurityStamp!, identityToken);
        var protectedTicket = _protector.Protect(
            JsonSerializer.Serialize(ticket), LinkLifetime);
        var link = new Uri(baseAddress.AbsoluteUri.TrimEnd('/') +
            "/reset-password?token=" + Uri.EscapeDataString(protectedTicket));

        cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
        await _emailSender.SendPasswordResetLinkAsync(
            user.Email!, link, cancellationToken);
    }

    public async Task<ReporterPasswordResetResult> ResetPasswordAsync(
        string? protectedTicket,
        string? newPassword,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
        var ticket = ReadTicket(protectedTicket);
        if (ticket is null) return Failure(InvalidLink);

        await using var scope = _scopes.CreateAsyncScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<AccpDbContext>();
        var users = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<UserManager<ApplicationUser>>();
        var audit = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<IAuditService>();
        try
        {
            // Authorization, password/stamp changes, and the audit commit
            // together. Concurrent role changes cannot bypass this check.
            await using var transaction = await db.Database.BeginTransactionAsync(
                IsolationLevel.Serializable, cancellationToken);
            var user = await users.FindByIdAsync(ticket.UserId.ToString());
            if (user is null || !await IsEligibleReporterAsync(users, user) ||
                !string.Equals(user.SecurityStamp, ticket.SecurityStamp, StringComparison.Ordinal) ||
                !string.Equals(user.NormalizedEmail, ticket.NormalizedEmail, StringComparison.Ordinal) ||
                !await users.VerifyUserTokenAsync(user,
                    users.Options.Tokens.PasswordResetTokenProvider,
                    UserManager<ApplicationUser>.ResetPasswordTokenPurpose,
                    ticket.IdentityToken))
                return Failure(InvalidLink);

            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(newPassword) || newPassword.Length > 128)
                return Failure("أدخل كلمة مرور جديدة لا تتجاوز 128 حرفًا.");

            // Identity applies the same password validators as registration.
            var reset = await users.ResetPasswordAsync(
                user, ticket.IdentityToken, newPassword);
            if (!reset.Succeeded) return Failure(PasswordError(reset));

            Ensure(await users.ResetAccessFailedCountAsync(user));
            if (users.SupportsUserLockout)
                Ensure(await users.SetLockoutEndDateAsync(user, null));
            Ensure(await users.UpdateSecurityStampAsync(user));

            var context = _http.HttpContext;
            await audit.WriteAsync(new AuditLogRequest
            {
                Action = AuditAction.AccountPasswordReset,
                ActorUserId = user.Id,
                ActorEmail = user.Email,
                ActorRole = IdentityRoles.User,
                EntityType = nameof(ApplicationUser),
                EntityId = user.Id,
                Description = "تمت استعادة كلمة مرور حساب المشتكي عبر رابط البريد الإلكتروني.",
                IsSuccessful = true,
                IpAddress = context?.Connection.RemoteIpAddress?.ToString(),
                UserAgent = context?.Request.Headers["User-Agent"].ToString(),
                CorrelationId = context?.TraceIdentifier
            }, cancellationToken);
            await transaction.CommitAsync(cancellationToken);
            return new(true, "تم تغيير كلمة المرور. سجّل الدخول بكلمة المرور الجديدة.");
        }
        catch (Exception exception) when (exception is not OperationCanceledException)
        {
            // Disposing the transaction rolls back credentials and audit on
            // any failure. Never include tokens or passwords in errors/logs.
            return Failure("تعذر إكمال الاستعادة. حاول مرة أخرى.");
        }
    }

    private static async Task<bool> IsEligibleReporterAsync(
        UserManager<ApplicationUser> users, ApplicationUser user)
    {
        if (!user.IsActive || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(user.Email) ||
            string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(user.NormalizedEmail) ||
            string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(user.SecurityStamp) ||
            !await users.HasPasswordAsync(user)) return false;
        var roles = await users.GetRolesAsync(user);
        // Staff and mixed-role accounts never use reporter self-service.
        return roles.Count == 1 && roles.Contains(IdentityRoles.User);
    }

    private Uri GetPublicBaseAddress()
    {
        var configured = _configuration["AccountRecovery:PublicBaseUrl"]?.Trim();
        if (!Uri.TryCreate(configured, UriKind.Absolute, out var address) ||
            !string.IsNullOrEmpty(address.UserInfo) ||
            !string.IsNullOrEmpty(address.Query) ||
            !string.IsNullOrEmpty(address.Fragment) ||
            (address.Scheme != Uri.UriSchemeHttps &&
             !(_environment.IsDevelopment() && address.IsLoopback &&
               address.Scheme == Uri.UriSchemeHttp)))
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                "AccountRecovery:PublicBaseUrl must be a trusted HTTPS site address.");
        return address;
    }

    private ResetTicket? ReadTicket(string? value)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value) || value.Length > 16_384) return null;
        try
        {
            var ticket = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<ResetTicket>(_protector.Unprotect(value));
            return ticket is not null && ticket.UserId != Guid.Empty &&
                !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ticket.NormalizedEmail) &&
                !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ticket.SecurityStamp) &&
                !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ticket.IdentityToken) ? ticket : null;
        }
        catch (CryptographicException) { return null; }
        catch (JsonException) { return null; }
    }

    private static string PasswordError(IdentityResult result)
    {
        if (result.Errors.Any(error => error.Code == "InvalidToken")) return InvalidLink;
        if (result.Errors.Any(error => error.Code.StartsWith("Password", StringComparison.Ordinal)))
            return "كلمة المرور لا تحقق شروط الأمان. استخدم كلمة أطول تحتوي حروفًا كبيرة وصغيرة ورقمًا ورمزًا.";
        return "تعذر تغيير كلمة المرور. حاول مرة أخرى.";
    }

    private static ReporterPasswordResetResult Failure(string message) => new(false, message);

    private static void Ensure(IdentityResult result)
    {
        if (!result.Succeeded) throw new InvalidOperationException("Identity account update failed.");
    }

    private sealed record ResetTicket(
        Guid UserId, string NormalizedEmail, string SecurityStamp, string IdentityToken);
}

public sealed record ReporterPasswordResetResult(bool Succeeded, string Message);
````

### S181 — `ACCP.Web/Security/SmtpPasswordResetEmailSender.cs`


الوظيفة: إرسال رسالة رابط الاستعادة عبر SMTP

[العودة إلى شرح الملف](#file-181)


````csharp
using System.Security.Authentication;
using System.Text.Encodings.Web;
using ACCP.Application.Security;
using MailKit.Net.Smtp;
using MailKit.Security;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using MimeKit;

namespace ACCP.Web.Security;

public sealed class SmtpPasswordResetEmailSender : IPasswordResetEmailSender
{
    private readonly IOptions<SmtpPasswordResetOptions> _options;
    private readonly IHostEnvironment _environment;

    public SmtpPasswordResetEmailSender(
        IOptions<SmtpPasswordResetOptions> options,
        IHostEnvironment environment)
    {
        _options = options;
        _environment = environment;
    }

    public async Task SendPasswordResetLinkAsync(
        string recipientEmail,
        Uri resetLink,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
        var settings = _options.Value;
        var security = ValidateSettings(settings);
        var recipient = ParseAddress(recipientEmail);
        ValidateLink(resetLink);

        var message = CreateMessage(settings, recipient, resetLink);
        using var client = new SmtpClient
        {
            Timeout = settings.TimeoutSeconds * 1000,
            SslProtocols = SslProtocols.Tls12 | SslProtocols.Tls13,
            CheckCertificateRevocation = true
        };
        // No protocol logger and no certificate-validation bypass: neither
        // the SMTP password nor reset links belong in application logs.
        using var deadline = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(cancellationToken);
        deadline.CancelAfter(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(settings.TimeoutSeconds));
        try
        {
            await client.ConnectAsync(
                settings.Host.Trim(), settings.Port, security, deadline.Token);
            await client.AuthenticateAsync(
                settings.Username.Trim(), settings.Password, deadline.Token);
            await client.SendAsync(message, deadline.Token);
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException) when (!cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            throw new TimeoutException("انتهت مهلة إرسال رسالة الاستعادة.");
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException)
        {
            throw;
        }
        catch (Exception)
        {
            // Provider responses can contain recipient or message details.
            // Keep them out of exceptions consumed by public reset pages.
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                "تعذر إرسال رسالة الاستعادة. راجع إعدادات خدمة البريد.");
        }
        finally
        {
            if (client.IsConnected)
            {
                // A failed QUIT must not report an already accepted message
                // as failed or trigger a duplicate email. Dispose closes it.
                using var cleanup = new CancellationTokenSource(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(3));
                try { await client.DisconnectAsync(true, cleanup.Token); }
                catch (Exception) { }
            }
        }
    }

    private static SecureSocketOptions ValidateSettings(SmtpPasswordResetOptions settings)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(settings.Host) || settings.Host.Length > 253 ||
            settings.Host.Any(char.IsWhiteSpace) || settings.Host.Any(char.IsControl) ||
            Uri.CheckHostName(settings.Host) == UriHostNameType.Unknown ||
            settings.Port is < 1 or > 65535 ||
            settings.TimeoutSeconds is < 5 or > 60 ||
            string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(settings.Username) || settings.Username.Length > 256 ||
            settings.Username.Any(char.IsControl) ||
            string.IsNullOrEmpty(settings.Password) || settings.Password.Length > 4096 ||
            settings.FromName is null || settings.FromName.Length > 128 ||
            settings.FromName.Any(char.IsControl))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("إعدادات Email:Smtp ناقصة أو غير صالحة.");

        _ = ParseAddress(settings.FromEmail);
        return settings.SecurityMode?.Trim() switch
        {
            "StartTls" => SecureSocketOptions.StartTls,
            "SslOnConnect" => SecureSocketOptions.SslOnConnect,
            _ => throw new InvalidOperationException(
                "Email:Smtp:SecurityMode must be StartTls or SslOnConnect.")
        };
    }

    private static MailboxAddress ParseAddress(string? value)
    {
        var address = value?.Trim() ?? string.Empty;
        if (address.Length is 0 or > 256 || address.Any(char.IsControl) ||
            !MailboxAddress.TryParse(address, out var mailbox) ||
            !string.IsNullOrEmpty(mailbox.Name) ||
            !string.Equals(mailbox.Address, address, StringComparison.Ordinal))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("عنوان البريد غير صالح للإرسال.");
        return mailbox;
    }

    private void ValidateLink(Uri? resetLink)
    {
        if (resetLink is null || !resetLink.IsAbsoluteUri ||
            resetLink.AbsoluteUri.Length > 16_384 ||
            !string.IsNullOrEmpty(resetLink.UserInfo) ||
            !string.IsNullOrEmpty(resetLink.Fragment) ||
            (resetLink.Scheme != Uri.UriSchemeHttps &&
             !(_environment.IsDevelopment() && resetLink.IsLoopback &&
               resetLink.Scheme == Uri.UriSchemeHttp)))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("رابط استعادة كلمة المرور غير صالح للإرسال.");
    }

    private static MimeMessage CreateMessage(
        SmtpPasswordResetOptions settings, MailboxAddress recipient, Uri resetLink)
    {
        var message = new MimeMessage();
        message.From.Add(new MailboxAddress(settings.FromName.Trim(), settings.FromEmail.Trim()));
        message.To.Add(recipient);
        message.Subject = "ACCP | استعادة كلمة المرور";
        message.Date = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow;
        var link = resetLink.AbsoluteUri;
        var safeLink = HtmlEncoder.Default.Encode(link);
        message.Body = new BodyBuilder
        {
            TextBody = $"""
                استعادة كلمة المرور — ACCP

                وصلنا طلب لاستعادة كلمة مرور حسابك.
                افتح الرابط التالي لتعيين كلمة مرور جديدة:

                {link}

                الرابط صالح لمدة 30 دقيقة من وقت طلبه، ويُستخدم مرة واحدة بعد تغيير كلمة المرور.
                إذا لم تطلب الاستعادة، تجاهل هذه الرسالة؛ كلمة المرور لم تتغيّر.
                لا تشارك رابط الاستعادة مع أي شخص.
                """,
            HtmlBody = $"""
                <!DOCTYPE html>
                <html lang="ar" dir="rtl">
                <body style="margin:0;padding:24px;background:#f5f7fb;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#163f59;line-height:1.9;">
                  <div style="max-width:560px;margin:auto;padding:28px;background:white;border:1px solid #dde6ee;border-radius:16px;">
                    <p style="margin:0;color:#0f766e;font-weight:bold;" dir="ltr">ACCP</p>
                    <h1 style="font-size:24px;">استعادة كلمة المرور</h1>
                    <p>وصلنا طلب لاستعادة كلمة مرور حسابك. اضغط الزر لتعيين كلمة مرور جديدة.</p>
                    <p style="margin:28px 0;"><a href="{safeLink}" style="display:inline-block;background:#0f766e;color:white;text-decoration:none;padding:12px 24px;border-radius:10px;">تعيين كلمة مرور جديدة</a></p>
                    <p>الرابط صالح لمدة <strong>30 دقيقة من وقت طلبه</strong>، ويُستخدم مرة واحدة بعد تغيير كلمة المرور.</p>
                    <p style="color:#596b7b;">إذا لم تطلب الاستعادة، تجاهل هذه الرسالة؛ كلمة المرور لم تتغيّر. لا تشارك الرابط مع أي شخص.</p>
                    <p style="font-size:13px;color:#596b7b;">إذا لم يعمل الزر، انسخ الرابط التالي إلى المتصفح:</p>
                    <p dir="ltr" style="font-size:12px;overflow-wrap:anywhere;"><a href="{safeLink}">{safeLink}</a></p>
                  </div>
                </body>
                </html>
                """
        }.ToMessageBody();
        return message;
    }
}

// Bind Email:Smtp to this class. Store the Password in user-secrets during
// development or in the hosting secret store, never in source-controlled JSON.
public sealed class SmtpPasswordResetOptions
{
    public string Host { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public int Port { get; set; } = 587;
    public string SecurityMode { get; set; } = "StartTls";
    public string Username { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string Password { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string FromEmail { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string FromName { get; set; } = "ACCP";
    public int TimeoutSeconds { get; set; } = 30;
}
````
