### S182 — `ACCP.Web/Security/StaffTwoFactorFlow.cs`


الوظيفة: حراسة تدفق العامل الثاني لحسابات الموظفين

[العودة إلى شرح الملف](#file-182)


````csharp
using System.Security.Claims;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text.Json;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Data;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Identity;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Builder;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.DataProtection;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;

namespace ACCP.Web.Security;

public static class StaffTwoFactorFlow
{
    private const string CookieName = "ACCP.StaffEnrollment";
    private const string Purpose =
        "ACCP.StaffEnrollment.PasswordVerified.v1";

    private static readonly TimeSpan Lifetime =
        TimeSpan.FromMinutes(10);

    public static async Task BeginEnrollmentAsync(
        HttpContext context,
        ApplicationUser passwordVerifiedUser,
        string expectedSecurityStamp)
    {
        var db = context.RequestServices
            .GetRequiredService<AccpDbContext>();

        var current = await db.Users
            .AsNoTracking()
            .SingleOrDefaultAsync(
                user => user.Id == passwordVerifiedUser.Id,
                context.RequestAborted);

        if (current is null ||
            !CanEnroll(current) ||
            string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(expectedSecurityStamp) ||
            !string.Equals(
                current.SecurityStamp,
                expectedSecurityStamp,
                StringComparison.Ordinal) ||
            !await IsStaffAsync(
                db,
                current.Id,
                context.RequestAborted))
        {
            ClearEnrollment(context);

            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                "تغيّرت حالة الحساب. أعد تسجيل الدخول.");
        }

        var signIn = context.RequestServices
            .GetRequiredService<SignInManager<ApplicationUser>>();

        await signIn.SignOutAsync();
        await signIn.ForgetTwoFactorClientAsync();

        context.User = new ClaimsPrincipal(new ClaimsIdentity());

        DeleteCookie(context, "ACCP.PendingTwoFactor");
        DeleteCookie(context, "ACCP.TwoFactorEnrollment");

        var payload = JsonSerializer.Serialize(
            new EnrollmentTicket(
                current.Id,
                current.SecurityStamp!));

        context.Response.Cookies.Append(
            CookieName,
            Protector(context).Protect(payload, Lifetime),
            CookieOptions(context));
    }

    public static async Task<ApplicationUser?>
        GetEnrollmentUserAsync(HttpContext context)
    {
        var ticket = ReadTicket(context);

        if (ticket is null)
        {
            ClearEnrollment(context);
            return null;
        }

        var db = context.RequestServices
            .GetRequiredService<AccpDbContext>();

        var users = context.RequestServices
            .GetRequiredService<UserManager<ApplicationUser>>();

        var user = await users.FindByIdAsync(
            ticket.UserId.ToString());

        if (user is not null)
        {
            await db.Entry(user)
                .ReloadAsync(context.RequestAborted);
        }

        if (user is null ||
            db.Entry(user).State == EntityState.Detached ||
            !CanEnroll(user) ||
            !string.Equals(
                user.SecurityStamp,
                ticket.SecurityStamp,
                StringComparison.Ordinal) ||
            !await IsStaffAsync(
                db,
                user.Id,
                context.RequestAborted))
        {
            ClearEnrollment(context);
            return null;
        }

        return user;
    }

    public static void ClearEnrollment(HttpContext context) =>
        DeleteCookie(context, CookieName);

    public static bool HasCompletedTwoFactor(
        ClaimsPrincipal principal) =>
        principal.Identities.Any(identity =>
            identity.IsAuthenticated &&
            identity.AuthenticationType ==
                IdentityConstants.ApplicationScheme &&
            identity.HasClaim("amr", "mfa"));

    public static IApplicationBuilder UseRequiredOfficerTwoFactor(
        this IApplicationBuilder app)
    {
        return app.Use(async (context, next) =>
        {
            if (context.User.Identity?.IsAuthenticated == true &&
                !await IsApplicationSessionAllowedAsync(context))
            {
                var signIn = context.RequestServices
                    .GetRequiredService<
                        SignInManager<ApplicationUser>>();

                await signIn.SignOutAsync();
                await signIn.ForgetTwoFactorClientAsync();

                context.User =
                    new ClaimsPrincipal(new ClaimsIdentity());

                ClearEnrollment(context);
            }

            await next(context);
        });
    }

    private static async Task<bool>
        IsApplicationSessionAllowedAsync(HttpContext context)
    {
        var users = context.RequestServices
            .GetRequiredService<UserManager<ApplicationUser>>();

        var options = users.Options.ClaimsIdentity;

        if (!Guid.TryParse(
                context.User.FindFirstValue(
                    options.UserIdClaimType),
                out var id))
        {
            return false;
        }

        var stamp = context.User.FindFirstValue(
            options.SecurityStampClaimType);

        var db = context.RequestServices
            .GetRequiredService<AccpDbContext>();

        var user = await db.Users
            .AsNoTracking()
            .SingleOrDefaultAsync(
                item => item.Id == id,
                context.RequestAborted);

        if (user is null ||
            !user.IsActive ||
            string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(stamp) ||
            string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(user.SecurityStamp) ||
            !string.Equals(
                user.SecurityStamp,
                stamp,
                StringComparison.Ordinal) ||
            IsLocked(user))
        {
            return false;
        }

        if (!await IsStaffAsync(
                db,
                user.Id,
                context.RequestAborted))
        {
            return true;
        }

        return user.TwoFactorEnabled &&
            HasCompletedTwoFactor(context.User);
    }

    private static bool CanEnroll(ApplicationUser user) =>
        user.IsActive &&
        !user.TwoFactorEnabled &&
        !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(user.SecurityStamp) &&
        !IsLocked(user);

    private static bool IsLocked(ApplicationUser user) =>
        user.LockoutEnabled &&
        user.LockoutEnd is { } end &&
        end > DateTimeOffset.UtcNow;

    private static Task<bool> IsStaffAsync(
        AccpDbContext db,
        Guid id,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken) =>
        db.UserRoles
            .Where(membership => membership.UserId == id)
            .Join(
                db.Roles,
                membership => membership.RoleId,
                role => role.Id,
                (_, role) => role.NormalizedName)
            .AnyAsync(
                role =>
                    role == IdentityRoles.Officer ||
                    role == IdentityRoles.Admin,
                cancellationToken);

    private static EnrollmentTicket? ReadTicket(
        HttpContext context)
    {
        if (!context.Request.Cookies.TryGetValue(
                CookieName,
                out var value) ||
            string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value) ||
            value.Length > 4096)
        {
            return null;
        }

        try
        {
            var ticket =
                JsonSerializer.Deserialize<EnrollmentTicket>(
                    Protector(context).Unprotect(value));

            return ticket is not null &&
                ticket.UserId != Guid.Empty &&
                !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ticket.SecurityStamp)
                    ? ticket
                    : null;
        }
        catch (CryptographicException)
        {
            return null;
        }
        catch (JsonException)
        {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private static ITimeLimitedDataProtector Protector(
        HttpContext context) =>
        context.RequestServices
            .GetRequiredService<IDataProtectionProvider>()
            .CreateProtector(Purpose)
            .ToTimeLimitedDataProtector();

    private static CookieOptions CookieOptions(
        HttpContext context) => new()
        {
            HttpOnly = true,
            Secure = context.Request.IsHttps,
            SameSite = SameSiteMode.Strict,
            IsEssential = true,
            Path = "/",
            MaxAge = Lifetime
        };

    private static void DeleteCookie(
        HttpContext context,
        string name)
    {
        var options = CookieOptions(context);
        options.MaxAge = TimeSpan.Zero;

        context.Response.Cookies.Delete(name, options);
    }

    private sealed record EnrollmentTicket(
        Guid UserId,
        string SecurityStamp);
}
````

### S183 — `ACCP.Web/Services/Chat/IntakeAssistantWorkflow.cs`


الوظيفة: تنسيق الرد والتقييم وحفظ حالة المحادثة

[العودة إلى شرح الملف](#file-183)


````csharp
using System.Data;
using ACCP.Application.Chat;
using ACCP.Domain.Entities;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Data;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Identity;
using ACCP.Web.Security;
using Microsoft.Data.SqlClient;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;

namespace ACCP.Web.Services.Chat;

public sealed class IntakeAssistantWorkflow : IIntakeAssistantWorkflow
{
    private readonly IServiceScopeFactory _scopes;
    private readonly CaseAuthorizationService _authorization;
    private readonly ICaseIntakeAssistant _assistant;

    public IntakeAssistantWorkflow(
        IServiceScopeFactory scopes,
        CaseAuthorizationService authorization,
        ICaseIntakeAssistant assistant)
    {
        _scopes = scopes;
        _authorization = authorization;
        _assistant = assistant;
    }

    public async Task<IntakeAssistantTurn> ReplyAsync(
        Guid conversationId,
        Guid operationId,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        RequireId(operationId);

        var snapshot = await ExecuteAsync(
            conversationId,
            async (db, conversation, reporterId, ct) =>
            {
                var messages = await db.IntakeConversationMessages
                    .AsNoTracking()
                    .Where(x => x.ConversationId == conversationId)
                    .OrderBy(x => x.SequenceNumber)
                    .Take(401)
                    .ToListAsync(ct);

                var reporterMessage = messages.SingleOrDefault(x =>
                    x.OperationId == operationId &&
                    x.Role == IntakeMessageRole.Reporter &&
                    x.AuthorUserId == reporterId);

                if (reporterMessage is null)
                    throw new InvalidOperationException(
                        "احفظ رسالتك قبل طلب رد المساعد.");

                var cached = await FindReplyAsync(
                    db, reporterMessage, ct);

                if (cached is not null)
                    return new ReplySnapshot(
                        reporterId, 0, [], [], cached);

                RequireOpen(conversation);
                RequireLatestReporter(messages, reporterMessage);

                if (messages.Count >= 400)
                    throw new InvalidOperationException(
                        "وصلت المحادثة للحد المتاح من الرسائل.");

                if (messages.Any(x => x.Role is not (
                    IntakeMessageRole.Reporter or
                    IntakeMessageRole.Assistant)))
                    throw new InvalidOperationException(
                        "هذه المحادثة غير متاحة للمساعد الآلي.");

                var history = messages.Select(x =>
                    new IntakeChatMessage(
                        x.Role == IntakeMessageRole.Reporter
                            ? IntakeChatRole.User
                            : IntakeChatRole.Assistant,
                        x.Content))
                    .ToArray();

                return new ReplySnapshot(
                    reporterId,
                    reporterMessage.SequenceNumber,
                    conversation.RowVersion.ToArray(),
                    history,
                    null);
            },
            cancellationToken);

        if (snapshot.Cached is not null)
            return snapshot.Cached;

        // استدعاء المساعد خارج معاملة قاعدة البيانات.
        var reply = await _assistant.ReplyAsync(
            snapshot.History,
            cancellationToken);

        cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();

        if (reply is null)
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                "لم يُرجع المساعد ردًا صالحًا.");

        var content = ValidateContent(reply.Message);

        return await ExecuteAsync(
            conversationId,
            async (db, conversation, reporterId, ct) =>
            {
                if (reporterId != snapshot.ReporterId)
                    throw NoAccess();

                var reporterMessage = await db.IntakeConversationMessages
                    .SingleOrDefaultAsync(x =>
                        x.ConversationId == conversationId &&
                        x.OperationId == operationId &&
                        x.Role == IntakeMessageRole.Reporter &&
                        x.AuthorUserId == reporterId, ct);

                if (reporterMessage is null)
                    throw NoAccess();

                var cached = await FindReplyAsync(
                    db, reporterMessage, ct);

                if (cached is not null)
                    return cached;

                RequireOpen(conversation);

                var lastSequence = await db.IntakeConversationMessages
                    .Where(x => x.ConversationId == conversationId)
                    .Select(x => (long?)x.SequenceNumber)
                    .MaxAsync(ct) ?? 0;

                if (lastSequence != snapshot.BasedOnSequenceNumber ||
                    reporterMessage.SequenceNumber !=
                        snapshot.BasedOnSequenceNumber ||
                    !conversation.RowVersion.SequenceEqual(
                        snapshot.RowVersion))
                    throw new InvalidOperationException(
                        "تغيرت المحادثة أثناء توليد الرد. " +
                        "حدّث المحادثة ثم أعد المحاولة.");

                if (await db.IntakeConversationMessages.CountAsync(
                    x => x.ConversationId == conversationId, ct) >= 400)
                    throw new InvalidOperationException(
                        "وصلت المحادثة للحد المتاح من الرسائل.");

                var now = DateTime.UtcNow;

                var message = new IntakeConversationMessage
                {
                    ConversationId = conversationId,
                    OperationId = operationId,
                    SequenceNumber = checked(lastSequence + 1),
                    Role = IntakeMessageRole.Assistant,
                    AuthorUserId = null,
                    Content = content,
                    CreatedAtUtc = now
                };

                db.IntakeConversationMessages.Add(message);

                IntakeRiskAssessment? assessment = null;

                if (reply.Assessment is { } result)
                {
                    assessment = new IntakeRiskAssessment(
                        conversationId,
                        message.Id,
                        reporterMessage.SequenceNumber,
                        result.Title,
                        result.Summary,
                        result.IncidentType,
                        decimal.Round(
                            result.RiskPercentage,
                            26,
                            MidpointRounding.ToEven),
                        result.RiskExplanation);

                    db.IntakeRiskAssessments.Add(assessment);

                    conversation.Title = assessment.Title;
                }

                conversation.UpdatedAtUtc = now;

                conversation.Status =
                    assessment?.ShouldOfferFormalReport == true
                        ? IntakeConversationStatus.AwaitingReportDecision
                        : IntakeConversationStatus.Assistant;

                // حفظ الرد والتقييم وحالة المحادثة معًا.
                await db.SaveChangesAsync(ct);

                return new IntakeAssistantTurn(
                    ToMessage(message),
                    assessment is null
                        ? null
                        : ToAssessment(assessment));
            },
            cancellationToken);
    }

    public Task<IntakeAssessmentInfo?> GetCurrentAssessmentAsync(
        Guid conversationId,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) =>
        ExecuteAsync<IntakeAssessmentInfo?>(
            conversationId,
            async (db, conversation, _, ct) =>
            {
                if (!IsOpen(conversation))
                    return null;

                var last = await db.IntakeConversationMessages
                    .AsNoTracking()
                    .Where(x => x.ConversationId == conversationId)
                    .OrderByDescending(x => x.SequenceNumber)
                    .FirstOrDefaultAsync(ct);

                if (last?.Role != IntakeMessageRole.Assistant)
                    return null;

                var reporterSequence = await db.IntakeConversationMessages
                    .Where(x =>
                        x.ConversationId == conversationId &&
                        x.Role == IntakeMessageRole.Reporter)
                    .Select(x => (long?)x.SequenceNumber)
                    .MaxAsync(ct);

                var assessment = await db.IntakeRiskAssessments
                    .AsNoTracking()
                    .SingleOrDefaultAsync(x =>
                        x.ConversationId == conversationId &&
                        x.AssistantMessageId == last.Id &&
                        x.BasedOnSequenceNumber == reporterSequence, ct);

                return assessment is null
                    ? null
                    : ToAssessment(assessment);
            },
            cancellationToken);

    private static async Task<IntakeAssistantTurn?> FindReplyAsync(
        AccpDbContext db,
        IntakeConversationMessage reporterMessage,
        CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var message = await db.IntakeConversationMessages
            .AsNoTracking()
            .SingleOrDefaultAsync(x =>
                x.ConversationId == reporterMessage.ConversationId &&
                x.OperationId == reporterMessage.OperationId &&
                x.Role == IntakeMessageRole.Assistant, ct);

        if (message is null)
            return null;

        if (message.SequenceNumber <= reporterMessage.SequenceNumber)
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                "ترتيب رسائل المحادثة غير صالح.");

        var assessment = await db.IntakeRiskAssessments
            .AsNoTracking()
            .SingleOrDefaultAsync(x =>
                x.ConversationId == message.ConversationId &&
                x.AssistantMessageId == message.Id, ct);

        if (assessment is not null &&
            assessment.BasedOnSequenceNumber !=
                reporterMessage.SequenceNumber)
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                "التقييم غير مرتبط بالرسالة المطلوبة.");

        return new IntakeAssistantTurn(
            ToMessage(message),
            assessment is null
                ? null
                : ToAssessment(assessment));
    }

    private async Task<T> ExecuteAsync<T>(
        Guid conversationId,
        Func<
            AccpDbContext,
            IntakeConversation,
            Guid,
            CancellationToken,
            Task<T>> action,
        CancellationToken ct)
    {
        RequireId(conversationId);

        for (var attempt = 0; ; attempt++)
        {
            ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();

            try
            {
                await using var scope = _scopes.CreateAsyncScope();

                var db = scope.ServiceProvider
                    .GetRequiredService<AccpDbContext>();

                return await db.Database
                    .CreateExecutionStrategy()
                    .ExecuteAsync(async () =>
                    {
                        await using var transaction =
                            await db.Database.BeginTransactionAsync(
                                IsolationLevel.Serializable,
                                ct);

                        db.ChangeTracker.Clear();

                        var reporterId = await RequireReporterAsync(
                            db, ct);

                        var conversation = await db.IntakeConversations
                            .SingleOrDefaultAsync(x =>
                                x.Id == conversationId &&
                                x.ReporterId == reporterId, ct);

                        if (conversation is null)
                            throw NoAccess();

                        var result = await action(
                            db,
                            conversation,
                            reporterId,
                            ct);

                        await transaction.CommitAsync(ct);

                        return result;
                    });
            }
            catch (Exception exception) when (
                attempt < 2 && IsRetryableConflict(exception))
            {
                await Task.Delay(
                    TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(40 * (attempt + 1)),
                    ct);
            }
        }
    }

    private async Task<Guid> RequireReporterAsync(
        AccpDbContext db,
        CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var actor = await _authorization.GetCurrentActorAsync(ct);

        if (actor is null || !actor.HasRole(IdentityRoles.User))
            throw NoAccess();

        var account = await db.Users
            .AsNoTracking()
            .SingleOrDefaultAsync(x => x.Id == actor.UserId, ct);

        var roles = await db.UserRoles
            .Where(x => x.UserId == actor.UserId)
            .Join(
                db.Roles,
                x => x.RoleId,
                x => x.Id,
                (_, role) => role.Name)
            .ToListAsync(ct);

        if (account is null ||
            !account.IsActive ||
            (account.LockoutEnabled &&
             account.LockoutEnd > DateTimeOffset.UtcNow) ||
            roles.Count != 1 ||
            roles[0] != IdentityRoles.User)
            throw NoAccess();

        var confirmed = await _authorization.GetCurrentActorAsync(ct);

        if (confirmed?.UserId != actor.UserId ||
            !confirmed.HasRole(IdentityRoles.User))
            throw NoAccess();

        return actor.UserId;
    }

    private static void RequireLatestReporter(
        IReadOnlyList<IntakeConversationMessage> messages,
        IntakeConversationMessage reporterMessage)
    {
        if (messages.Count == 0 ||
            messages[^1].Id != reporterMessage.Id)
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                "يمكن توليد رد جديد لآخر رسالة فقط. " +
                "حدّث المحادثة ثم أعد المحاولة.");
    }

    private static bool IsOpen(IntakeConversation conversation) =>
        conversation.CyberCaseId is null &&
        conversation.FormalReportConsentAtUtc is null &&
        conversation.Status is (
            IntakeConversationStatus.Assistant or
            IntakeConversationStatus.AwaitingReportDecision);

    private static void RequireOpen(
        IntakeConversation conversation)
    {
        if (!IsOpen(conversation))
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                "هذه المحادثة غير متاحة للمساعد الآلي.");
    }

    private static string ValidateContent(string? value)
    {
        var text = value?.Trim() ?? string.Empty;

        if (text.Length is < 1 or > 6000 ||
            text.Any(c =>
                char.IsControl(c) &&
                c is not ('\r' or '\n' or '\t')))
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                "لم يُرجع المساعد ردًا صالحًا للحفظ.");

        return text;
    }

    private static bool IsRetryableConflict(Exception exception) =>
        exception is DbUpdateConcurrencyException ||
        exception is SqlException
        {
            Number: 1205 or 2601 or 2627
        } ||
        exception is DbUpdateException
        {
            InnerException: SqlException
            {
                Number: 1205 or 2601 or 2627
            }
        };

    private static void RequireId(Guid id)
    {
        if (id == Guid.Empty)
            throw new ArgumentException(
                "معرّف الطلب غير صالح.");
    }

    private static UnauthorizedAccessException NoAccess() =>
        new("تعذر الوصول إلى المحادثة.");

    private static IntakeMessageInfo ToMessage(
        IntakeConversationMessage item) =>
        new(
            item.Id,
            item.SequenceNumber,
            item.Role,
            item.Content,
            item.OperationId,
            item.CreatedAtUtc);

    private static IntakeAssessmentInfo ToAssessment(
        IntakeRiskAssessment item) =>
        new(
            item.Id,
            item.AssistantMessageId,
            item.BasedOnSequenceNumber,
            new CaseRiskAssessment(
                item.Title,
                item.Summary,
                item.IncidentType,
                item.RiskPercentage,
                item.RiskExplanation),
            item.CreatedAtUtc);

    private sealed record ReplySnapshot(
        Guid ReporterId,
        long BasedOnSequenceNumber,
        byte[] RowVersion,
        IReadOnlyList<IntakeChatMessage> History,
        IntakeAssistantTurn? Cached);
}
````

### S184 — `ACCP.Web/Services/Chat/IntakeConversationService.cs`


الوظيفة: إدارة تخزين محادثات الاستقبال ورسائلها

[العودة إلى شرح الملف](#file-184)


````csharp
using System.Data;
using ACCP.Application.Chat;
using ACCP.Domain.Entities;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Data;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Identity;
using ACCP.Web.Security;
using Microsoft.Data.SqlClient;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace ACCP.Web.Services.Chat;

public sealed class IntakeConversationService : IIntakeConversationService
{
    private readonly IServiceScopeFactory _scopes;
    private readonly CaseAuthorizationService _authorization;

    public IntakeConversationService(
        IServiceScopeFactory scopes,
        CaseAuthorizationService authorization)
    {
        _scopes = scopes;
        _authorization = authorization;
    }

    public Task<IntakeConversationInfo> CreateAsync(
        Guid conversationId,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        RequireId(conversationId);

        return WriteAsync(async (db, reporterId, ct) =>
        {
            var existing = await db.IntakeConversations
                .SingleOrDefaultAsync(x => x.Id == conversationId, ct);

            if (existing is not null)
            {
                if (existing.ReporterId != reporterId) throw NoAccess();
                return ToInfo(existing);
            }

            var now = DateTime.UtcNow;
            var conversation = new IntakeConversation
            {
                Id = conversationId,
                ReporterId = reporterId,
                Title = "محادثة جديدة",
                Status = IntakeConversationStatus.Assistant,
                CreatedAtUtc = now,
                UpdatedAtUtc = now
            };

            db.IntakeConversations.Add(conversation);
            await db.SaveChangesAsync(ct);
            return ToInfo(conversation);
        }, cancellationToken);
    }

    public async Task<IntakeConversationInfo?> GetAsync(
        Guid conversationId,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        RequireId(conversationId);
        await using var scope = _scopes.CreateAsyncScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<AccpDbContext>();
        var reporterId = await RequireReporterAsync(db, cancellationToken);

        var item = await db.IntakeConversations.AsNoTracking()
            .SingleOrDefaultAsync(
                x => x.Id == conversationId && x.ReporterId == reporterId,
                cancellationToken);

        return item is null ? null : ToInfo(item);
    }

    public async Task<IReadOnlyList<IntakeConversationInfo>> ListAsync(
        int skip = 0,
        int take = 20,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        if (skip < 0 || take is < 1 or > 100)
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(take));

        await using var scope = _scopes.CreateAsyncScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<AccpDbContext>();
        var reporterId = await RequireReporterAsync(db, cancellationToken);

        var items = await db.IntakeConversations.AsNoTracking()
            .Where(x => x.ReporterId == reporterId)
            .OrderByDescending(x => x.UpdatedAtUtc)
            .ThenBy(x => x.Id)
            .Skip(skip)
            .Take(take)
            .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

        return items.Select(ToInfo).ToArray();
    }

    public async Task<IntakeMessagePage> GetMessagesAsync(
        Guid conversationId,
        long afterSequenceNumber = 0,
        int take = 50,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        RequireId(conversationId);

        if (afterSequenceNumber < 0 || take is < 1 or > 100)
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(take));

        await using var scope = _scopes.CreateAsyncScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<AccpDbContext>();
        var reporterId = await RequireReporterAsync(db, cancellationToken);

        if (!await db.IntakeConversations.AnyAsync(
            x => x.Id == conversationId && x.ReporterId == reporterId,
            cancellationToken))
            throw NoAccess();

        var items = await db.IntakeConversationMessages.AsNoTracking()
            .Where(x =>
                x.ConversationId == conversationId &&
                x.Conversation.ReporterId == reporterId &&
                x.SequenceNumber > afterSequenceNumber)
            .OrderBy(x => x.SequenceNumber)
            .Take(take + 1)
            .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

        var hasMore = items.Count > take;
        var page = items.Take(take).Select(ToMessage).ToArray();

        return new IntakeMessagePage(
            page,
            hasMore,
            page.Length == 0
                ? afterSequenceNumber
                : page[^1].SequenceNumber);
    }

    public Task<IntakeMessageInfo> AppendReporterMessageAsync(
        Guid conversationId,
        Guid operationId,
        string content,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        RequireId(conversationId);
        RequireId(operationId);

        var text = content?.Trim() ?? string.Empty;

        if (text.Length is < 2 or > 3000 ||
            text.Any(c => char.IsControl(c) &&
                c is not ('\r' or '\n' or '\t')))
            throw new ArgumentException(
                "اكتب رسالة بين حرفين و3000 حرف بدون محارف تحكم غير صالحة.",
                nameof(content));

        return WriteAsync(async (db, reporterId, ct) =>
        {
            var conversation = await db.IntakeConversations
                .SingleOrDefaultAsync(
                    x => x.Id == conversationId &&
                         x.ReporterId == reporterId, ct);

            if (conversation is null) throw NoAccess();

            var previous = await db.IntakeConversationMessages
                .SingleOrDefaultAsync(
                    x => x.ConversationId == conversationId &&
                         x.OperationId == operationId &&
                         x.Role == IntakeMessageRole.Reporter, ct);

            if (previous is not null)
            {
                if (previous.AuthorUserId != reporterId ||
                    !string.Equals(
                        previous.Content, text, StringComparison.Ordinal))
                    throw new InvalidOperationException(
                        "لا يمكن استخدام معرّف الرسالة نفسه لمحتوى مختلف.");

                return ToMessage(previous);
            }

            if (conversation.CyberCaseId is not null ||
                conversation.FormalReportConsentAtUtc is not null ||
                conversation.Status is not (
                    IntakeConversationStatus.Assistant or
                    IntakeConversationStatus.AwaitingReportDecision))
                throw new InvalidOperationException(
                    "هذه المحادثة غير متاحة لإرسال رسائل استقبال جديدة.");

            if (await db.IntakeConversationMessages.CountAsync(
                x => x.ConversationId == conversationId, ct) >= 400)
                throw new InvalidOperationException(
                    "وصلت المحادثة للحد المتاح من الرسائل.");

            var lastSequence = await db.IntakeConversationMessages
                .Where(x => x.ConversationId == conversationId)
                .Select(x => (long?)x.SequenceNumber)
                .MaxAsync(ct) ?? 0;

            var now = DateTime.UtcNow;
            var message = new IntakeConversationMessage
            {
                ConversationId = conversationId,
                OperationId = operationId,
                SequenceNumber = checked(lastSequence + 1),
                Role = IntakeMessageRole.Reporter,
                AuthorUserId = reporterId,
                Content = text,
                CreatedAtUtc = now
            };

            db.IntakeConversationMessages.Add(message);
            conversation.UpdatedAtUtc = now;
            conversation.Status = IntakeConversationStatus.Assistant;

            await db.SaveChangesAsync(ct);
            return ToMessage(message);
        }, cancellationToken);
    }

    private async Task<Guid> RequireReporterAsync(
        AccpDbContext db,
        CancellationToken ct)
    {
        ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();

        var actor = await _authorization.GetCurrentActorAsync(ct);

        if (actor is null || !actor.HasRole(IdentityRoles.User))
            throw NoAccess();

        var account = await db.Users.AsNoTracking()
            .SingleOrDefaultAsync(x => x.Id == actor.UserId, ct);

        var roles = await db.UserRoles
            .Where(x => x.UserId == actor.UserId)
            .Join(
                db.Roles,
                x => x.RoleId,
                x => x.Id,
                (_, role) => role.Name)
            .ToListAsync(ct);

        if (account is null || !account.IsActive ||
            (account.LockoutEnabled &&
             account.LockoutEnd > DateTimeOffset.UtcNow) ||
            roles.Count != 1 || roles[0] != IdentityRoles.User)
            throw NoAccess();

        var confirmed = await _authorization.GetCurrentActorAsync(ct);

        if (confirmed?.UserId != actor.UserId ||
            !confirmed.HasRole(IdentityRoles.User))
            throw NoAccess();

        return actor.UserId;
    }

    private async Task<T> WriteAsync<T>(
        Func<AccpDbContext, Guid, CancellationToken, Task<T>> action,
        CancellationToken ct)
    {
        for (var attempt = 0; ; attempt++)
        {
            ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();

            try
            {
                await using var scope = _scopes.CreateAsyncScope();
                var db = scope.ServiceProvider
                    .GetRequiredService<AccpDbContext>();

                return await db.Database.CreateExecutionStrategy()
                    .ExecuteAsync(async () =>
                    {
                        await using var transaction =
                            await db.Database.BeginTransactionAsync(
                                IsolationLevel.Serializable, ct);

                        db.ChangeTracker.Clear();

                        var reporterId = await RequireReporterAsync(db, ct);
                        var result = await action(db, reporterId, ct);

                        await transaction.CommitAsync(ct);
                        return result;
                    });
            }
            catch (Exception exception) when (
                attempt < 2 && IsRetryableConflict(exception))
            {
                await Task.Delay(
                    TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(40 * (attempt + 1)), ct);
            }
        }
    }

    private static bool IsRetryableConflict(Exception exception) =>
        exception is DbUpdateConcurrencyException ||
        exception is SqlException
        {
            Number: 1205 or 2601 or 2627
        } ||
        exception is DbUpdateException
        {
            InnerException: SqlException
            {
                Number: 1205 or 2601 or 2627
            }
        };

    private static void RequireId(Guid id)
    {
        if (id == Guid.Empty)
            throw new ArgumentException("معرّف الطلب غير صالح.");
    }

    private static UnauthorizedAccessException NoAccess() =>
        new("تعذر الوصول إلى المحادثة.");

    private static IntakeConversationInfo ToInfo(
        IntakeConversation item) =>
        new(
            item.Id, item.Title, item.Status, item.CyberCaseId,
            item.CreatedAtUtc, item.UpdatedAtUtc);

    private static IntakeMessageInfo ToMessage(
        IntakeConversationMessage item) =>
        new(
            item.Id, item.SequenceNumber, item.Role, item.Content,
            item.OperationId, item.CreatedAtUtc);
}
````

### S185 — `ACCP.Web/Services/Chat/IntakeFormalReportService.cs`


الوظيفة: خدمة إنشاء البلاغ المرتبط باستقبال وموافقة

[العودة إلى شرح الملف](#file-185)


````csharp
using System;
using System.Data;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using ACCP.Application.Chat;
using ACCP.Domain.Entities;
using ACCP.Domain.Enums;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Data;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Identity;
using ACCP.Web.Security;
using Microsoft.Data.SqlClient;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;

namespace ACCP.Web.Services.Chat;

public sealed class IntakeFormalReportService : IIntakeFormalReportService
{
    private readonly IServiceScopeFactory _scopes;
    private readonly CaseAuthorizationService _authorization;

    public IntakeFormalReportService(
        IServiceScopeFactory scopes,
        CaseAuthorizationService authorization)
    {
        _scopes = scopes;
        _authorization = authorization;
    }

    public async Task<IntakeFormalReportInfo> SubmitAsync(
        Guid conversationId,
        Guid assessmentId,
        bool consent,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        if (!consent)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                "يجب الموافقة صراحة على تقديم البلاغ.");
        }

        if (conversationId == Guid.Empty ||
            assessmentId == Guid.Empty)
        {
            throw new ArgumentException(
                "معرّف المحادثة أو التقييم غير صالح.");
        }

        var caseId = Guid.NewGuid();

        var caseNumber =
            $"ACCP-{DateTime.UtcNow:yyyyMMdd}-{caseId:N}";

        for (var attempt = 0; ; attempt++)
        {
            cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();

            try
            {
                await using var scope = _scopes.CreateAsyncScope();

                var db = scope.ServiceProvider
                    .GetRequiredService<AccpDbContext>();

                return await db.Database
                    .CreateExecutionStrategy()
                    .ExecuteAsync(async () =>
                    {
                        await using var transaction =
                            await db.Database.BeginTransactionAsync(
                                IsolationLevel.Serializable,
                                cancellationToken);

                        db.ChangeTracker.Clear();

                        var reporter = await RequireReporterAsync(
                            db,
                            cancellationToken);

                        var conversation = await db.IntakeConversations
                            .SingleOrDefaultAsync(
                                x => x.Id == conversationId &&
                                     x.ReporterId == reporter.Id,
                                cancellationToken);

                        if (conversation is null)
                        {
                            throw NoAccess();
                        }

                        var result = await SubmitCoreAsync(
                            db,
                            conversation,
                            reporter,
                            assessmentId,
                            caseId,
                            caseNumber,
                            cancellationToken);

                        await transaction.CommitAsync(
                            cancellationToken);

                        return result;
                    });
            }
            catch (Exception exception) when (
                attempt < 2 &&
                IsRetryableConflict(exception))
            {
                await Task.Delay(
                    TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(
                        40 * (attempt + 1)),
                    cancellationToken);
            }
        }
    }

    private static async Task<IntakeFormalReportInfo> SubmitCoreAsync(
        AccpDbContext db,
        IntakeConversation conversation,
        ApplicationUser reporter,
        Guid assessmentId,
        Guid caseId,
        string caseNumber,
        CancellationToken ct)
    {
        // إعادة المحاولة ترجع البلاغ الموجود حتى بعد تعيينه أو إغلاقه.
        if (conversation.CyberCaseId is { } existingCaseId)
        {
            if (conversation.FormalReportAssessmentId != assessmentId ||
                conversation.FormalReportConsentAtUtc is null)
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException(
                    "هذه المحادثة مرتبطة ببلاغ مقدم بتقييم آخر.");
            }

            var existing = await db.CyberCases
                .AsNoTracking()
                .SingleOrDefaultAsync(
                    x => x.Id == existingCaseId &&
                         x.ReporterId == reporter.Id &&
                         x.Path == CasePath.FormalReport,
                    ct);

            if (existing is null)
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException(
                    "تعذر التحقق من البلاغ المرتبط بالمحادثة.");
            }

            return ToInfo(
                conversation,
                existing,
                true);
        }

        if (conversation.Status !=
                IntakeConversationStatus.AwaitingReportDecision ||
            conversation.FormalReportAssessmentId is not null ||
            conversation.FormalReportConsentAtUtc is not null)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                "المحادثة غير جاهزة لتقديم بلاغ جديد.");
        }

        var assessment = await db.IntakeRiskAssessments
            .AsNoTracking()
            .SingleOrDefaultAsync(
                x => x.Id == assessmentId &&
                     x.ConversationId == conversation.Id,
                ct);

        if (assessment is null)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                "التقييم المطلوب غير متاح لهذه المحادثة.");
        }

        // التحقق مجددًا من القيم المحفوظة قبل إنشاء البلاغ.
        var validated = new CaseRiskAssessment(
            assessment.Title,
            assessment.Summary,
            assessment.IncidentType,
            assessment.RiskPercentage,
            assessment.RiskExplanation);

        if (!validated.ShouldOfferFormalReport)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                "تقديم البلاغ يتطلب درجة خطورة أعلى من 80%.");
        }

        var lastMessage = await db.IntakeConversationMessages
            .AsNoTracking()
            .Where(x =>
                x.ConversationId == conversation.Id)
            .OrderByDescending(x => x.SequenceNumber)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(ct);

        var lastReporterMessage =
            await db.IntakeConversationMessages
                .AsNoTracking()
                .Where(x =>
                    x.ConversationId == conversation.Id &&
                    x.Role == IntakeMessageRole.Reporter)
                .OrderByDescending(x => x.SequenceNumber)
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(ct);

        if (lastMessage is null ||
            lastReporterMessage is null ||
            lastMessage.Id != assessment.AssistantMessageId ||
            lastMessage.Role != IntakeMessageRole.Assistant ||
            lastMessage.AuthorUserId is not null ||
            lastReporterMessage.AuthorUserId != reporter.Id ||
            lastReporterMessage.SequenceNumber !=
                assessment.BasedOnSequenceNumber ||
            lastMessage.SequenceNumber <=
                lastReporterMessage.SequenceNumber ||
            lastMessage.OperationId == Guid.Empty ||
            lastMessage.OperationId !=
                lastReporterMessage.OperationId)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                "تغيرت المحادثة أو التقييم. " +
                "حدّث المحادثة وراجع التقييم الأخير قبل التقديم.");
        }

        var now = DateTime.UtcNow;

        var report = new CyberCase
        {
            Id = caseId,
            CaseNumber = caseNumber,
            ReporterId = reporter.Id,
            Title = validated.Title,
            Description = validated.Summary,
            IncidentType = validated.IncidentType,

            // فئة العرض الحالية للبلاغات المؤهلة بدرجة أعلى من 80.
            // الدرجة الدقيقة تبقى محفوظة في التقييم المرتبط.
            SeverityLevel = SeverityLevel.High,

            Status = CaseStatus.New,
            Path = CasePath.FormalReport,
            CreatedAtUtc = now,
            IsReporterIdentityDisclosed = false
        };

        db.CyberCases.Add(report);

        conversation.CyberCase = report;
        conversation.CyberCaseId = report.Id;
        conversation.FormalReportAssessmentId = assessment.Id;
        conversation.FormalReportConsentAtUtc = now;
        conversation.Status =
            IntakeConversationStatus.AwaitingOfficer;
        conversation.UpdatedAtUtc = now;

        db.AuditLogs.Add(new AuditLog
        {
            Action = AuditAction.CaseCreated,
            ActorUserId = reporter.Id,
            ActorEmail = reporter.Email,
            ActorRole = IdentityRoles.User,
            CyberCaseId = report.Id,
            EntityType = nameof(CyberCase),
            EntityId = report.Id,
            Description =
                $"تم إنشاء البلاغ {report.CaseNumber} بموافقة المشتكي اعتمادًا على التقييم {assessment.Id:D}.",
            CorrelationId = conversation.Id.ToString("D"),
            IsSuccessful = true,
            CreatedAtUtc = now
        });

        db.UserNotifications.Add(new UserNotification
        {
            RecipientUserId = reporter.Id,
            CyberCase = report,
            CyberCaseId = report.Id,
            Type = NotificationType.General,
            Title = "تم تقديم البلاغ",
            Message =
                $"تم تسجيل بلاغك رقم {report.CaseNumber} وهو بانتظار متابعة الموظف المختص.",
            IsRead = false,
            CreatedAtUtc = now
        });

        // حفظ البلاغ والموافقة والتدقيق والإشعار ضمن المعاملة نفسها.
        await db.SaveChangesAsync(ct);

        return ToInfo(
            conversation,
            report,
            false);
    }

    private async Task<ApplicationUser> RequireReporterAsync(
        AccpDbContext db,
        CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var actor =
            await _authorization.GetCurrentActorAsync(ct);

        if (actor is null ||
            !actor.HasRole(IdentityRoles.User))
        {
            throw NoAccess();
        }

        var account = await db.Users
            .AsNoTracking()
            .SingleOrDefaultAsync(
                x => x.Id == actor.UserId,
                ct);

        var roles = await db.UserRoles
            .Where(x => x.UserId == actor.UserId)
            .Join(
                db.Roles,
                x => x.RoleId,
                x => x.Id,
                (_, role) => role.Name)
            .ToListAsync(ct);

        if (account is null ||
            !account.IsActive ||
            (account.LockoutEnabled &&
             account.LockoutEnd > DateTimeOffset.UtcNow) ||
            roles.Count != 1 ||
            roles[0] != IdentityRoles.User)
        {
            throw NoAccess();
        }

        var confirmed =
            await _authorization.GetCurrentActorAsync(ct);

        if (confirmed?.UserId != actor.UserId ||
            !confirmed.HasRole(IdentityRoles.User))
        {
            throw NoAccess();
        }

        return account;
    }

    private static IntakeFormalReportInfo ToInfo(
        IntakeConversation conversation,
        CyberCase report,
        bool alreadySubmitted)
    {
        return new IntakeFormalReportInfo(
            conversation.Id,
            report.Id,
            report.CaseNumber,
            conversation.FormalReportAssessmentId!.Value,
            conversation.FormalReportConsentAtUtc!.Value,
            alreadySubmitted);
    }

    private static bool IsRetryableConflict(
        Exception exception)
    {
        return exception is DbUpdateConcurrencyException ||
               exception is SqlException
               {
                   Number: 1205 or 2601 or 2627
               } ||
               exception is DbUpdateException
               {
                   InnerException: SqlException
                   {
                       Number: 1205 or 2601 or 2627
                   }
               };
    }

    private static UnauthorizedAccessException NoAccess()
    {
        return new UnauthorizedAccessException(
            "تعذر الوصول إلى المحادثة.");
    }
}
````

### S186 — `ACCP.Web/Services/Chat/StaffIntakeHistoryService.cs`


الوظيفة: التحقق وعرض سجل استقبال للموظف المخول

[العودة إلى شرح الملف](#file-186)


````csharp
using System;
using System.Data;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using ACCP.Application.Chat;
using ACCP.Application.Security;
using ACCP.Domain.Entities;
using ACCP.Domain.Enums;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Data;
using ACCP.Web.Security;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;

namespace ACCP.Web.Services.Chat;

public sealed class StaffIntakeHistoryService : IStaffIntakeHistoryService
{
    private readonly IServiceScopeFactory _scopes;
    private readonly CaseAuthorizationService _authorization;

    public StaffIntakeHistoryService(
        IServiceScopeFactory scopes,
        CaseAuthorizationService authorization)
    {
        _scopes = scopes;
        _authorization = authorization;
    }

    public async Task<StaffIntakeHistory?> GetForCaseAsync(
        Guid caseId,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        if (caseId == Guid.Empty)
        {
            throw new ArgumentException(
                "معرّف القضية غير صالح.");
        }

        await using var scope = _scopes.CreateAsyncScope();

        var db = scope.ServiceProvider
            .GetRequiredService<AccpDbContext>();

        return await db.Database
            .CreateExecutionStrategy()
            .ExecuteAsync(async () =>
            {
                await using var transaction =
                    await db.Database.BeginTransactionAsync(
                        IsolationLevel.Serializable,
                        cancellationToken);

                var actor =
                    await _authorization.GetCurrentActorAsync(
                        cancellationToken);

                if (actor is null || !actor.HasRole("OFFICER"))
                    throw NoAccess();

                var account = await db.Users
                    .AsNoTracking()
                    .SingleOrDefaultAsync(
                        x => x.Id == actor.UserId,
                        cancellationToken);

                var roles = await db.UserRoles
                    .Where(x => x.UserId == actor.UserId)
                    .Join(
                        db.Roles,
                        x => x.RoleId,
                        x => x.Id,
                        (_, role) => role.Name)
                    .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

                if (account is null ||
                    !account.IsActive ||
                    !account.TwoFactorEnabled ||
                    !roles.Contains("OFFICER") ||
                    (account.LockoutEnabled &&
                     account.LockoutEnd > DateTimeOffset.UtcNow))
                {
                    throw NoAccess();
                }

                // التحقق من علاقة الموظف بالقضية قبل قراءة المحادثة.
                var cyberCase = await db.CyberCases
                    .AsNoTracking()
                    .Where(x => x.Id == caseId)
                    .Select(x => new CyberCase
                    {
                        Id = x.Id,
                        ReporterId = x.ReporterId,
                        Path = x.Path,
                        AssignedOfficerId = x.AssignedOfficerId,

                        Collaborators = x.Collaborators
                            .Where(c => c.IsActive)
                            .Select(c => new CaseCollaborator
                            {
                                CyberCaseId = c.CyberCaseId,
                                OfficerId = c.OfficerId,
                                IsActive = c.IsActive
                            })
                            .ToList()
                    })
                    .SingleOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken);

                if (cyberCase is null ||
                    cyberCase.Path != CasePath.FormalReport ||
                    !CaseAccessPolicy.IsAllowed(
                        actor,
                        cyberCase,
                        CasePermission.ReadDetails))
                {
                    throw NoAccess();
                }

                var conversation = await db.IntakeConversations
                    .AsNoTracking()
                    .SingleOrDefaultAsync(
                        x => x.CyberCaseId == caseId,
                        cancellationToken);

                if (conversation is null)
                {
                    // البلاغات القديمة قد لا ترتبط بمحادثة استقبال.
                    await transaction.CommitAsync(
                        cancellationToken);

                    return (StaffIntakeHistory?)null;
                }

                if (conversation.ReporterId != cyberCase.ReporterId ||
                    conversation.FormalReportConsentAtUtc
                        is not { } consentAt ||
                    conversation.FormalReportAssessmentId
                        is not { } assessmentId)
                {
                    throw InvalidHistory();
                }

                var stored = await db.IntakeRiskAssessments
                    .AsNoTracking()
                    .SingleOrDefaultAsync(
                        x => x.Id == assessmentId &&
                             x.ConversationId == conversation.Id,
                        cancellationToken);

                if (stored is null)
                    throw InvalidHistory();

                var assessment = new CaseRiskAssessment(
                    stored.Title,
                    stored.Summary,
                    stored.IncidentType,
                    stored.RiskPercentage,
                    stored.RiskExplanation);

                if (!assessment.ShouldOfferFormalReport)
                    throw InvalidHistory();

                var approvedMessage =
                    await db.IntakeConversationMessages
                        .AsNoTracking()
                        .SingleOrDefaultAsync(
                            x => x.ConversationId == conversation.Id &&
                                 x.Id == stored.AssistantMessageId,
                            cancellationToken);

                if (approvedMessage is null ||
                    approvedMessage.Role != IntakeMessageRole.Assistant ||
                    approvedMessage.AuthorUserId is not null ||
                    approvedMessage.SequenceNumber <=
                        stored.BasedOnSequenceNumber)
                {
                    throw InvalidHistory();
                }

                // عرض السجل حتى رد المساعد المعتمد لتقديم البلاغ.
                var messages =
                    await db.IntakeConversationMessages
                        .AsNoTracking()
                        .Where(x =>
                            x.ConversationId == conversation.Id &&
                            x.SequenceNumber <=
                                approvedMessage.SequenceNumber)
                        .OrderBy(x => x.SequenceNumber)
                        .Take(401)
                        .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

                if (messages.Count == 0 ||
                    messages.Count > 400 ||
                    messages.Any(x =>
                        x.SequenceNumber <= 0 ||
                        x.Role is not (
                            IntakeMessageRole.Reporter or
                            IntakeMessageRole.Assistant) ||
                        (x.Role == IntakeMessageRole.Reporter &&
                         x.AuthorUserId != conversation.ReporterId) ||
                        (x.Role == IntakeMessageRole.Assistant &&
                         x.AuthorUserId is not null)))
                {
                    throw InvalidHistory();
                }

                var basis = messages.SingleOrDefault(
                    x => x.SequenceNumber ==
                         stored.BasedOnSequenceNumber);

                if (basis is null ||
                    basis.Role != IntakeMessageRole.Reporter ||
                    basis.OperationId == Guid.Empty ||
                    basis.OperationId != approvedMessage.OperationId ||
                    messages[^1].Id != approvedMessage.Id)
                {
                    throw InvalidHistory();
                }

                var confirmed =
                    await _authorization.GetCurrentActorAsync(
                        cancellationToken);

                if (confirmed?.UserId != actor.UserId ||
                    !confirmed.HasRole("OFFICER"))
                {
                    throw NoAccess();
                }

                var result = new StaffIntakeHistory(
                    conversation.Id,
                    consentAt,
                    assessment,
                    messages.Select(x => new StaffIntakeMessage(
                        x.SequenceNumber,
                        x.Role == IntakeMessageRole.Reporter
                            ? IntakeChatRole.User
                            : IntakeChatRole.Assistant,
                        x.Content,
                        x.CreatedAtUtc))
                    .ToArray());

                await transaction.CommitAsync(
                    cancellationToken);

                return result;
            });
    }

    private static UnauthorizedAccessException NoAccess() =>
        new("لا تملك صلاحية عرض سجل استقبال هذه القضية.");

    private static InvalidOperationException InvalidHistory() =>
        new("تعذر التحقق من سجل الاستقبال والتقييم المعتمد.");
}
````

````csharp
using ACCP.Application.Chat;

namespace ACCP.Web.Services.Chat;

public sealed class UnavailableCaseIntakeAssistant : ICaseIntakeAssistant
{
    public Task<IntakeAssistantReply> ReplyAsync(
        IReadOnlyList<IntakeChatMessage> conversation,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(conversation);

        return Task.FromException<IntakeAssistantReply>(
            new InvalidOperationException(
                "خدمة المساعد والتقييم غير متاحة حاليًا. لم يتم إنشاء تقييم أو إرسال بلاغ. حاول لاحقًا."));
    }
}
````

````css
:root {

h1, .h1 { font-size: clamp(1.55rem, 2.5vw, 2rem); }
h2, .h2 { font-size: clamp(1.3rem, 2vw, 1.65rem); }
a { text-underline-offset: .2em; }
.text-muted { color: var(--accp-muted) !important; }
.btn { min-height: 2.75rem; padding: .58rem 1rem; border-radius: .6rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.5; }
.btn-sm { min-height: 2.25rem; padding: .4rem .75rem; font-size: .8rem; }
.btn-primary {
    --bs-btn-color: #fff;
    --bs-btn-bg: #146c60;
    --bs-btn-border-color: #146c60;
    --bs-btn-hover-color: #fff;
    --bs-btn-hover-bg: #10584e;
    --bs-btn-hover-border-color: #10584e;
    --bs-btn-active-color: #fff;
    --bs-btn-active-bg: #0c4b42;
    --bs-btn-active-border-color: #0c4b42;
    --bs-btn-disabled-color: #fff;
    --bs-btn-disabled-bg: #146c60;
    --bs-btn-disabled-border-color: #146c60;
    --bs-btn-focus-shadow-rgb: 20, 108, 96;
}
.btn-outline-primary {
    --bs-btn-color: #146c60;
    --bs-btn-border-color: #146c60;
    --bs-btn-hover-color: #fff;
    --bs-btn-hover-bg: #146c60;
    --bs-btn-hover-border-color: #146c60;
    --bs-btn-active-bg: #10584e;
    --bs-btn-active-color: #fff;
    --bs-btn-active-border-color: #10584e;
    --bs-btn-disabled-color: #146c60;
    --bs-btn-disabled-border-color: #146c60;
    --bs-btn-disabled-bg: transparent;
    --bs-btn-focus-shadow-rgb: 20, 108, 96;
}
.btn-link { color: var(--accp-brand); }
.btn-outline-secondary { --bs-btn-color: #526279; --bs-btn-border-color: #cbd5e0; }
.card { border: 1px solid var(--accp-border); border-radius: .9rem; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 3px 12px #20324a05; }
.card-header { padding: 1rem 1.2rem; background: #fff; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--accp-border); font-weight: 700; }
.card-body { padding: 1.25rem; }
.card-header:first-child { border-radius: calc(.9rem - 1px) calc(.9rem - 1px) 0 0; }
.table { --bs-table-bg: #fff; --bs-table-color: #20324a; --bs-table-border-color: #e0e7ef; --bs-table-striped-bg: #f7f9fc; margin-bottom: 0; font-size: .9rem; }
.table > :not(caption) > * > * { padding: .9rem 1rem; vertical-align: middle; }
.table thead th { background: #f0f4f8; color: #526279; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; }
.table-responsive { border: 1px solid var(--accp-border); border-radius: .75rem; background: #fff; }
.table-responsive > .table-bordered { border: 0; }
.table caption { color: var(--accp-muted); padding: .75rem 1rem; }
.form-label { margin-bottom: .4rem; font-size: .9rem; font-weight: 600; }
.form-control, .form-select { min-height: 2.8rem; border-color: #cad5e2; border-radius: .6rem; background-color: #fff; color: var(--accp-ink); }
.form-control::placeholder { color: #718096; opacity: 1; }
.form-control:focus, .form-select:focus { border-color: #368c7e; box-shadow: 0 0 0 .2rem #146c601c; }
.form-check-input { border-color: #9aaabd; }
.form-check-input:checked { background-color: #146c60; border-color: #146c60; }
.form-check-input:focus { border-color: #368c7e; box-shadow: 0 0 0 .2rem #146c601c; }
.form-text { color: var(--accp-muted); line-height: 1.7; }
input[type="email"], input[type="password"], input[type="url"], input[type="tel"] { direction: ltr; text-align: left; }
code, pre, .font-monospace { direction: ltr; unicode-bidi: isolate; }
pre { text-align: left; white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.alert { border-radius: .75rem; padding: 1rem 1.2rem; line-height: 1.8; }
.badge { font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; }
:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #247f73; outline-offset: 3px; }
.btn:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; }
.valid.modified:not([type="checkbox"]) { border-color: #268463; }
.invalid { outline: 2px solid #b42338; outline-offset: 1px; }
.validation-message { color: #b42338; font-size: .85rem; margin-top: .35rem; }
.blazor-error-boundary { padding: 1rem 1.25rem; color: #fff; background: #a72c3b; border-radius: .65rem; }
.blazor-error-boundary::after { content: "تعذر عرض هذا الجزء من الصفحة. حاول إعادة التحميل."; }
.darker-border-checkbox.form-check-input { border-color: #7e8fa4; }
.form-floating > .form-control-plaintext::placeholder, .form-floating > .form-control::placeholder { color: var(--bs-secondary-color); text-align: end; }
.form-floating > .form-control-plaintext:focus::placeholder, .form-floating > .form-control:focus::placeholder { text-align: start; }
@media (max-width: 575.98px) {
    .card-body { padding: 1rem; }
    .table > :not(caption) > * > * { padding: .75rem; }
    .btn { white-space: normal; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    *, *::before, *::after { scroll-behavior: auto !important; transition-duration: .01ms !important; animation-duration: .01ms !important; animation-iteration-count: 1 !important; }
}
````

<a id="source-195"></a>
### S195 — `Repair-Admin.ps1`


الوظيفة: مساعد محلي لإعداد/إصلاح حساب المدير عبر إعدادات البيئة وتشغيل الحل؛ ليس من مسار المستخدم العادي. لا تنفذه تلقائيا.

[العودة إلى شرح الملف](#file-195)


````powershell
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Email,
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Password,
    [string]$ProjectRoot = $PSScriptRoot
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$accpRoot = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $ProjectRoot).Path
$accpWebPath = Join-Path $accpRoot 'ACCP.Web'
$accpInfrastructureProject = Join-Path $accpRoot 'ACCP.Infrastructure\ACCP.Infrastructure.csproj'
if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $accpInfrastructureProject) -or
    !(Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $accpWebPath 'appsettings.json'))) {
    throw 'Save this script in the ACCP solution folder, or pass -ProjectRoot.'
}
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Email) -or [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Password)) {
    throw 'Email and password must not be empty.'
}

$accpWorkDirectory = Join-Path ([System.IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) ('ACCP.AdminRecovery.' + [Guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'))
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $accpWorkDirectory | Out-Null
$accpTempProject = Join-Path $accpWorkDirectory 'AdminRecovery.csproj'
$accpProjectReference = [System.Security.SecurityElement]::Escape($accpInfrastructureProject)

$accpProjectSource = @"
<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">
  <PropertyGroup>
    <OutputType>Exe</OutputType>
    <TargetFramework>net10.0</TargetFramework>
    <ImplicitUsings>enable</ImplicitUsings>
    <Nullable>enable</Nullable>
  </PropertyGroup>
  <ItemGroup>
    <FrameworkReference Include="Microsoft.AspNetCore.App" />
    <ProjectReference Include="$accpProjectReference" />
  </ItemGroup>
</Project>
"@

$accpProgramSource = @'
using System.Data;
using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Data;
using ACCP.Infrastructure.Identity;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.DataProtection;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Data.SqlClient;

public static class RecoveryProgram
{
    public static async Task<int> Main()
    {
        try
        {
            var root = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("ACCP_RECOVERY_ROOT")
                ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Missing project folder.");
            var email = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("ACCP_RECOVERY_EMAIL")
                ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Missing email.");
            var password = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("ACCP_RECOVERY_PASSWORD")
                ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Missing password.");
            var configuration = new ConfigurationBuilder()
                .SetBasePath(Path.Combine(root, "ACCP.Web"))
                .AddJsonFile("appsettings.json", optional: false)
                .AddJsonFile("appsettings.Development.json", optional: true)
                .AddEnvironmentVariables()
                .Build();
            var connection = configuration.GetConnectionString("DefaultConnection")
                ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Missing DefaultConnection.");

            var services = new ServiceCollection();
            services.AddLogging(options => options.SetMinimumLevel(LogLevel.Warning));
            services.AddDataProtection();
            services.AddDbContext<AccpDbContext>(options => options.UseSqlServer(connection));
            services.AddIdentityCore<ApplicationUser>(RecoveryCore.ConfigureIdentity)
                .AddRoles<IdentityRole<Guid>>()
                .AddEntityFrameworkStores<AccpDbContext>()
                .AddDefaultTokenProviders();
            await using var provider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
            await using var scope = provider.CreateAsyncScope();
            var sp = scope.ServiceProvider;
            var db = sp.GetRequiredService<AccpDbContext>();
            var user = await RecoveryCore.RepairAsync(db,
                sp.GetRequiredService<UserManager<ApplicationUser>>(),
                sp.GetRequiredService<RoleManager<IdentityRole<Guid>>>(), email, password);

            Console.WriteLine("ADMIN_READY: " + user.Email);
            Console.WriteLine("Password verified. Account active; ADMIN role verified; lockout cleared.");
            Console.WriteLine("Database: " + db.Database.GetDbConnection().Database);
            Console.WriteLine("TwoFactorEnabled: " + user.TwoFactorEnabled);
            return 0;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            // Only safe operation codes are printed, never connection strings or credentials.
            var detail = ex is RecoveryException safe ? safe.Message
                : ex is SqlException sql ? "SQL_ERROR_" + sql.Number
                : ex.GetType().Name;
            Console.Error.WriteLine("RECOVERY_FAILED: " + detail);
            return 1;
        }
    }
}

public static class RecoveryCore
{
    // Scoped to this one-shot recovery process. The Web project's password
    // validators and normal registration policies remain unchanged.
    public static void ConfigureIdentity(IdentityOptions options)
    {
        options.User.RequireUniqueEmail = true;
        options.Password.RequiredLength = 8;
        options.Password.RequireUppercase = true;
        options.Password.RequireDigit = true;
        options.Password.RequireNonAlphanumeric = true;
        options.Password.RequireLowercase = false;
    }

    public static async Task<ApplicationUser> RepairAsync(AccpDbContext db,
        UserManager<ApplicationUser> users, RoleManager<IdentityRole<Guid>> roles,
        string email, string password)
    {
        email = email.Trim();
        if (!new EmailAddressAttribute().IsValid(email))
            throw new RecoveryException("INVALID_EMAIL_FORMAT");
        await using var transaction = await db.Database.BeginTransactionAsync(IsolationLevel.Serializable);
        if (!await roles.RoleExistsAsync(IdentityRoles.Admin))
            Ensure(await roles.CreateAsync(new IdentityRole<Guid> { Id = Guid.NewGuid(), Name = IdentityRoles.Admin }));

        var user = await users.FindByEmailAsync(email);
        if (user is null)
        {
            user = new ApplicationUser
            {
                Id = Guid.NewGuid(), UserName = email, Email = email,
                FullName = "System administrator", IsActive = true,
                EmailConfirmed = false, CreatedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow
            };
            Ensure(await users.CreateAsync(user, password));
        }
        else
        {
            user.IsActive = true;
            var token = await users.GeneratePasswordResetTokenAsync(user);
            Ensure(await users.ResetPasswordAsync(user, token, password));
        }
        if (!await users.IsInRoleAsync(user, IdentityRoles.Admin))
            Ensure(await users.AddToRoleAsync(user, IdentityRoles.Admin));
        Ensure(await users.SetLockoutEndDateAsync(user, null));
        Ensure(await users.ResetAccessFailedCountAsync(user));
        Ensure(await users.UpdateSecurityStampAsync(user));
        if (!user.IsActive || !await users.CheckPasswordAsync(user, password) ||
            !await users.IsInRoleAsync(user, IdentityRoles.Admin) || await users.IsLockedOutAsync(user))
            throw new RecoveryException("VERIFICATION_FAILED");

        // Existing authenticator keys, MFA flags and recovery codes are preserved.
        await transaction.CommitAsync();
        return user;
    }

    private static void Ensure(IdentityResult result)
    {
        if (!result.Succeeded)
            throw new RecoveryException("IDENTITY_ERROR: " + string.Join(",", result.Errors.Select(error => error.Code)));
    }
}
public sealed class RecoveryException : Exception
{
    public RecoveryException(string message) : base(message) { }
}
'@

$accpSucceeded = $false
try {
    Set-Content -LiteralPath $accpTempProject -Value $accpProjectSource -Encoding UTF8
    Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $accpWorkDirectory 'Program.cs') -Value $accpProgramSource -Encoding UTF8
    $env:ACCP_RECOVERY_ROOT = $accpRoot
    $env:ACCP_RECOVERY_EMAIL = $Email.Trim()
    $env:ACCP_RECOVERY_PASSWORD = $Password
    & dotnet run --project $accpTempProject --verbosity quiet
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw 'Recovery did not complete. Send the RECOVERY_FAILED line or build error.'
    }
    $accpSucceeded = $true
}
finally {
    foreach ($accpVariable in @('ACCP_RECOVERY_ROOT', 'ACCP_RECOVERY_EMAIL', 'ACCP_RECOVERY_PASSWORD',
        'ACCP_ADMIN_EMAIL', 'ACCP_ADMIN_PASSWORD', 'ACCP_OFFICER_RESET_EMAIL', 'ACCP_OFFICER_RESET_PASSWORD')) {
        Remove-Item -LiteralPath "Env:\$accpVariable" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    }
    $Password = $null
    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $accpWorkDirectory -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}

if ($accpSucceeded) {
    Write-Host "Ready. Sign in with: $Email"
    & dotnet run --project $accpWebPath
}
````



## 21. معجم مختصر للمفاهيم


| المصطلح | المعنى في هذا المشروع |
| --- | --- |
| Actor | هوية خادم تم التحقق منها حديثا؛ ليست UserId من form. |
| Authorization boundary | طبقة Web التي تمنع استدعاء خدمات التخزين بمدخلات هوية غير موثوقة. |
| Scope | نطاق DI قصير العمر لكل عملية لمنع مشاركة DbContext بين عمليات Blazor المتزامنة. |
| Core service | تنفيذ Infrastructure لقواعد العمل والتخزين؛ لا يستبدل حارس Web. |
| Snapshot | بيانات متوقعة للإسناد/الحالة للتحقق من أن العملية لا تعمل على عرض قديم. |
| RowVersion | رمز تزامن من قاعدة SQL Server لبعض الكيانات، ولا يمثل إثبات جلسة. |
| ConcurrencyStamp | رمز تعديل مستخدم Identity؛ يختلف عن SecurityStamp وعن كلمة المرور. |
| SecurityStamp | ختم جلسة Identity المستخدم لإبطال صلاحية جلسة قديمة بعد تغييرات الحساب. |
| OperationId | مفتاح تكرار لرسالة استقبال؛ ليس رمز وصول للمحادثة. |
| Serializable | عزل معاملات يساعد على منع تعارضات محددة؛ لا يثبت غياب deadlocks أو يغني عن اختبارات SQL Server. |
| Restricted evidence | دليل لا يعرض للموظف حتى تتوافر موافقة العرض وعلاقة القضية معا. |
| Formal report | قضية رسمية في مسار FormalReport؛ تختلف عن مجرد حفظ محادثة. |
| MFA | إثبات عامل ثان يرتبط بحساب الموظف/المدير الحالي وجلسة صحيحة. |
| Static review | قراءة وفهرسة الكود؛ لا تعني نجاح build أو اختبار واجهة. |
| Generated output | ملف مولد يعاد إنتاجه من المصدر/SDK/NuGet، وليس مكان التعديل اليدوي. |


## 22. إغلاق ملف التسليم

انتهت مهمة هذا الدور بإنشاء وثيقة الاستكمال فقط. لم يجر تعديل ملفات التطبيق الأصلي أو حذفها أو تشغيل قاعدة بيانات المستخدم. الخطوة التالية تبدأ من خطة القسم 16، بعد مطابقة هذه البصمة مع أحدث نسخة لدى المستخدم. تحديث هذا الملف لاحقا يجب أن يسجل مصدر النسخة وتاريخها والاختبارات الفعلية وملفات التغيير، لا أن يحول المقترحات إلى إنجازات غير منفذة.
